primary_objective.statement: Two noncongruent smooth embedded tight tori with exactly the same metric, agreeing on a nonempty open set, with no open planar patch.
primary_objective.scope: First assertion of thm:main-fiber only; the Cantor-family clause is deferred.

declarations.name: OAI.BorsukNine.Admissible.casesOn
declarations.type:
{V : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] →
      {ι : Type u_2} →
        [inst_2 : Fintype ι] →
          {f : V → ι → ℝ} →
            {motive : OAI.BorsukNine.Admissible f → Sort u} →
              (t : OAI.BorsukNine.Admissible f) →
                ((smooth : ∀ (i : ι), ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ fun u => f u i) →
                    (antipodal : ∀ (u : V) (i : ι), f (-u) i = f u i) →
                      (nonneg : ∀ (u : V), ‖u‖ = 1 → ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f u i) →
                        (sum_one : ∀ (u : V), ‖u‖ = 1 → ∑ i, f u i = 1) →
                          (orthogonal :
                              ∀ (u v : V), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖v‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u v = 0 → ∀ (i : ι), ¬(0 < f u i ∧ 0 < f v i)) →
                            motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

    ∀ {u v : V},
      ‖u‖ = 1 →
        ‖v‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u v = 0 → Disjoint (OAI.BorsukNine.positiveSupport f u) (OAI.BorsukNine.positiveSupport f v)

        OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.cone K (e a) ∘ₗ OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.mapChains K K ⇑e

declarations.type: ℕ → PreAbstractSimplicialComplex OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.SignedVertex

    OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.normMap (OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.cross m)
            OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.flip ∘ₗ
          T =

          OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.normMap (OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.cross n)
            OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.flip →
      OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.augmentation (OAI.BorsukNine.SimplicialChains.cross m) ∘ₗ T =

declarations.type:

  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.IsFilledCoordinateFamily D Ω v F →
    (∀ (i : I), IsOpen (D i)) →

        IsCompact Q →
          Q ⊆ Ω →
            IsCompact K →
              IsOpen U →
                K ⊆ U →
                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                      (fun z =>
                        2 *
                          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.coordinateWedges
                            (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.natCoordinateFamily v) n z)
                      (Q \ K) MeasureTheory.volume →
                    ∀ {ε : ℝ},
                      ∫ (z : ℝ × ℝ) in Q \ K,
                            2 *
                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.coordinateWedges
                                (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.natCoordinateFamily v) n z <
                          ε →
                        ∃ τ N g,
                          0 < τ ∧
                            IsOpen N ∧
                              K ⊆ N ∧
                                N ⊆ U ∧
                                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) g ∧
                                    (∀ (z : ℝ × ℝ), Matrix.PosDef (g z)) ∧
                                      (∀ᶠ (z : ℝ × ℝ) in nhdsSet K, g z = 1) ∧
                                        (∀ z ∈ Q \ N,
                                            g z =
                                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.coordinateGram
                                                  (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.natCoordinateFamily F) n z +
                                                τ • 1) ∧
                                          ∫ (z : ℝ × ℝ) in Q \ K,
                                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.matrixEnergy
                                                (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.coordinateGram
                                                  (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.natCoordinateFamily F) n z)
                                                (g z) <
                                            ε

    0 < δ →

                          c)| ∂MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) /

              |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge u v| +

                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)

declarations.type:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) {Ω Q K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)},
  IsOpen Ω →
    IsCompact Q →
      Q ⊆ Ω →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (f i) Ω) →
          IsClosed K →
            ∀ {ε : ℝ},
              ∫ (z : ℝ × ℝ) in Q \ K, 2 * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.coordinateWedges f n z < ε →
                ∃ R g,
                  0 < R ∧
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) g ∧
                      (∀ (z : ℝ × ℝ), Matrix.PosDef (g z)) ∧
                        (∀ᶠ (z : ℝ × ℝ) in nhdsSet K,
                            g z = OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.sphericalMetricFactor z • 1) ∧
                          (∀ z ∉ Metric.closedBall 0 R,
                              g z = OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.sphericalMetricFactor z • 1) ∧
                            ∫ (z : ℝ × ℝ) in Q \ K,
                                OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.matrixEnergy
                                  (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.coordinateGram f n z) (g z) <
                              ε

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.exists_terminal_balls_with_band_control
declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} [inst : MetricSpace X] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (p : I → X),
  Function.Injective p →
    ∀ (O : I → Set X),
      (∀ (i : I), O i ∈ nhds (p i)) →
        ∀ (ρ : I → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : I), 0 < ρ i) →
            ∀ (G : I → Set X) (f : I → J → X → ℝ) (M : I → J → ℝ),
              (∀ (i : I) (j : J), ∀ y ∈ G i, |f i j y| ≤ M i j) →
                ∀ (active : I → J → Prop) {h : ℝ},
                  0 < h →
                    ∃ r,
                      (∀ (i : I), 0 < r i ∧ r i < ρ i) ∧
                        (∀ (i : I), Metric.closedBall (p i) (r i) ⊆ O i) ∧
                          Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun i => Metric.closedBall (p i) (r i)) ∧
                            ∀ (i : I) (j : J),
                              active i j →
                                ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (p i) (r i) ∩ G i,
                                  Filter.liminf (f i j) (nhdsWithin (p i) (G i)) - h < f i j y ∧
                                    f i j y < Filter.limsup (f i j) (nhdsWithin (p i) (G i)) + h

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.exists_terminal_balls_with_uniform_staircase_oscillation
declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} [inst : MetricSpace X] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (p : I → X),
  Function.Injective p →
    ∀ (O : I → Set X),
      (∀ (i : I), O i ∈ nhds (p i)) →
        ∀ (ρ : I → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : I), 0 < ρ i) →
            ∀ (G : I → Set X) (f : I → J → X → ℝ) (M : I → J → ℝ),
              (∀ (i : I) (j : J), ∀ y ∈ G i, |f i j y| ≤ M i j) →
                ∀ (active : I → J → Prop) (a : I → J → ℝ),
                  (∀ (i : I) (j : J),
                      active i j →
                        Filter.limsup (f i j) (nhdsWithin (p i) (G i)) -
                            Filter.liminf (f i j) (nhdsWithin (p i) (G i)) ≤
                          a i j) →
                    ∀ {h : ℝ},
                      0 < h →
                        ∃ r,
                          (∀ (i : I), 0 < r i ∧ r i < ρ i) ∧
                            (∀ (i : I), Metric.closedBall (p i) (r i) ⊆ O i) ∧
                              Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun i => Metric.closedBall (p i) (r i)) ∧
                                ∀ (i : I) (j : J),
                                  active i j →
                                    ∀ (δ θ : ℝ),
                                      ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (p i) (r i) ∩ G i,
                                        ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (p i) (r i) ∩ G i,
                                          |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.shiftedStaircase h δ θ (f i j x) -
                                                OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.shiftedStaircase h δ θ
                                                  (f i j y)| ≤
                                            a i j + 4 * h

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.exists_uniform_lattice_distance
declarations.type:
∀ {h θ : ℝ},

      IsCompact E →
        Disjoint E (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.shiftedLattice h θ) →
          ∃ ρ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (k : ℤ), ρ ≤ |x - (θ + h * ↑k)|

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.expected_grid_pair_wedge_le
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (u v c : ℝ × ℝ) (x y : ℝ) {h δ χ : ℝ},
      0 < h →
        0 < δ →
          δ < h / 4 →
            0 ≤ χ →
              χ ≤ 1 →
                (∫ (θ : Fin n → ℝ),
                    |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge
                        (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.staircaseCovector h δ χ (θ i) x u c)
                        (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.staircaseCovector h δ χ (θ j) y v
                          c)| ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.shiftLaw h) ≤
                  |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge u v| +
                    h *
                      (|OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge u c| +
                        |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge c v|)

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.expected_integrated_grid_pair_wedge_le
declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ] {n : ℕ}
  {i j : Fin n},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (u v c : X → ℝ × ℝ) (x y χ : X → ℝ) {h δ : ℝ},
      0 < h →
        0 < δ →
          δ < h / 4 →
            (∀ (z : X), 0 ≤ χ z) →
              (∀ (z : X), χ z ≤ 1) →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                    (fun p =>
                      |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge
                          (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.staircaseCovector h δ (χ p.2) p.1.1 (x p.2) (u p.2)
                            (c p.2))
                          (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.staircaseCovector h δ (χ p.2) p.1.2 (y p.2) (v p.2)
                            (c p.2))|)
                    (((OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.shiftLaw h).prod
                          (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.shiftLaw h)).prod
                      μ) →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun z =>
                        |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge (u z) (v z)| +
                          h *
                            (|OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge (u z) (c z)| +
                              |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge (c z) (v z)|))
                      μ →
                    (∫ (θ : Fin n → ℝ),
                        ∫ (z : X),
                          |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge
                              (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.staircaseCovector h δ (χ z) (θ i) (x z) (u z)
                                (c z))
                              (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.staircaseCovector h δ (χ z) (θ j) (y z) (v z)
                                (c
                                  z))| ∂μ ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x =>
                          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.shiftLaw h) ≤
                      ∫ (z : X),
                        |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge (u z) (v z)| +
                          h *
                            (|OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge (u z) (c z)| +
                              |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge (c z) (v z)|) ∂μ

declarations.type:

    ContinuousAt v x →
      ((fun y => ↑(u y)) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => ↑(v y)) →
        ∀ (χ : E → ℝ) {P : ℝ → ℝ},
          (∀ (r : ℝ), P (r + 1) = P r + 1) →
            fderiv ℝ (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.cutoffStaircase u χ P) x =
              fderiv ℝ (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.cutoffStaircase v χ P) x

    Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint D) →
      ∀ (u g : I → E → ℝ) {v : E → ℝ} {i : I} {x : E},
        x ∈ D i →
          ContinuousAt v x →
            ContinuousAt (u i) x →
              ((fun y => ↑(v y)) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => ↑(u i y)) →
                fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y + OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.fillingCorrection D u g y) x =

  0 < τ →
    ∀ (x y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ),

          √(OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.gramTensor x y n + τ • 1).det =

                          h ^ 2 * |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge u v| +

                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                  (fun z =>
                    |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge
                        (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.staircaseCovector h δ (χ z)
                          (θ (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.upperPair p).1)

                                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.fieldEnergy

                            (fun y => w y + OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.fillingCorrection D u' g' y) x) =
                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.planarWedge

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.LengthArea.affine_of_length_area_estimates
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {D W : Set ℂ} {r s : ι → ℝ} {A : ℝ},
  IsOpen D →
    IsPreconnected D →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f D →
        IsOpen W →
          W.Nonempty →
            Bornology.IsBounded W →
              W ⊆ D →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖deriv f z‖) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W) →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖deriv f z‖ ^ 2) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W) →
                    (Summable fun j => r j ^ 2) →
                      (Summable fun j => s j ^ 2) →
                        (∫ (x : ℂ) in W, 1) + Real.pi * ∑' (j : ι), r j ^ 2 ≤ A →
                          (∫ (z : ℂ) in W, ‖deriv f z‖ ^ 2) + Real.pi * ∑' (j : ι), s j ^ 2 ≤ A →
                            2 * A ≤ (2 * ∫ (z : ℂ) in W, ‖deriv f z‖) + 2 * Real.pi * ∑' (j : ι), r j * s j →
                              (∃ a b, ‖a‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ z ∈ D, f z = a * z + b) ∧ ∀ (j : ι), r j = s j

            ∫ (x : X), u x ^ 2 ∂μ + Real.pi * ∑' (j : ι), s j ^ 2 ≤ A →
              2 * A ≤ 2 * ∫ (x : X), u x ∂μ + 2 * Real.pi * ∑' (j : ι), r j * s j →

declarations.type:

  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral φ u γ =
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
      (φ * fun z => (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.circleFDeriv u z) 1)
      (φ * fun z => (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.circleFDeriv u z) Complex.I) γ

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral_constant_weight
declarations.type:
∀ {O : Set ℂ},
  IsOpen O →
    ∀ {u : ℂ → UnitAddCircle},
      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.SmoothCircleOn u O →
        ∀ (φ : ℂ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ),
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
            (∀ (t : ℝ), γ t ∈ O) →
              ∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ),
                Continuous v →
                  (∀ (t : ℝ), ↑(v t) = u (γ t)) →
                    ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, φ (γ t) = ρ) →
                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral φ u γ = ρ * (v 1 - v 0)

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral_eq_covector
declarations.type:
∀ (φ : ℂ → ℝ) (u : ℂ → UnitAddCircle) (γ : ℝ → ℂ),
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral φ u γ =
    ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, φ (γ t) * (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.circleFDeriv u (γ t)) (deriv γ t)

declarations.type:
∀ {O : Set ℂ},
  IsOpen O →
    ∀ {u : ℂ → UnitAddCircle},
      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.SmoothCircleOn u O →
        ∀ (φ : ℂ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ),
          Differentiable ℝ γ →
            (∀ (t : ℝ), γ t ∈ O) →
              ∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ),
                Continuous v →
                  (∀ (t : ℝ), ↑(v t) = u (γ t)) →
                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral φ u γ = ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, φ (γ t) * deriv v t

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral_unitCircle_zero_period
declarations.type:
∀ {O : Set ℂ},
  IsOpen O →
    ∀ {u : ℂ → UnitAddCircle},
      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.SmoothCircleOn u O →
        ∀ (φ : ℂ → ℝ),
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) φ O →
            LipschitzWith 1 φ →
              ∀ (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ},
                0 ≤ r →
                  (∀ (t : ℝ), OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam c r t ∈ O) →
                    ∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ),
                      Continuous v →
                        (∀ (t : ℝ), ↑(v t) = u (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam c r t)) →
                          v 1 = v 0 →
                            ∀ (A : ℝ),
                              (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, |v t - v 0| ≤ A) →
                                |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral φ u
                                      (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam c r)| ≤
                                  2 * Real.pi * r * A

      (∀ (i : Fin n), Metric.closedBall (c i) (r i) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H) →
        ∀ (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ),
          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam (c i) (r i) t ∈
            closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H) \ ⋃ j, Metric.ball (c j) (r j)

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circle_zero_period_integral_bound
declarations.type:
∀ (φ : ℂ → ℝ),
  LipschitzWith 1 φ →
    ∀ (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ},
      0 ≤ r →
        ∀ (dφ u du : ℝ → ℝ),
          (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi), HasDerivAt (φ ∘ circleMap c r) (dφ x) x) →
            (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi), HasDerivAt u (du x) x) →
              IntervalIntegrable dφ MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
                IntervalIntegrable du MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
                  u (2 * Real.pi) = u 0 →
                    ∀ (A : ℝ),
                      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi), |u x - u 0| ≤ A) →
                        |∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * Real.pi, φ (circleMap c r x) * du x| ≤ 2 * Real.pi * r * A

declarations.type:

      ∫ (z : ℂ) in OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H,

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.integral_pulledPlanarForm_curl_rectangle
declarations.type:
∀ {P Q : ℂ → ℝ} {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
        ∀ (a b : ℝ × ℝ),
          a ≤ b →
            ∫ (x : ℝ × ℝ) in Set.Icc a b,
                (((fderiv ℝ F x) (1, 0)).re * ((fderiv ℝ F x) (0, 1)).im -
                    ((fderiv ℝ F x) (1, 0)).im * ((fderiv ℝ F x) (0, 1)).re) *
                  ((fderiv ℝ Q (F x)) 1 - (fderiv ℝ P (F x)) Complex.I) =
              (((∫ (s : ℝ) in a.1..b.1, OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.pulledPlanarForm P Q F (1, 0) (s, a.2)) +
                    ∫ (t : ℝ) in a.2..b.2, OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.pulledPlanarForm P Q F (0, 1) (b.1, t)) -
                  ∫ (s : ℝ) in a.1..b.1, OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.pulledPlanarForm P Q F (1, 0) (s, b.2)) -
                ∫ (t : ℝ) in a.2..b.2, OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.pulledPlanarForm P Q F (0, 1) (a.1, t)

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.integrated_line_payment_of_absolutelyContinuous
declarations.type:
∀ {v : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {L a b : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    a ≤ b →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun p => deriv (v p.1) p.2 ^ 2)
          ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)).prod (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (-L) L))) →
        (∀ᵐ (y : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b),
            AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (v y) (-L) L ∧ v y (-L) = 0 ∧ ∃ c ∈ Set.Icc (-L) L, v y c = 1) →
          (b - a) / (2 * L) ≤
            ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
              deriv (v p.1) p.2 ^
                2 ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)).prod (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (-L) L))

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.integrated_parallel_line_payment
declarations.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (c : I → ℂ) (r A : I → ℝ) {ρ : ℂ → ℝ} {J : Set ℝ} {L : ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.volume J ≠ ⊤ →
    (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ r i) →
      (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ A i) →
        0 ≤ L →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp ρ 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ (z : ℂ), 0 ≤ ρ z) →
              Function.support ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 L →
                (∀ᵐ (y : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict J,
                    1 ≤
                      (∫ (x : ℝ), ρ { re := x, im := y }) +
                        ∑ i, (Set.Icc ((c i).im - r i) ((c i).im + r i)).indicator (fun x => A i) y) →
                  (MeasureTheory.volume J).toReal ≤ √Real.pi * L * √(∫ (z : ℂ), ρ z ^ 2) + ∑ i, 2 * r i * A i

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.integrated_parallel_line_payment_square_norm
declarations.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (c : I → ℂ) (r A : I → ℝ) {ρ : ℂ → ℝ} {J : Set ℝ} {L : ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.volume J ≠ ⊤ →
    (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ r i) →
      (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ A i) →
        0 ≤ L →
          Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun i => Metric.closedBall (c i) (r i)) →
            (∀ (i : I), Metric.closedBall (c i) (r i) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 L) →
              MeasureTheory.MemLp ρ 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                (∀ (z : ℂ), 0 ≤ ρ z) →
                  Function.support ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 L →
                    (∀ᵐ (y : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict J,
                        1 ≤
                          (∫ (x : ℝ), ρ { re := x, im := y }) +
                            ∑ i, (Set.Icc ((c i).im - r i) ((c i).im + r i)).indicator (fun x => A i) y) →
                      (MeasureTheory.volume J).toReal ≤ √Real.pi * L * √(∫ (z : ℂ), ρ z ^ 2) + 2 * L * √(∑ i, A i ^ 2)

                    0 < OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarMapJacobian (fderiv ℝ (↑e) p)) →
                  ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-r) 0 ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H →
                    ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 r ⊆
                        (closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H))ᶜ →
                      ∀ {P Q : ℂ → ℝ},

        (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), ↑e p = OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ p) →
          (∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (t - r, -r) (t + r, r),
              ↑e p ∈ frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H) ↔ p.2 = 0) →
            ∀ {s : ℝ},
              s ∈ Set.Icc (t - 1 / 2) (t + 1 / 2) →
                γ s ∈ ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-r) r → s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r)

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.normal_box_sides_fixed
declarations.type:
∀ {H : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × ℝ) ℂ) (t r : ℝ),
  0 < r →
    (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), ↑e p = OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ p) →
      Set.Icc (t - r, -r) (t + r, r) ⊆ e.source →
        (∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (t - r, -r) (t + r, r), ↑e p ∈ frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H) ↔ p.2 = 0) →
          ∀ (positive : Bool),
            (∃ δ > 0,
                ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 δ,
                  if positive = true then
                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (t, ρ) ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H ∧
                      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (t, -ρ) ∈
                        (closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H))ᶜ
                  else
                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (t, -ρ) ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H ∧
                      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (t, ρ) ∈
                        (closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H))ᶜ) →
              if positive = true then
                ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 r ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H ∧
                  ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-r) 0 ⊆
                    (closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H))ᶜ
              else
                ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-r) 0 ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H ∧
                  ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 r ⊆ (closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H))ᶜ

    ↑e '' Set.Ioo (t - r) (t + r) ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 r ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H →

declarations.type:

declarations.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.normal_strip_lower_green
declarations.type:
∀ {P Q : ℂ → ℝ} {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
        ∀ (a b R : ℝ),
          a ≤ b →
            0 ≤ R →
              (∀ y ∈ Set.uIcc (-R) 0,
                  P (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (a, y)) = 0 ∧
                    Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (a, y)) = 0) →
                (∀ y ∈ Set.uIcc (-R) 0,
                    P (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (b, y)) = 0 ∧
                      Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (b, y)) = 0) →
                  (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b,
                      P (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (x, -R)) = 0 ∧
                        Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (x, -R)) = 0) →
                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in Set.Icc (a, -R) (b, 0),
                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarMapJacobian
                            (fderiv ℝ (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ) p) *
                          ((fderiv ℝ Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ p)) 1 -
                            (fderiv ℝ P (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ p)) Complex.I) =
                      -∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, P (γ t) * (deriv γ t).re + Q (γ t) * (deriv γ t).im

                    Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (a, y)) = 0) →
                (∀ y ∈ Set.uIcc 0 R,
                    P (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (b, y)) = 0 ∧
                      Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (b, y)) = 0) →
                  (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b,
                      P (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (x, R)) = 0 ∧
                        Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ (x, R)) = 0) →
                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in Set.Icc (a, 0) (b, R),
                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarMapJacobian
                            (fderiv ℝ (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ) p) *
                          ((fderiv ℝ Q (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ p)) 1 -
                            (fderiv ℝ P (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.curveNormalStrip γ p)) Complex.I) =
                      ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, P (γ t) * (deriv γ t).re + Q (γ t) * (deriv γ t).im

declarations.name: OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm_add
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.Plane M]
  [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {F U : M → V} {p : M},
  MDiffAt F p →
    MDiffAt U p →
      ∀ (v w : TangentSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel p),
        OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (F + U) p v w - OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm F p v w =
          OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.linearMetricForm F U p v w + OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm U p v w

declarations.name: OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm_finite_sum
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.Plane M]
  [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {ι : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Fintype ι]
  [inst_5 : DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → M → V) {p : M},
  (∀ (i : ι), MDiffAt (f i) p) →
    ∀ (v w : TangentSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel p),
      OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (∑ i, f i) p v w =
        ∑ i, OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (f i) p v w +
          ∑ i,
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
              inner ℝ ((OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.surfaceDifferential (f i) p) v)
                ((OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.surfaceDifferential (f j) p) w)

declarations.name: OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm_free_forced
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.Plane M]
  [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] {F U V' : M → V} {p : M},
  MDiffAt F p →
    MDiffAt U p →
      MDiffAt V' p →
        ∀ (v w : TangentSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel p) (T : ℝ),
          OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (F + (U + V')) p v w - OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm F p v w - T =
            OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.linearMetricForm F U p v w + OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.linearMetricForm F V' p v w +
                  (OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm U p v w - T) +
                OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.linearMetricForm U V' p v w +
              OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm V' p v w

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.CompatibilityCalculus.coordPartial_quadratic
declarations.type:
∀ {A B C X Y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ A p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ B p →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ C p →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ X p →
          DifferentiableAt ℝ Y p →
            ∀ (k : Fin 2),
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => A q * X q ^ 2 - 2 * B q * X q * Y q + C q * Y q ^ 2) p =
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k A p * X p ^ 2 +
                        2 * A p * X p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k X p -
                      (2 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k B p * X p * Y p +
                          2 * B p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k X p * Y p +
                        2 * B p * X p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k Y p) +
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k C p * Y p ^ 2 +
                  2 * C p * Y p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k Y p

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField) (k i j : Fin 2) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g k i j p =
    1 / 2 *
      ∑ l,
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inverseMetric g p k l *
          (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => g q j l) p +
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j (fun q => g q i l) p -
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial l (fun q => g q i j) p)

  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffelFirstKind g i j p l =
    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => g q j l) p +
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j (fun q => g q i l) p -

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial_covHessian
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) z U →
        p ∈ U →
          ∀ (i j k : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z q j k) p =
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k z)) p -
                ∑ a,
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g a j k) p *
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a z p +
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g a j k p *
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a z) p)

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial_heightEnergy
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) z U →
        p ∈ U →
          ∀ (k : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z) p =
              2 * (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g 0 k 0 p + OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g 1 k 1 p) *
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z p -
                2 *
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p k 0 *
                      (g p 1 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p -
                        g p 0 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p) +
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p k 1 *
                      (g p 0 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p -
                        g p 0 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p))

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial_heightEnergy_polynomial
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) z U →
        p ∈ U →
          ∀ (k : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z) p =
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => (g q).det) p -
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q 1 1) p *
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p ^ 2 +
                        2 * g p 1 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p *
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z) p -
                      (2 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q 0 1) p *
                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p *
                            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p +
                          2 * g p 0 1 *
                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z) p *
                            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p +
                        2 * g p 0 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p *
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z) p) +
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q 0 0) p *
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p ^ 2 +
                  2 * g p 0 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p *
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z) p)

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial_normalResidual
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F U →
      IsOpen U →
        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          p ∈ U →
            ∀ (d a b : Fin 2),
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (fun q => OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.normalResidual g F q a b) p =
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d
                    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial b F)) p -
                  ∑ r,
                    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g r a b) p •
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial r F p +
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g r a b p •
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial r F) p)

  DifferentiableAt ℝ c p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ A p →
      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => c q • A q) p =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i c p • A p + c p • OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i A p

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField) (z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
  (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i j : Fin 2),
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p i j =
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j z) p -
      ∑ k, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g k i j p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k z p

declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →

                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covDerivHessian g z j i k p =
              -∑ a, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.riemann g a k i j p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a z p

  g =ᶠ[nhds p] h →

      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z p = OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy h z p

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy_polynomial
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} (z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      p ∈ U →
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z p =
          (g p).det -
            (g p 1 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p ^ 2 -
                (g p 0 1 + g p 1 0) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p *
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p +
              g p 0 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p ^ 2)

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy_polynomial_symm
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} (z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ),
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    p ∈ U →
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z p =
        (g p).det -
          (g p 1 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p ^ 2 -
              2 * g p 0 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p +
            g p 0 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p ^ 2)

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy_y_quotient
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) z U →
        p ∈ U →
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p 1 1 ≠ 0 →
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z) p =
              2 * (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g 0 0 1 p + OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g 1 1 1 p) *
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.heightEnergy g z p -
                2 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p 1 1 *
                  ((g p 0 0 -
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p 0 1 / OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p 1 1 *
                          g p 0 1) *
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 z p -
                    (g p 0 1 -
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p 0 1 / OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.covHessian g z p 1 1 *
                          g p 1 1) *
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 z p)

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.metricDet_coordPartial
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    IsOpen U →
      p ∈ U →
        ∀ (k : Fin 2),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => (g q).det) p =
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q 0 0) p * g p 1 1 +
                g p 0 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q 1 1) p -
              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q 0 1) p * g p 1 0 +
                g p 0 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q 1 0) p)

            2 * (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g 0 k 0 p + OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g 1 k 1 p) *

declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsometricOn g F U →
    IsOpen U →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ U →
          ∀ (i j k : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => g q i j) p =
              inner ℝ (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i F) p)
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j F p) +
                inner ℝ (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i F p)
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j F) p)

declarations.name: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.metric_second_compatibility
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    IsOpen U →
      p ∈ U →
        ∀ (d k i j : Fin 2),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k fun q => g q i j) p =
            ∑ r,
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g r k i) p * g p r j +
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g r k i p *
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (fun q => g q r j) p) +
              ∑ r,
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g r k j) p * g p i r +
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel g r k j p *
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial d (fun q => g q i r) p)

declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {M : Type u_2}
  [inst_3 : MetricSpace M] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace E M] [inst_5 : IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) M]
  [inst_6 : Bundle.RiemannianBundle fun x => TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) x]
  [IsContMDiffRiemannianBundle (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) E fun x => TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) x]
  [IsRiemannianManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) M] (x : M) {U : Set ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ {c : ℝ → E},
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) c U →
        (∀ t ∈ U, c t ∈ (chartAt E x).target) →
          ∀ {a C : ℝ},
            a ∈ U →
              0 ≤ C →
                (∀ s ∈ U, ∀ t ∈ U, dist (↑(chartAt E x).symm (c s)) (↑(chartAt E x).symm (c t)) = C * |s - t|) →
                  ∀ {y₀ : E}
                    (N :
                      OAI.WeakMTWGlobalSupport.NormalNeighborhood.NormalFlow
                        (OAI.WeakMTWGlobalSupport.ChartMetric.metric x) (chartAt E x).target y₀),
                    0 ∈ (N.normalAt (c a)).source →
                      ∃ δ,
                        0 < δ ∧
                          Metric.ball a δ ⊆ U ∧
                            ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball a δ, c t = ↑(N.normalAt (c a)) (((t - a) / N.time) • deriv c a)

                  (∀ i ≤ n + 1, ∀ j ≤ n + 1, i ≠ j → 2 * R ≤ dist (A.vertex i) (A.vertex j)) →

                      (∀ i ≤ n,
                          ∀ j ≤ n,
                            j ≠ i → ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc lam (A.len i - lam), ∀ y ∈ A.edge j, 2 * rho ≤ dist (A.pt i c) y) →
                        (∀ i < n,
                            rho * (1 + |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) ≤
                              lam * |(A.back i).det (A.tang (i + 1))|) →
                          (∀ i < n, Metric.ball (A.vertex (i + 1)) R ⊆ D) →
                            (∀ i ≤ n, ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc lam (A.len i - lam), Metric.ball (A.pt i c) rho ⊆ D) →

declarations.name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.Realization.IsCellDecomposition.exists_face_of_ear
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} {R : S.Realization} {D N : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  R.IsCellDecomposition D →
    Schoenflies.CellsAbsorb R.skeletonSet {A | ∃ F ∈ S.faces, A = R.cell F} →
      IsPreconnected N →
        N.Nonempty →
          N ⊆ D →
            Disjoint N R.skeletonSet →
              ∀ {a b : γ},
                a ∈ S.skel.vertexSet →
                  b ∈ S.skel.vertexSet →
                    R.pos a ∈ closure N →
                      R.pos b ∈ closure N →
                        ∃ F ∈ S.faces, N ⊆ R.cell F ∧ S.sub a F ∧ S.sub b F ∧ ∀ T ∈ S.faces, N ⊆ R.cell T → T = F

        N.Nonempty →
          N ⊆ D → Disjoint N R.skeletonSet → ∃ F ∈ S.faces, N ⊆ R.cell F ∧ ∀ T ∈ S.faces, N ⊆ R.cell T → T = F

          (∀ ⦃z : γ⦄, z ∈ d.ear.vertexSet → z ≠ d.source → z ≠ d.target → closure (R'.cell z) = R'.cell z) →
            (∀ ⦃f a b : γ⦄, d.ear.IsLink f a b → closure (R'.cell f) = R'.cell f ∪ (R'.cell a ∪ R'.cell b)) →
              closure (R'.cell d.face₁) = R'.cell d.face₁ ∪ R'.cellUnion d.earCells ∪ R'.cellUnion d.cells₁ →

                                          (face₂_notMem_ear : face₂ ∉ ear.vertexSet ∪ ear.edgeSet) →

                                                      {source, target}) →

                                                      source := source, target := target, earWalk := earWalk,
                                                      path₁ := path₁, path₂ := path₂, isPathGraph := isPathGraph,
                                                      isPath₁ := isPath₁, isPath₂ := isPath₂,
                                                      ear_disjoint := ear_disjoint,
                                                      source_ne_target := source_ne_target, face_mem := face_mem,
                                                      vertexSet_inter := vertexSet_inter, edge_fresh := edge_fresh,
                                                      vertex_fresh := vertex_fresh, face₁_notMem := face₁_notMem,
                                                      face₂_notMem := face₂_notMem,
                                                      face₁_notMem_ear := face₁_notMem_ear,
                                                      face₂_notMem_ear := face₂_notMem_ear, face_ne := face_ne,

          motive t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.realize._proof_1
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} (R : S.Realization) (d : S.SplitData)
  (earPos : γ → Schoenflies.Plane) (earDraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane),
  d.EarCrosscut R earPos earDraw →
    ∀ ⦃x : γ⦄,
      x ∈ (S.splitFace d).skel.vertexSet →
        ∀ ⦃y : γ⦄, y ∈ (S.splitFace d).skel.vertexSet → d.splitPos R earPos x = d.splitPos R earPos y → x = y

declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} (R : S.Realization) (d : S.SplitData)
  (earPos : γ → Schoenflies.Plane) (earDraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane),
  d.EarCrosscut R earPos earDraw →
    (Graph.map (d.splitPos R earPos) (S.splitFace d).skel).IsDrawing (d.splitDrawing R earDraw)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.realize._proof_3
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} (R : S.Realization) (d : S.SplitData)
  (earPos : γ → Schoenflies.Plane) (earDraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane),
  d.EarCrosscut R earPos earDraw →
    ∀ ⦃v : γ⦄, v ∈ (S.splitFace d).skel.vertexSet → d.splitCell R earPos earDraw v = {d.splitPos R earPos v}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SplitData.realize._proof_4
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} (R : S.Realization) (d : S.SplitData)
  (earPos : γ → Schoenflies.Plane) (earDraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane),
  d.EarCrosscut R earPos earDraw →
    ∀ ⦃e x y : γ⦄,
      (S.splitFace d).skel.IsLink e x y →
        d.splitCell R earPos earDraw e =
          Graph.edgeArc (d.splitDrawing R earDraw) e \ {d.splitPos R earPos x, d.splitPos R earPos y}

  (newEdge₁_notMem : newEdge₁ ∉ S.cells) (newEdge₂_notMem : newEdge₂ ∉ S.cells) (newVertex_ne₁ : newVertex ≠ newEdge₁)
  (newVertex_ne₂ : newVertex ≠ newEdge₂) (newEdge_ne : newEdge₁ ≠ newEdge₂) (newBoundary : γ → List γ)
  (boundary_subst :
    ∀ ⦃F : γ⦄,
      F ∈ S.faces →
        ∃ u,
          S.skel.IsWalk u (S.boundary F) u ∧
            S.SubstWalk edge left right newEdge₁ newEdge₂ u (S.boundary F) (newBoundary F)),
  sizeOf
      { edge := edge, left := left, right := right, newVertex := newVertex, newEdge₁ := newEdge₁, newEdge₂ := newEdge₂,
        isLink := isLink, newVertex_notMem := newVertex_notMem, newEdge₁_notMem := newEdge₁_notMem,
        newEdge₂_notMem := newEdge₂_notMem, newVertex_ne₁ := newVertex_ne₁, newVertex_ne₂ := newVertex_ne₂,
        newEdge_ne := newEdge_ne, newBoundary := newBoundary, boundary_subst := boundary_subst } =
    1 + sizeOf edge + sizeOf left + sizeOf right + sizeOf newVertex + sizeOf newEdge₁ + sizeOf newEdge₂ + sizeOf isLink

declarations.name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.rec
declarations.type:
{γ : Type u_1} →
  {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} →
    {motive : S.SubdivData → Sort u} →
      ((edge left right newVertex newEdge₁ newEdge₂ : γ) →
          (isLink : S.skel.IsLink edge left right) →
            (newVertex_notMem : newVertex ∉ S.cells) →
              (newEdge₁_notMem : newEdge₁ ∉ S.cells) →
                (newEdge₂_notMem : newEdge₂ ∉ S.cells) →
                  (newVertex_ne₁ : newVertex ≠ newEdge₁) →
                    (newVertex_ne₂ : newVertex ≠ newEdge₂) →
                      (newEdge_ne : newEdge₁ ≠ newEdge₂) →
                        (newBoundary : γ → List γ) →
                          (boundary_subst :
                              ∀ ⦃F : γ⦄,
                                F ∈ S.faces →
                                  ∃ u,
                                    S.skel.IsWalk u (S.boundary F) u ∧
                                      S.SubstWalk edge left right newEdge₁ newEdge₂ u (S.boundary F) (newBoundary F)) →
                            motive
                              { edge := edge, left := left, right := right, newVertex := newVertex,
                                newEdge₁ := newEdge₁, newEdge₂ := newEdge₂, isLink := isLink,
                                newVertex_notMem := newVertex_notMem, newEdge₁_notMem := newEdge₁_notMem,
                                newEdge₂_notMem := newEdge₂_notMem, newVertex_ne₁ := newVertex_ne₁,
                                newVertex_ne₂ := newVertex_ne₂, newEdge_ne := newEdge_ne, newBoundary := newBoundary,
                                boundary_subst := boundary_subst }) →
        (t : S.SubdivData) → motive t

                  (newEdge₂_notMem : newEdge₂ ∉ S.cells) →
                    (newVertex_ne₁ : newVertex ≠ newEdge₁) →
                      (newVertex_ne₂ : newVertex ≠ newEdge₂) →
                        (newEdge_ne : newEdge₁ ≠ newEdge₂) →
                          (newBoundary : γ → List γ) →
                            (boundary_subst :
                                ∀ ⦃F : γ⦄,
                                  F ∈ S.faces →
                                    ∃ u,
                                      S.skel.IsWalk u (S.boundary F) u ∧
                                        S.SubstWalk edge left right newEdge₁ newEdge₂ u (S.boundary F)
                                          (newBoundary F)) →
                              motive
                                { edge := edge, left := left, right := right, newVertex := newVertex,

                                  newVertex_notMem := newVertex_notMem, newEdge₁_notMem := newEdge₁_notMem,
                                  newEdge₂_notMem := newEdge₂_notMem, newVertex_ne₁ := newVertex_ne₁,
                                  newVertex_ne₂ := newVertex_ne₂, newEdge_ne := newEdge_ne, newBoundary := newBoundary,
                                  boundary_subst := boundary_subst }) →
          motive t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.skeleton_isLink
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} (d : S.SubdivData) {f a b : γ},
  d.skeleton.IsLink f a b ↔
    S.skel.IsLink f a b ∧ f ≠ d.edge ∧ f ≠ d.newEdge₁ ∧ f ≠ d.newEdge₂ ∨
      f = d.newEdge₁ ∧ s(a, b) = s(d.left, d.newVertex) ∨ f = d.newEdge₂ ∧ s(a, b) = s(d.newVertex, d.right)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.CellStructure.SubdivData.skeleton_isLink._simp_1_2
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {H : Graph γ γ} {e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ} {hne : e₁ ≠ e₂} {h₁ : e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet} {h₂ : e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet}
  {f a b : γ},
  (Schoenflies.subdivGraph H e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁ h₂).IsLink f a b =
    (H.IsLink f a b ∧ f ≠ e ∧ f ≠ e₁ ∧ f ≠ e₂ ∨
      f = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(x, v) ∨ f = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(v, y))

            (∀ ⦃F : γ⦄, F ∈ S'.faces → par F ∈ S.faces) →
              (∀ ⦃σ τ : γ⦄, S'.sub σ τ → S.sub (par σ) (par τ)) →
                (∀ ⦃σ : γ⦄, σ ∈ S.cells → σ ≠ c → R'.cell σ = R.cell σ) →
                  R.IsCellDecomposition D → R'.IsCellDecomposition D → R'.Refines R par

  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ Q ∈ C.pieces, Schoenflies.hgt u Q.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u Q.2) →

  (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → t < k → w ∉ P.edge (a + ↑t)) → ∃ r > 0, Metric.ball w r ∩ P.arc a k ⊆ P.edge a

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.exists_cone_radius
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m) {U : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  IsOpen U →
    P.carrier ⊆ U →
      ∃ R > 0,
        (∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), R ≤ P.len i) ∧
          (∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)), i ≠ j → 2 * R ≤ dist (P.vertex i) (P.vertex j)) ∧
            (∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → ∀ y ∈ P.edge j, 2 * R ≤ dist (P.vertex i) y) ∧
              Metric.thickening R P.carrier ⊆ U

declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m),

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.exists_germ_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m) (i : ZMod (m + 3)) {lam : ℝ},
  0 < lam → ∃ ε > 0, ε * (1 + |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)|) ≤ lam * |(P.rayIn i).det (P.tang i)|

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.exists_half_width
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m) {lam : ℝ},
  0 < lam →
    ∃ rho > 0,
      rho < lam ∧
        (∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)),
            j ≠ i → ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc lam (P.len i - lam), ∀ y ∈ P.edge j, 2 * rho ≤ dist (P.pt i c) y) ∧
          ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), rho * (1 + |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)|) ≤ lam * |(P.rayIn i).det (P.tang i)|

    (∀ Q ∈ P.pieces, Schoenflies.hgt u Q.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u Q.2) →

  0 < r → v₁ ≠ v₀ → segment ℝ v₀ v₁ ∩ Metric.ball v₀ r ⊆ segment ℝ v₀ u₁ → ∃ c, 0 < c ∧ v₁ - v₀ = c • (u₁ - v₀)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.exists_step_lt
declarations.type: ∀ {ρ : ℝ}, 0 < ρ → ∀ (u v : Schoenflies.Plane), ∃ s, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧ s * ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ s * ‖v‖ < ρ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.exists_two_sided_collar
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m) {U : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  IsOpen U →
    P.carrier ⊆ U →
      ∃ N NL NR,
        IsOpen N ∧
          P.carrier ⊆ N ∧
            N ⊆ U ∧
              IsOpen NL ∧
                IsOpen NR ∧
                  IsConnected NL ∧
                    IsConnected NR ∧
                      Disjoint NL NR ∧ N \ P.carrier = NL ∪ NR ∧ P.carrier ⊆ closure NL ∧ P.carrier ⊆ closure NR

  (edges_meet :
    ∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)),
      i ≠ j →
        segment ℝ (vertex i) (vertex (i + 1)) ∩ segment ℝ (vertex j) (vertex (j + 1)) ⊆ {vertex i, vertex (i + 1)})
  (corner : ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), (vertex (i - 1) - vertex i).det (vertex (i + 1) - vertex i) ≠ 0)
  (vertex_1 : ZMod (m + 3) → Schoenflies.Plane) (vertex_inj_1 : Function.Injective vertex_1)
  (edges_meet_1 :
    ∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)),
      i ≠ j →
        segment ℝ (vertex_1 i) (vertex_1 (i + 1)) ∩ segment ℝ (vertex_1 j) (vertex_1 (j + 1)) ⊆
          {vertex_1 i, vertex_1 (i + 1)})
  (corner_1 : ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), (vertex_1 (i - 1) - vertex_1 i).det (vertex_1 (i + 1) - vertex_1 i) ≠ 0),
  ({ vertex := vertex, vertex_inj := vertex_inj, edges_meet := edges_meet, corner := corner } =
      { vertex := vertex_1, vertex_inj := vertex_inj_1, edges_meet := edges_meet_1, corner := corner_1 }) =
    (vertex = vertex_1)

                  {vertex i, vertex (i + 1)}} →
          {corner : ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), (vertex (i - 1) - vertex i).det (vertex (i + 1) - vertex i) ≠ 0} →
            {vertex' : ZMod (m + 3) → Schoenflies.Plane} →

                  {corner' :
                      ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), (vertex' (i - 1) - vertex' i).det (vertex' (i + 1) - vertex' i) ≠ 0} →
                    { vertex := vertex, vertex_inj := vertex_inj, edges_meet := edges_meet, corner := corner } =
                        { vertex := vertex', vertex_inj := vertex_inj', edges_meet := edges_meet', corner := corner' } →

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.parity_flip_carrier
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m) {u : Schoenflies.Plane},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ Q ∈ P.pieces, Schoenflies.hgt u Q.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u Q.2) →
      ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)) {p : Schoenflies.Plane},
        p ∈ openSegment ℝ (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (i + 1)) →
          ∃ δ > 0,
            ∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 < t →
                t < δ →
                  p - t • u ∉ P.carrier ∧
                    p + t • u ∉ P.carrier ∧
                      Schoenflies.parity u P.pieces (p - t • u) = Schoenflies.parity u P.pieces (p + t • u) + 1

      ∀ {x y : Schoenflies.Plane},
        x ∉ C.carrier →
          y ∉ C.carrier →
            (Schoenflies.parity u C.pieces x ≠ Schoenflies.parity u C.pieces y ↔ x ∈ Schoenflies.farRegion C.carrier y)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.parity_splitting
declarations.type:
∀ {L₁ L₂ : List Schoenflies.Piece} {m k : ℕ} (C : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m) (u : Schoenflies.Plane)
  (a : ZMod (m + 3)),
  k ≤ m + 3 →
    ∀ {K : List Schoenflies.Piece},
      Schoenflies.SameEdges L₁ (C.arcPieces a k ++ K) →
        Schoenflies.SameEdges L₂ (C.arcPieces (a + ↑k) (m + 3 - k) ++ K) →
          ∀ (q : Schoenflies.Plane),
            Schoenflies.parity u L₁ q + Schoenflies.parity u L₂ q = Schoenflies.parity u C.pieces q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon.polygonal_jordan
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m),
  Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve P.carrier ∧
    Schoenflies.IsPolygonal P.carrier ∧
      IsOpen (Schoenflies.inside P.carrier) ∧
        IsOpen (Schoenflies.outside P.carrier) ∧
          IsConnected (Schoenflies.inside P.carrier) ∧
            IsConnected (Schoenflies.outside P.carrier) ∧
              Disjoint (Schoenflies.inside P.carrier) (Schoenflies.outside P.carrier) ∧
                Schoenflies.inside P.carrier ∪ Schoenflies.outside P.carrier = P.carrierᶜ ∧
                  Bornology.IsBounded (Schoenflies.inside P.carrier) ∧
                    ¬Bornology.IsBounded (Schoenflies.outside P.carrier) ∧
                      (∀ x ∉ P.carrier,
                          connectedComponentIn P.carrierᶜ x = Schoenflies.inside P.carrier ∨
                            connectedComponentIn P.carrierᶜ x = Schoenflies.outside P.carrier) ∧
                        frontier (Schoenflies.inside P.carrier) = P.carrier ∧
                          frontier (Schoenflies.outside P.carrier) = P.carrier

                              Schoenflies.JoinedLocalGridSourceExtensionData r p s epsilon)

              c = Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert l ∨
                c = Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert (l + 1) ∨
                  c = Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge i ∨
                    c = Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge j ∨
                      c = Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge l ∨ c = Schoenflies.InitialCell.chord) →
        Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert i ∈ F →
          Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert j ∈ F →
            Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert l ∈ F →
              Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert (l + 1) ∈ F →
                Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge i ∈ F →
                  Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge j ∈ F →
                    Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge l ∈ F →
                      Schoenflies.InitialCell.chord ∈ F →
                        Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert 1 ∈ F →
                          Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert 4 ∈ F →
                            ⋃ c ∈ F, H.cellSet c =

declarations.name: Schoenflies.HexData.casesOn
declarations.type:

  (t : Schoenflies.HexData) →
    ((pos : Fin 6 → Schoenflies.Plane) →
        (outer : Fin 6 → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane) →
          (chordParam : ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane) →
            (injective_pos : Function.Injective pos) →
              (continuousOn_outer : ∀ (i : Fin 6), ContinuousOn (outer i) unitInterval) →
                (injOn_outer : ∀ (i : Fin 6), Set.InjOn (outer i) unitInterval) →
                  (outer_zero : ∀ (i : Fin 6), outer i 0 = pos i) →
                    (outer_one : ∀ (i : Fin 6), outer i 1 = pos (i + 1)) →
                      (continuousOn_chord : ContinuousOn chordParam unitInterval) →
                        (injOn_chord : Set.InjOn chordParam unitInterval) →
                          (chord_zero : chordParam 0 = pos 1) →
                            (chord_one : chordParam 1 = pos 4) →
                              (outer_meet :
                                  ∀ (i j : Fin 6),
                                    i ≠ j →
                                      outer i '' unitInterval ∩ outer j '' unitInterval ⊆
                                        {pos i, pos (i + 1)} ∩ {pos j, pos (j + 1)}) →
                                (chord_meet :
                                    ∀ (i : Fin 6),
                                      chordParam '' unitInterval ∩ outer i '' unitInterval ⊆ {pos 1, pos 4}) →
                                  motive
                                    { pos := pos, outer := outer, chordParam := chordParam,
                                      injective_pos := injective_pos, continuousOn_outer := continuousOn_outer,

∀ {x : Schoenflies.Plane} {ρ : ℝ} {v : Schoenflies.Plane} {A : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  x ∈ v.cone A ρ ↔ x - v ∈ A ∧ dist x v < ρ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_frontier_closedSquare
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  z ∈ frontier (c.closedSquare r) ↔ max |z.ofLp 0 - c.ofLp 0| |z.ofLp 1 - c.ofLp 1| = r

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_frontier_closedSquare_iff_sides
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r →
    (z ∈ frontier (c.closedSquare r) ↔
      z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNE r) (c.sqNW r) ∨
        z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNW r) (c.sqSW r) ∨ z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqSW r) (c.sqSE r) ∨ z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqSE r) (c.sqNE r))

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_frontier_closedSquare_of_fst
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  |z.ofLp 0 - c.ofLp 0| = r → |z.ofLp 1 - c.ofLp 1| ≤ r → z ∈ frontier (c.closedSquare r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_frontier_closedSquare_of_snd
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  |z.ofLp 1 - c.ofLp 1| = r → |z.ofLp 0 - c.ofLp 0| ≤ r → z ∈ frontier (c.closedSquare r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_line_iff
declarations.type: ∀ {a b x : Schoenflies.Plane}, x ∈ a.line b ↔ ∃ t, (AffineMap.lineMap a b) t = x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_line_iff_det_eq_zero
declarations.type: ∀ {a b x : Schoenflies.Plane}, a ≠ b → (x ∈ a.line b ↔ (b - a).det (x - a) = 0)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_line_iff_det_eq_zero._abel_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane} (t : ℝ), t • (b - a) + a - a = t • (b - a)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_line_iff_det_eq_zero._abel_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {a x : Schoenflies.Plane}, x - a + a = x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_openSquare_iff
declarations.type: ∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ) (x : Schoenflies.Plane), x ∈ c.openSquare r ↔ ∀ (i : Fin 2), |x.ofLp i - c.ofLp i| < r

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_openSquare_iff._simp_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b c : α}, (max b c < a) = (b < a ∧ c < a)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_openSquare_iff._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {p : Fin 2 → Prop}, (∀ (i : Fin 2), p i) = (p 0 ∧ p 1)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_openSquare_self
declarations.type: ∀ {p : Schoenflies.Plane} {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → p ∈ p.openSquare s

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_ray_or_mem_arcCCW
declarations.type:
∀ {u w d : Schoenflies.Plane},
  0 < u.det w → d ≠ 0 → (∃ c, 0 < c ∧ d = c • u) ∨ (∃ c, 0 < c ∧ d = c • w) ∨ d ∈ u.arcCCW w ∨ d ∈ w.arcCCW u

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_ray_or_mem_arcCCW'
declarations.type:
∀ {d r₁ r₂ : Schoenflies.Plane},
  r₁.det r₂ ≠ 0 → d ≠ 0 → (∃ c, 0 < c ∧ d = c • r₁) ∨ (∃ c, 0 < c ∧ d = c • r₂) ∨ d ∈ r₁.arcCCW r₂ ∨ d ∈ r₂.arcCCW r₁

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_sectorPairs_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {D : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {p : Schoenflies.Plane × Schoenflies.Plane},
  p ∈ Schoenflies.Plane.sectorPairs D ↔ Schoenflies.Plane.IsSectorPair D p.1 p.2

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_seg_bottom
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r → (z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqSW r) (c.sqSE r) ↔ z.ofLp 1 = c.ofLp 1 - r ∧ |z.ofLp 0 - c.ofLp 0| ≤ r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_seg_left
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r → (z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNW r) (c.sqSW r) ↔ z.ofLp 0 = c.ofLp 0 - r ∧ |z.ofLp 1 - c.ofLp 1| ≤ r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_seg_right
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r → (z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqSE r) (c.sqNE r) ↔ z.ofLp 0 = c.ofLp 0 + r ∧ |z.ofLp 1 - c.ofLp 1| ≤ r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_seg_top
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r → (z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNE r) (c.sqNW r) ↔ z.ofLp 1 = c.ofLp 1 + r ∧ |z.ofLp 0 - c.ofLp 0| ≤ r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_segment_abs
declarations.type: ∀ {a r x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → (x ∈ segment ℝ (a - r) (a + r) ↔ |x - a| ≤ r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_segment_abs'
declarations.type: ∀ {a r x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → (x ∈ segment ℝ (a + r) (a - r) ↔ |x - a| ≤ r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_segment_iff_coord
declarations.type:
∀ {a b u x : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L → u.IsDirection → L • u = b - a → (x ∈ segment ℝ a b ↔ a.coordAcross u x = 0 ∧ a.coordAlong u x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_sideHalfPlane_of_sideGap_nonpos
declarations.type:
∀ {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ} {p : Schoenflies.Plane} {i : Fin 2} {b : Bool},
  c.sideGap r p i b ≤ 0 → p ∈ c.sideHalfPlane r i b

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_strip_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {u a x : Schoenflies.Plane} {t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ : ℝ},
  x ∈ a.strip u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ ↔
    t₁ < a.coordAlong u x ∧ a.coordAlong u x < t₂ ∧ s₁ < a.coordAcross u x ∧ a.coordAcross u x < s₂

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mem_strip_param
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane},
  u.IsDirection →
    ∀ (a : Schoenflies.Plane) {t s t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ : ℝ},
      a + t • u + s • u.perp ∈ a.strip u t₁ t₂ s₁ s₂ ↔ t₁ < t ∧ t < t₂ ∧ s₁ < s ∧ s < s₂

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mk
declarations.type: ℝ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mk._proof_1
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mk_inj
declarations.type: ∀ {x y x' y' : ℝ}, Schoenflies.Plane.mk x y = Schoenflies.Plane.mk x' y' → x = x' ∧ y = y'

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mk_one
declarations.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), (Schoenflies.Plane.mk x y).ofLp 1 = y

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.mk_zero
declarations.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), (Schoenflies.Plane.mk x y).ofLp 0 = x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.ne_zero_left_of_det_ne_zero
declarations.type: ∀ {u w : Schoenflies.Plane}, u.det w ≠ 0 → u ≠ 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.ne_zero_right_of_det_ne_zero
declarations.type: ∀ {u w : Schoenflies.Plane}, u.det w ≠ 0 → w ≠ 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.norm_le_sqrt_two_mul_supNorm
declarations.type: ∀ (x : Schoenflies.Plane), ‖x‖ ≤ √2 * x.supNorm

declarations.type: ∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane), ‖u.perp‖ = ‖u‖

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.norm_sq_eq
declarations.type: ∀ (x : Schoenflies.Plane), ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x.ofLp 0 ^ 2 + x.ofLp 1 ^ 2

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.notMem_arcCCW_asymm
declarations.type: ∀ {u v w : Schoenflies.Plane}, v ∈ u.arcCCW w → w ∉ u.arcCCW v

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.notMem_arcCCW_smul
declarations.type: ∀ {c : ℝ} (u w : Schoenflies.Plane), 0 ≤ c → c • u ∉ u.arcCCW w ∧ c • u ∉ w.arcCCW u

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.notMem_arcCCW_swap
declarations.type: ∀ {u v w : Schoenflies.Plane}, v ∈ u.arcCCW w → u ∉ v.arcCCW w

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.notMem_of_mem_segment_of_isMinOn
declarations.type:
∀ {K : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {x a y : Schoenflies.Plane},
  a ∈ K → x ∉ K → (∀ b ∈ K, dist x a ≤ dist x b) → y ∈ segment ℝ x a → y ≠ a → y ∉ K

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.not_isBounded_compl_closedSquare
declarations.type: ∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ), ¬Bornology.IsBounded (c.closedSquare r)ᶜ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare
declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ → Set Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ), c.openSquare r = {x | x.supDist c < r}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_disjoint_sideHalfPlane
declarations.type:
∀ {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {r s : ℝ} {p : Schoenflies.Plane} {i : Fin 2} {b : Bool},
  s ≤ c.sideGap r p i b → ∀ x ∈ p.openSquare s, x ∉ c.sideHalfPlane r i b

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_eq_inter
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ),
  c.openSquare r =
    {x | c.ofLp 0 - r < x.ofLp 0} ∩ {x | x.ofLp 0 < c.ofLp 0 + r} ∩
      ({x | c.ofLp 1 - r < x.ofLp 1} ∩ {x | x.ofLp 1 < c.ofLp 1 + r})

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_eq_inter._simp_1_4
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u} (x : α) (a b : Set α), (x ∈ a ∩ b) = (x ∈ a ∧ x ∈ b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_eq_inter._simp_1_5
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b c : α}, (max b c < a) = (b < a ∧ c < a)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_eq_inter._simp_1_6
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddGroup α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [AddLeftMono α] {a b : α} [AddRightMono α],
  (|a| < b) = (-b < a ∧ a < b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_mono
declarations.type: ∀ {p : Schoenflies.Plane} {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → p.openSquare s ⊆ p.openSquare t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_subset_ball
declarations.type: ∀ (p : Schoenflies.Plane) (ε : ℝ), p.openSquare (ε / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball p ε

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare_subset_closedSquare
declarations.type: ∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ), c.openSquare r ⊆ c.closedSquare r

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane), u.perp = Schoenflies.Plane.mk (-u.ofLp 1) (u.ofLp 0)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_neg
declarations.type: ∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane), (-u).perp = -u.perp

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_one
declarations.type: ∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane), u.perp.ofLp 1 = u.ofLp 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_perp
declarations.type: ∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane), u.perp.perp = -u

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.perp_zero
declarations.type: ∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane), u.perp.ofLp 0 = -u.ofLp 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.pos_of_lt_lt
declarations.type: ∀ {r p : ℝ}, -r < p → p < r → 0 < r

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.radial_meet
declarations.type:
∀ {c c' p p' z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 < r →
    p.supDist c = r →
      p'.supDist c' = r →
        p ≠ p' →
          (c ≠ c' → Disjoint (c.closedSquare r) (c'.closedSquare r)) → z ∈ segment ℝ c p → z ∈ segment ℝ c' p' → z = c

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.right_mem_line
declarations.type: ∀ (a b : Schoenflies.Plane), b ∈ a.line b

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.right_mem_line._simp_1
declarations.type: ∀ (a b : Schoenflies.Plane), (b ∈ a.line b) = True

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.right_notMem_arcCCW
declarations.type: ∀ (u w : Schoenflies.Plane), w ∉ u.arcCCW w

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.same_arc_of_det_neg_of_det_pos
declarations.type: ∀ {u w d₁ d₂ : Schoenflies.Plane}, 0 < u.det w → u.det d₁ < 0 → 0 < w.det d₂ → d₁ ∈ w.arcCCW u ∧ d₂ ∈ w.arcCCW u

declarations.type: Set Schoenflies.Plane → Set (Schoenflies.Plane × Schoenflies.Plane)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.sectorPairs_finite
declarations.type: ∀ {D : Set Schoenflies.Plane}, D.Finite → (Schoenflies.Plane.sectorPairs D).Finite

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.segment_subset_closedSquare
declarations.type: ∀ {c p : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → p.supDist c ≤ r → segment ℝ c p ⊆ c.closedSquare r

declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → Fin 2 → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.setCoord.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (z : Schoenflies.Plane) (j : Fin 2) (t : ℝ), z.setCoord j t = z + (t - z.ofLp j) • Schoenflies.Plane.axisVec j

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.setCoord_of_ne
declarations.type: ∀ {i j : Fin 2}, i ≠ j → ∀ (z : Schoenflies.Plane) (t : ℝ), (z.setCoord j t).ofLp i = z.ofLp i

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.setCoord_self
declarations.type: ∀ (z : Schoenflies.Plane) (j : Fin 2) (t : ℝ), (z.setCoord j t).ofLp j = t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear
declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r a b k k' : ℝ) (i j : Fin 2) (z : Schoenflies.Plane),
  c.shear r a b k k' i j z =
    z +
      (Schoenflies.Plane.bend r (a + k * c.shearWeight r b j z) (a + (k + k') * c.shearWeight r b j z)
            (z.ofLp i - c.ofLp i) -
          (z.ofLp i - c.ofLp i)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single i 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shearWeight
declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ → ℝ → Fin 2 → Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shearWeight.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r b : ℝ) (j : Fin 2) (z : Schoenflies.Plane),
  c.shearWeight r b j z = Schoenflies.Plane.tent r b (z.ofLp j - c.ofLp j)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shearWeight_mem
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ} {j : Fin 2} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear r a b k k' → z ∈ c.closedSquare r → c.shearWeight r b j z ∈ Set.Icc 0 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_apply_ne
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ} {i j l : Fin 2} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  l ≠ i → (c.shear r a b k k' i j z).ofLp l = z.ofLp l

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_apply_same
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ} {i j : Fin 2} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  (c.shear r a b k k' i j z).ofLp i =
    c.ofLp i +
      Schoenflies.Plane.bend r (a + k * c.shearWeight r b j z) (a + (k + k') * c.shearWeight r b j z)
        (z.ofLp i - c.ofLp i)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_continuousOn
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ},
  Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear r a b k k' → ∀ (i j : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (c.shear r a b k k' i j) (c.closedSquare r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_eq_self_of_boundary
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ} {i j : Fin 2} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear r a b k k' → j ≠ i → z ∈ c.closedSquare r → z.supDist c = r → c.shear r a b k k' i j z = z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_mapsTo
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ},
  Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear r a b k k' →
    ∀ (i j : Fin 2), Set.MapsTo (c.shear r a b k k' i j) (c.closedSquare r) (c.closedSquare r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_mid_mem
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ} {j : Fin 2} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear r a b k k' → z ∈ c.closedSquare r → a + k * c.shearWeight r b j z ∈ Set.Ioo (-r) r

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_shear
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ} {i j : Fin 2} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear r a b k k' →
    j ≠ i → z ∈ c.closedSquare r → c.shear r a b (k + k') (-k') i j (c.shear r a b k k' i j z) = z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.shear_top_mem
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : Schoenflies.Plane} {a b k k' : ℝ} {j : Fin 2} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.Plane.IsShear r a b k k' → z ∈ c.closedSquare r → a + (k + k') * c.shearWeight r b j z ∈ Set.Ioo (-r) r

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.sideGap
declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane → Fin 2 → Bool → ℝ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.sideGap.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ) (p : Schoenflies.Plane) (i : Fin 2) (b : Bool),
  c.sideGap r p i b = bif b then c.ofLp i + r - p.ofLp i else p.ofLp i - (c.ofLp i - r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.sideHalfPlane
declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ → Fin 2 → Bool → Set Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.sideHalfPlane_subset_compl
declarations.type: ∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) (b : Bool), c.sideHalfPlane r i b ⊆ (c.openSquare r)ᶜ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.smul_add_apply
declarations.type: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (x y : Schoenflies.Plane) (i : Fin 2), (a • x + b • y).ofLp i = a * x.ofLp i + b * y.ofLp i

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.smul_apply
declarations.type: ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : Schoenflies.Plane) (i : Fin 2), (r • x).ofLp i = r * x.ofLp i

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.smul_mem_arcCCW
declarations.type: ∀ {u w d : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → (r • d ∈ u.arcCCW w ↔ d ∈ u.arcCCW w)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.sqNE
declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.Plane.sqNE._proof_1
