declarations.name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.exists_arcCollar
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Schoenflies.PolyArc n) {D K : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  IsOpen D →
    A.vertex 0 ∉ D →
      A.vertex (n + 1) ∉ D →
        A.carrier \ {A.vertex 0, A.vertex (n + 1)} ⊆ D →
          IsCompact K → K ⊆ D ∩ A.carrier → Nonempty (Schoenflies.ArcCollar D A.carrier K)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.exists_cone_radius
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Schoenflies.PolyArc n) {D K : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  IsOpen D →
    IsCompact K →
      K ⊆ D →
        (∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n → A.vertex j ∈ D) →
          A.vertex 0 ∉ D →
            A.vertex (n + 1) ∉ D →
              ∃ R > 0,
                (∀ i ≤ n, R ≤ A.len i) ∧
                  (∀ i ≤ n + 1, ∀ j ≤ n + 1, i ≠ j → 2 * R ≤ dist (A.vertex i) (A.vertex j)) ∧
                    (∀ i ≤ n + 1, ∀ j ≤ n, i ≠ j → i ≠ j + 1 → ∀ y ∈ A.edge j, 2 * R ≤ dist (A.vertex i) y) ∧
                      (∀ i < n, Metric.ball (A.vertex (i + 1)) R ⊆ D) ∧
                        ∀ x ∈ K, R ≤ dist x (A.vertex 0) ∧ R ≤ dist x (A.vertex (n + 1))

declarations.name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.exists_cone_radius._proof_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : ℕ), ¬1 ≤ i + 1 → False

declarations.name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.exists_cone_radius._proof_1_2

declarations.name: Schoenflies.PolyArc.exists_half_width
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Schoenflies.PolyArc n) {D : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {lam : ℝ},
  IsOpen D →
    0 < lam →
      (∀ i ≤ n, A.trimmed i lam ⊆ D) →
        ∃ rho > 0,
          rho < lam ∧
            (∀ i ≤ n, ∀ j ≤ n, j ≠ i → ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc lam (A.len i - lam), ∀ y ∈ A.edge j, 2 * rho ≤ dist (A.pt i c) y) ∧
              (∀ i < n, rho * (1 + |inner ℝ (A.back i) (A.tang (i + 1))|) ≤ lam * |(A.back i).det (A.tang (i + 1))|) ∧
                ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc lam (A.len i - lam), Metric.ball (A.pt i c) rho ⊆ D

          y ∈ connectedComponentIn P.carrierᶜ x → Schoenflies.parity u P.pieces y = Schoenflies.parity u P.pieces x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.PrePolygon.parity_flip_carrier
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (P : Schoenflies.PrePolygon m) {u : Schoenflies.Plane},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ Q ∈ P.pieces, Schoenflies.hgt u Q.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u Q.2) →
      ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)) {p : Schoenflies.Plane},
        p ∈ openSegment ℝ (P.vertex i) (P.vertex (i + 1)) →
          ∃ δ > 0,
            ∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 < t →
                t < δ →
                  p - t • u ∉ P.carrier ∧
                    p + t • u ∉ P.carrier ∧
                      Schoenflies.parity u P.pieces (p - t • u) = Schoenflies.parity u P.pieces (p + t • u) + 1

      ∀ {x y : Schoenflies.Plane},
        x ∉ P.carrier →
          y ∉ P.carrier →

declarations.name: Schoenflies.StripData.casesOn
declarations.type:
{m : ℕ} →
  {P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m} →
    {motive : Schoenflies.StripData P → Sort u} →
      (t : Schoenflies.StripData P) →
        ((R lam rho : ℝ) →
            (rho_pos : 0 < rho) →
              (rho_lt_lam : rho < lam) →
                (two_lam_lt_R : 2 * lam < R) →
                  (four_lam_lt_len : ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), 4 * lam < P.len i) →
                    (R_le_len : ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)), R ≤ P.len i) →
                      (sep_vertex : ∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)), i ≠ j → 2 * R ≤ dist (P.vertex i) (P.vertex j)) →
                        (sep_vertex_edge :
                            ∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → ∀ y ∈ P.edge j, 2 * R ≤ dist (P.vertex i) y) →
                          (sep_trim_edge :
                              ∀ (i j : ZMod (m + 3)),
                                j ≠ i →
                                  ∀ c ∈ Set.Icc lam (P.len i - lam), ∀ y ∈ P.edge j, 2 * rho ≤ dist (P.pt i c) y) →
                            (germ :
                                ∀ (i : ZMod (m + 3)),
                                  rho * (1 + |inner ℝ (P.rayIn i) (P.tang i)|) ≤ lam * |(P.rayIn i).det (P.tang i)|) →
                              motive
                                { R := R, lam := lam, rho := rho, rho_pos := rho_pos, rho_lt_lam := rho_lt_lam,
                                  two_lam_lt_R := two_lam_lt_R, four_lam_lt_len := four_lam_lt_len,
                                  R_le_len := R_le_len, sep_vertex := sep_vertex, sep_vertex_edge := sep_vertex_edge,
                                  sep_trim_edge := sep_trim_edge, germ := germ }) →
          motive t

    P.carrier ⊆ D.nbhd ∧
      D.nbhd \ P.carrier = D.sideL ∪ D.sideR ∧

    c ≤ P.len i - 2 * D.lam →
      η ≤ min D.lam D.rho →
        ∀ {y : Schoenflies.Plane},
          y ∈ Metric.ball (P.pt i c) η →
            (0 < (P.vertex i).coordAcross (P.tang i) y → y ∈ D.blockL i) ∧

declarations.name: Schoenflies.StripData.local_two_sided
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {P : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m} (D : Schoenflies.StripData P) {i : ZMod (m + 3)} {c η : ℝ},
  2 * D.lam ≤ c →
    c ≤ P.len i - 2 * D.lam →
      0 < η →
        η ≤ min D.lam D.rho →
          Metric.ball (P.pt i c) η ∩ P.carrier ⊆ P.edge i ∧
            (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (P.pt i c) η,
                y ∉ P.carrier →
                  0 < (P.vertex i).coordAcross (P.tang i) y ∧ y ∈ D.sideL ∨
                    (P.vertex i).coordAcross (P.tang i) y < 0 ∧ y ∈ D.sideR) ∧
              P.off i c (η / 2) ∈ Metric.ball (P.pt i c) η ∩ D.sideL ∧
                P.off i c (-(η / 2)) ∈ Metric.ball (P.pt i c) η ∩ D.sideR

    D.lam < (P.vertex i).coordAlong (P.tang i) x ∧
      (P.vertex i).coordAlong (P.tang i) x < P.len i - D.lam ∧
        0 < (P.vertex i).coordAcross (P.tang i) x ∧ (P.vertex i).coordAcross (P.tang i) x < D.rho

  {J₂ : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m₂} {K : List Schoenflies.Piece} {a : ZMod (m + 3)} {k : ℕ} {y : Schoenflies.Plane}
  {A B P : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {p q w₁ w₂ : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut C J₁ J₂ K a k y →

declarations.name: Schoenflies.concatenate_seam
declarations.type:
∀ {f g : ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Set.InjOn f unitInterval →
    Set.InjOn g unitInterval →
      f 1 = g 0 →
        (∀ z ∈ f '' unitInterval, z ∈ g '' unitInterval → z = f 1) →
          ∀ {x y : ℝ},
            x ∈ Schoenflies.lowerHalf →
              y ∈ Schoenflies.upperHalf → Schoenflies.concatenate f g x = Schoenflies.concatenate f g y → x = y

declarations.name: Schoenflies.concatenate_seam_loop
declarations.type:
∀ {f g : ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Set.InjOn f unitInterval →
    Set.InjOn g unitInterval →
      f 1 = g 0 →
        g 1 = f 0 →
          (∀ z ∈ f '' unitInterval, z ∈ g '' unitInterval → z = f 0 ∨ z = f 1) →
            ∀ {x y : ℝ},
              x ∈ Schoenflies.lowerHalf →
                y ∈ Schoenflies.upperHalf →
                  y ≠ 1 → Schoenflies.concatenate f g x = Schoenflies.concatenate f g y → x = y

declarations.name: Schoenflies.concatenate_upperHalf
declarations.type:
∀ {f g : ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  f 1 = g 0 → ∀ {t : ℝ}, t ∈ Schoenflies.upperHalf → Schoenflies.concatenate f g t = g (2 * t - 1)

    Schoenflies.Plane.IsSectorPair (Schoenflies.localDirs S x) d' w' →
      d ≠ d' ∨ w ≠ w' → Disjoint (x.cone (d.arcCCW w) r) (x.cone (d'.arcCCW w') r)

        ∀ {e w : Schoenflies.Plane},
          Schoenflies.Plane.IsSectorPair (Schoenflies.localDirs S x) e w →

declarations.name: Schoenflies.crosscut_cell_partition
declarations.type:
∀ {C P A₁ A₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {p q : Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Plane), Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve S → Schoenflies.IsSeparating S) →
    Schoenflies.IsCrosscut C P p q →
      Schoenflies.IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂ →
        Schoenflies.HasArcCollars (Schoenflies.inside C) P →
          Schoenflies.inside C = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∪ Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∪ P \ {p, q} ∧
            Disjoint (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
              Disjoint (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) (P \ {p, q}) ∧
                Disjoint (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) (P \ {p, q}) ∧
                  IsOpen (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) ∧
                    IsOpen (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
                      (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧
                        (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧
                          closure (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∪ (A₁ ∪ P) ∧
                            closure (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) = Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∪ (A₂ ∪ P)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.crosscut_cells
declarations.type:
∀ {C P A₁ A₂ Ω Ω' : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSeparating C →
    Schoenflies.IsSeparating (A₁ ∪ P) →
      Schoenflies.IsSeparating (A₂ ∪ P) →
        A₁ ⊆ C →
          A₂ ⊆ C →
            P ∩ C ⊆ A₁ →
              P ∩ C ⊆ A₂ →
                A₁ ≠ A₂ →
                  Schoenflies.IsRegionPair C Ω Ω' →
                    ∀ {W₁ V₁ W₂ V₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
                      Schoenflies.IsRegionPair (A₁ ∪ P) W₁ V₁ →
                        Ω' ⊆ W₁ →
                          Schoenflies.IsRegionPair (A₂ ∪ P) W₂ V₂ →
                            Ω' ⊆ W₂ →
                              (V₁ ⊆ Ω \ P ∧ ∀ z ∈ V₁, connectedComponentIn (Ω \ P) z = V₁) ∧
                                (V₂ ⊆ Ω \ P ∧ ∀ z ∈ V₂, connectedComponentIn (Ω \ P) z = V₂) ∧
                                  V₁ ≠ V₂ ∧ closure V₁ ∩ C = A₁ ∧ closure V₂ ∩ C = A₂

declarations.name: Schoenflies.crosscut_side_correspondence
declarations.type:
∀ {C 𝒜 A₁ A₂ P P' : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u v F F' : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsHomeoOn u v C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
    Schoenflies.IsHomeoOn F F' (Schoenflies.inside C) (Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare 0 1) →
      𝒜 ⊆ C →
        C ⊆ closure 𝒜 →
          Schoenflies.HasSpokes C 𝒜 u F →
            Schoenflies.IsCutPair C a b A₁ A₂ →
              Schoenflies.IsCrosscut C P a b →
                Schoenflies.IsCrosscut Schoenflies.modelCurve P' (u a) (u b) →
                  F '' (P \ {a, b}) = P' \ {u a, u b} →
                    F '' Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) = Schoenflies.inside (u '' A₁ ∪ P') ∧
                      F '' Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P) = Schoenflies.inside (u '' A₂ ∪ P')

declarations.name: Schoenflies.crosscut_theorem
declarations.type:
∀ {C P A₁ A₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {p q : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsCrosscut C P p q →
    Schoenflies.IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂ →
      Schoenflies.inside C \ P = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∪ Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∧
        Disjoint (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
          (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧
            (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧
              Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ≠ Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∧
                (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P),
                    connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) ∧
                  (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P),
                      connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
                    (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.inside C \ P,
                        connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∨
                          connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
                      closure (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) ∩ C = A₁ ∧ closure (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∩ C = A₂

        (∀ j < n, yc j ≤ yc (j + 1)) →
          Graph.edgesCover Schoenflies.segmentDrawing
              (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryLast xc yc m n :: Schoenflies.gridBoundaryDetour xc yc m n) =
            segment ℝ (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc 0 0) (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc m 0) ∪
                segment ℝ (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc m 0) (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc m n) ∪
              (segment ℝ (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc 0 n) (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc m n) ∪

    Graph.edgesCover Schoenflies.segmentDrawing
        (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryLast xc yc m n :: Schoenflies.gridBoundaryDetour xc yc m n) =
      ⋃ t ∈ Set.Iio (2 * m + 2 * n), (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryEdge xc yc m n t).seg

declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S₀ : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} {srcOuter srcDom tgtOuter tgtDom : Set Schoenflies.Plane}
  {P T : Schoenflies.GeneratedPair S₀ srcOuter srcDom tgtOuter tgtDom} {B H : Graph Schoenflies.Plane γ}
  {Hdraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane} {a b : Schoenflies.Plane} {D : List γ} {par : γ → γ},
  Schoenflies.IsSourceExtension P.tgt tgtOuter tgtDom H Hdraw →
    B ≤ H →
      H.IsPath a D b →
        a ≠ b →
          a ∈ B.vertexSet →
            b ∈ B.vertexSet →
              (∀ y ∈ H.walkVertices a D, y ≠ a → y ≠ b → y ∉ B.vertexSet) →
                (∀ g ∈ D, g ∉ B.edgeSet) →
                  Schoenflies.IsTargetPartialTransferOf T P B Hdraw par →
                    ∃ u v F,
                      u ∈ T.str.skel.vertexSet ∧
                        v ∈ T.str.skel.vertexSet ∧
                          u ≠ v ∧
                            T.tgt.pos u = a ∧
                              T.tgt.pos v = b ∧
                                F ∈ T.str.faces ∧
                                  Graph.edgesCover Hdraw D \ {a, b} ⊆ T.tgt.cell F ∧ T.str.sub u F ∧ T.str.sub v F

declarations.name: Schoenflies.exists_tripod
declarations.type:
∀ {C Ω : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  IsOpen Ω →
    IsPreconnected Ω →
      Disjoint Ω C →
        ∀ {a b c : Schoenflies.Plane},
          a ∈ C →
            b ∈ C →
              c ∈ C →
                a ≠ b →
                  a ≠ c →
                    b ≠ c →
                      Schoenflies.PolyAccessible Ω a →
                        Schoenflies.PolyAccessible Ω b →
                          Schoenflies.PolyAccessible Ω c →
                            ∃ x ∈ Ω,
                              ∃ Ta Tb Tc,
                                Schoenflies.IsArcBetween Ta x a ∧
                                  Schoenflies.IsArcBetween Tb x b ∧
                                    Schoenflies.IsArcBetween Tc x c ∧
                                      Ta \ {a} ⊆ Ω ∧
                                        Tb \ {b} ⊆ Ω ∧ Tc \ {c} ⊆ Ω ∧ Ta ∩ Tb ⊆ {x} ∧ Ta ∩ Tc ⊆ {x} ∧ Tb ∩ Tc ⊆ {x}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.exists_two_common_vertices
declarations.type:
∀ {pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece} {points : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) →
    Schoenflies.MeetsAreCut pieces points →
      ∀ {c₁ c₂ : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
        0 < r →
          c₁.supDist c₂ < r →
            (∀ P ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₁ r, P ∈ pieces) →
              (∀ P ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₂ r, P ∈ pieces) →
                ∃ p q,
                  p ≠ q ∧
                    p ∈ (Schoenflies.overlayGraph pieces points).vertexSet ∧
                      q ∈ (Schoenflies.overlayGraph pieces points).vertexSet

declarations.name: Schoenflies.exists_two_cut_points
declarations.type:
∀ {pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece} {points : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) →
    Schoenflies.MeetsAreCut pieces points →
      ∀ {c₁ c₂ : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
        0 < r →
          c₁.supDist c₂ < r →
            (∀ P ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₁ r, P ∈ pieces) →
              (∀ P ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₂ r, P ∈ pieces) →
                ∃ p q,
                  p ≠ q ∧
                    p ∈ points ∧
                      q ∈ points ∧
                        p ∈ frontier (c₁.closedSquare r) ∩ frontier (c₂.closedSquare r) ∧
                          q ∈ frontier (c₁.closedSquare r) ∩ frontier (c₂.closedSquare r)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.exists_two_frontier_inter
declarations.type:

declarations.name: Schoenflies.exists_two_meets
declarations.type:
∀ {c₁ c₂ : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 < r →
    c₁.supDist c₂ < r →
      ∃ p q,
        p ≠ q ∧
          (∃ P ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₁ r, ∃ Q ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₂ r, Schoenflies.meetOf P Q = {p}) ∧
            ∃ P ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₁ r, ∃ Q ∈ Schoenflies.squarePieces c₂ r, Schoenflies.meetOf P Q = {q}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.exists_two_vertices_familySquare
declarations.type:
∀ {r : ℝ} {c : ℕ → Schoenflies.Plane} {N : ℕ},

    ∀ {j j' : ℕ},
      j ≤ N →
        j' ≤ N →
          (c j).supDist (c j') < r →
            ∃ a b,
              a ≠ b ∧
                a ∈ (Schoenflies.familySquare c N r j).vertexSet ∧
                  a ∈ (Schoenflies.familySquare c N r j').vertexSet ∧
                    b ∈ (Schoenflies.familySquare c N r j).vertexSet ∧ b ∈ (Schoenflies.familySquare c N r j').vertexSet

declarations.type:

  R ∈ (Schoenflies.extendOverlay pieces extra joins).edgeSet →
    (∃ A ∈ (Schoenflies.attachGraph pieces extra).edgeSet, R.seg ⊆ A.seg) ∨ ∃ A ∈ joins, R.seg ⊆ A.seg

declarations.type:

  (∀ R ∈ pieces, R.Nondeg) →
    (∀ R ∈ joins, R.Nondeg) →
      ∀ {A : Schoenflies.Piece},
        A ∈ (Schoenflies.attachGraph pieces extra).edgeSet →
          ∀ {R : Schoenflies.Piece},
            R ∈ (Schoenflies.extendOverlay pieces extra joins).edgeSet →
              (Graph.edgeArc Schoenflies.segmentDrawing R ∩
                    (Graph.edgeArc Schoenflies.segmentDrawing A \
                      (Schoenflies.extendOverlay pieces extra joins).vertexSet)).Nonempty →
                Graph.edgeArc Schoenflies.segmentDrawing R ⊆ Graph.edgeArc Schoenflies.segmentDrawing A

declarations.type:
∀ (u q : Schoenflies.Plane) (s : ℝ) (v : Schoenflies.Plane),

    if

declarations.type:

declarations.name: Schoenflies.general_crosscut
declarations.type:
∀ {C P A₁ A₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {p q : Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Plane), Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve S → Schoenflies.IsSeparating S) →
    Schoenflies.IsCrosscut C P p q →
      Schoenflies.IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂ →
        Schoenflies.HasArcCollars (Schoenflies.inside C) P →
          Schoenflies.inside C \ P = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∪ Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∧
            Disjoint (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
              (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧
                (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)).Nonempty ∧
                  Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ≠ Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P) ∧
                    (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P),
                        connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) ∧
                      (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P),
                          connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
                        (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.inside C \ P,
                            connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ∨
                              connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) z = Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∧
                          closure (Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P)) ∩ C = A₁ ∧
                            closure (Schoenflies.inside (A₂ ∪ P)) ∩ C = A₂

declarations.name: Schoenflies.general_crosscut_three_regions
declarations.type:
∀ {C P A₁ A₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {p q : Schoenflies.Plane},

declarations.name: Schoenflies.gridGraph_full_square_aligned_ends
declarations.type:
∀ {xc yc : ℕ → ℝ} {m n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    1 ≤ n →
      StrictMonoOn xc (Set.Iic m) →
        StrictMonoOn yc (Set.Iic n) →
          xc 0 = -1 →
            xc m = 1 →
              yc 0 = -1 →
                yc n = 1 →
                  ∀ {i : ℕ},
                    0 < i →
                      i < m →
                        Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i 0 ∈ Schoenflies.modelCurve ∧
                          Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i n ∈ Schoenflies.modelCurve ∧
                            (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i 0).ofLp 0 = (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i n).ofLp 0 ∧
                              (∃ P ∈ (Schoenflies.gridGraph xc yc m n).edgeSet,
                                  (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i 0 = P.1 ∨ Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i 0 = P.2) ∧
                                    ¬P.seg ⊆ Schoenflies.modelCurve) ∧
                                ∃ P ∈ (Schoenflies.gridGraph xc yc m n).edgeSet,
                                  (Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i n = P.1 ∨ Schoenflies.gridPt xc yc i n = P.2) ∧

  0 ≤ r →
    r ≠ 1 →
      1 ≤ m →
        1 ≤ n →
          StrictMonoOn xc (Set.Iic m) →
            StrictMonoOn yc (Set.Iic n) →
              xc 0 = -r →
                xc m = r →
                  yc 0 = -r →
                    yc n = r →
                      (Schoenflies.gridGraph xc yc m n).IsCycleThrough (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryLast xc yc m n)
                          (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryPt xc yc m n 0)
                          (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryPt xc yc m n (2 * m + 2 * n - 1))
                          (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryDetour xc yc m n) ∧
                        Graph.edgesCover Schoenflies.segmentDrawing
                              (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryLast xc yc m n :: Schoenflies.gridBoundaryDetour xc yc m n) =
                            Schoenflies.ringSet r ∧
                          Graph.edgesCover Schoenflies.segmentDrawing
                                (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryLast xc yc m n :: Schoenflies.gridBoundaryDetour xc yc m n) ∩
                              Schoenflies.modelCurve =
                            ∅

declarations.name: Schoenflies.head_getLast_mem_endSet_segsOf.match_1_1
declarations.type:
∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane)
  (motive :
    (tl : List Schoenflies.Plane) →
      (∀ (hvs : tl ≠ []),
          tl.head hvs ≠ tl.getLast hvs →
            tl.head hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf tl) ∧
              tl.getLast hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf tl)) →
        (hvs : u :: tl ≠ []) → (u :: tl).head hvs ≠ (u :: tl).getLast hvs → Prop)
  (tl : List Schoenflies.Plane)
  (ih :
    ∀ (hvs : tl ≠ []),
      tl.head hvs ≠ tl.getLast hvs →
        tl.head hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf tl) ∧
          tl.getLast hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf tl))
  (hvs : u :: tl ≠ []) (hne : (u :: tl).head hvs ≠ (u :: tl).getLast hvs),
  (∀
      (ih :
        ∀ (hvs : [] ≠ []),
          [].head hvs ≠ [].getLast hvs →
            [].head hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf []) ∧
              [].getLast hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf []))
      (hvs : [u] ≠ []) (hne : [u].head hvs ≠ [u].getLast hvs), motive [] ih hvs hne) →
    (∀ (v : Schoenflies.Plane) (rest : List Schoenflies.Plane)
        (ih :
          ∀ (hvs : v :: rest ≠ []),
            (v :: rest).head hvs ≠ (v :: rest).getLast hvs →
              (v :: rest).head hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf (v :: rest)) ∧
                (v :: rest).getLast hvs ∈ Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.segsOf (v :: rest)))
        (hvs : u :: v :: rest ≠ []) (hne : (u :: v :: rest).head hvs ≠ (u :: v :: rest).getLast hvs),
        motive (v :: rest) ih hvs hne) →
      motive tl ih hvs hne

declarations.name: Schoenflies.image_crosscut_side_subset
declarations.type:
∀ {C 𝒜 A₁ A₂ P P' : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u v F F' : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsHomeoOn u v C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
    Schoenflies.IsHomeoOn F F' (Schoenflies.inside C) (Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare 0 1) →
      𝒜 ⊆ C →
        C ⊆ closure 𝒜 →
          Schoenflies.HasSpokes C 𝒜 u F →
            Schoenflies.IsCutPair C a b A₁ A₂ →
              Schoenflies.IsCrosscut C P a b →
                Schoenflies.IsCrosscut Schoenflies.modelCurve P' (u a) (u b) →
                  F '' (P \ {a, b}) = P' \ {u a, u b} →
                    F '' Schoenflies.inside (A₁ ∪ P) ⊆ Schoenflies.inside (u '' A₁ ∪ P')

  Set.BijOn F (A ∪ B) T → F '' A = A' → Disjoint A B → F '' B = T \ A'

declarations.name: Schoenflies.image_inside_eq

  Schoenflies.IsHomeoOn F G (C ∪ Schoenflies.inside C) (C' ∪ Schoenflies.inside C') →
    Set.EqOn F f C → f '' C = C' → F '' Schoenflies.inside C = Schoenflies.inside C'

declarations.name: Schoenflies.image_inside_sdiff
declarations.type:
∀ {C P P' : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u F F' : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsHomeoOn F F' (Schoenflies.inside C) (Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare 0 1) →
    Schoenflies.IsCrosscut C P a b →
      Schoenflies.IsCrosscut Schoenflies.modelCurve P' (u a) (u b) →
        F '' (P \ {a, b}) = P' \ {u a, u b} →
          F '' (Schoenflies.inside C \ P) = Schoenflies.inside Schoenflies.modelCurve \ P'

  (∀ (A : Set Schoenflies.Plane), Schoenflies.IsArc A → IsConnected Aᶜ) →
    Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve C →
      ∃ d,
        d.sourceRealization.graph.IsTwoConnected ∧
          d.targetRealization.graph.IsTwoConnected ∧
            d.sourceRealization.outerSet = C ∧
              d.targetRealization.outerSet = Schoenflies.modelCurve ∧
                IsConnected d.sourceRealization.nonboundary ∧

declarations.name: Schoenflies.initial_pair'
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsJordanCurve C →
    ∀ (A : Schoenflies.AnchorSet C),
      ∃ d,
        d.a ∈ A.carrier ∧
          d.b ∈ A.carrier ∧
            Schoenflies.StronglyAccessible (Schoenflies.inside C) d.a ∧
              Schoenflies.StronglyAccessible (Schoenflies.inside C) d.b ∧
                d.u d.a ∈ Schoenflies.openTop ∧
                  d.u d.b ∈ Schoenflies.openBottom ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin 6), d.u (d.src.pos i) = d.tgt.pos i) ∧
                      d.sourceRealization.graph.IsTwoConnected ∧
                        d.targetRealization.graph.IsTwoConnected ∧
                          d.sourceRealization.outerSet = C ∧
                            d.targetRealization.outerSet = Schoenflies.modelCurve ∧
                              IsConnected d.sourceRealization.nonboundary ∧
                                IsConnected d.targetRealization.nonboundary ∧
                                  Schoenflies.IsPolygonal d.crossSet ∧
                                    (∀ e ∈ Schoenflies.initSkel.edgeSet,
                                        Schoenflies.IsPolygonal (Graph.edgeArc d.tgt.draw e)) ∧
                                      d.tgt.chordSet = segment ℝ (d.u d.a) (d.u d.b) ∧
                                        (∀ x ∈ C, d.skeletonHomeo.toFun x = d.u x) ∧
                                          (∀ (k : Bool), d.tgt.arcOf k = d.u '' d.src.arcOf k) ∧
                                            (∀ (k : Bool),
                                                closure (d.sourceRealization.cell (Schoenflies.InitialCell.face k)) ∩

declarations.name: Schoenflies.localGrid_outer_cycle
declarations.type:
∀ {p : Schoenflies.Plane} {s : ℝ} {k : ℕ},
  0 < s →
    1 ≤ k →
      (Schoenflies.localGrid p s k).IsCycleThrough
          (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryLast (Schoenflies.localGridX p s k) (Schoenflies.localGridY p s k) k k)
          (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryPt (Schoenflies.localGridX p s k) (Schoenflies.localGridY p s k) k k 0)
          (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryPt (Schoenflies.localGridX p s k) (Schoenflies.localGridY p s k) k k
            (2 * k + 2 * k - 1))
          (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryDetour (Schoenflies.localGridX p s k) (Schoenflies.localGridY p s k) k k) ∧
        Graph.edgesCover Schoenflies.segmentDrawing
            (Schoenflies.gridBoundaryLast (Schoenflies.localGridX p s k) (Schoenflies.localGridY p s k) k k ::
              Schoenflies.gridBoundaryDetour (Schoenflies.localGridX p s k) (Schoenflies.localGridY p s k) k k) =
          segment ℝ (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 - s) (p.ofLp 1 - s))
                (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 + s) (p.ofLp 1 - s)) ∪
              segment ℝ (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 + s) (p.ofLp 1 - s))
                (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 + s) (p.ofLp 1 + s)) ∪
            (segment ℝ (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 - s) (p.ofLp 1 + s))
                (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 + s) (p.ofLp 1 + s)) ∪
              segment ℝ (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 - s) (p.ofLp 1 - s))
                (Schoenflies.Plane.mk (p.ofLp 0 - s) (p.ofLp 1 + s)))

declarations.name: Schoenflies.meetOf_horiz_vert
declarations.type:
∀ {x₀ y₀ u v s t : ℝ},
  x₀ ∈ segment ℝ s t →
    y₀ ∈ segment ℝ u v →
      Schoenflies.meetOf (Schoenflies.Plane.mk s y₀, Schoenflies.Plane.mk t y₀)
          (Schoenflies.Plane.mk x₀ u, Schoenflies.Plane.mk x₀ v) =

    Schoenflies.hgt u a ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u c →

    min (Schoenflies.hgt u P.1) (Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) ≤ t →

    Schoenflies.hgt u a ≤ t → t ≤ Schoenflies.hgt u b → Schoenflies.meet u a b t ∈ segment ℝ a b

declarations.type:

  Schoenflies.hgt u a ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u b →
    Schoenflies.hgt u c ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u b →
      ∀ {r : ℝ}, c = a + r • (b - a) → ∀ (t : ℝ), Schoenflies.meet u c b t = Schoenflies.meet u a b t

declarations.type: ∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ}, b - (a + r • (b - a)) = b - a - r • (b - a)

declarations.type:
∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ} (k : ℝ),

∀ {u a b : Schoenflies.Plane},

declarations.name: Schoenflies.mem_iff_of_goodRadius
declarations.type:

      x ∈ S →

                ∀ {base : Schoenflies.Plane},
                  base ∈ (Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).exterior Schoenflies.segmentDrawing →
                    Bornology.IsBounded ((Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).face Schoenflies.segmentDrawing base) →
                      (Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).face Schoenflies.segmentDrawing base ⊆
                          Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare 0 1 ∧
                        Metric.diam ((Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).face Schoenflies.segmentDrawing base) < δ

    P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points ∧ (v = P.1 ∧ w = P.2 ∨ v = P.2 ∧ w = P.1) → x = v ∨ x = w

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph._proof_3

  P ∈ {P | P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points} ↔

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph._proof_4
declarations.type:

  (motive : (∃ x y, P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)) → Prop)
  (x : ∃ x y, P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)),
  (∀ (w w_1 : Schoenflies.Plane) (hP : P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points)

declarations.type:
∀ {l l' : List Schoenflies.Piece} {points : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ P ∈ l, P.Nondeg) →
    (∀ P ∈ l', P.Nondeg) →
      (Schoenflies.pieceListGraph (Schoenflies.subdivide l points)).IsTwoConnected →
        (Schoenflies.pieceListGraph (Schoenflies.subdivide l' points)).IsTwoConnected →
          ∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
            a ≠ b →
              a ∈ points →
                b ∈ points →
                  a ∈ Schoenflies.cover l →
                    b ∈ Schoenflies.cover l →
                      a ∈ Schoenflies.cover l' →
                        b ∈ Schoenflies.cover l' → (Schoenflies.overlayGraph (l ++ l') points).IsTwoConnected

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayGraph_vertexSet
declarations.type:
∀ {pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece} {points : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  (Schoenflies.overlayGraph pieces points).vertexSet = Schoenflies.endSet (Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces
declarations.type: List Schoenflies.Piece → List Schoenflies.Plane → List Schoenflies.Piece

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece) (points : List Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points =
    (List.map Schoenflies.orientPiece (Schoenflies.subdivide pieces points)).dedup

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_avoids
declarations.type:
∀ {pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece} {points : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) → ∀ p ∈ points, ∀ P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points, p ∉ P.interior

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_cover
declarations.type:
∀ (pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece) (points : List Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.cover (Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points) = Schoenflies.cover pieces

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_disjoint_interiors
declarations.type:
∀ {pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece} {points : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) →
    Schoenflies.EndsAreCut pieces points →
      Schoenflies.MeetsAreCut pieces points →
        ∀ {P Q : Schoenflies.Piece},
          P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points →
            Q ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points →
              P ≠ Q → ∀ {x : Schoenflies.Plane}, x ∈ P.interior → x ∉ Q.interior

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_ends_cut
declarations.type:
∀ {pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece} {points : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.EndsAreCut pieces points →
    ∀ P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points, ∀ (z : Schoenflies.Plane), z = P.1 ∨ z = P.2 → z ∈ points

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_nodup
declarations.type: ∀ (pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece) (points : List Schoenflies.Plane), (Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points).Nodup

declarations.name: Schoenflies.overlayPieces_nondeg
declarations.type:
∀ {pieces : List Schoenflies.Piece} (points : List Schoenflies.Plane),
  (∀ P ∈ pieces, P.Nondeg) → ∀ P ∈ Schoenflies.overlayPieces pieces points, P.Nondeg

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pair_eq_of_mem_pair
declarations.type: ∀ {a b p q : Schoenflies.Plane}, a ≠ b → a = p ∨ a = q → b = p ∨ b = q → a = p ∧ b = q ∨ a = q ∧ b = p

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par
declarations.type: {n : ℕ} → (T : Finset ℝ) → T.card = n → Fin n → ℝ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par.congr_simp
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (T T_1 : Finset ℝ) (e_T : T = T_1) (hcard : T.card = n) (i i_1 : Fin n),
  i = i_1 → Schoenflies.par T hcard i = Schoenflies.par T_1 ⋯ i_1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (T : Finset ℝ) (hcard : T.card = n) (i : Fin n), Schoenflies.par T hcard i = (T.orderEmbOfFin hcard) i

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parNext
declarations.type: {n : ℕ} → (T : Finset ℝ) → T.card = n → Fin n → ℝ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parNext.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (T : Finset ℝ) (hcard : T.card = n) (i : Fin n),
  Schoenflies.parNext T hcard i = if h : ↑i + 1 < n then (T.orderEmbOfFin hcard) ⟨↑i + 1, h⟩ else 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parNext_le_one
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ} (hcard : T.card = n),
  (∀ s ∈ T, s ∈ Set.Ico 0 1) → ∀ (i : Fin n), Schoenflies.parNext T hcard i ≤ 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par_card_pos
declarations.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ}, T.card = n → 0 ∈ T → 0 < n

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par_le_par
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ} (hcard : T.card = n) {i j : Fin n},
  i ≤ j → Schoenflies.par T hcard i ≤ Schoenflies.par T hcard j

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par_lt_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ} (hcard : T.card = n) {i j : Fin n},
  Schoenflies.par T hcard i < Schoenflies.par T hcard j ↔ i < j

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par_lt_par
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ} (hcard : T.card = n) {i j : Fin n},
  i < j → Schoenflies.par T hcard i < Schoenflies.par T hcard j

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par_lt_parNext
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ} (hcard : T.card = n),
  (∀ s ∈ T, s ∈ Set.Ico 0 1) → ∀ (i : Fin n), Schoenflies.par T hcard i < Schoenflies.parNext T hcard i

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par_mem
declarations.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ} (hcard : T.card = n) (i : Fin n), Schoenflies.par T hcard i ∈ T

declarations.name: Schoenflies.par_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {T : Finset ℝ} (hcard : T.card = n),
  (∀ s ∈ T, s ∈ Set.Ico 0 1) → ∀ (h0 : 0 ∈ T), Schoenflies.par T hcard ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parameter_le_of_distance
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  a ≠ b → ∀ {s t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ t → dist a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) s) ≤ dist a ((AffineMap.lineMap a b) t) → s ≤ t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity
declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → List Schoenflies.Piece → Schoenflies.Plane → ZMod 2

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane) (L : List Schoenflies.Piece) (q : Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.parity u L q = (List.map (fun P => Schoenflies.mark u P q) L).sum

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_append
declarations.type:
∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane) (L₁ L₂ : List Schoenflies.Piece) (q : Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.parity u (L₁ ++ L₂) q = Schoenflies.parity u L₁ q + Schoenflies.parity u L₂ q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_cons
declarations.type:
∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane) (P : Schoenflies.Piece) (L : List Schoenflies.Piece) (q : Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.parity u (P :: L) q = Schoenflies.mark u P q + Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_crossings
declarations.type:
∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane) (L : List Schoenflies.Piece) (q : Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.parity u L q = ↑(Schoenflies.crossings u L q)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_isPreconnected
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
      Schoenflies.IsClosedChain L →
        ∀ {S : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
          IsPreconnected S →
            (∀ z ∈ S, z ∉ Schoenflies.cover L) →
              ∀ {x y : Schoenflies.Plane}, x ∈ S → y ∈ S → Schoenflies.parity u L x = Schoenflies.parity u L y

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_mem_ball
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
      Schoenflies.IsClosedChain L →
        ∀ {q q' : Schoenflies.Plane} {ε : ℝ},
          q' ∈ Metric.ball q ε →
            (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball q ε, y ∉ Schoenflies.cover L) → Schoenflies.parity u L q' = Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_mem_ball._abel_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {u q q' : Schoenflies.Plane}, q + Schoenflies.fwd u (q' - q) • u - q = Schoenflies.fwd u (q' - q) • u

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_mem_ball._abel_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {q q' : Schoenflies.Plane}, q' = q + (q' - q)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_of_mem_connectedComponentIn
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
      Schoenflies.IsClosedChain L →
        ∀ {x y : Schoenflies.Plane},
          x ∉ Schoenflies.cover L →
            y ∈ connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.cover L)ᶜ x → Schoenflies.parity u L y = Schoenflies.parity u L x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_one_of_mem_inside_cover
declarations.type:
∀ {L : List Schoenflies.Piece} {u : Schoenflies.Plane},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ Q ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u Q.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u Q.2) →
      Schoenflies.IsClosedChain L →
        Schoenflies.IsSeparating (Schoenflies.cover L) →
          ∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
            a ∉ Schoenflies.cover L →
              b ∉ Schoenflies.cover L →
                Schoenflies.parity u L a ≠ Schoenflies.parity u L b →
                  ∀ {x : Schoenflies.Plane}, x ∈ Schoenflies.inside (Schoenflies.cover L) → Schoenflies.parity u L x = 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_zero_of_lt
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
    ∀ {q : Schoenflies.Plane},
      (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.cover L, Schoenflies.fwd u z < Schoenflies.fwd u q) → Schoenflies.parity u L q = 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_eq_zero_of_mem_outside_cover
declarations.type:
∀ {L : List Schoenflies.Piece} {u : Schoenflies.Plane},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ Q ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u Q.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u Q.2) →
      Schoenflies.IsClosedChain L →
        Schoenflies.IsSeparating (Schoenflies.cover L) →
          ∀ {x : Schoenflies.Plane}, x ∈ Schoenflies.outside (Schoenflies.cover L) → Schoenflies.parity u L x = 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_flip
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane},
  u.IsDirection →
    ∀ {L₁ L₂ : List Schoenflies.Piece} {a b p : Schoenflies.Plane},
      (∀ P ∈ L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
        p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b →
          p ∉ Schoenflies.cover L₁ →
            p ∉ Schoenflies.cover L₂ →
              ∃ δ > 0,
                ∀ (t : ℝ),
                  0 < t →
                    t < δ →
                      p - t • u ∉ Schoenflies.cover (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) ∧
                        p + t • u ∉ Schoenflies.cover (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) ∧
                          Schoenflies.parity u (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) (p - t • u) =
                            Schoenflies.parity u (L₁ ++ (a, b) :: L₂) (p + t • u) + 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_flip._abel_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {u p : Schoenflies.Plane} (t : ℝ), p - t • u = p + -(t • u)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_flip._abel_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {u p : Schoenflies.Plane} (r : ℝ), p + r • u - p = r • u

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_map_orientPiece
declarations.type:
∀ (u : Schoenflies.Plane) (L : List Schoenflies.Piece) (q : Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.parity u (List.map Schoenflies.orientPiece L) q = Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_move_across
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
      Schoenflies.IsClosedChain L →
        ∀ {q : Schoenflies.Plane} {s : ℝ},
          0 ≤ s →
            (∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q (q + s • u.perp), y ∉ Schoenflies.cover L) →
              Schoenflies.parity u L (q + s • u.perp) = Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_move_across'
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
      Schoenflies.IsClosedChain L →
        ∀ {q q' : Schoenflies.Plane} (s : ℝ),
          q' = q + s • u.perp →
            (∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q q', y ∉ Schoenflies.cover L) → Schoenflies.parity u L q' = Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_move_along
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
      ∀ {q : Schoenflies.Plane} {s : ℝ},
        0 ≤ s →
          (∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q (q + s • u), y ∉ Schoenflies.cover L) →
            Schoenflies.parity u L (q + s • u) = Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_move_along'
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  u.IsDirection →
    (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
      ∀ {q q' : Schoenflies.Plane} (s : ℝ),
        q' = q + s • u →
          (∀ y ∈ segment ℝ q q', y ∉ Schoenflies.cover L) → Schoenflies.parity u L q' = Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_nil
declarations.type: ∀ (u q : Schoenflies.Plane), Schoenflies.parity u [] q = 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_perm
declarations.type:
∀ {L₁ L₂ : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  L₁.Perm L₂ → ∀ (u q : Schoenflies.Plane), Schoenflies.parity u L₁ q = Schoenflies.parity u L₂ q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_split
declarations.type:
∀ {L₁ L₂ : List Schoenflies.Piece} (u : Schoenflies.Plane) {LC A₁ A₂ K : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  Schoenflies.SameEdges LC (A₁ ++ A₂) →
    Schoenflies.SameEdges L₁ (A₁ ++ K) →
      Schoenflies.SameEdges L₂ (A₂ ++ K) →
        ∀ (q : Schoenflies.Plane), Schoenflies.parity u L₁ q + Schoenflies.parity u L₂ q = Schoenflies.parity u LC q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.parity_subdivide
declarations.type:
∀ {u : Schoenflies.Plane} {L : List Schoenflies.Piece},
  (∀ P ∈ L, Schoenflies.hgt u P.1 ≠ Schoenflies.hgt u P.2) →
    ∀ (points : List Schoenflies.Plane) (q : Schoenflies.Plane),
      Schoenflies.parity u (Schoenflies.subdivide L points) q = Schoenflies.parity u L q

declarations.name: Schoenflies.paste
declarations.type:
Set Schoenflies.Plane →
  (Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane) →
    (Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane) → Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.paste_of_mem
declarations.type:
∀ {S : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {f₁ f₂ : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  z ∈ S → Schoenflies.paste S f₁ f₂ z = f₁ z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.paste_of_notMem
declarations.type:
∀ {S : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {f₁ f₂ : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
  z ∉ S → Schoenflies.paste S f₁ f₂ z = f₂ z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathGraph_edge_trace_le
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} {R : S.Realization} {outer dom : Set Schoenflies.Plane}
  {H : Graph Schoenflies.Plane γ} {Hdraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSourceExtension R outer dom H Hdraw →
    ∀ {e a b : γ},
      S.skel.IsLink e a b →
        ∀ {D : List γ},
          H.IsPath (R.pos a) D (R.pos b) →
            Graph.edgesCover Hdraw D = Graph.edgeArc R.drawing e →
              H.pathGraphOf (R.pos a) D ≤ H.traceGraph Hdraw (Graph.edgeArc R.drawing e)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathPieces
declarations.type: List Schoenflies.Plane → List Schoenflies.Piece

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathPieces._f
declarations.type: (x : List Schoenflies.Plane) → List.below x → List Schoenflies.Piece

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathPieces._sunfold
declarations.type: List Schoenflies.Plane → List Schoenflies.Piece

declarations.type: List Schoenflies.Plane → List Schoenflies.Piece

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathPieces.match_1
declarations.type:
(motive : List Schoenflies.Plane → Sort u_1) →
  (x : List Schoenflies.Plane) →
    (Unit → motive []) →
      ((head : Schoenflies.Plane) → motive [head]) →
        ((v w : Schoenflies.Plane) → (rest : List Schoenflies.Plane) → motive (v :: w :: rest)) → motive x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathPieces_cons_cons
declarations.type:
∀ (v w : Schoenflies.Plane) (rest : List Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.pathPieces (v :: w :: rest) = (v, w) :: Schoenflies.pathPieces (w :: rest)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathPieces_nil
declarations.type: Schoenflies.pathPieces [] = []

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pathPieces_singleton
declarations.type: ∀ (v : Schoenflies.Plane), Schoenflies.pathPieces [v] = []

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceDirs
declarations.type: List Schoenflies.Piece → Schoenflies.Plane → Set Schoenflies.Plane

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceDirs_finite
declarations.type: ∀ (ps : List Schoenflies.Piece) (x : Schoenflies.Plane), (Schoenflies.pieceDirs ps x).Finite

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceDirs_subset_localDirs
declarations.type:
∀ {S F : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {ps : List Schoenflies.Piece} {x : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  S = F ∪ Schoenflies.cover ps →
    0 < r → (∀ P ∈ ps, Schoenflies.GoodRadius x P r) → Schoenflies.pieceDirs ps x ⊆ Schoenflies.localDirs S x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph
declarations.type: List Schoenflies.Piece → Graph Schoenflies.Plane Schoenflies.Piece

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph._proof_1
declarations.type:
∀ (edges : List Schoenflies.Piece),
  ∀ x ∈ {P | P ∈ edges}, Std.Symm fun x_2 y => x ∈ edges ∧ (x_2 = x.1 ∧ y = x.2 ∨ x_2 = x.2 ∧ y = x.1)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph._proof_2
declarations.type:
∀ (edges : List Schoenflies.Piece) ⦃P : Schoenflies.Piece⦄ ⦃x y v w : Schoenflies.Plane⦄,
  P ∈ edges ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1) →
    P ∈ edges ∧ (v = P.1 ∧ w = P.2 ∨ v = P.2 ∧ w = P.1) → x = v ∨ x = w

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph._proof_3
declarations.type:
∀ (edges : List Schoenflies.Piece) (P : Schoenflies.Piece),
  P ∈ {P | P ∈ edges} ↔ ∃ x y, P ∈ edges ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph._proof_4
declarations.type:
∀ (edges : List Schoenflies.Piece) ⦃P : Schoenflies.Piece⦄ ⦃x y : Schoenflies.Plane⦄,
  P ∈ edges ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1) → x ∈ Schoenflies.endSet edges

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph.match_1
declarations.type:
∀ (edges : List Schoenflies.Piece) (P : Schoenflies.Piece)
  (motive : (∃ x y, P ∈ edges ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)) → Prop)
  (x : ∃ x y, P ∈ edges ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)),
  (∀ (w w_1 : Schoenflies.Plane) (hP : P ∈ edges) (right : w = P.1 ∧ w_1 = P.2 ∨ w = P.2 ∧ w_1 = P.1), motive ⋯) →
    motive x

declarations.name: Schoenflies.pieceListGraph_append_crosscut
declarations.type:
∀ {l : List Schoenflies.Piece} {q₀ q₁ : Schoenflies.Plane},
  (Schoenflies.pieceListGraph l).IsTwoConnected →
    q₀ ≠ q₁ →
      q₀ ∈ Schoenflies.endSet l →

    IsCompact K →
      a ∉ K →
        Schoenflies.CellsAbsorb K cells →

declarations.name: Schoenflies.polyArc_crosscut_at_most_two
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Schoenflies.PolyArc n) {D : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
  IsOpen D →
    IsPreconnected D →
      A.vertex 0 ∉ D →
        A.vertex (n + 1) ∉ D →
          A.carrier \ {A.vertex 0, A.vertex (n + 1)} ⊆ D →
            ∃ zL ∈ D \ A.carrier,
              ∃ zR ∈ D \ A.carrier,
                ∀ x ∈ D \ A.carrier,
                  x ∈ connectedComponentIn (D \ A.carrier) zL ∨ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (D \ A.carrier) zR

    IsPreconnected D →
      A.vertex 0 ∉ D →
        A.vertex (n + 1) ∉ D →
          A.carrier \ {A.vertex 0, A.vertex (n + 1)} ⊆ D →
            v₁ ∈ D \ A.carrier →
              v₂ ∈ D \ A.carrier →
                connectedComponentIn (D \ A.carrier) v₁ ≠ connectedComponentIn (D \ A.carrier) v₂ →

                    x ∈ connectedComponentIn (D \ A.carrier) v₁ ∨ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (D \ A.carrier) v₂

declarations.name: Schoenflies.polygonal_crosscut
declarations.type:
∀ {m m₁ m₂ : ℕ} {C : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m} {J₁ : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m₁}
  {J₂ : Schoenflies.ClosedPolygon m₂} {K : List Schoenflies.Piece} {a : ZMod (m + 3)} {k : ℕ} {y : Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsPolygonalCrosscut C J₁ J₂ K a k y →
    Schoenflies.farRegion C.carrier y \ Schoenflies.cover K =
        Schoenflies.farRegion J₁.carrier y ∪ Schoenflies.farRegion J₂.carrier y ∧
      Disjoint (Schoenflies.farRegion J₁.carrier y) (Schoenflies.farRegion J₂.carrier y) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.farRegion J₁.carrier y,
            connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.farRegion C.carrier y \ Schoenflies.cover K) z =
              Schoenflies.farRegion J₁.carrier y) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Schoenflies.farRegion J₂.carrier y,
              connectedComponentIn (Schoenflies.farRegion C.carrier y \ Schoenflies.cover K) z =
                Schoenflies.farRegion J₂.carrier y) ∧
            frontier (Schoenflies.farRegion J₁.carrier y) = J₁.carrier ∧
              frontier (Schoenflies.farRegion J₂.carrier y) = J₂.carrier ∧
                closure (Schoenflies.farRegion J₁.carrier y) ∩ C.carrier = C.arc a k ∧
                  closure (Schoenflies.farRegion J₂.carrier y) ∩ C.carrier = C.arc (a + ↑k) (m + 3 - k) ∧
                    ∀ z ∉ C.carrier ∪ Schoenflies.cover K,
                      connectedComponentIn (C.carrier ∪ Schoenflies.cover K)ᶜ z = Schoenflies.farRegion J₁.carrier y ∨
                        connectedComponentIn (C.carrier ∪ Schoenflies.cover K)ᶜ z = Schoenflies.farRegion J₂.carrier y ∨
                          connectedComponentIn (C.carrier ∪ Schoenflies.cover K)ᶜ z = connectedComponentIn C.carrierᶜ y

declarations.name: Schoenflies.radial_diam_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {fresh : List Schoenflies.Plane} {δ : ℝ},
      2 * √2 ≤ δ * ↑N →
        Schoenflies.FreshDense fresh δ →
          ∀ {F : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
            IsPreconnected F →
              (∀ x ∈ F, x ∉ Schoenflies.cover (Schoenflies.meshSegments N fresh)) →
                ∀ {base : Schoenflies.Plane},
                  base ∈ F → base.supNorm < 1 → (∀ x ∈ F, x.supNorm < 1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, dist x y ≤ δ / 2 + √2 / ↑N

declarations.name: Schoenflies.radial_diam_bound._abel_1_2
declarations.type:
∀ (x y : Schoenflies.Plane),
  x - y = x - x.supNorm • (fun x => x.supNorm⁻¹ • x) y + (x.supNorm • (fun x => x.supNorm⁻¹ • x) y - y)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.radial_diam_bound._proof_1_1
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {base : Schoenflies.Plane},
  ⌊base.supNorm * ↑N⌋₊ < N → ⌊base.supNorm * ↑N⌋₊ > 0 → ¬⌊base.supNorm * ↑N⌋₊ - 1 < N → False

declarations.name: Schoenflies.reaches_trace_delete_of_deleteEdges_isWalk
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} {R : S.Realization} {outer dom : Set Schoenflies.Plane}
  {H : Graph Schoenflies.Plane γ} {Hdraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSourceExtension R outer dom H Hdraw →
    ∀ {c : Schoenflies.Plane},
      c ∉ R.graph.vertexSet →
        ∀ {e₀ : γ},
          e₀ ∈ S.skel.edgeSet →
            c ∈ Graph.edgeArc R.drawing e₀ →
              ∀ {a b : γ} {W : List γ},
                (S.skel.deleteEdges {e₀}).IsWalk a W b →
                  ((H.traceGraph Hdraw R.skeletonSet).deleteVerts {c}).Reaches (R.pos a) (R.pos b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.reaches_trace_delete_of_deleteVerts_isWalk
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} {R : S.Realization} {outer dom : Set Schoenflies.Plane}
  {H : Graph Schoenflies.Plane γ} {Hdraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSourceExtension R outer dom H Hdraw →
    ∀ {z a b : γ} {W : List γ},
      z ∈ S.skel.vertexSet →
        (S.skel.deleteVerts {z}).IsWalk a W b →
          ((H.traceGraph Hdraw R.skeletonSet).deleteVerts {R.pos z}).Reaches (R.pos a) (R.pos b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.reaches_trace_of_isWalk
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} {R : S.Realization} {outer dom : Set Schoenflies.Plane}
  {H : Graph Schoenflies.Plane γ} {Hdraw : γ → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSourceExtension R outer dom H Hdraw →
    ∀ {a b : γ} {W : List γ}, S.skel.IsWalk a W b → (H.traceGraph Hdraw R.skeletonSet).Reaches (R.pos a) (R.pos b)

declarations.type:
{motive : Schoenflies.InitialCell → Sort u_1} →
  {c : Schoenflies.InitialCell} →
    c ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells →
      ((i : Fin 6) → motive (Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert i)) →
        ((i : Fin 6) → motive (Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge i)) →
          motive Schoenflies.InitialCell.chord → ((k : Bool) → motive (Schoenflies.InitialCell.face k)) → motive c

declarations.name: Schoenflies.recOnCells.match_1
declarations.type:
(motive : (c : Schoenflies.InitialCell) → c ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells → Sort u_1) →
  (c : Schoenflies.InitialCell) →
    (hc : c ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells) →
      ((i : Fin 6) →
          (hc : Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert i ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells) →
            motive (Schoenflies.InitialCell.vert i) hc) →
        ((i : Fin 6) →
            (hc : Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge i ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells) →
              motive (Schoenflies.InitialCell.edge i) hc) →
          ((hc : Schoenflies.InitialCell.chord ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells) →
              motive Schoenflies.InitialCell.chord hc) →
            ((k : Bool) →
                (hc : Schoenflies.InitialCell.face k ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells) →
                  motive (Schoenflies.InitialCell.face k) hc) →
              ((n : ℕ) →
                  (hc : Schoenflies.InitialCell.aux n ∈ Schoenflies.initialStructure.cells) →
                    motive (Schoenflies.InitialCell.aux n) hc) →
                motive c hc

declarations.name: Schoenflies.same_ends_of_meeting_interiors
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ {u v s t x : Schoenflies.Plane},
      u ∈ segment ℝ a b →
        v ∈ segment ℝ a b →
          s ∈ segment ℝ a b →
            t ∈ segment ℝ a b →
              x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v →
                x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t →
                  s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v →
                    t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v →
                      u ∉ openSegment ℝ s t → v ∉ openSegment ℝ s t → u = s ∧ v = t ∨ u = t ∧ v = s

declarations.name: Schoenflies.same_ends_of_meeting_interiors_oriented
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ {u v s t x : Schoenflies.Plane},
      u ∈ segment ℝ a b →
        v ∈ segment ℝ a b →
          dist a u ≤ dist a v →
            s ∈ segment ℝ a b →
              t ∈ segment ℝ a b →
                dist a s ≤ dist a t →
                  x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v →
                    x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t →
                      s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v →
                        t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v → u ∉ openSegment ℝ s t → v ∉ openSegment ℝ s t → u = s ∧ v = t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample
declarations.type: ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (n i : ℕ), Schoenflies.sample n i = ↑i / ↑n

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_last
declarations.type: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → Schoenflies.sample n n = 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_le_one
declarations.type: ∀ {n i : ℕ}, i ≤ n → Schoenflies.sample n i ≤ 1

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_mem_I

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_mem_Icc_of_block
declarations.type:
∀ {K m j p : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    p * m ≤ j →
      j ≤ (p + 1) * m → Schoenflies.sample (K * m) j ∈ Set.Icc (Schoenflies.sample K p) (Schoenflies.sample K (p + 1))

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_mono
declarations.type: ∀ {n i j : ℕ}, i ≤ j → Schoenflies.sample n i ≤ Schoenflies.sample n j

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_mul

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_strictMono

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_succ_sub
declarations.type: ∀ (n i : ℕ), Schoenflies.sample n (i + 1) - Schoenflies.sample n i = 1 / ↑n

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sample_zero
declarations.type: ∀ (n : ℕ), Schoenflies.sample n 0 = 0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.scheduledQuantitativeSuccessor
declarations.type:
{γ : Type u_1} →
  {S₀ : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} →
    {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} →
      [Infinite γ] →
        Schoenflies.IsSeparating C →
          S₀.OuterEdgesFormCycle →
            (q : Schoenflies.QuantitativeSchedule C) →
              (n : ℕ) →
                (P :
                    Schoenflies.GeneratedPair S₀ C (C ∪ Schoenflies.inside C) Schoenflies.modelCurve
                      (Schoenflies.Plane.closedSquare 0 1)) →

                    (Schoenflies.dyadicScale n) (Schoenflies.dyadicTargetBound n)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.scheduledQuantitativeSuccessor._proof_1
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {S₀ : Schoenflies.CellStructure γ} {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} [Infinite γ],
  Schoenflies.IsSeparating C →
    S₀.OuterEdgesFormCycle →
      ∀ (q : Schoenflies.QuantitativeSchedule C) (n : ℕ)
        (P :
          Schoenflies.GeneratedPair S₀ C (C ∪ Schoenflies.inside C) Schoenflies.modelCurve
            (Schoenflies.Plane.closedSquare 0 1)),

declarations.type: ∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Piece), ∀ x ∈ S, Std.Symm fun x_2 y => x ∈ S ∧ (x_2 = x.1 ∧ y = x.2 ∨ x_2 = x.2 ∧ y = x.1)

declarations.type:
∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Piece) ⦃P : Schoenflies.Piece⦄ ⦃x y v w : Schoenflies.Plane⦄,
  P ∈ S ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1) → P ∈ S ∧ (v = P.1 ∧ w = P.2 ∨ v = P.2 ∧ w = P.1) → x = v ∨ x = w

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segGraph._proof_3
declarations.type: ∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Piece) (P : Schoenflies.Piece), P ∈ S ↔ ∃ x y, P ∈ S ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segGraph._proof_4
declarations.type:

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segGraph.match_1
declarations.type:
∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Piece) (P : Schoenflies.Piece)
  (motive : (∃ x y, P ∈ S ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)) → Prop)
  (x : ∃ x y, P ∈ S ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)),
  (∀ (w w_1 : Schoenflies.Plane) (hP : P ∈ S) (right : w = P.1 ∧ w_1 = P.2 ∨ w = P.2 ∧ w_1 = P.1), motive ⋯) → motive x

declarations.type:
∀ {S : Set Schoenflies.Piece} {P : Schoenflies.Piece} {x y : Schoenflies.Plane},
  (Schoenflies.segGraph S).IsLink P x y ↔ P ∈ S ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segGraph_isLink._simp_1
declarations.type:
∀ {S : Set Schoenflies.Piece} {P : Schoenflies.Piece} {x y : Schoenflies.Plane},
  (Schoenflies.segGraph S).IsLink P x y = (P ∈ S ∧ (x = P.1 ∧ y = P.2 ∨ x = P.2 ∧ y = P.1))

declarations.type: ∀ {S T : Set Schoenflies.Piece}, S ⊆ T → Schoenflies.segGraph S ≤ Schoenflies.segGraph T

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segGraph_vertexSet
declarations.type: ∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Piece), (Schoenflies.segGraph S).vertexSet = {v | ∃ P ∈ S, v = P.1 ∨ v = P.2}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.seg_subset_crosscut
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {a b y q₀ q₁ : Schoenflies.Plane} {J : Schoenflies.Piece},
  (∀ (S : Set Schoenflies.Plane), IsPreconnected S → S ⊆ a.line b ∩ F → y ∈ S → S ⊆ openSegment ℝ q₀ q₁) →
    J.interior ⊆ a.line b ∩ F → y ∈ J.interior → J.seg ⊆ segment ℝ q₀ q₁

declarations.type: ∀ i ≤ 0, ∀ j ≤ 0, ¬i = j → False

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc._proof_2
declarations.type: ∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane}, a ≠ b → ∀ ⦃k l : ℕ⦄, a + ↑k • (b - a) = a + ↑l • (b - a) → k = l

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc._proof_3
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  ∀ i ≤ 0,
    ∀ j ≤ 0,
      i ≠ j →
        segment ℝ (a + ↑i • (b - a)) (a + ↑(i + 1) • (b - a)) ∩ segment ℝ (a + ↑j • (b - a)) (a + ↑(j + 1) • (b - a)) ⊆
          {a + ↑i • (b - a), a + ↑(i + 1) • (b - a)}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc.congr_simp
declarations.type:
∀ {a a_1 : Schoenflies.Plane} (e_a : a = a_1) {b b_1 : Schoenflies.Plane} (e_b : b = b_1) (hab : a ≠ b),

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc_carrier

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc_carrier._proof_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ i ≤ 0, ¬i = 0 → False

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc_vertex_one
declarations.type: ∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane} (hab : a ≠ b), (Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc hab).vertex 1 = b

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc_vertex_zero
declarations.type: ∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane} (hab : a ≠ b), (Schoenflies.segmentPolyArc hab).vertex 0 = a

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_crosscut_at_most_two
declarations.type:
∀ {D : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  a ≠ b →
    IsOpen D →
      IsPreconnected D →
        a ∉ D →
          b ∉ D →
            segment ℝ a b \ {a, b} ⊆ D →
              ∃ zL ∈ D \ segment ℝ a b,
                ∃ zR ∈ D \ segment ℝ a b,
                  ∀ x ∈ D \ segment ℝ a b,
                    x ∈ connectedComponentIn (D \ segment ℝ a b) zL ∨ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (D \ segment ℝ a b) zR

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_eq_hPiece
declarations.type:
∀ (c : ℝ) {lo hi : ℝ},

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_eq_hPiece._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] {a b x : α}, (x ∈ Set.Icc a b) = (a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_eq_radial

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_eq_vPiece
declarations.type:
∀ (c : ℝ) {lo hi : ℝ},

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_eq_vPiece._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] {a b x : α}, (x ∈ Set.Icc a b) = (a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_halves_inter

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_inside_of_ends_outside
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ {u v s t x : Schoenflies.Plane},
      u ∈ segment ℝ a b →
        v ∈ segment ℝ a b →
          s ∈ segment ℝ a b →
            t ∈ segment ℝ a b →
              x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v →
                x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t → s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v → t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v → segment ℝ u v ⊆ segment ℝ s t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_inside_of_ends_outside_oriented
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : Schoenflies.Plane},
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ {u v s t x : Schoenflies.Plane},
      u ∈ segment ℝ a b →
        v ∈ segment ℝ a b →
          dist a u ≤ dist a v →
            s ∈ segment ℝ a b →
              t ∈ segment ℝ a b →
                dist a s ≤ dist a t →
                  x ∈ openSegment ℝ u v →
                    x ∈ openSegment ℝ s t →
                      s ∉ openSegment ℝ u v → t ∉ openSegment ℝ u v → segment ℝ u v ⊆ segment ℝ s t

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_inter_shared._simp_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a b : α}, (a ∈ {b}) = (a = b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.segment_lineMap_image
declarations.type:

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex
declarations.type:
{α β : ℝ} →
  {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} →
    {u w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} →
      {sp : ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane} →
        Schoenflies.IsSetHomeoOn u w C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
          |α| < 1 →
            |β| < 1 →
              ContinuousOn sp unitInterval →
                Set.InjOn sp unitInterval →
                  sp 0 = w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 1) →
                    sp 1 = w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 4) →
                      sp '' unitInterval \ {w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 1), w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 4)} ⊆
                          Schoenflies.inside C →
                        Schoenflies.HexData

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex._proof_1
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : ℝ} {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSetHomeoOn u w C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
    |α| < 1 → |β| < 1 → ∀ (i j : Fin 6), w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β i) = w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β j) → i = j

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex._proof_2
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : ℝ} {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSetHomeoOn u w C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
    |α| < 1 → |β| < 1 → ∀ (i : Fin 6), ContinuousOn (w ∘ Schoenflies.tgtOuter α β i) unitInterval

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex._proof_3
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : ℝ} {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSetHomeoOn u w C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
    |α| < 1 → |β| < 1 → ∀ (i : Fin 6), Set.InjOn (w ∘ Schoenflies.tgtOuter α β i) unitInterval

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex._proof_4
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : ℝ} {w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} (i : Fin 6),
  w (Schoenflies.tgtOuter α β i 0) = w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β i)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex._proof_5
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : ℝ} {w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} (i : Fin 6),
  w (Schoenflies.tgtOuter α β i 1) = w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β (i + 1))

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex._proof_6
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : ℝ} {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSetHomeoOn u w C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
    |α| < 1 →
      |β| < 1 →
        ∀ (i j : Fin 6),
          i ≠ j →
            ∀ ⦃z : Schoenflies.Plane⦄,
              z ∈
                  (fun t => w (Schoenflies.tgtOuter α β i t)) '' unitInterval ∩
                    (fun t => w (Schoenflies.tgtOuter α β j t)) '' unitInterval →
                z ∈
                  {w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β i), w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β (i + 1))} ∩
                    {w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β j), w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β (j + 1))}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sourceHex._proof_7
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : ℝ} {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} {u w : Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane} {sp : ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane},
  Schoenflies.IsSetHomeoOn u w C Schoenflies.modelCurve →
    |α| < 1 →
      |β| < 1 →
        sp '' unitInterval \ {w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 1), w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 4)} ⊆ Schoenflies.inside C →
          ∀ (i : Fin 6) ⦃z : Schoenflies.Plane⦄,
            z ∈ sp '' unitInterval ∩ (fun t => w (Schoenflies.tgtOuter α β i t)) '' unitInterval →
              z ∈ {w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 1), w (Schoenflies.tgtPos α β 4)}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.source_ear_edge_polygonal
declarations.type:

declarations.name: Schoenflies.spokeWalk
declarations.type: ℕ → List Schoenflies.Plane → List Schoenflies.Plane → Schoenflies.Plane → List Schoenflies.Piece

declarations.name: Schoenflies.spokeWalk.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (fresh anchors : List Schoenflies.Plane) (z : Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.spokeWalk N fresh anchors z =
    if h :
        ∃ W,
          (Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).IsPath z W ((↑N)⁻¹ • z) ∧
            ∀ (Q : Schoenflies.Piece),
              Q ∈ W ↔
                Q ∈ (Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).edgeSet ∧ Q.seg ⊆ (Schoenflies.spokePiece N z).seg then
      h.choose
    else []

declarations.name: Schoenflies.spokeWalk_isPath
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {fresh : List Schoenflies.Plane},
      (∀ u ∈ fresh, u ∈ Schoenflies.modelCurve) →
        ∀ (anchors : List Schoenflies.Plane) {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
          z ∈ fresh →
            (Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).IsPath z (Schoenflies.spokeWalk N fresh anchors z) ((↑N)⁻¹ • z)

declarations.type:

        ∀ (anchors : List Schoenflies.Plane) {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
          z ∈ fresh →
            ∀ {Q : Schoenflies.Piece},
              Q ∈ Schoenflies.spokeWalk N fresh anchors z → Q.seg ⊆ (Schoenflies.spokePiece N z).seg

declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {fresh : List Schoenflies.Plane},
      (∀ u ∈ fresh, u ∈ Schoenflies.modelCurve) →
        ∀ (anchors : List Schoenflies.Plane) {z : Schoenflies.Plane},
          z ∈ fresh →
            (Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).IsPath z (Schoenflies.spokeWalk N fresh anchors z) ((↑N)⁻¹ • z) ∧
              ∀ (Q : Schoenflies.Piece),
                Q ∈ Schoenflies.spokeWalk N fresh anchors z ↔
                  Q ∈ (Schoenflies.meshGraph N fresh anchors).edgeSet ∧ Q.seg ⊆ (Schoenflies.spokePiece N z).seg

declarations.type:

      P.Nondeg →
        P.seg ⊆ (Schoenflies.spokePiece N z).seg →
          z = P.1 ∨ z = P.2 → ∃ t₀ < 1, P.interior = (fun t => t • z) '' Set.Ioo t₀ 1

declarations.type: Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ → Schoenflies.Plane → ℝ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord._proof_1
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord._proof_2
declarations.type: (3 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord._proof_3
declarations.type: (5 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) (r : ℝ) (z : Schoenflies.Plane),
  Schoenflies.sqCoord c r z =
    if z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNE r) (c.sqNW r) then dist (c.sqNE r) z
    else
      if z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNW r) (c.sqSW r) then 2 * r + dist (c.sqNW r) z
      else if z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqSW r) (c.sqSE r) then 4 * r + dist (c.sqSW r) z else 6 * r + dist (c.sqSE r) z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord_bottom
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 < r → z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqSW r) (c.sqSE r) → Schoenflies.sqCoord c r z = 4 * r + dist (c.sqSW r) z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord_left
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r → z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNW r) (c.sqSW r) → Schoenflies.sqCoord c r z = 2 * r + dist (c.sqNW r) z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord_right
declarations.type:
∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ},
  0 < r → z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqSE r) (c.sqNE r) → z ≠ c.sqNE r → Schoenflies.sqCoord c r z = 6 * r + dist (c.sqSE r) z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqCoord_top
declarations.type: ∀ {c z : Schoenflies.Plane} {r : ℝ}, z ∈ segment ℝ (c.sqNE r) (c.sqNW r) → Schoenflies.sqCoord c r z = dist (c.sqNE r) z

declarations.name: Schoenflies.sqNW_ne_sqNE

declarations.type:
∀ {fresh anchors : List Schoenflies.Plane},
  (∀ z ∈ fresh, z ∈ Schoenflies.modelCurve) →
    ∀ (delta : ℝ) {dom : Set Schoenflies.Plane},
      (Schoenflies.squareMesh delta fresh anchors).pointSet Schoenflies.segmentDrawing ⊆ dom →
        ∀ ⦃f : Schoenflies.Piece⦄,
          f ∈ (Schoenflies.squareMesh delta fresh anchors).edgeSet →
            Graph.edgeArc Schoenflies.segmentDrawing f ⊆ Schoenflies.modelCurve ∨
              Schoenflies.IsPolygonal (Graph.edgeArc Schoenflies.segmentDrawing f) ∧
                Graph.edgeArc Schoenflies.segmentDrawing f \ (Schoenflies.squareMesh delta fresh anchors).vertexSet ⊆
                  dom \ Schoenflies.modelCurve

declarations.name: Schoenflies.squareMesh_edge_dichotomy._simp_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a b : α}, (a ∈ {b}) = (a = b)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.squareMesh_face_small
declarations.type:

  (∀ z ∈ fresh, z ∈ Schoenflies.modelCurve) →
    ∀ {δ : ℝ},
      0 < δ →
        Schoenflies.FreshDense fresh δ →
          ∀ {anchors : List Schoenflies.Plane} {base : Schoenflies.Plane},
            base ∈ (Schoenflies.squareMesh δ fresh anchors).exterior Schoenflies.segmentDrawing →
              Bornology.IsBounded ((Schoenflies.squareMesh δ fresh anchors).face Schoenflies.segmentDrawing base) →
                (Schoenflies.squareMesh δ fresh anchors).face Schoenflies.segmentDrawing base ⊆
                    Schoenflies.Plane.openSquare 0 1 ∧
                  Metric.diam ((Schoenflies.squareMesh δ fresh anchors).face Schoenflies.segmentDrawing base) < δ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.squarePolygon._proof_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) {r : ℝ},
  0 < r →
    ∀ ⦃i j : ZMod (1 + 3)⦄,
      ![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] i = ![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] j → i = j

declarations.name: Schoenflies.squarePolygon._proof_2
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) {r : ℝ},
  0 < r →
    ∀ (i j : ZMod (1 + 3)),
      i ≠ j →
        segment ℝ (![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] i) (![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] (i + 1)) ∩
            segment ℝ (![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] j)
              (![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] (j + 1)) ⊆
          {![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] i, ![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] (i + 1)}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.squarePolygon._proof_3
declarations.type:
∀ (c : Schoenflies.Plane) {r : ℝ},
  0 < r →
    ∀ (i : ZMod (1 + 3)),
      (![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] (i - 1) - ![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] i).det
          (![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] (i + 1) - ![c.sqNE r, c.sqNW r, c.sqSW r, c.sqSE r] i) ≠
        0

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph
declarations.type: {γ : Type u_1} → (H : Graph γ γ) → γ → γ → γ → γ → (e₁ e₂ : γ) → e₁ ≠ e₂ → e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet → e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet → Graph γ γ

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph._proof_1
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} (H : Graph γ γ) (e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ),
  e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet →
      e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet →
        ∀ x_1 ∈ H.edgeSet \ {e} ∪ {f | (f = e₁ ∨ f = e₂) ∧ H.IsLink e x y},
          Std.Symm fun a b =>
            H.IsLink x_1 a b ∧ x_1 ≠ e ∧ x_1 ≠ e₁ ∧ x_1 ≠ e₂ ∨
              x_1 = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(x, v) ∨ x_1 = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(v, y)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph._proof_2
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} (H : Graph γ γ) (e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ),
  e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    ∀ ⦃f a b c d : γ⦄,
      H.IsLink f a b ∧ f ≠ e ∧ f ≠ e₁ ∧ f ≠ e₂ ∨
          f = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(x, v) ∨ f = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(v, y) →
        H.IsLink f c d ∧ f ≠ e ∧ f ≠ e₁ ∧ f ≠ e₂ ∨
            f = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(c, d) = s(x, v) ∨ f = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(c, d) = s(v, y) →
          a = c ∨ a = d

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph._proof_3
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} (H : Graph γ γ) (e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ),
  e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet →
      e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet →
        ∀ (f : γ),
          f ∈ H.edgeSet \ {e} ∪ {f | (f = e₁ ∨ f = e₂) ∧ H.IsLink e x y} ↔
            ∃ x_1 y_1,
              H.IsLink f x_1 y_1 ∧ f ≠ e ∧ f ≠ e₁ ∧ f ≠ e₂ ∨
                f = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(x_1, y_1) = s(x, v) ∨ f = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(x_1, y_1) = s(v, y)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph._proof_4
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} (H : Graph γ γ) (e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ),
  e₁ ≠ e₂ →
    e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet →
      e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet →
        ∀ ⦃f a b : γ⦄,
          H.IsLink f a b ∧ f ≠ e ∧ f ≠ e₁ ∧ f ≠ e₂ ∨
              f = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(x, v) ∨ f = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(v, y) →
            a ∈ H.vertexSet ∪ {z | z = v ∧ H.IsLink e x y}

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph.congr_simp
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} (H H_1 : Graph γ γ) (e_H : H = H_1) (e e_1 : γ),
  e = e_1 →
    ∀ (x x_1 : γ),
      x = x_1 →
        ∀ (y y_1 : γ),
          y = y_1 →
            ∀ (v v_1 : γ),
              v = v_1 →
                ∀ (e₁ e₁_1 : γ) (e_e₁ : e₁ = e₁_1) (e₂ e₂_1 : γ) (e_e₂ : e₂ = e₂_1) (hne : e₁ ≠ e₂)
                  (h₁ : e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet) (h₂ : e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet),
                  Schoenflies.subdivGraph H e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁ h₂ =
                    Schoenflies.subdivGraph H_1 e_1 x_1 y_1 v_1 e₁_1 e₂_1 ⋯ ⋯ ⋯

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph_edgeSet
Schoenflies.subdivGraph_eq_self
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {H : Graph γ γ} {e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ} {hne : e₁ ≠ e₂} {h₁ : e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet} {h₂ : e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet},
  e ∉ H.edgeSet → Schoenflies.subdivGraph H e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁ h₂ = H

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph_eq_self._simp_1_2
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {H : Graph γ γ} {e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ} {hne : e₁ ≠ e₂} {h₁ : e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet} {h₂ : e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet}
  {f a b : γ},
  (Schoenflies.subdivGraph H e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁ h₂).IsLink f a b =
    (H.IsLink f a b ∧ f ≠ e ∧ f ≠ e₁ ∧ f ≠ e₂ ∨
      f = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(x, v) ∨ f = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(v, y))

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph_isLink
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {H : Graph γ γ} {e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ} {hne : e₁ ≠ e₂} {h₁ : e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet} {h₂ : e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet}
  {f a b : γ},
  (Schoenflies.subdivGraph H e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁ h₂).IsLink f a b ↔
    H.IsLink f a b ∧ f ≠ e ∧ f ≠ e₁ ∧ f ≠ e₂ ∨
      f = e₁ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(x, v) ∨ f = e₂ ∧ H.IsLink e x y ∧ s(a, b) = s(v, y)

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph_mono
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {H K : Graph γ γ} {e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ},
  H ≤ K →
    ∀ {hne : e₁ ≠ e₂} {h₁ : e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet} {h₂ : e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet} {h₁' : e₁ ∉ K.edgeSet} {h₂' : e₂ ∉ K.edgeSet},
      Schoenflies.subdivGraph H e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁ h₂ ≤ Schoenflies.subdivGraph K e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁' h₂'

declarations.name: Schoenflies.subdivGraph_vertexSet
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {H : Graph γ γ} {e x y v e₁ e₂ : γ} {hne : e₁ ≠ e₂} {h₁ : e₁ ∉ H.edgeSet} {h₂ : e₂ ∉ H.edgeSet},
  (Schoenflies.subdivGraph H e x y v e₁ e₂ hne h₁ h₂).vertexSet = H.vertexSet ∪ {z | z = v ∧ H.IsLink e x y}

∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.Plane M] {m : ℕ}
  {X : M → TightVer401.Manifold.ThreeSpace} {Y : Fin m → M → TightVer401.Manifold.ThreeSpace},
  ContMDiff OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ TightVer401.Manifold.ThreeSpace) (↑⊤) X →
    (∀ (k : Fin m), TightVer401.Manifold.IsBending X (Y k)) →
      (∀ (k l : Fin m), k ≠ l → Disjoint (tsupport (Y k)) (tsupport (Y l))) →
        ∀ (a ε : Fin m → ℝ),
          (∀ (k : Fin m), ε k ^ 2 = 1) →
            ∀ (p : M) (v w : TangentSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel p),
              OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (X + ∑ k, (ε k * a k) • Y k) p v w =
