declarations.type:
{RN mu h : ℝ} →
  {motive : TightVer401.ParabolicConvexClosureData RN mu h → Sort u} →
    (t : TightVer401.ParabolicConvexClosureData RN mu h) →
      ((toProtectedParabolicMeridianInput : TightVer401.ProtectedParabolicMeridianInput RN mu h) →
          (radius_pos : 0 < RN) →
            (coefficient_pos : 0 < mu) →
              (height_pos : 0 < h) →
                (second_negative :
                    ∀ z ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h, deriv (deriv toProtectedParabolicMeridianInput.meridian) z < 0) →
                  (strictConcave : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-h) h) toProtectedParabolicMeridianInput.meridian) →
                    (lower_endpoint : toProtectedParabolicMeridianInput.meridian (-h) = RN) →
                      (upper_endpoint : toProtectedParabolicMeridianInput.meridian h = RN) →
                        (collarWidth : ℝ) →
                          (collarWidth_mem : collarWidth ∈ Set.Ioo 0 h) →
                            (lower_germ :
                                Set.EqOn toProtectedParabolicMeridianInput.meridian (fun z => RN + √(2 * mu * (h + z)))
                                  (Set.Icc (-h) (-h + collarWidth))) →
                              (upper_germ :
                                  Set.EqOn toProtectedParabolicMeridianInput.meridian
                                    (fun z => RN + √(2 * mu * (h - z))) (Set.Icc (h - collarWidth) h)) →

                                        (TightVer401.positiveExitFermiHeight Ge ζ)

          ContinuousOn saddle (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) →
            ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤)
                saddle (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi) →
              (∀ p ∈ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi, Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% saddle p)) →
                Set.InjOn saddle (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) →
                  (∀ p ∈ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi, ‖TightVer401.corrugatedAmbientHorizontalCLM (saddle p)‖ < RN) →
                    (∃ ε > 0,
                        ε < Real.pi / 2 ∧
                          ∀ (q : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)),
                            ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc 0 ε,
                              saddle (q, u) =
                                TightVer401.protectedTorusSouthCollar RN μ h
                                  (q, -TightVer401.protectedTorusCollarScale h μ * Real.sin (u / 2))) →
                      (∃ ε > 0,
                          ε < Real.pi / 2 ∧
                            ∀ (q : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)),
                              ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (Real.pi - ε) Real.pi,
                                saddle (q, u) =
                                  TightVer401.protectedTorusNorthCollar RN μ h
                                    (q, -TightVer401.protectedTorusCollarScale h μ * Real.cos (u / 2))) →
                        (meridian : ℝ → ℝ) →
                          ContinuousOn meridian (Set.Icc (-h) h) →
                            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) meridian (Set.Ioo (-h) h) →
                              (∀ z ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h, RN < meridian z) →
                                (∃ ε > 0, ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (h - ε) h, meridian z = RN + √(2 * μ * (h - z))) →
                                  (∃ ε > 0, ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (-h) (-h + ε), meridian z = RN + √(2 * μ * (h + z))) →

                          (TightVer401.affineMarkedTorusLinearBase X + t • TightVer401.affineMarkedTorusLinearBending Y)

declarations.name: TightVer401.angularDescentPotential_cartesian_gradient
declarations.type:
∀ {W : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
    (∀ (r theta : ℝ), W ![r, theta + 2 * Real.pi] = W ![r, theta]) →
      ∀ {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        0 < q 0 →
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential W)
                (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q) =
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 W q * Real.cos (q 1) -
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 W q / q 0 * Real.sin (q 1) ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential W)
                (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q) =
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 W q * Real.sin (q 1) +
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 W q / q 0 * Real.cos (q 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.angularDescentPotential_exists_branch_neighborhood
declarations.type:
∀ {W : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
    (∀ (r theta : ℝ), W ![r, theta + 2 * Real.pi] = W ![r, theta]) →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
          ∃ U G,
            IsOpen U ∧
              p ∈ U ∧
                U ⊆ {q | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius q} ∧
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U ∧
                    Set.EqOn (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential W) G U ∧
                      ((G = fun q => W ![TightVer401.planarRadius q, (TightVer401.angularDescentComplex q).arg]) ∨
                        G = fun q =>
                          W ![TightVer401.planarRadius q, (-TightVer401.angularDescentComplex q).arg - Real.pi])

      ∀ {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        0 < q 0 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i W q =
              ∑ a,

                    (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q) *

        0 < q 0 →
          TightVer401.planarHessian W q 0 0 < 0 →
            0 < TightVer401.planarHessian W q 1 1 + q 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 W q →
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature

                    (TightVer401.planarSupportMap (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential W)))
                  (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q) <

declarations.name: TightVer401.angularDescentPotential_hessian_det
declarations.type:
∀ {W : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
    (∀ (r theta : ℝ), W ![r, theta + 2 * Real.pi] = W ![r, theta]) →
      ∀ {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        0 < q 0 →
          (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential W) (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q)).det =
            (TightVer401.planarHessian W q 0 0 *
                  (TightVer401.planarHessian W q 1 1 + q 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 W q) -
                (TightVer401.planarHessian W q 0 1 - OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 W q / q 0) ^ 2) /
              q 0 ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.angularDescentPotential_second_chain_rule
declarations.type:
∀ {W : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
    (∀ (r theta : ℝ), W ![r, theta + 2 * Real.pi] = W ![r, theta]) →
      ∀ {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

          ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
            TightVer401.planarHessian W q i j =

                      TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential W)
                        (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q) *

                      (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q) *

                  (∀ (t : ℝ), ↑(v t) = OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.normalizedArgument (F (γ t) - y)) ∧
                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                        (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γ =
                      v 1 - v 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.annularAngularForm_integral_eq_interior
declarations.type:
∀ {F : ℂ → ℂ} {O : Set ℂ},

      ∀ {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
          (∀ (t : ℝ), γ t ∈ O) →
            γ 1 = γ 0 →
              ∀ (H : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ),
                Set.range (F ∘ γ) ⊆ frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H) →
                  ∀ (y z : ℂ),
                    y ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H →
                      z ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H →
                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                            (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γ =
                          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F z)
                            (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F z) γ

                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP f y)
                        (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ f y) γ =

declarations.name: TightVer401.annularAngularForm_integral_eq_pathIncrement
declarations.type:
∀ {F : ℂ → ℂ} {O : Set ℂ} (hO : IsOpen O) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F O) {γ : ℝ → ℂ} (hγ : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ)
  (hγO : ∀ (t : ℝ), γ t ∈ O) (y : ℂ) (hAvoid : ∀ (t : ℝ), F (γ t) ≠ y),
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
      (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γ =

declarations.name: TightVer401.annularAngularForm_integral_profile
declarations.type:
∀ {F : ℂ → ℂ} {O : Set ℂ},

      ∀ {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
          (∀ (t : ℝ), γ t ∈ O) →
            γ 1 = γ 0 →
              ∀ (H : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ),
                Set.range (F ∘ γ) = frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H) →
                  ∀ z ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H,
                    ∀ (w : ℝ),
                      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F z)
                            (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F z) γ =

                        (∀ y ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H,
                            OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γ =
                              w) ∧
                          ∀ y ∉ closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H),
                            OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γ =
                              0

        ∀ {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},

              (∀ (t : ℝ), γouter t ∈ O) →

                  γouter 1 = γouter 0 →
                    γinner 1 = γinner 0 →
                      ↑(TightVer401.annularBoundaryDegree F γouter γinner y) =
                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                            (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γouter -

                            (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γinner

declarations.type:

  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Houter γouter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Hinner γinner →
      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
        ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (O : Set ℂ),
          IsOpen O →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F O →
              TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ⊆ O →
                ∀
                  y ∉
                    F ''
                      (frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter) ∪
                        frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner)),
                  ↑(TightVer401.annularBoundaryDegree F γouter γinner y) =
                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                        (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γouter -
                      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                        (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γinner

declarations.name: TightVer401.annularBoundaryDegree_eq_actual_sign_mul_ncard
declarations.type:
∀ {Houter Hinner : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Houter γouter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Hinner γinner →
      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral (fun x => 1) (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.centeredArgument (Houter 0))
              γouter =
            1 →
          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral (fun x => 1)
                (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.centeredArgument (Hinner 0)) γinner =
              1 →
            ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (O : Set ℂ),
              IsOpen O →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F O →
                  TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ⊆ O →
                    ∀ (s : ℤ),
                      s = 1 ∨ s = -1 →
                        (∀ z ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanInterior Houter Hinner, 0 < ↑s * (fderiv ℝ F z).det) →
                          ∀
                            y ∉
                              F ''
                                (frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter) ∪
                                  frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner)),
                            TightVer401.annularBoundaryDegree F γouter γinner y =
                              s * ↑{x | x ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ∧ F x = y}.ncard

declarations.type:

  {y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {s : ℤ},
  (TightVer401.annularFiber F K y).Finite →

      (∀ x ∈ TightVer401.annularFiber F K y, 0 < ↑s * TightVer401.annularJacobian F x) →
        TightVer401.annularSignedPreimageCount F K y = s * ↑(TightVer401.annularFiber F K y).ncard

  {y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {s : ℤ},
  (TightVer401.annularFiber F K y).Finite →

      (∀ x ∈ TightVer401.annularFiber F K y, 0 < ↑s * TightVer401.annularJacobian F x) →
        (TightVer401.annularSignedPreimageCount F K y).natAbs = (TightVer401.annularFiber F K y).ncard

  IsCompact K →
    ContinuousOn F K →

              TightVer401.annularSignedPreimageCount F K y = s * ↑(TightVer401.annularFiber F K y).ncard

declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_area_pullback_curl
declarations.type:

    (fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.annularAreaPullbackQ F) z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.annularAreaPullbackP F) z) Complex.I =

            OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAreaPullbackP F)
                (TightVer401.annularAreaPullbackQ F) γ =
              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (fun x => 0) Complex.re (F ∘ γ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_boundary_green_excision
declarations.type:
∀ {Houter Hinner : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Houter γouter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Hinner γinner →
      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
        ∃ εouter εinner,
          |εouter| = 1 ∧
            |εinner| = 1 ∧
              ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℂ) (r : Fin n → ℝ),
                (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < r i) →
                  Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun i => Metric.closedBall (c i) (r i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin n),
                        Metric.closedBall (c i) (r i) ⊆
                          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter \
                            closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner)) →
                      ∀ (O : Set ℂ),
                        IsOpen O →
                          TightVer401.annularGreenCore Houter Hinner c r ⊆ O →
                            ∀ (P Q : ℂ → ℝ),
                              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) P O →
                                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Q O →
                                  (∀ z ∈ O, (fderiv ℝ Q z) 1 = (fderiv ℝ P z) Complex.I) →
                                    εouter * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γouter -
                                        εinner * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γinner =
                                      ∑ i,
                                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q
                                          (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam (c i) (r i))

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_boundary_green_excision_with_orientation
declarations.type:
∀ {Houter Hinner : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Houter γouter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Hinner γinner →
      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
        ∃ εouter εinner,
          |εouter| = 1 ∧
            |εinner| = 1 ∧
              (∀ (P Q : ℂ → ℝ),
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
                      εouter * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γouter =
                        ∫ (z : ℂ) in OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter,
                          (fderiv ℝ Q z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ P z) Complex.I) ∧
                (∀ (P Q : ℂ → ℝ),
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
                        εinner * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γinner =
                          ∫ (z : ℂ) in OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner,
                            (fderiv ℝ Q z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ P z) Complex.I) ∧
                  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℂ) (r : Fin n → ℝ),
                    (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < r i) →
                      Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun i => Metric.closedBall (c i) (r i)) →
                        (∀ (i : Fin n),
                            Metric.closedBall (c i) (r i) ⊆
                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter \
                                closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner)) →
                          ∀ (O : Set ℂ),
                            IsOpen O →
                              TightVer401.annularGreenCore Houter Hinner c r ⊆ O →
                                ∀ (P Q : ℂ → ℝ),
                                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) P O →
                                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Q O →
                                      (∀ z ∈ O, (fderiv ℝ Q z) 1 = (fderiv ℝ P z) Complex.I) →
                                        εouter * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γouter -
                                            εinner * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γinner =
                                          ∑ i,
                                            OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q
                                              (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam (c i) (r i))

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_boundary_union_homeomorph_of_components
declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {So Si To Ti : Set ℂ},
  IsCompact (So ∪ Si) →
    ContinuousOn f (So ∪ Si) →
      Disjoint To Ti →
        ∀ (Bo : ↑So ≃ₜ ↑To) (Bi : ↑Si ≃ₜ ↑Ti),
          (∀ (x : ↑So), ↑(Bo x) = f ↑x) → (∀ (x : ↑Si), ↑(Bi x) = f ↑x) → ∃ B, ∀ (x : ↑(So ∪ Si)), ↑(B x) = f ↑x

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_boundary_union_map_properties
declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {So Si To Ti : Set ℂ},
  Disjoint To Ti →
    ∀ (Bo : ↑So ≃ₜ ↑To) (Bi : ↑Si ≃ₜ ↑Ti),
      (∀ (x : ↑So), ↑(Bo x) = f ↑x) →
        (∀ (x : ↑Si), ↑(Bi x) = f ↑x) →
          Set.MapsTo f (So ∪ Si) (To ∪ Ti) ∧ Set.InjOn f (So ∪ Si) ∧ Set.SurjOn f (So ∪ Si) (To ∪ Ti)

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_boundary_winding_profile_of_one_point
declarations.type:
∀ {F : ℂ → ℂ} {O : Set ℂ},
  IsOpen O →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F O →
      ∀ {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γouter →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γinner →
            (∀ (t : ℝ), γouter t ∈ O) →
              (∀ (t : ℝ), γinner t ∈ O) →
                γouter 1 = γouter 0 →
                  γinner 1 = γinner 0 →
                    ∀ (Houter Hinner : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ),
                      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆
                          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
                        Set.range (F ∘ γouter) = frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter) →
                          Set.range (F ∘ γinner) = frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) →
                            ∀ (w : ℝ),
                              |w| = 1 →
                                OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                      (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F (Houter 0))
                                      (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F (Houter 0)) γouter =
                                    w →
                                  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                        (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F (Hinner 0))
                                        (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F (Hinner 0)) γinner =
                                      w →
                                    (∀ y ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanForbidden Houter Hinner,
                                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                              (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                              (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γouter -
                                            OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                              (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                              (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γinner =
                                          0) ∧
                                      ∀ y ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanInterior Houter Hinner,
                                        |OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                                (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                                (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γouter -
                                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                                (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                                (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γinner| =
                                          1

declarations.type:

  DifferentiableAt ℝ F x →
    ∀ (hi : Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ F x)),

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_complex_boundary_preimage_formula
declarations.type:
∀ {Houter Hinner : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Houter γouter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Hinner γinner →
      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
        ∃ εouter εinner,
          |εouter| = 1 ∧
            |εinner| = 1 ∧
              ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (O : Set ℂ),
                IsOpen O →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F O →
                    TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ⊆ O →
                      ∀ (s : ℝ),
                        |s| = 1 →
                          (∀ z ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanInterior Houter Hinner, 0 < s * (fderiv ℝ F z).det) →
                            ∀
                              y ∉
                                F ''
                                  (frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter) ∪
                                    frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner)),
                              εouter *
                                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                      (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γouter -
                                  εinner *
                                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                      (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γinner =
                                s * ↑{x | x ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ∧ F x = y}.ncard

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_complex_boundary_preimage_formula_with_orientation
declarations.type:
∀ {Houter Hinner : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Houter γouter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Hinner γinner →
      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
        ∃ εouter εinner,
          |εouter| = 1 ∧
            |εinner| = 1 ∧
              (∀ (P Q : ℂ → ℝ),
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
                      εouter * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γouter =
                        ∫ (z : ℂ) in OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter,
                          (fderiv ℝ Q z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ P z) Complex.I) ∧
                (∀ (P Q : ℂ → ℝ),
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
                        εinner * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γinner =
                          ∫ (z : ℂ) in OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner,
                            (fderiv ℝ Q z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ P z) Complex.I) ∧
                  ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (O : Set ℂ),
                    IsOpen O →
                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F O →
                        TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ⊆ O →
                          ∀ (s : ℝ),
                            |s| = 1 →
                              (∀ z ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanInterior Houter Hinner, 0 < s * (fderiv ℝ F z).det) →
                                ∀
                                  y ∉
                                    F ''
                                      (frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter) ∪
                                        frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner)),
                                  εouter *
                                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                          (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y) (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y)
                                          γouter -
                                      εinner *
                                        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral
                                          (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y) (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y)
                                          γinner =
                                    s * ↑{x | x ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ∧ F x = y}.ncard

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_complex_positive_boundary_preimage_formula
declarations.type:
∀ {Houter Hinner : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γouter γinner : ℝ → ℂ},
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Houter γouter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization Hinner γinner →
      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter →
        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral (fun x => 1) (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.centeredArgument (Houter 0))
              γouter =
            1 →
          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral (fun x => 1)
                (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.centeredArgument (Hinner 0)) γinner =
              1 →
            ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (O : Set ℂ),
              IsOpen O →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F O →
                  TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ⊆ O →
                    ∀ (s : ℝ),
                      |s| = 1 →
                        (∀ z ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanInterior Houter Hinner, 0 < s * (fderiv ℝ F z).det) →
                          ∀
                            y ∉
                              F ''
                                (frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Houter) ∪
                                  frontier (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hinner)),
                            OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                  (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γouter -
                                OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral (TightVer401.annularAngularFormP F y)
                                  (TightVer401.annularAngularFormQ F y) γinner =
                              s * ↑{x | x ∈ TightVer401.annularJordanClosure Houter Hinner ∧ F x = y}.ncard

  IsCompact K →
    ContinuousOn F K →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F (interior K) →
        s = 1 ∨ s = -1 →
          (∀ x ∈ interior K, 0 < ↑s * TightVer401.annularJacobian F x) →

              interior L = V →
                closure V = L →

                    Set.InjOn F (frontier K) →

declarations.type:

  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization H γ →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral (fun x => 1) (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.centeredArgument (H 0)) γ = 1

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_regular_image_circle_argument_sign
declarations.type:
∀ {F : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ},
  IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F U →
      ∀ (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ},
        0 < r →
          Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ U →
            ∀ (s : ℝ),
              |s| = 1 →
                (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, 0 < s * (fderiv ℝ F z).det) →
                  ∀ (H : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ),
                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization H
                        (F ∘ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam c r) →
                      ∀ y ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H,
                        ∃ v,
                          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) v ∧
                            (∀ (t : ℝ),
                                ↑(v t) =
                                  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.FiniteTransfer.normalizedArgument
                                    (F (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam c r t) - y)) ∧
                              v 1 - v 0 = s

declarations.name: TightVer401.annular_source_orientation_eq_argument_integral
declarations.type:
∀ {H : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ} {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.RegularJordanParametrization H γ →
    ∀ (ε : ℝ),
      (∀ (P Q : ℂ → ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
              ε * OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarFormIntegral P Q γ =
                ∫ (z : ℂ) in OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior H, (fderiv ℝ Q z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ P z) Complex.I) →
        ε = OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.circleFormIntegral (fun x => 1) (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.centeredArgument (H 0)) γ

      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) φ →

      ∀ (ε : ℝ) (p : AddCircle L × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 b)) (v w : ℝ × ℝ),

declarations.name: TightVer401.bandBending_compact_actual_curvature_threshold
declarations.type:

  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U →
    TightVer401.IsInfinitesimalBendingOn X Y U →
      IsOpen U →
        (∀ p ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ X p)) →
          IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ U →
              (∀ p ∈ K, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric X) p < 0) →
                ∃ δ > 0,
                  ∀ (a : ℝ),
                    |a| < δ →
                      ∀ p ∈ K,
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                            (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric fun q => X q + a • Y q) p <
                          0

declarations.type:
∀ {L b : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < L)] {φ Y : AddCircle L × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 b) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContMDiff ((modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ).prod (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ))
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) φ →
    ContMDiff ((modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ).prod (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ))
        (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) Y →
      ∀ (ε : ℝ) (p : AddCircle L × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 b)) (v w : ℝ × ℝ),
        TightVer401.bandInducedForm (φ + ε • Y) p v w =
          TightVer401.bandInducedForm φ p v w +
              ε *
                (inner ℝ ((TightVer401.bandDifferential φ p) v) ((TightVer401.bandDifferential Y p) w) +
                  inner ℝ ((TightVer401.bandDifferential Y p) v) ((TightVer401.bandDifferential φ p) w)) +
            ε ^ 2 * TightVer401.bandInducedForm Y p v w

declarations.name: TightVer401.bandProfile.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} (k τ ρ W : A → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (T n : A → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) {b : ℝ}
  (p : A × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 b)),
  TightVer401.bandProfile k τ ρ W F T n p =
    (τ p.1 * ↑p.2 / (2 * ρ p.1) * deriv F (1 / (ρ p.1 * ↑p.2) - W p.1)) • T p.1 +
      (↑p.2 * F (1 / (ρ p.1 * ↑p.2) - W p.1) -
          (1 - k p.1 * ↑p.2) / (2 * ρ p.1) * deriv F (1 / (ρ p.1 * ↑p.2) - W p.1)) •
        n p.1

    TightVer401.NativeTorusSmoothEmbedding X →
      TightVer401.NativeTorusSmoothEmbedding Y →

            TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm X p v w = TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm Y p v w) →
          Set.range X = Set.range Y →

TightVer401.ClassicalEmbeddedImageReparametrizationClaim →
  ∀ (X Y : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
    TightVer401.NativeTorusSmoothEmbedding X →
      TightVer401.NativeTorusSmoothEmbedding Y →
        Set.range X = Set.range Y →
          ∃ e,
            ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel ↑⊤ ⇑e ∧
              ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel ↑⊤ ⇑e.symm ∧

declarations.type:
TightVer401.ClassicalExternalResults →
  ∀ (X : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
    TightVer401.NativeTorusSmoothEmbedding X →
      ∀ (N : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere),
        ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤) N →
          (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource) (v : ℝ × ℝ), inner ℝ (↑(N p)) ((mfderiv% X p) v) = 0) →
            ∀ (E : Set ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere),
              E.Finite →
                ∀ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere),
                  e.source = TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion X →
                    e.target = Set.univ \ E →
                      Set.EqOn (↑e) N e.source →
                        ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
                            (↑⊤) (↑e) e.source →
                          ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) TightVer401.nativeProductModel
                              (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltFirst
declarations.type: ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltFirst.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (w u : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ),
  TightVer401.compactTiltFirst L w u k = ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, w x * Real.exp (-k * u x) * u x

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltFirst_eventually_ratio_lt
declarations.type:
∀ {w u : ℝ → ℝ},
  Continuous w →
    Continuous u →
      ∀ {L A B c η : ℝ},
        0 < L →
          0 < A →
            0 ≤ B →
              (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, A ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ B ∧ u x ∈ Set.Icc 0 2) →
                c ∈ Set.Icc 0 L →
                  u c = 0 →
                    0 < η →
                      ∀ᶠ (k : ℝ) in Filter.atTop,
                        TightVer401.compactTiltFirst L w u k / TightVer401.compactTiltMass L w u k < η

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltFirst_nonneg
declarations.type: ∀ {w u : ℝ → ℝ} {L k : ℝ}, 0 ≤ L → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, 0 ≤ w x ∧ 0 ≤ u x) → 0 ≤ TightVer401.compactTiltFirst L w u k

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltFirst_ratio_tendsto_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {w u : ℝ → ℝ},
  Continuous w →
    Continuous u →
      ∀ {L A B c : ℝ},
        0 < L →
          0 < A →
            0 ≤ B →
              (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, A ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ B ∧ u x ∈ Set.Icc 0 2) →
                c ∈ Set.Icc 0 L →
                  u c = 0 →
                    Filter.Tendsto (fun k => TightVer401.compactTiltFirst L w u k / TightVer401.compactTiltMass L w u k)
                      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltFirst_upper
declarations.type:
∀ {w u : ℝ → ℝ},
  Continuous w →
    Continuous u →
      ∀ {L k B δ : ℝ},
        0 ≤ L →
          0 ≤ k →
            0 ≤ B →
              0 ≤ δ →
                (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, w x ∈ Set.Icc 0 B ∧ u x ∈ Set.Icc 0 2) →
                  TightVer401.compactTiltFirst L w u k ≤
                    δ * TightVer401.compactTiltMass L w u k + L * (2 * B * Real.exp (-k * δ))

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltMass.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (L : ℝ) (w u : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ), TightVer401.compactTiltMass L w u k = ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, w x * Real.exp (-k * u x)

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltMass_lower
declarations.type:
∀ {w u : ℝ → ℝ},
  Continuous w →
    Continuous u →
      ∀ {L p q k A δ : ℝ},
        0 ≤ k →
          0 ≤ A →
            0 ≤ p →
              p ≤ q →
                q ≤ L →
                  (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, 0 ≤ w x) →
                    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc p q, A ≤ w x ∧ u x ≤ δ / 2) →
                      (q - p) * A * Real.exp (-k * (δ / 2)) ≤ TightVer401.compactTiltMass L w u k

declarations.name: TightVer401.compactTiltMass_pos
declarations.type:
∀ {w u : ℝ → ℝ},
  Continuous w →
    Continuous u → ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, 0 < w x) → ∀ (k : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.compactTiltMass L w u k

                        ∀ (q : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)),

                            (A + B * (u - Real.pi / 2) ^ 2) • TightVer401.revolutionCircleRadial q +

                  (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
                    (∀ p ∈ e.source, (TightVer401.planarHessian G p).det < 0) →

                            StrictMonoOn β (Set.Icc (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi) →
                              β (Real.pi / 2) = A →
                                β Real.pi = RN →
                                  (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi, 0 < deriv β u) →
                                    (β =ᶠ[nhds (Real.pi / 2)] fun u => A + B * (u - Real.pi / 2) ^ 2) →

                                            (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric
                                              (TightVer401.nativeProductPlaneCoordinateMap
                                                (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusCylinderMap G e A RN d0 dInfinity β)
                                                p))
                                            ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.finTwoArrow ℝ ℝ).symm
                                              (↑(chartAt (ModelProd ℝ ℝ) p) p)) <

declarations.name: TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusCylinderMap_quadratic_formula
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) {A RN μ ε d0 dInfinity : ℝ},
  0 < A →
    0 < μ →
      e.source = {p | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p} →
        e.target = TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingOpenAnnulus A RN →
          (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                  TightVer401.planarRadius p < ε →
                    G p = RN * TightVer401.planarRadius p - μ * TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 2 / 2 + d0) →
              ∀ {β : ℝ → ℝ} (q : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) {u t : ℝ},
                β (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusCylinderPhase u) = RN + μ * t →
                  t ≤ 0 →
                    A < RN + μ * t →
                      -t < ε →
                        TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusCylinderMap G e A RN d0 dInfinity β (q, u) =
                          (RN + μ * t) • TightVer401.revolutionCircleRadial q +
                            (if u ≤ Real.pi / 2 then -(dInfinity - d0) + μ * t ^ 2 / 2

                              TightVer401.revolutionAxis

            RN + μ * TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusSouthTransverse h μ u

declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
  {A RN μ B ε L d0 dInfinity : ℝ},
  0 < A →
    A < RN →
      0 < μ →
        0 < B →
          0 < ε →
            0 < L →
              e.source = {p | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p} →
                e.target = TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingOpenAnnulus A RN →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
                        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                            0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                              TightVer401.planarRadius p < ε →
                                G p = RN * TightVer401.planarRadius p - μ * TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 2 / 2 + d0) →
                          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                              L < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                                G p = A * TightVer401.planarRadius p - B / TightVer401.planarRadius p + dInfinity) →
                            (∀ y ∈ e.target,
                                0 < (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusUpperGraph G e dInfinity y).ofLp 2 ∧
                                  (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusUpperGraph G e dInfinity y).ofLp 2 <
                                      dInfinity - d0 ∧
                                    -(dInfinity - d0) <
                                        (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusLowerGraph G e dInfinity y).ofLp 2 ∧
                                      (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusLowerGraph G e dInfinity y).ofLp 2 < 0) ∧
                              Disjoint (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusUpperGraph G e dInfinity '' e.target)
                                (TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusLowerGraph G e dInfinity '' e.target)

                                          F '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F ∧

                                            F '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F ∧

declarations.type:

  {K : Set (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w))},
  TightVer401.ClassicalExternalResults →
    ∀ (Q : TightVer401.CompletedSaddleAnnulusGeometryOutput d K RN μ h)
      (Cdata : TightVer401.ProtectedTorusActualGraphCylinderData Q.cylinder)
      (D : TightVer401.ParabolicConvexClosureData RN μ h),
      0 < w →
        ∀ {Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
          TightVer401.IsBandBending d.bandMap Y →
            HasCompactSupport Y →
              (∃ p, Y p ≠ 0) →
                tsupport Y ⊆ K →
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤)
                      (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d (TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandAffine Q)
                        ↑TightVer401.torusAffineMarkerLinearEquiv) →
                    TightVer401.IsInfinitesimalBendingOn
                        (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d (TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandAffine Q)
                          ↑TightVer401.torusAffineMarkerLinearEquiv)
                        (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateField Y (TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandAffine Q)
                          ↑TightVer401.torusAffineMarkerContraLinearEquiv)
                        (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateDomain w) →
                      (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateDomain w,
                          Function.Injective
                            ⇑(fderiv ℝ
                                (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d
                                  (TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandAffine Q)
                                  ↑TightVer401.torusAffineMarkerLinearEquiv)
                                q)) →
                        (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateDomain w,
                            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric
                                  (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d
                                    (TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandAffine Q)
                                    ↑TightVer401.torusAffineMarkerLinearEquiv))
                                q <
                              0) →
                          have F := TightVer401.protectedTorusMap Q.cylinder.saddle D.meridian h;
                          have Z :=
                            TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField (TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandChart Q)
                              (TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandAffine Q) Y;
                          have G := TightVer401.affineMarkedTorusLinearBase F;
                          have W := TightVer401.affineMarkedTorusLinearBending Z;
                          TightVer401.nativeProductIsBending F Z ∧
                            ∃ δ > 0,
                              ∀ (a : ℝ),
                                |a| < δ →
                                  TightVer401.NativeTorusSmoothEmbedding (G + a • W) ∧
                                    TightVer401.NativeTorusSmoothEmbedding (G - a • W) ∧
                                      (∀ p ∈ ↑(TightVer401.completedSaddleTorusBandChart Q) '' tsupport Y,
                                          TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature G p < 0 ∧
                                            TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature (G + a • W) p < 0 ∧
                                              TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature (G - a • W) p < 0) ∧
                                        TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G + a • W) =
                                            TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                                          TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G - a • W) =
                                              TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                                            Set.EqOn (G + a • W) G (TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G) ∧
                                              Set.EqOn (G - a • W) G (TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G) ∧
                                                (G + a • W) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G + a • W) =
                                                    G '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                                                  (G - a • W) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G - a • W) =
                                                      G '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                                                    (G + a • W) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G + a • W) =
                                                        (G - a • W) ''
                                                          TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G - a • W) ∧
                                                      (∀ p ∈ TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G,
                                                          G + a • W =ᶠ[nhds p] G) ∧
                                                        (∀ p ∈ TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G,
                                                            G - a • W =ᶠ[nhds p] G) ∧
                                                          Nonempty
                                                              (TightVer401.NativeTorusPositiveGaussData (G + a • W)) ∧
                                                            Nonempty
                                                                (TightVer401.NativeTorusPositiveGaussData (G - a • W)) ∧
                                                              TightVer401.IsTightImage (G + a • W) ∧
                                                                TightVer401.IsTightImage (G - a • W)

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste_contDiffOn
declarations.type:

        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) qL U →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Q →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) qR U →
              Q =ᶠ[nhds A] qL → Q =ᶠ[nhds B] qR → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste A B qL Q qR) U

declarations.type: ∀ (A B : ℝ) (qL Q qR : ℝ → ℝ), Set.EqOn (TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste A B qL Q qR) qL (Set.Iio A)

declarations.type:

  A < B →
    ∀ (qL Q qR : ℝ → ℝ),
      Q =ᶠ[nhds A] qL →
        Q =ᶠ[nhds B] qR →
          x < A ∧ TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste A B qL Q qR =ᶠ[nhds x] qL ∨
            x ∈ Set.Icc A B ∧ TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste A B qL Q qR =ᶠ[nhds x] Q ∨
              B < x ∧ TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste A B qL Q qR =ᶠ[nhds x] qR

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste_right
declarations.type: ∀ {A B : ℝ}, A < B → ∀ (qL Q qR : ℝ → ℝ), Set.EqOn (TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste A B qL Q qR) qR (Set.Ioi B)

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetJoinPaste_second_negative
declarations.type:

        Q =ᶠ[nhds B] qR →
          (∀ x ∈ U, deriv (deriv qL) x < 0) →
            (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc A B, deriv (deriv Q) x < 0) →
              (∀ x ∈ U, deriv (deriv qR) x < 0) →

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetJoin_corrected_outer_germs
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {L c r : ℝ},
  0 < r →
    0 < c - r →
      c + r < L →
        ∀ (hL hR a : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ),
          (∀ (j : Fin n), tsupport (ψ j) ⊆ Set.Ioo 0 L) →
            (Function.support fun x => a x - TightVer401.concaveJetJoinBlendAcceleration c r hL hR x) ⊆
                ⋃ j, Function.support (ψ j) →
              (∃ α > 0, α < c - r ∧ Set.EqOn a hL (Set.Iio α)) ∧ ∃ β < L, c + r < β ∧ Set.EqOn a hR (Set.Ioi β)

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetJoin_endpoint_of_affine_moment
declarations.type:
∀ {L c : ℝ},
  c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L →

      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) qL →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) qR →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
            qL c = qR c →
              deriv qL c = deriv qR c →
                TightVer401.jetAccelerationMoment 0 L TightVer401.jetAffineMomentVector a =
                    TightVer401.jetAccelerationMoment 0 L TightVer401.jetAffineMomentVector
                      (TightVer401.concaveJetJoinBlendPiecewise c (fun x => -deriv (deriv qL) x) fun x =>
                        -deriv (deriv qR) x) →
                  TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction 0 (qL 0) (deriv qL 0) a L = qR L ∧
                    deriv (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction 0 (qL 0) (deriv qL 0) a) L = deriv qR L

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetJoin_eqOn_of_second_deriv
declarations.type:
∀ {U : Set ℝ} {q Q : ℝ → ℝ},

    IsPreconnected U →
      ∀ {c : ℝ},
        c ∈ U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) q U →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Q U →
              Set.EqOn (deriv (deriv q)) (deriv (deriv Q)) U → q c = Q c → deriv q c = deriv Q c → Set.EqOn q Q U

declarations.type:
∀ {U : Set ℝ} {q h : ℝ → ℝ},

    IsPreconnected U →
      ∀ {r : ℝ},
        r ∈ U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) q U →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
              ∀ (c value slope : ℝ),
                (∀ x ∈ U, deriv (deriv q) x = -h x) →
                  q r = TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope h r →
                    deriv q r = deriv (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope h) r →
                      Set.EqOn q (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope h) U

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction.eq_1
declarations.type:

declarations.type:
∀ {U : Set ℝ} {q h : ℝ → ℝ},

    IsPreconnected U →
      ∀ {c : ℝ},
        c ∈ U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) q U →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
              (∀ r ∈ U, deriv (deriv q) r = -h r) →
                Set.EqOn q (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c (q c) (deriv q c) h) U

declarations.type:

declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction_piecewise_endpoint
declarations.type:
∀ {qL qR h : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) qL →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) qR →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
        ∀ (A c B : ℝ),
          qL c = qR c →
            deriv qL c = deriv qR c →
              ∫ (x : ℝ) in A..B, h x =
                  (∫ (x : ℝ) in A..c, -deriv (deriv qL) x) + ∫ (x : ℝ) in c..B, -deriv (deriv qR) x →
                ∫ (x : ℝ) in A..B, x * h x =
                    (∫ (x : ℝ) in A..c, x * -deriv (deriv qL) x) + ∫ (x : ℝ) in c..B, x * -deriv (deriv qR) x →
                  TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction A (qL A) (deriv qL A) h B = qR B ∧
                    deriv (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction A (qL A) (deriv qL A) h) B = deriv qR B

declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction_strict_concavity
declarations.type:
∀ {h : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
    ∀ (c value slope : ℝ) {U : Set ℝ},
      (∀ r ∈ U, 0 < h r) → ∀ r ∈ U, deriv (deriv (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope h)) r < 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction_two_moment_match
declarations.type:
∀ {h k : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
      ∀ (c value slope r : ℝ),
        ∫ (t : ℝ) in c..r, h t = ∫ (t : ℝ) in c..r, k t →
          ∫ (t : ℝ) in c..r, t * h t = ∫ (t : ℝ) in c..r, t * k t →
            TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope h r =
                TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope k r ∧
              deriv (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope h) r =
                deriv (TightVer401.concaveJetReconstruction c value slope k) r

  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_inner
declarations.type:
∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ F p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ G p →
      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => inner ℝ (F q) (G q)) p =
          inner ℝ (F p) (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i G p) +

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_add
declarations.type:
∀ {f g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ f p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ g p →
      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => f q + g q) p =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i f p + OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i g p

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {F : ℝ → ℝ} {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {F' : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt F F' (g p) →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ g p →
      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => F (g q)) p = F' * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i g p

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_comp_two
declarations.type:
∀ {f g₀ g₁ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ g₀ p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ g₁ p →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f ![g₀ p, g₁ p] →
        ∀ (i : Fin 2),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => f ![g₀ q, g₁ q]) p =
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i g₀ p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 f ![g₀ p, g₁ p] +
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i g₁ p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 f ![g₀ p, g₁ p]

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_const
declarations.type: ∀ (c : ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i : Fin 2), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun x => c) p = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_div
declarations.type:
∀ {f g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ f p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ g p →
      g p ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (i : Fin 2),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => f q / g q) p =
            (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i f p * g p - f p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i g p) /
              g p ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_inv
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

    f p ≠ 0 →

        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => (f q)⁻¹) p =
          -OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i f p / f p ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {f g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

          f p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i g p + g p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i f p

declarations.name: TightVer401.coordPartial_scalar_sub

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedScaledHomogeneous_actual_triple
declarations.type:
∀ {a : ℝ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
      ∀ (t : ℝ),
        inner ℝ (deriv (deriv fun s => a s • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous (f s)) t)
            (TightVer401.ambientCross (a t • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous (f t))
              (deriv (fun s => a s • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous (f s)) t)) =
          a t ^ 3 * TightVer401.corrugatedSeedPlaneDet (deriv f t) (deriv (deriv f) t)

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedScaledHomogeneous_deriv
declarations.type:
∀ {a : ℝ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ},
  Differentiable ℝ a →
    Differentiable ℝ f →
      ∀ (t : ℝ),
        deriv (fun s => a s • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous (f s)) t =
          deriv a t • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous (f t) + a t • TightVer401.corrugatedHorizontal (deriv f t)

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedScaledHomogeneous_normal
declarations.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ) (z v : ℂ),
  -TightVer401.ambientCross (a • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous z)
        (b • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous z + a • TightVer401.corrugatedHorizontal v) =
    a ^ 2 • TightVer401.corrugatedNormalNumerator z v

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedScaledHomogeneous_second_deriv
declarations.type:
∀ {a : ℝ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
      ∀ (t : ℝ),
        deriv (deriv fun s => a s • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous (f s)) t =
          deriv (deriv a) t • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous (f t) +
              (2 * deriv a t) • TightVer401.corrugatedHorizontal (deriv f t) +
            a t • TightVer401.corrugatedHorizontal (deriv (deriv f) t)

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedScaledHomogeneous_triple
declarations.type:
∀ (a b c : ℝ) (z v w : ℂ),
  inner ℝ
      (c • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous z + (2 * b) • TightVer401.corrugatedHorizontal v +
        a • TightVer401.corrugatedHorizontal w)
      (TightVer401.ambientCross (a • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous z)
        (b • TightVer401.corrugatedHomogeneous z + a • TightVer401.corrugatedHorizontal v)) =
    a ^ 3 * TightVer401.corrugatedSeedPlaneDet v w

declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (k : ℝ) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) {f : ℝ → E},

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedSeed_balanced_actual_band
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10000 ≤ N →
    ∀ (e : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ),
      ⇑e = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcMap ↑N →
        ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑e.symm →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), HasDerivAt (⇑e.symm) (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphericalSpeed (↑N) (e.symm r))⁻¹ r) →
            ∀ {a : ℝ → ℝ},
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
                Function.Periodic a (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N) →
                  (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
                    ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..↑N * TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N,
                          a r • TightVer401.normalLoopTangent (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) r =
                        0 →
                      ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..↑N * TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N,
                            deriv (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm)) r /
                              √(a r) =
                          0 →
                        Set.InjOn
                            (TightVer401.covariantSpeedCurve (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N)
                              (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedRotation ↑N) a
                              (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedFrameHorizontal ↑N ⇑e.symm))
                            (Set.Ico 0 (↑N * TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N)) →
                          have ell := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N;
                          have L := ↑N * ell;
                          have ζ := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm;
                          ∃ S,
                            ⇑S = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a ∧
                              ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                ∃ d,
                                  d.γ = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedSpatial (↑N) (⇑e.symm) ell a ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                    d.T = TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                      d.E = deriv ζ ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                        d.n = ζ ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                          d.k =
                                              TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalK a (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                                                ⇑S.symm ∧
                                            d.τ = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalTau a ⇑S.symm ∧
                                              TightVer401.PrincipalNormalIdentityBand d ∧
                                                ∃ (_ : 0 < OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a L),
                                                  ∃ δ > 0,
                                                    Topology.IsEmbedding d.bandMap ∧
                                                      Topology.IsEmbedding
                                                          (⇑TightVer401.corrugatedAmbientHorizontalCLM ∘ d.bandMap) ∧
                                                        (Function.Injective fun p => d.fullGaussMap (p.1, ↑p.2)) ∧
                                                          ∀
                                                            (p :
                                                              AddCircle
                                                                  (OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a
                                                                    L) ×
                                                                ↑(Set.Ioo 0 δ)),
                                                            0 < (d.fullGaussMap (p.1, ↑p.2)).ofLp 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedSeed_spike_normal
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (e : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ),
      ⇑e = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcMap ↑N →
        ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑e.symm →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), HasDerivAt (⇑e.symm) (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphericalSpeed (↑N) (e.symm r))⁻¹ r) →
            have L := ↑N * TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N;
            have ζ := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm;
            0 < L ∧
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ζ ∧
                Function.Periodic ζ L ∧
                  Set.InjOn ζ (Set.Ico 0 L) ∧
                    (∀ (r : ℝ), inner ℝ (ζ r) (ζ r) = 1) ∧
                      (∀ (r : ℝ), inner ℝ (deriv ζ r) (deriv ζ r) = 1) ∧ ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < (ζ r).ofLp 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.corrugatedSeed_spike_speed
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10000 ≤ N →
    ∀ [inst : Fact (0 < TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N)] (e : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ),
      ⇑e = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcMap ↑N →
        ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑e.symm →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), HasDerivAt (⇑e.symm) (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphericalSpeed (↑N) (e.symm r))⁻¹ r) →
            ∀ {η ε : ℝ},
              0 < η →
                0 < ε →
                  let ell := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N;
                  have L := ↑N * ell;
                  have ζ := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm;
                  have Ph := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedFrameHorizontal ↑N ⇑e.symm;
                  have b := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedInitialSpeed ↑N ⇑e.symm;
                  ∃ a,
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a ∧
                      Function.Periodic a ell ∧
                        (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) ∧
                          ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..ell, ‖a r - b r‖ < η ∧
                            ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..ell, a r * (TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ r).ofLp 2 = 0 ∧
                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, a r • TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ r = 0 ∧
                                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..ell, deriv (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) r / √(a r) = 0 ∧
                                  ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, deriv (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) r / √(a r) = 0 ∧
                                    Set.InjOn (TightVer401.speedCurve a (TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ))
                                        (Set.Ico 0 L) ∧
                                      Set.InjOn
                                          (TightVer401.covariantSpeedCurve ell (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedRotation ↑N) a
                                            Ph)
                                          (Set.Ico 0 L) ∧
                                        (∀ (r : ℝ),
                                            1 / 4 <
                                                ‖TightVer401.covariantSpeedCurve ell
                                                    (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedRotation ↑N) a Ph r‖ ∧
                                              0 <
                                                inner ℝ (Ph r)
                                                  (TightVer401.corrugatedVisibilityDirection (1 / 4)
                                                    (TightVer401.covariantSpeedCurve ell
                                                      (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedRotation ↑N) a Ph r))) ∧
                                          ∃ A B,
                                            ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) A ∧
                                              ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) B ∧
                                                (∀ (r : ℝ), A ((TightVer401.periodProjection ell) r) = a r) ∧
                                                  (∀ (r : ℝ), B ((TightVer401.periodProjection ell) r) = b r) ∧
                                                    ∃ n ≤ 2,
                                                      ∃ centers radii,
                                                        (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 ≤ radii j) ∧
                                                          ∑ j, 2 * radii j < ε ∧
                                                            (Function.support fun q => A q - B q) ⊆
                                                              ⋃ j,
                                                                ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection ell) ''
                                                                  Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticAngularError.eq_1
declarations.type:

  TightVer401.dualQuadraticAngularError R chi h b r t =
    chi r * (deriv (deriv h) t + (r - R) * deriv (deriv b) t) + r * (deriv chi r * (h t + (r - R) * b t) + chi r * b t)

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller
declarations.type: ℝ → ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) (chi h b : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b p = -M / 2 * (p 0 - R) ^ 2 + chi (p 0) * (h (p 1) + (p 0 - R) * b (p 1))

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_angular_expression
declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b)) p +
              p 0 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) p =
            M * (p 0 * (R - p 0)) + TightVer401.dualQuadraticAngularError R chi h b (p 0) (p 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_angular_periodic
declarations.type:
∀ (R M L : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  Function.Periodic h L →
    Function.Periodic b L →
      ∀ (r : ℝ), Function.Periodic (fun theta => TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b ![r, theta]) L

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_angular_second
declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b)) p =
            chi (p 0) * (deriv (deriv h) (p 1) + (p 0 - R) * deriv (deriv b) (p 1))

declarations.type:
∀ (R M L : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},

              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b))
                  ![p 0, p 1 + L] =
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b)) p

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_angular_shift
declarations.type:
∀ (R M L : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  Function.Periodic h L →
    Function.Periodic b L →
      ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
        TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b ![p 0, p 1 + L] = TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b p

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_boundary_first_jet
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ (M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), 3 * R / 4 ≤ r → chi r = 1) →
              ∀ (t : ℝ),
                TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b ![R, t] = h t ∧
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) ![R, t] = b t ∧
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) ![R, t] =
                      deriv h t

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_boundary_polar_hessian
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ (M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), 3 * R / 4 ≤ r → chi r = 1) →
              ∀ (theta : ℝ),
                TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) ![R, theta] 0 0 = -M ∧
                  TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) ![R, theta] 1 1 =
                      deriv (deriv h) theta ∧
                    TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) ![R, theta] 0 1 =
                      deriv b theta

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_cartesian_boundary_first_jet
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ (M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
            Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) →
              Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 3 * R / 4 ≤ r → chi r = 1) →
                  ∀ (theta : ℝ),
                    TightVer401.angularDescentPotential (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b)
                          (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                        h theta ∧
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                            (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b))
                            (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                          b theta * Real.cos theta - deriv h theta / R * Real.sin theta ∧
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                            (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b))
                            (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                          b theta * Real.sin theta + deriv h theta / R * Real.cos theta

∀ (R M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_coordPartial
declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i : Fin 2),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) p =
            if i = 0 then -M * (p 0 - R) + deriv chi (p 0) * (h (p 1) + (p 0 - R) * b (p 1)) + chi (p 0) * b (p 1)
            else chi (p 0) * (deriv h (p 1) + (p 0 - R) * deriv b (p 1))

declarations.type:
∀ (R M L : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},

        Function.Periodic h L →

            ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i : Fin 2),
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) ![p 0, p 1 + L] =
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) p

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_inner_germ
declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  (∀ r ≤ R / 2, chi r = 0) →
    ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      p 0 ≤ R / 2 →
        TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b p =

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_radial_angular
declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
          TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M chi h b) p 0 1 =

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller_radial_second
declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) {chi h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) chi →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),

            -M + deriv (deriv chi) (p 0) * (h (p 1) + (p 0 - R) * b (p 1)) + 2 * deriv chi (p 0) * b (p 1)

declarations.type:

                          Set.EqOn g (TightVer401.dualRadialQuadraticProfile R M (-M * R ^ 2 / 2)) (Set.Ioo d b) →

                              Set.EqOn F (TightVer401.radialPlanarPotential g)
                                  {x | a < TightVer401.planarRadius x ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius x < b} →
                                Set.EqOn F H {x | d < TightVer401.planarRadius x ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius x < S} →
                                  Set.EqOn H (TightVer401.dualRadialQuadraticPotential R M (-M * R ^ 2 / 2))
                                      {x | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius x ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius x < R / 2} →
                                    ∀ (Gamma : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ),
                                      0 ∈ ⇑Gamma '' Metric.closedBall 0 1 →
                                        (∀ z ∈ ⇑Gamma '' Metric.closedBall 0 1, ‖z‖ < M * (R - b)) →
                                          ∀
                                            (e :
                                              OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord
                                                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                            e.source =
                                                {x | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius x ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius x < S} →
                                              e.target =
                                                  ⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord ''
                                                    (Metric.ball 0 (M * R) \ ⇑Gamma '' Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
                                                (∀ x ∈ e.source, ↑e x = TightVer401.planarGradient H x) →
                                                  Set.BijOn (TightVer401.planarGradient F)
                                                    {x |
                                                      a < TightVer401.planarRadius x ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius x < S}
                                                    (⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord ''
                                                      (Set.univ \ ⇑Gamma '' Metric.closedBall 0 1))

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch_contDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {U0 U1 U2 : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {F0 F1 F2 : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  IsOpen U0 →
    IsOpen U1 →
      IsOpen U2 →
        Set.EqOn F0 F1 (U0 ∩ U1) →
          Set.EqOn F0 F2 (U0 ∩ U2) →
            Set.EqOn F1 F2 (U1 ∩ U2) →
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F0 U0 →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F1 U1 →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F2 U2 →
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2) (U0 ∪ U1 ∪ U2)

declarations.type:

  Set.EqOn F0 F1 (U0 ∩ U1) →
    Set.EqOn F0 F2 (U0 ∩ U2) →
      Set.EqOn F1 F2 (U1 ∩ U2) →
        Set.EqOn (TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2) F0 U0 ∧
          Set.EqOn (TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2) F1 U1 ∧
            Set.EqOn (TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2) F2 U2

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch_germs
declarations.type:
∀ {U0 U1 U2 : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {F0 F1 F2 : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  IsOpen U0 →
    IsOpen U1 →
      IsOpen U2 →
        Set.EqOn F0 F1 (U0 ∩ U1) →
          Set.EqOn F0 F2 (U0 ∩ U2) →
            Set.EqOn F1 F2 (U1 ∩ U2) →
              (∀ p ∈ U0, TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2 =ᶠ[nhds p] F0) ∧
                (∀ p ∈ U1, TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2 =ᶠ[nhds p] F1) ∧
                  ∀ p ∈ U2, TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2 =ᶠ[nhds p] F2

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch_saddle
declarations.type:
∀ {U0 U1 U2 : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {F0 F1 F2 : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  IsOpen U0 →
    IsOpen U1 →
      IsOpen U2 →
        Set.EqOn F0 F1 (U0 ∩ U1) →
          Set.EqOn F0 F2 (U0 ∩ U2) →
            Set.EqOn F1 F2 (U1 ∩ U2) →
              (∀ p ∈ U0, (TightVer401.planarHessian F0 p).det < 0) →
                (∀ p ∈ U1, (TightVer401.planarHessian F1 p).det < 0) →
                  (∀ p ∈ U2, (TightVer401.planarHessian F2 p).det < 0) →
                    ∀ p ∈ U0 ∪ U1 ∪ U2,
                      (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionPatch U0 U1 F0 F1 F2) p).det < 0
