declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionRetainedContour_geometry
declarations.type:
∀ {Gin : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Uin : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {L R etaMax : ℝ}
  [inst : Fact (0 < L)] {D : TightVer401.VisibleConnectorIncomingData Gin Uin L R}
  (C : TightVer401.VisibleConnectorConstructionData D etaMax)
  (eC eF : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  closure C.source_annulus ⊆ eC.source →
    ↑eC = TightVer401.planarGradient C.G →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) C.G eC.source →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑eC.symm) eC.target →
          Set.EqOn (↑eC.symm) (↑C.gradient_chart.symm) C.gradient_annulus →
            ∀ {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V Uc : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {S0 : ℝ},
              IsOpen V →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H V →
                  ↑eF = TightVer401.planarGradient H →
                    IsOpen Uc →
                      Uc ⊆ TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionFillingDomain C eC ∩ eF.source ∩ V →
                        R < S0 →
                          TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadiusLevel S0 ⊆ Uc →
                            (∀ y ∈ Uc, H =ᶠ[nhds y] TightVer401.planarLegendre C.G eC) →
                              (∀ y ∈ Uc, 0 < TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.planarLegendre C.G eC) y ⬝ᵥ y) →
                                ∀ {HOld GammaS Gamma0 : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ},
                                  Set.range (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace D.incoming.p) =
                                      ⇑HOld '' Metric.sphere 0 1 →
                                    0 ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior GammaS →
                                      eF.target ⊆
                                          (⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord ''
                                              closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior GammaS))ᶜ →
                                        Set.range (TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingGradientComplexTrace H S0) =
                                            ⇑Gamma0 '' Metric.sphere 0 1 →
                                          0 ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Gamma0 ∧
                                            ⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord '' ⇑Gamma0 '' Metric.sphere 0 1 ⊆
                                                C.source_annulus ∧
                                              closure (TightVer401.positiveExitInside D.incoming.p) ⊆
                                                  ⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord ''
                                                    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Gamma0 ∧
                                                ⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord ''
                                                      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior GammaS) ⊆
                                                    ⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord ''
                                                      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Gamma0 ∧
                                                  ⇑TightVer401.seamComplexCoord ''
                                                      closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Gamma0) ⊆
                                                    TightVer401.positiveExitInside C.terminal.p

declarations.type:

  {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Uc : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {S0 : ℝ} {Gamma0 : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ},
  IsOpen Uc →

                      (∀ (theta : ℝ),
                          0 < TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadialTrace (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) R theta) ∧
                        ∀ (theta : ℝ),
                          0 <
                            deriv
                                (deriv
                                  (TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingValueTrace (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) R))
                                theta +

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialCompletionTrace_seam_deriv
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →

                    (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < inner ℝ (deriv p t) (deriv gamma t)) →

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialCompletion_terminal_traces
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
        ∀ {R L : ℝ},
          0 < R →
            0 < L →
              ∀ {P : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
                  ∀ {phase : ℝ → ℝ},
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) phase →
                      (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < deriv phase s) →
                        (∀ (s : ℝ), phase (s + L) = phase s + 2 * Real.pi) →
                          (∀ (s : ℝ), P s ∈ e.source) →
                            (∀ (s : ℝ), ↑e (P s) = TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, phase s]) →
                              (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < P s ⬝ᵥ TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadialUnit (phase s)) →
                                (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                    0 < deriv P s ⬝ᵥ deriv (fun r => TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, phase r]) s) →
                                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤)
                                      (TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingValueTrace (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e)
                                        R) ∧
                                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤)
                                        (TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadialTrace (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e)
                                          R) ∧
                                      Function.Periodic
                                          (TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingValueTrace (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e)
                                            R)
                                          (2 * Real.pi) ∧
                                        Function.Periodic
                                            (TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadialTrace
                                              (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) R)
                                            (2 * Real.pi) ∧
                                          (∀ (t : ℝ),
                                              0 <
                                                TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadialTrace
                                                  (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) R t) ∧
                                            ∀ (t : ℝ),
                                              0 <
                                                deriv
                                                    (deriv
                                                      (TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingValueTrace
                                                        (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) R))
                                                    t +
                                                  R *
                                                    TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadialTrace
                                                      (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) R t

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialQuadraticPotential_gaussianCurvature
declarations.type:
∀ {R M d : ℝ},

    ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      p ∈ TightVer401.radialPlanarDomain (Set.Ioo 0 R) →
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
            (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric
              (TightVer401.planarSupportMap (TightVer401.dualRadialQuadraticPotential R M d)))

declarations.name: TightVer401.dualRadialQuadraticPotential_hessian
declarations.type:
∀ {R M d : ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  p ∈ TightVer401.radialPlanarDomain (Set.Ioo 0 R) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
      TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.dualRadialQuadraticPotential R M d) p i j =
        ((M * R - M * TightVer401.planarRadius p) / TightVer401.planarRadius p * if i = j then 1 else 0) +
          (-M / TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 2 -
                (M * R - M * TightVer401.planarRadius p) / TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 3) *
              p i *
            p j

  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U →
    TightVer401.IsInfinitesimalBendingOn X y U →
      IsOpen U →
        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          p ∈ U →
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (fun q => X q + y q) p =

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_band_cutoff
declarations.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace A] [CompactSpace A] [Nonempty A] {ρ W : A → ℝ} {b : ℝ},
  Continuous ρ →
    Continuous W →
      (∀ (a : A), 0 < ρ a) → 0 < b → ∃ cb, (∀ (a : A), 1 / (ρ a * b) - W a ≤ cb) ∧ ∃ a, 1 / (ρ a * b) - W a = cb

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_bounded_interval_moment_coordinates
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)} {L : ℝ}
  (ψ : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L))) → ℝ → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))),
      Function.support (ψ j) ⊆ Set.Ioo 0 L) →
    (LinearIndependent ℝ fun j => ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, ψ j x • f x) →
      ∃ T C,
        0 < C ∧
          ∀ (u : ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L))),
            ∑ j, T u j • ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, ψ j x • f x = ↑u ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))), |T u j| ≤ C * ‖u‖) ∧
                ∑ j, |T u j| ≤ C * ‖u‖

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_completeProfile
declarations.type:
∀ {H β : ℝ} {q₀ : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    H ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) q₀ U →
        0 < q₀ H →
          0 < deriv q₀ H →
            (∀ z ∈ U, 0 < deriv (deriv q₀) z) →
              0 < β →
                ∃ q,
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) q ∧
                    q =ᶠ[nhds H] q₀ ∧
                      (∀ z ∈ Set.Ici H, 0 < q z ∧ 0 < deriv q z ∧ 0 < deriv (deriv q) z) ∧
                        (∀ᶠ (z : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, deriv (deriv q) z = β) ∧
                          Filter.Tendsto (deriv q) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_completeProfile_acceleration
declarations.type:
∀ {H β : ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    H ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F U →
        (∀ z ∈ U, 0 < F z) →
          0 < β → ∃ b, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b ∧ (∀ (z : ℝ), 0 < b z) ∧ b =ᶠ[nhds H] F ∧ ∀ᶠ (z : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, b z = β

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_completedSaddleAnnulusCylinderInput
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
  {A RN μ B ε L d0 dInfinity : ℝ},
  0 < A →
    A < RN →
      0 < μ →
        0 < B →
          0 < ε →
            0 < L →
              e.source = {p | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p} →
                e.target = TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingOpenAnnulus A RN →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
                        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                            0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                              TightVer401.planarRadius p < ε →
                                G p = RN * TightVer401.planarRadius p - μ * TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 2 / 2 + d0) →
                          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                              L < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                                G p = A * TightVer401.planarRadius p - B / TightVer401.planarRadius p + dInfinity) →
                            (∀ p ∈ e.source, (TightVer401.planarHessian G p).det < 0) →
                              d0 < dInfinity ∧
                                ∃ β,
                                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) β ∧
                                    StrictMonoOn β (Set.Icc (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi) ∧
                                      β (Real.pi / 2) = A ∧
                                        β Real.pi = RN ∧
                                          (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi, 0 < deriv β u) ∧
                                            (β =ᶠ[nhds (Real.pi / 2)] fun u => A + B * (u - Real.pi / 2) ^ 2) ∧
                                              (β =ᶠ[nhds Real.pi] fun u =>
                                                  RN - 2 * √(μ * (dInfinity - d0)) * Real.cos (u / 2)) ∧
                                                ∃ D,
                                                  D.saddle =
                                                      TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusCylinderMap G e A RN d0
                                                        dInfinity β ∧
                                                    (∀ p ∈ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi,
                                                        (p.2 < Real.pi / 2 → (D.saddle p).ofLp 2 < 0) ∧
                                                          (Real.pi / 2 < p.2 → 0 < (D.saddle p).ofLp 2)) ∧
                                                      (∀ p ∈ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi,
                                                          (D.saddle p).ofLp 2 = 0 ↔ p.2 = Real.pi / 2) ∧
                                                        ∀ p ∈ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi,
                                                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                                                              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric
                                                                (TightVer401.nativeProductPlaneCoordinateMap D.saddle
                                                                  p))
                                                              ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.finTwoArrow ℝ ℝ).symm
                                                                (↑(chartAt (ModelProd ℝ ℝ) p) p)) <
                                                            0

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_completedSaddleAnnulusGeometryOutput
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < T)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame T) (K : Set (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)))
  {G G0 : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
  {A RN μ B ε L d0 dInfinity : ℝ},
  0 < A →
    A < RN →
      0 < μ →
        0 < B →
          0 < ε →
            0 < L →
              e.source = {p | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p} →
                e.target = TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingOpenAnnulus A RN →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
                        (∀ p ∈ e.source, (TightVer401.planarHessian G p).det < 0) →
                          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                              0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                                TightVer401.planarRadius p < ε →
                                  G p = RN * TightVer401.planarRadius p - μ * TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 2 / 2 + d0) →
                            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                L < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                                  G p = A * TightVer401.planarRadius p - B / TightVer401.planarRadius p + dInfinity) →
                              ∀
                                (c0 :
                                  OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel
                                    (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) (↑c0) c0.source →
                                  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
                                      TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑c0.symm) c0.target →
                                    (∀ p ∈ c0.source, TightVer401.planarSupportMap G0 (↑c0 p) = d.bandMap p) →
                                      K ⊆ c0.source →
                                        ∀ {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                                          IsOpen W →
                                            W ⊆ e.source →
                                              ↑c0 '' K ⊆ W →
                                                Set.EqOn G G0 W →
                                                  d0 < dInfinity ∧
                                                    ∃ β,
                                                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) β ∧
                                                        StrictMonoOn β (Set.Icc (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi) ∧
                                                          β (Real.pi / 2) = A ∧
                                                            β Real.pi = RN ∧
                                                              (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi, 0 < deriv β u) ∧
                                                                (β =ᶠ[nhds (Real.pi / 2)] fun u =>
                                                                    A + B * (u - Real.pi / 2) ^ 2) ∧

                                                    ∃ β,
                                                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) β ∧

                                                                          Real.cos (u / 2)) ∧

                                                                            G e A RN d0 dInfinity β ∧
                                                                        Q.verticalOffset = dInfinity ∧

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_finite_radial_cap
declarations.type:

  IsOpen U →

      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) k₀ U →
        ∀ {j : ℝ},
          0 < j →
            j ∈ U →
              0 < deriv k₀ j →
                (∀ x ∈ U, deriv (deriv k₀) x < 0) →
                  ∃ ε > 0,
                    ∀ (d : ℝ),
                      0 < d →
                        d < ε →
                          have a := TightVer401.radialCapRadius d (deriv k₀ j);
                          have C := k₀ j - d / deriv k₀ j;
                          have R := j + d;
                          a < R ∧
                            TightVer401.radialCap C R a j = k₀ j ∧
                              deriv (TightVer401.radialCap C R a) j = deriv k₀ j ∧
                                ∃ u e k,
                                  0 < u ∧
                                    u < j ∧
                                      0 < e ∧
                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) k (Set.Ioo u (R + e)) ∧
                                          (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo u (R + e), deriv (deriv k) x < 0) ∧
                                            (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo u R, 0 < deriv k x) ∧
                                              deriv k R = 0 ∧
                                                deriv (deriv k) R = -1 / a ∧
                                                  (∃ v ∈ Set.Ioo u j, Set.EqOn k k₀ (Set.Ioo u v)) ∧
                                                    k =ᶠ[nhds R] TightVer401.radialCap C R a

declarations.type:
∀ {h : ℝ},
  0 < h →
    ∀ {r0 : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContinuousOn r0 (Set.Icc (-h) h) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) r0 (Set.Ioo (-h) h) →
          (∀ z ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h, deriv (deriv r0) z < 0) →
            (∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h, r0 (-z) = r0 z) →
              ∃ r,
                ContinuousOn r (Set.Icc (-h) h) ∧
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) r (Set.Ioo (-h) h) ∧
                    (∀ z ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h, deriv (deriv r) z < 0) ∧
                      StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Icc (-h) h) r ∧
                        (∀ (z : ℝ), r0 z ≤ r z) ∧
                          (∀ (z : ℝ), z ≤ h / 4 ∨ 3 * h / 4 ≤ z → r z = r0 z) ∧ ∃ z ∈ Set.Ioo 0 h, r (-z) ≠ r z

                                              (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                                            b theta * Real.cos theta - deriv h theta / R * Real.sin theta ∧
                                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 F
                                              (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                                            b theta * Real.sin theta + deriv h theta / R * Real.cos theta) ∧
                                    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                        0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                                          TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ R / 2 →
                                            F p = TightVer401.dualRadialQuadraticPotential R M (-M * R ^ 2 / 2) p) ∧

                                                      (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_radialCap_smoothing
declarations.type:
∀ {U : Set ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ {k₀ : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) k₀ U →
        ∀ {j d : ℝ},
          0 < j →
            j ∈ U →
              0 < d →
                0 < deriv k₀ j →
                  (∀ x ∈ U, deriv (deriv k₀) x < 0) →
                    have a := TightVer401.radialCapRadius d (deriv k₀ j);
                    have C := k₀ j - d / deriv k₀ j;
                    have R := j + d;
                    ∃ u e k,
                      0 < u ∧
                        u < j ∧
                          0 < e ∧
                            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) k (Set.Ioo u (R + e)) ∧

                                        k =ᶠ[nhds R] TightVer401.radialCap C R a

                                                                  TightVer401.planarGradient
                                                                    (TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise P f g) x‖ <
                                                              η

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_revolutionEnd_complete_continuation
declarations.type:

  IsOpen U →
    H ∈ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) q₀ U →
        0 < q₀ H →
          0 < deriv q₀ H →
            (∀ z ∈ U, 0 < deriv (deriv q₀) z) →
              0 < β →
                ∃ q,
                  ∃ (hq : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) q) (hpos : ∀ z ∈ Set.Ici H, 0 < q z),
                    q =ᶠ[nhds H] q₀ ∧
                      (∀ z ∈ Set.Ici H, 0 < deriv q z ∧ 0 < deriv (deriv q) z) ∧
                        (∀ᶠ (z : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, deriv (deriv q) z = β) ∧
                          Filter.Tendsto (deriv q) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
                            (∃ ε > 0,
                                ∀ (p : TightVer401.RevolutionClosedEnd H),
                                  ↑p.2 ≤ H + ε →
                                    TightVer401.revolutionEndCircle q H p = TightVer401.revolutionEndCircle q₀ H p) ∧
                              ContMDiff TightVer401.revolutionEndBoundaryModel
                                  (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤)
                                  (TightVer401.revolutionEndCircle q H) ∧
                                (∀ (p : TightVer401.RevolutionClosedEnd H),
                                    Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% (TightVer401.revolutionEndCircle q H) p)) ∧
                                  Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (TightVer401.revolutionEndCircle q H) ∧
                                    CompleteSpace (TightVer401.RevolutionClosedEnd H) ∧
                                      ContMDiff TightVer401.revolutionEndBoundaryModel
                                          (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤)
                                          (TightVer401.revolutionEndGauss q H) ∧
                                        Function.Injective (TightVer401.revolutionEndGauss q H) ∧
                                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Ici H,
                                              TightVer401.revolutionEndAbsoluteCurvatureDensity q
                                                ![p.1, p.2] ∂MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume <
                                            2 * Real.pi

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_scalarCellFinitePaste

  {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {N : ℕ},
  0 < ε →
    r 0 = 0 →
      IsOpen V →
        0 ∈ V →
          (∀ j < N, 0 < r (j + 1) - r j) →
            (∀ j < N, r (j + 1) - r j < ε / 4) →
              (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (w j) (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε V)) →
                (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε V, ![q 0, w j q] ∈ W) →
                  (∀ j ≤ N,
                      ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε V,
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (w j) q = f ![q 0, w j q]) →
                    (∀ j < N, ∀ x ∈ V, w j =ᶠ[nhds ![r (j + 1), x]] w (j + 1)) →
                      (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ (t : ℝ), |t - r j| < ε → w j ![t, 0] = 0) →
                        (∀ x ∈ V, w 0 ![0, x] = x) →
                          ∃ u D,
                            IsOpen D ∧
                              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u D ∧
                                (∀ q ∈ D, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) ∧
                                  (∀ q ∈ D, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) ∧
                                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 (r N), ![t, 0] ∈ D ∧ u ![t, 0] = 0) ∧
                                      (fun x => u ![0, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id

  0 < P →
    0 < η →
      ∃ N,
        0 < N ∧
          0 < TightVer401.scalarCellStep P N ∧
            TightVer401.scalarCellStep P N < η ∧
              TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N 0 = 0 ∧
                TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N N = P ∧
                  (∀ j ≤ N, TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N j ∈ Set.Icc 0 P) ∧
                    (∀ (j : ℕ),
                        TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N (j + 1) =
                          TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N j + TightVer401.scalarCellStep P N) ∧
                      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) (P + η), ∃ j ≤ N, |t - TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N j| < η

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_scalarFlowPeriod_family
declarations.type:

    IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
        (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ W) →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), f ![r, 0] = 0) →
            ∃ V u,
              IsOpen V ∧
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V ∧
                  (∀ q ∈ V, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) ∧
                    (∀ q ∈ V, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) ∧
                      (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ V) ∧
                        (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, u ![r, 0] = 0) ∧ (fun x => u ![0, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_short_circle_moment_controls
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (L : ℝ) [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (f : AddCircle L → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)),
  Continuous f →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (f ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) →
      ∀ {a ε : ℝ},
        a ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L →
          0 < ε →
            ∃ r Ψ χ,
              0 < r ∧
                r < ε ∧
                  0 < a - r ∧
                    a + r < L ∧
                      (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f))),
                          ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) (Ψ j)) ∧
                        (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f))) (q : AddCircle L),
                            0 ≤ Ψ j q) ∧
                          (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f))),
                              ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..L, Ψ j ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) s) = 1) ∧
                            (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f))),
                                ∃ c, tsupport (Ψ j) ⊆ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Set.Icc (c - r) (c + r)) ∧
                              (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (Ψ i)) (tsupport (Ψ j))) ∧
                                ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) χ ∧
                                  (∀ (q : AddCircle L), χ q ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
                                    tsupport χ ⊆ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Metric.closedBall a r ∧
                                      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (a - r / 2) (a + r / 2),
                                          χ ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) s) = 1) ∧
                                        (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f))),
                                            Disjoint (tsupport (Ψ j))
                                              (⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Metric.closedBall a r)) ∧
                                          (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f))),
                                              Disjoint (tsupport (Ψ j)) (tsupport χ)) ∧
                                            (LinearIndependent ℝ fun j => TightVer401.circleControlMoment L f (Ψ j)) ∧
                                              Submodule.span ℝ
                                                  (Set.range fun j => TightVer401.circleControlMoment L f (Ψ j)) =
                                                TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_short_independent_interval_controls
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)},
  Continuous f →
    ∀ {L a ε : ℝ},
      a ∈ Set.Ioo 0 L →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ r ψ,
            0 < r ∧
              r < ε ∧
                0 < a - r ∧
                  a + r < L ∧
                    (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))),
                        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (ψ j)) ∧
                      (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))) (x : ℝ),
                          0 ≤ ψ j x) ∧
                        (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))),
                            ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, ψ j x = 1) ∧
                          (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))),
                              tsupport (ψ j) ⊆ Set.Ioo 0 L) ∧
                            (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))),
                                ∃ c, tsupport (ψ j) = Set.Icc (c - r) (c + r)) ∧
                              (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (ψ i)) (tsupport (ψ j))) ∧
                                (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)))),
                                    Disjoint (tsupport (ψ j)) (Metric.closedBall a r)) ∧
                                  (LinearIndependent ℝ fun j => ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, ψ j x • f x) ∧
                                    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun j => ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, ψ j x • f x) =
                                      TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_speedCurve_L1_embedded_interpolation_threshold
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (L : ℝ)
  [hL : Fact (0 < L)] (P : ℝ → E),
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
    Function.Periodic P L →
      (∀ (r : ℝ), P r ≠ 0) →
        ∀ (b : ℝ → ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
            Function.Periodic b L →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < b r) →
                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, b r • P r = 0 →
                  Set.InjOn (TightVer401.speedCurve b P) (Set.Ico 0 L) →
                    ∃ η > 0,
                      ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ),
                        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
                          Function.Periodic a L →
                            (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, a r • P r = 0 →
                                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, |a r - b r| < η →
                                  ∃ H,
                                    ContMDiff ((modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ).prod (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ))
                                        (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H ∧
                                      (∀ (t r : ℝ),
                                          H (t, (TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) =
                                            TightVer401.speedCurve (TightVer401.speedLinearInterpolation b a t) P r) ∧
                                        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1,
                                            (Topology.IsEmbedding fun q => H (t, q)) ∧
                                              ∀ (q : AddCircle L),
                                                Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun q => H (t, q)) q)) ∧
                                          (∀ (r : ℝ),
                                              H (0, (TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) =
                                                TightVer401.speedCurve b P r) ∧
                                            ∀ (r : ℝ),
                                              H (1, (TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) = TightVer401.speedCurve a P r

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_speedCurve_L1_embedding_threshold
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (L : ℝ)
  [hL : Fact (0 < L)] (P : ℝ → E),
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
    Function.Periodic P L →
      (∀ (x : ℝ), P x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ (b : ℝ → ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
            Function.Periodic b L →
              (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < b x) →
                ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, b x • P x = 0 →
                  Set.InjOn (TightVer401.speedCurve b P) (Set.Ico 0 L) →
                    ∃ η > 0,
                      ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ),
                        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
                          Function.Periodic a L →
                            (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < a x) →
                              ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, a x • P x = 0 →
                                ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, |a x - b x| < η →
                                  ∃ C,
                                    ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) C ∧
                                      Topology.IsEmbedding C ∧
                                        (∀ (x : ℝ),
                                            C ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) x) = TightVer401.speedCurve a P x) ∧
                                          Set.InjOn (TightVer401.speedCurve a P) (Set.Ico 0 L)

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_speedCurve_L1_regular_projection_threshold
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (L : ℝ) [inst_6 : Fact (0 < L)]
  (π : E →L[ℝ] F) (P : ℝ → E),
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P →
    Function.Periodic P L →
      (∀ (r : ℝ), π (P r) ≠ 0) →
        ∀ (b : ℝ → ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
            Function.Periodic b L →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < b r) →
                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, b r • P r = 0 →
                  Set.InjOn (⇑π ∘ TightVer401.speedCurve b P) (Set.Ico 0 L) →
                    ∃ η > 0,
                      ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ),
                        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
                          Function.Periodic a L →
                            (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, a r • P r = 0 →
                                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, |a r - b r| < η →
                                  ∀ (C : AddCircle L → E),
                                    (∀ (r : ℝ), C ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) = TightVer401.speedCurve a P r) →
                                      Topology.IsEmbedding (⇑π ∘ C) ∧

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_speedCurve_L1_representative_threshold
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {L : ℝ},

    ∀ (P : ℝ → E),
      Continuous P →
        (∀ (x : ℝ), P x ≠ 0) →
          ∀ (b : ℝ → ℝ),
            Continuous b →
              Function.Periodic (TightVer401.speedCurve b P) L →
                Set.InjOn (TightVer401.speedCurve b P) (Set.Ico 0 L) →
                  ∃ η > 0,
                    ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ),
                      Continuous a →
                        (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < a x) →
                          Function.Periodic (TightVer401.speedCurve a P) L →
                            ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..L, |a x - b x| < η → Set.InjOn (TightVer401.speedCurve a P) (Set.Ico 0 L)

declarations.name: TightVer401.exists_speedCurve_L1_representative_threshold._abel_1_1
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (P : ℝ → E) (b a : ℝ → ℝ) (x y : ℝ),
  TightVer401.speedCurve b P x - TightVer401.speedCurve b P y =
    TightVer401.speedCurve b P x - TightVer401.speedCurve a P y +

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic._proof_1

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (ℓ M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (v : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N v p =
    ℓ (TightVer401.exitGraphPoint v p) + 2 * (p 1 * deriv v (p 0)) * M (TightVer401.exitGraphPoint v p) +
      (p 1 * deriv v (p 0)) ^ 2 * N (TightVer401.exitGraphPoint v p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic_actual_tangent
declarations.type:
∀ {ℓ M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {v : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) v →
    ∀ (δ r : ℝ),
      TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N v ![r, δ] =
        deriv (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ) r ⬝ᵥ
          !![ℓ (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ r), M (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ r);
                M (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ r), N (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ r)].mulVec
            (deriv (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ) r)

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic_contDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {ℓ M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {v : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) ℓ U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) M U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) v →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N v) (TightVer401.exitGraphPoint v ⁻¹' U)

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic_hasDerivAt_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {ℓ M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {v : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {r : ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) ℓ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) M U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
          ![r, 0] ∈ U →
            HasDerivAt (fun δ => TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N v ![r, δ])
              (v r * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 ℓ ![r, 0] + 2 * deriv v r * M ![r, 0]) 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic_matrix
declarations.type:

  TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N v ![r, δ] =
    ![1, δ * deriv v r] ⬝ᵥ
      !![ℓ ![r, δ * v r], M ![r, δ * v r]; M ![r, δ * v r], N ![r, δ * v r]].mulVec ![1, δ * deriv v r]

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic_transverse_seam
declarations.type:
∀ {ℓ M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {v a b : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {r m : ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) ℓ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) M U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) v →
            ![r, 0] ∈ U →
              M ![r, 0] = a r →
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 ℓ ![r, 0] = -2 * a r * b r →
                  deriv v r = (b r - m) * v r →
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N v) ![r, 0] =
                      -2 * a r * m * v r

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic_uniform_sign
declarations.type:
∀ {ℓ M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {v a b : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P m : ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) ℓ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) M U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) v →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < v r) →
              m ≠ 0 →
                (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                  (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ℓ ![r, 0] = 0) →
                    (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, M ![r, 0] = a r) →
                      (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, 0 < a r) →
                        (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 ℓ ![r, 0] = -2 * a r * b r) →
                          (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, deriv v r = (b r - m) * v r) →
                            ∃ ε > 0,
                              ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P,
                                ∀ (δ : ℝ), |δ| < ε → δ * m < 0 → 0 < TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N v ![r, δ]

declarations.name: TightVer401.exitPositiveGraph_uniform_sign
declarations.type:
∀ {ℓ M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {a b : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 < P →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
      Function.Periodic b P →
        IsOpen U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) ℓ U →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) M U →
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
                (∀ (t : ℝ), Function.Periodic (fun r => ℓ ![r, t]) P) →
                  (∀ (t : ℝ), Function.Periodic (fun r => M ![r, t]) P) →
                    (∀ (t : ℝ), Function.Periodic (fun r => N ![r, t]) P) →
                      TightVer401.exitGraphMean P b ≠ 0 →
                        (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                          (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ℓ ![r, 0] = 0) →
                            (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, M ![r, 0] = a r) →
                              (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, 0 < a r) →
                                (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P,
                                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 ℓ ![r, 0] = -2 * a r * b r) →
                                  ∃ ε > 0,
                                    ∀ (δ : ℝ),
                                      |δ| < ε →
                                        δ * TightVer401.exitGraphMean P b < 0 →
                                          ∀ (r : ℝ),
                                            0 <
                                              TightVer401.exitGraphQuadratic ℓ M N
                                                (TightVer401.exitPositiveGraphProfile P b) ![r, δ]

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (L M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N p = -L p / (M p + √(M p ^ 2 - L p * N p))

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope_contDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {L M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) L W →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) M W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N W →
        (∀ p ∈ W, 0 < M p ^ 2 - L p * N p) →
          (∀ p ∈ W, 0 < M p) → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N) W

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope_quadratic
declarations.type:
∀ {L M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  0 ≤ M p ^ 2 - L p * N p →
    M p + √(M p ^ 2 - L p * N p) ≠ 0 →
      L p + 2 * M p * TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N p + N p * TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N p ^ 2 = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope_seam
declarations.type:
∀ {L M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ L p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ M p →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ N p →
        L p = 0 →
          0 < M p →
            ∀ (i : Fin 2),
              TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N p = 0 ∧
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N) p =
                  -OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i L p / (2 * M p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiExit_graph_uniform_smooth_convergence
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ζ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
      χ 0 = 1 →
        IsOpen U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
            (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) p ≠ 0) →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) H r) →
                  ∀ (ε P : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {η : ℝ},
                    0 < η →
                      have v :=
                        TightVer401.exitPositiveGraphProfile P
                          (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                            (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) H χ));
                      ∃ e > 0,
                        ∀ (δ : ℝ),
                          |δ| < e →
                            ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P,
                              ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
                                      (fun s => TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ s)) r -
                                    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ζ r‖ <
                                η

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiMetric_christoffel
declarations.type:
∀ {h : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ h p →
    h p ≠ 0 →
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 0 0 0 p =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 h p / h p ∧
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 0 0 1 p =
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 h p / h p ∧
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 0 1 0 p =
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 h p / h p ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 0 1 1 p = 0 ∧
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 1 0 0 p =
                  -h p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 h p ∧
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 1 0 1 p = 0 ∧
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 1 1 0 p = 0 ∧
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.christoffel (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) 1 1 1 p = 0

declarations.type:
∀ {h : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ h p →
    ∀ (k : Fin 2),
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => TightVer401.fermiMetric h q 0 0) p =
          2 * h p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k h p ∧
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => TightVer401.fermiMetric h q 0 1) p = 0 ∧
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => TightVer401.fermiMetric h q 1 0) p = 0 ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k (fun q => TightVer401.fermiMetric h q 1 1) p = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiMetric_support_entries
declarations.type:
∀ {h H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ h p →
    h p ≠ 0 →
      TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) H p 0 0 =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H) p -
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 h p / h p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H p +
              h p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 h p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H p +
            H p * h p ^ 2 ∧
        TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) H p 0 1 =
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H) p -
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 h p / h p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H p ∧
          TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor (TightVer401.fermiMetric h) H p 1 1 =
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H) p + H p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap
declarations.type: (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ p = Real.cos (p 1) • ζ (p 0) + Real.sin (p 1) • TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap_central_differential_injective
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap_contDiff
declarations.type: ∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ζ → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap_inducedMetric
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap_metric
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap_partials
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},

              TightVer401.fermiNormalScale (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) p • deriv ζ (p 0) ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ) p =
              TightVer401.fermiNormalTransverse ζ p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalMap_unit
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},

        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScale
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScale.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p = Real.cos (p 1) + κ (p 0) * Real.sin (p 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse κ p = -Real.sin (p 1) + κ (p 0) * Real.cos (p 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse_contDiff
declarations.type: ∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse κ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse_partials
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse κ) p =
          deriv κ (p 0) * Real.cos (p 1) ∧
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse κ) p =
          -TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScale_contDiff
declarations.type: ∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScale_partials
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ) p = deriv κ (p 0) * Real.sin (p 1) ∧
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ) p =
          TightVer401.fermiNormalScaleTransverse κ p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScale_periodic
declarations.type: ∀ {L : ℝ} {κ : ℝ → ℝ}, Function.Periodic κ L → TightVer401.FermiPeriodic L (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalScale_seam
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ∀ (r : ℝ),
      TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ ![r, 0] = 1 ∧
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ) ![r, 0] = 0 ∧
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ) ![r, 0] = κ r ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)) ![r, 0] =
                -1 ∧
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)) ![r, 0] =
                deriv κ r

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalTransverse
declarations.type: (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiNormalTransverse.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiNormalTransverse ζ p =
    -Real.sin (p 1) • ζ (p 0) + Real.cos (p 1) • TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPeriodic_coordPartial
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  TightVer401.FermiPeriodic L H → ∀ (i : Fin 2), TightVer401.FermiPeriodic L (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i H)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPeriodic_iff_slices
declarations.type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ),
  TightVer401.FermiPeriodic L H ↔ ∀ (t : ℝ), Function.Periodic (fun r => H ![r, t]) L

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport
declarations.type: ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport_linearMultiplier
declarations.type:
∀ {κ χ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 < P →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
        χ 0 = 1 →
          IsOpen U →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
              (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                  (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r) →
                    TightVer401.exitGraphMean P (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ H) = 0 →
                      ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                        TightVer401.fermiSeamLinearMultiplier P
                            (TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε κ H χ)) κ
                            (TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε κ H χ)) =
                          Real.exp (-(ε / 2 * ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..P, κ r ^ 2))

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport_mean
declarations.type:
∀ {κ χ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
      χ 0 = 1 →
        IsOpen U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
            (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r) →
                  ∀ (P ε : ℝ),
                    TightVer401.exitGraphMean P
                        (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε κ H χ)) =
                      TightVer401.exitGraphMean P (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ H) -
                        (ε / 2 * ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..P, κ r ^ 2) / P

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport_mean_ne_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {χ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P ε : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ζ →
    0 < P →
      Function.Periodic ζ P →
        (∀ (r : ℝ), inner ℝ (ζ r) (ζ r) = 1) →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), inner ℝ (deriv ζ r) (deriv ζ r) = 1) →
            ∀ {e : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
              (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < inner ℝ (ζ r) e) →
                ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
                  χ 0 = 1 →
                    IsOpen U →
                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
                        (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) p ≠ 0) →
                          (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                            (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) H r) →
                              TightVer401.exitGraphMean P
                                    (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) H) =
                                  0 →
                                ε ≠ 0 →
                                  TightVer401.exitGraphMean P
                                      (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                                        (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) H χ)) ≠
                                    0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport_profile_contDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {κ χ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
      χ 0 = 1 →
        IsOpen U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
            (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r) →
                  ∀ (ε P : ℝ),
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤)
                      (TightVer401.exitPositiveGraphProfile P
                        (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε κ H χ)))

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport_seam_coefficients
declarations.type:
∀ {κ χ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
      χ 0 = 1 →
        IsOpen U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
            (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r) →
                  ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                    TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε κ H χ) =
                        TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H ∧
                      (TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε κ H χ) = fun r =>
                          TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal H r + ε * TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r * κ r) ∧
                        TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport ε κ H χ) = fun r =>
                          TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ H r - ε / 2 * κ r ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiProduct
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiProduct._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiProduct.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (A B : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), TightVer401.fermiProduct A B p = A (p 0) * B (p 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiProduct_contDiff
declarations.type: ∀ {A B : ℝ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) A → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) B → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.fermiProduct A B)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiProduct_partials
declarations.type:
∀ {A B : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) A →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) B →
      ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiProduct A B) p = deriv A (p 0) * B (p 1) ∧
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiProduct A B) p = A (p 0) * deriv B (p 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiProduct_quadraticCutoff_seam
declarations.type:
∀ {A χ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) A →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
      ∀ (r : ℝ),
        TightVer401.fermiProduct A (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ) ![r, 0] = 0 ∧
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiProduct A (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ))
                ![r, 0] =
              0 ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiProduct A (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ))
                  ![r, 0] =
                0 ∧
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                      (TightVer401.fermiProduct A (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ)))
                    ![r, 0] =
                  0 ∧
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                      (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                        (TightVer401.fermiProduct A (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ)))
                      ![r, 0] =
                    0 ∧
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                      (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                        (TightVer401.fermiProduct A (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ)))
                      ![r, 0] =
                    2 * A r * χ 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiProduct_second_partials
declarations.type:
∀ {A B : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) A →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) B →
      ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiProduct A B))
              p =
            deriv (deriv A) (p 0) * B (p 1) ∧
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiProduct A B)) p =
              deriv A (p 0) * deriv B (p 1) ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiProduct A B)) p =
              A (p 0) * deriv (deriv B) (p 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (χ : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ), TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ t = t ^ 2 * χ t

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff_contDiff
declarations.type: ∀ {χ : ℝ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {χ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ → ∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ) (2 * t * χ t + t ^ 2 * deriv χ t) t

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff_zero_jets
declarations.type:
∀ {χ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
    TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ 0 = 0 ∧
      deriv (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ) 0 = 0 ∧ deriv (deriv (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ)) 0 = 2 * χ 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiScalar_derivative_periodic
declarations.type: ∀ {a : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a → Function.Periodic a L → Function.Periodic (deriv a) L

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamLinearMultiplier.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (a κ c : ℝ → ℝ),
  TightVer401.fermiSeamLinearMultiplier L a κ c =
    Real.exp (∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.fermiSeamSlopeCoefficient a κ c r)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamLinearMultiplier_perturbation
declarations.type:
∀ {a κ c : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c →
        (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
          ∀ (L ε : ℝ),
            (TightVer401.fermiSeamLinearMultiplier L a κ fun s => c s + ε * a s * κ s) =
              TightVer401.fermiSeamLinearMultiplier L a κ c * Real.exp (-(ε / 2 * ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, κ r ^ 2))

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal
declarations.type: (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamPerturbation
declarations.type: ℝ → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamPerturbation._proof_1
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamPerturbation.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (ε : ℝ) (a κ χ : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiSeamPerturbation ε a κ χ p =
    TightVer401.fermiProduct (fun r => ε / 2 * a r * κ r) (TightVer401.fermiQuadraticCutoff χ) p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSeamPerturbation_const_mul
declarations.type:
∀ (a κ χ : ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ),
  TightVer401.fermiSeamPerturbation ε a κ χ = fun p => ε * TightVer401.fermiSeamPerturbation 1 a κ χ p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupportL._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupportL.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H p =
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H) p -
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ) p /
              TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p *
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H p +
        TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ) p *
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H p +
      H p * TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupportM
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupportM.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p =
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H) p -
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ) p / TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p *
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope_mean_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
        (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r) →
              Function.Periodic κ P →
                TightVer401.FermiPeriodic P H →
                  ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..P, κ r * TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal H r / TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r = 0 →
                    TightVer401.exitGraphMean P (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ H) = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_actual_entries
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ∀ (H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0 →
        TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor (TightVer401.fermiMetric (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)) H p 0 0 =
            TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H p ∧
          TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor (TightVer401.fermiMetric (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)) H p 0 1 =
              TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p ∧
            TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor (TightVer401.fermiMetric (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)) H p 1 1 =
              TightVer401.fermiSupportN H p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_actual_identity_return_mean_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H u : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 ≤ P →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
      IsOpen U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
          (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H ![r, 0] = 0) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r) →
                  IsOpen V →
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
                      (∀ q ∈ V,
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q =
                            TightVer401.fermiSupportAsymptoticSlope κ H ![q 0, u q]) →
                        (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ V) →
                          (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, u ![r, 0] = 0) →
                            (fun x => u ![0, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                              (fun x => u ![P, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                                TightVer401.exitGraphMean P (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope κ H) = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_actual_matrix
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          p ∈ U →
            TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0 →
              TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor (TightVer401.fermiMetric (TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ)) H p =
                !![TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H p, TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p;
                  TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p, TightVer401.fermiSupportN H p]

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_actual_spatial_saddle
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ζ →
    (∀ (r : ℝ), inner ℝ (ζ r) (ζ r) = 1) →
      (∀ (r : ℝ), inner ℝ (deriv ζ r) (deriv ζ r) = 1) →
        IsOpen U →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
            (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ) p ≠ 0) →
              ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                p ∈ U →
                  (TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor
                          (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ)) H p).det <
                      0 →
                    have Q := TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ;
                    have g := OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric Q;
                    have X := TightVer401.sphereSupportMap g Q H;
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U ∧
                      Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ X p) ∧
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (Q p) p ∧
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental X (Q p) p =
                              -TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor g H p ∧
                            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric X) p < 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_add
declarations.type:
∀ {H J : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) H →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) J →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
        TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ (fun q => H q + J q) p =
            TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H p + TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ J p ∧
          TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ (fun q => H q + J q) p =
              TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p + TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ J p ∧
            TightVer401.fermiSupportN (fun q => H q + J q) p =
              TightVer401.fermiSupportN H p + TightVer401.fermiSupportN J p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_const_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {J : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) J →
    ∀ (ε : ℝ) (κ : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
      TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ (fun q => ε * J q) p = ε * TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ J p ∧
        TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ (fun q => ε * J q) p = ε * TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ J p ∧
          TightVer401.fermiSupportN (fun q => ε * J q) p = ε * TightVer401.fermiSupportN J p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_contDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    IsOpen U →

declarations.type:
∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

    ∀ (κ : ℝ → ℝ),
      TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ F =ᶠ[nhds p] TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ G ∧
        TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ F =ᶠ[nhds p] TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ G ∧

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_flow_return_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H u : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U V W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 ≤ P →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
      IsOpen U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
          (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H ![r, 0] = 0) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r) →
                  IsOpen V →
                    IsOpen W →
                      W ⊆ U →
                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
                          (∀ p ∈ W,
                              0 <
                                TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p ^ 2 -
                                  TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H p * TightVer401.fermiSupportN H p) →
                            (∀ p ∈ W, 0 < TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p) →

                                      (fun x => u ![0, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                                        HasDerivAt (fun x => u ![P, x])
                                          (TightVer401.fermiSeamLinearMultiplier P (TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H) κ
                                            (TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal H))
                                          0

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_local_add
declarations.type:
∀ {H J : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) J →
        ∀ (κ : ℝ → ℝ) {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          p ∈ U →
            TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ (fun q => H q + J q) p =
                TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H p + TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ J p ∧
              TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ (fun q => H q + J q) p =
                  TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H p + TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ J p ∧
                TightVer401.fermiSupportN (fun q => H q + J q) p =
                  TightVer401.fermiSupportN H p + TightVer401.fermiSupportN J p

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_local_seam_codazzi
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
        ∀ {r : ℝ},
          ![r, 0] ∈ U →
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H) ![r, 0] =
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H) ![r, 0] +
                  κ r * TightVer401.fermiSupportN H ![r, 0] +
                κ r * TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H ![r, 0]

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_local_seam_slope_coefficient
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
        (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiNormalScale κ p ≠ 0) →
          ∀ {r : ℝ},
            ![r, 0] ∈ U →
              TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H ![r, 0] = 0 →
                0 < TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r →
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H) ![r, 0] =
                      -2 * TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H r *
                        TightVer401.fermiSeamSlopeCoefficient (TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H) κ
                          (TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal H) r ∧
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                        (TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope (TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H)
                          (TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H) (TightVer401.fermiSupportN H))
                        ![r, 0] =
                      TightVer401.fermiSeamSlopeCoefficient (TightVer401.fermiSeamMixed κ H) κ
                        (TightVer401.fermiSeamNormal H) r

declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ∀ (H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (r : ℝ),
      TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H ![r, 0] =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H) ![r, 0] +
              κ r * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H ![r, 0] +
            H ![r, 0] ∧
        TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H ![r, 0] =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H) ![r, 0] -
            κ r * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H ![r, 0]

declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) H →
      ∀ (r : ℝ),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.fermiSupportM κ H) ![r, 0] =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H)) ![r, 0] -
              deriv κ r * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H ![r, 0] -
            κ r * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H) ![r, 0]

declarations.name: TightVer401.fermiSupport_transverse_seam
declarations.type:
∀ {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) H →
      ∀ (r : ℝ),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.fermiSupportL κ H) ![r, 0] =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H)) ![r, 0] -
                  deriv κ r * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 H ![r, 0] +
                κ r ^ 2 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H ![r, 0] +
              κ r * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 H) ![r, 0] +
