declarations.name: TightVer401.finite_moment_period_prescription
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (L : ℝ) [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (f : AddCircle L → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (g b : AddCircle L → ℝ),
  Continuous f →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (f ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) →
      Continuous g →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (b ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) →
          (∀ (q : AddCircle L), 0 < b q) →
            (∃ q, 0 < g q) →
              (∃ q, g q < 0) →
                ∀ (B : ℝ) {η ε : ℝ},
                  0 < η →
                    0 < ε →
                      ∃ A,
                        ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) A ∧
                          (∀ (q : AddCircle L), 0 < A q) ∧
                            ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                  ‖A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) - b ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r)‖ <
                                η ∧
                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                    A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) • f ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) =
                                  ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                    b ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) • f ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) ∧
                                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                      g ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) /
                                        √(A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r)) =
                                    B ∧
                                  ∃ centers radii,
                                    (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f) + 1)),
                                        0 ≤ radii j) ∧
                                      ∑ j, 2 * radii j < ε ∧
                                        (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆
                                          ⋃ j,
                                            ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) ''
                                              Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.finite_moment_period_prescription_smooth_circle
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (L : ℝ) [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (f : AddCircle L → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (g b : AddCircle L → ℝ),
  ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))) (↑⊤) f →
    ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) g →
      ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) b →
        (∀ (q : AddCircle L), 0 < b q) →
          (∃ q, 0 < g q) →
            (∃ q, g q < 0) →
              ∀ (B : ℝ) {η ε : ℝ},
                0 < η →
                  0 < ε →
                    ∃ A,
                      ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) A ∧
                        (∀ (q : AddCircle L), 0 < A q) ∧
                          ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                ‖A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) - b ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r)‖ <
                              η ∧
                            ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                  A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) • f ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) =
                                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                  b ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) • f ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) ∧
                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                    g ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) / √(A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r)) =
                                  B ∧
                                ∃ centers radii,
                                  (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f) + 1)),
                                      0 ≤ radii j) ∧
                                    ∑ j, 2 * radii j < ε ∧
                                      (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆
                                        ⋃ j,
                                          ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) ''
                                            Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.finite_quadratic_diagonal
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {Y : Fin m → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (k : Fin m), DifferentiableAt ℝ (Y k) p) →
    (∀ (k l : Fin m), k ≠ l → Disjoint (tsupport (Y k)) (tsupport (Y l))) →
      ∀ (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (fun q => ∑ k, c k • Y k q) p i j =
          ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (Y k) p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.finite_sign_metric
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {X : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {Y : Fin m → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U →
    (∀ (k : Fin m), TightVer401.IsInfinitesimalBendingOn X (Y k) U) →
      (∀ (k l : Fin m), k ≠ l → Disjoint (tsupport (Y k)) (tsupport (Y l))) →
        IsOpen U →
          ∀ (a ε : Fin m → ℝ),
            (∀ (k : Fin m), ε k ^ 2 = 1) →
              ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                p ∈ U →
                  ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (fun q => X q + ∑ k, (ε k * a k) • Y k q) p i j =
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric X p i j +
                        ∑ k, a k ^ 2 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (Y k) p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussCoordinate_differential_injective
declarations.type:
∀ {N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, ‖N q‖ = 1) →
        ∀ (w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          ‖w‖ = 1 →
            ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
              p ∈ U →
                0 < inner ℝ w (N p) →
                  Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ N p) →
                    Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.gaussCoordinate w hw N) p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImageInverse
declarations.type: {M : Type u_1} → [Nonempty M] → (M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere) → Set M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → M

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImageInverse.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty M] (N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere) (U : Set M) (q : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere),
  TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U q = if hq : q ∈ N '' U then Classical.choose hq else Classical.arbitrary M

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImageInverse_contMDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty M] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_2 : ChartedSpace OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord M]
  [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere}
  {U : Set M},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun x => ↑(N x)) q)) →
        Set.InjOn N U →
          ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
            (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) (TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U) (N '' U)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImageInverse_left
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere} {U : Set M},
  Set.InjOn N U → ∀ {p : M}, p ∈ U → TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U (N p) = p

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImageInverse_mem
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere} {U : Set M} {q : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  q ∈ N '' U → TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U q ∈ U

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImageInverse_right
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere} {U : Set M} {q : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  q ∈ N '' U → N (TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U q) = q

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImage_inverse
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty M] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_2 : ChartedSpace OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord M]
  [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere}
  {U : Set M},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun x => ↑(N x)) q)) →
        Set.InjOn N U →
          IsOpen (N '' U) ∧
            ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
                (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) (TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U)
                (N '' U) ∧
              (∀ p ∈ U, TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U (N p) = p) ∧
                ∀ q ∈ N '' U, TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U q ∈ U ∧ N (TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U q) = q

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImage_support_exists
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord M]
  [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere}
  {X : M → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set M},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun x => ↑(N x)) q)) →
        Set.InjOn N U →
          ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
              (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) X U →
            (∀ p ∈ U,
                ∀ (v : TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) p),
                  inner ℝ ((mfderiv% X p) v) ↑(N p) = 0) →
              ∃ H,
                IsOpen (N '' U) ∧
                  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) H
                      (N '' U) ∧
                    ∀ p ∈ U, X p = TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H (N p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussImage_support_reconstruction
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty M] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_2 : ChartedSpace OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord M]
  [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere}
  {X : M → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set M},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun x => ↑(N x)) q)) →
        Set.InjOn N U →
          ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
              (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) X U →
            (∀ p ∈ U,
                ∀ (v : TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) p),
                  inner ℝ ((mfderiv% X p) v) ↑(N p) = 0) →
              have F := fun q => X (TightVer401.gaussImageInverse N U q);
              have H := fun q => inner ℝ (F q) ↑q;
              IsOpen (N '' U) ∧
                ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) H
                    (N '' U) ∧
                  ∀ p ∈ U, X p = TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H (N p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussManifold_exists_smooth_local_inverse
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord M]
  [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere}
  {U : Set M},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun x => ↑(N x)) q)) →
        ∀ {p : M},
          p ∈ U →
            ∃ e,
              p ∈ e.source ∧
                e.source ⊆ U ∧
                  (∀ q ∈ e.source, ↑e q = N q) ∧
                    ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
                      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussManifold_image_isOpen
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord M]
  [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) M] {N : M → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere}
  {U : Set M},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U → (∀ q ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun x => ↑(N x)) q)) → IsOpen (N '' U)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussMap_differential_injective
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {X N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsometricOn g X U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
        IsOpen U →
          (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (N q) q) →
            ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
              p ∈ U → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature g p ≠ 0 → Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ N p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussMap_differential_injective_of_second_form
declarations.type:
∀ {X N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
      IsOpen U →
        (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (N q) q) →
          ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
            p ∈ U → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental X (N p) p).det ≠ 0 → Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ N p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussMap_exists_smooth_inverse_coordinates
declarations.type:
∀ {N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, ‖N q‖ = 1) →
        (∀ q ∈ U, Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ N q)) →
          ∀ (w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (hw : w ≠ 0),
            ‖w‖ = 1 →
              ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                p ∈ U →
                  0 < inner ℝ w (N p) →
                    ∃ e,
                      p ∈ e.source ∧
                        e.source ⊆ U ∧
                          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target ∧
                            ↑e = TightVer401.gaussCoordinate w hw N ∧
                              ∀ q ∈ e.source, N q = TightVer401.sphereHemisphere w hw (↑e q)

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussMap_partial_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {X N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
      IsOpen U →
        (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (N q) q) →
          ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
            p ∈ U →
              ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                inner ℝ (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i N p) (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j X p) =
                  -OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental X (N p) p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.gaussSupport_reconstruction_local
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {X N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsometricOn g X U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
        IsOpen U →
          (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (N q) q) →
            (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature g q ≠ 0) →
              ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                p ∈ U →
                  ∃ (hw : N p ≠ 0) (_ : ‖N p‖ = 1),
                    ∃ e,
                      p ∈ e.source ∧
                        e.source ⊆ U ∧
                          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target ∧
                            (∀ q ∈ e.source, N q = TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (N p) hw (↑e q)) ∧
                              ∀ y ∈ e.target,
                                X (↑e.symm y) =
                                  TightVer401.sphereSupportMap
                                    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (N p) hw))
                                    (TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (N p) hw)
                                    (fun z => inner ℝ (X (↑e.symm z)) (TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (N p) hw z)) y

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledCross
declarations.type:
(ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
  (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
    (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledCross._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledCross.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p = TightVer401.ambientCross (c₁ (p 0) + p 1 • e₁ (p 0)) (e (p 0))

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledDelta
declarations.type:
(ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
  (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledDelta._proof_1
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledDelta.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (s : ℝ),
  TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ s = inner ℝ (e₁ s) (TightVer401.ambientCross (c₁ s) (e s))

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledDelta_eq_det
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (s : ℝ),
  TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ s =
    Matrix.det ![fun i => (c₁ s).ofLp i, fun i => (e s).ofLp i, fun i => (e₁ s).ofLp i]

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient
declarations.type: (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
  TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e =
    TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁ (deriv c) e (deriv e) (deriv (deriv c)) (deriv (deriv e))

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledNormal
declarations.type:
(ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
  (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
    (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledNormal.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p =
    ‖TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p‖⁻¹ • TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient
declarations.type: (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
  TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient c e = TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂ (deriv c) e (deriv e) (deriv (deriv e))

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁
declarations.type:
(ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
  (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
    (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
      (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁._proof_1
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (t : ℝ),
  TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁ c₁ e e₁ c₂ e₂ t =
    -(inner ℝ (c₂ t) (TightVer401.ambientCross (e₁ t) (e t)) + inner ℝ (e₂ t) (TightVer401.ambientCross (c₁ t) (e t))) /
      (2 * TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ t)

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂
declarations.type:
(ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
  (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
    (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (t : ℝ),
  TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂ c₁ e e₁ e₂ t =
    -inner ℝ (e₂ t) (TightVer401.ambientCross (e₁ t) (e t)) / (2 * TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ t)

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledReturn
declarations.type: (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory
declarations.type: (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_actual_coefficients_contDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.generalRuledDelta (deriv c) e (deriv e) s ≠ 0) →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁ (deriv c) e (deriv e) (deriv (deriv c)) (deriv (deriv e))) ∧
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂ (deriv c) e (deriv e) (deriv (deriv e)))

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_actual_riccati
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.generalRuledDelta (deriv c) e (deriv e) s ≠ 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) ![s, 0]) ![s, 0] 0 0 =
              0) →
          ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (w : ℝ),
            ![1, w] ⬝ᵥ
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                        (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) p) p).mulVec
                    ![1, w] =
                0 ↔
              w =
                TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁ (deriv c) e (deriv e) (deriv (deriv c)) (deriv (deriv e)) (p 0) * p 1 +
                  TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂ (deriv c) e (deriv e) (deriv (deriv e)) (p 0) * p 1 ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_asymptotic_slope
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {w : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt c (c₁ s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (e₁ s) s) →
      HasDerivAt c₁ (c₂ (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt e₁ (e₂ (p 0)) (p 0) →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledMap c e) →
            TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
              (![1, w] ⬝ᵥ
                    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                          (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p) p).mulVec
                      ![1, w] =
                  0 ↔
                w =
                  -inner ℝ (c₂ (p 0) + p 1 • e₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p) /
                    (2 * TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0)))

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_central_numerator_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {s : ℝ},
  (∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt c (c₁ t) t) →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (e₁ t) t) →
      HasDerivAt c₁ (c₂ s) s →
        HasDerivAt e₁ (e₂ s) s →
          TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ s ≠ 0 →
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                  (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ ![s, 0]) ![s, 0] 0 0 =
                0 →
              inner ℝ (c₂ s) (TightVer401.ambientCross (c₁ s) (e s)) = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_coefficients_contDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {c₁ e e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e₁ →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c₂ →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e₂ →
            (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ s ≠ 0) →
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁ c₁ e e₁ c₂ e₂) ∧
                ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂ c₁ e e₁ e₂)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_contDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_cross_ne_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {c₁ e e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0) ≠ 0 → TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p ≠ 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_differential_injective
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  HasDerivAt c (c₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt e (e₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
      TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0) ≠ 0 → Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.ruledMap c e) p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_flow_over_period
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.generalRuledDelta (deriv c) e (deriv e) s ≠ 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) ![s, 0]) ![s, 0] 0 0 =
              0) →
          ∀ (L : ℝ),
            ∃ δ > 0,
              ∀ (x : ℝ),
                |x| < δ →
                  TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory c e x 0 = x ∧
                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
                        HasDerivAt (TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory c e x)
                          (TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e t *
                              TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory c e x t +
                            TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient c e t *
                              TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory c e x t ^ 2)
                          t) ∧
                      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
                          have p := ![t, TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory c e x t];
                          have v := deriv (fun r => ![r, TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory c e x r]) t;
                          v ⬝ᵥ
                              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                                    (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) p) p).mulVec
                                v =
                            0) ∧
                        TightVer401.generalRuledTrajectory c e x L = TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L x

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_gaussianCurvature
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.generalRuledDelta (deriv c) e (deriv e) s ≠ 0) →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.ruledMap c e))
              p =
            -TightVer401.generalRuledDelta (deriv c) e (deriv e) (p 0) ^ 2 /
              ‖TightVer401.generalRuledCross (deriv c) e (deriv e) p‖ ^ 4

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_isUnitNormal
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  HasDerivAt c (c₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt e (e₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
      TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt (TightVer401.ruledMap c e) (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p) p

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_metric_det
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  HasDerivAt c (c₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt e (e₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
      (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.ruledMap c e) p).det =
        ‖TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_mixed_numerator
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  inner ℝ (e₁ (p 0)) (TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p) = TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_normal_unit
declarations.type:
∀ {c₁ e e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
    inner ℝ (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p) (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p) = 1

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_numerator_polynomial
declarations.type:
∀ (c₁ e e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  inner ℝ (c₂ (p 0) + p 1 • e₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p) =
    inner ℝ (c₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.ambientCross (c₁ (p 0)) (e (p 0))) +
        (inner ℝ (c₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.ambientCross (e₁ (p 0)) (e (p 0))) +
            inner ℝ (e₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.ambientCross (c₁ (p 0)) (e (p 0)))) *
          p 1 +
      inner ℝ (e₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.ambientCross (e₁ (p 0)) (e (p 0))) * p 1 ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_partial
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  HasDerivAt c (c₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt e (e₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledMap c e) p =
          Pi.single i 1 0 • (c₁ (p 0) + p 1 • e₁ (p 0)) + Pi.single i 1 1 • e (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_partial_t
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  HasDerivAt c (c₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt e (e₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.ruledMap c e) p = c₁ (p 0) + p 1 • e₁ (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_partial_u
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  HasDerivAt c (c₁ (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt e (e₁ (p 0)) (p 0) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.ruledMap c e) p = e (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_periodic_coefficients
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {L : ℝ},
  Function.Periodic c L →
    Function.Periodic e L →
      Function.Periodic (TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e) L ∧
        Function.Periodic (TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient c e) L

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_periodic_map
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {L : ℝ},
  Function.Periodic c L →
    Function.Periodic e L → ∀ (t u : ℝ), TightVer401.ruledMap c e ![t + L, u] = TightVer401.ruledMap c e ![t, u]

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_q_polynomial
declarations.type:
∀ {c₁ e e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  inner ℝ (c₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.ambientCross (c₁ (p 0)) (e (p 0))) = 0 →
    -inner ℝ (c₂ (p 0) + p 1 • e₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p) /
        (2 * TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0)) =
      TightVer401.generalRuledQ₁ c₁ e e₁ c₂ e₂ (p 0) * p 1 + TightVer401.generalRuledQ₂ c₁ e e₁ e₂ (p 0) * p 1 ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_return
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {L : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e →
      Function.Periodic c L →
        Function.Periodic e L →
          0 < L →
            (∀ (s : ℝ),
                Matrix.det ![fun i => (deriv c s).ofLp i, fun i => (e s).ofLp i, fun i => (deriv e s).ofLp i] ≠ 0) →
              (∀ (s : ℝ),
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                      (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) ![s, 0]) ![s, 0] 0 0 =
                    0) →
                (∀ (t u : ℝ), TightVer401.ruledMap c e ![t + L, u] = TightVer401.ruledMap c e ![t, u]) ∧
                  (Function.Periodic (TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e) L ∧
                      Function.Periodic (TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient c e) L) ∧
                    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)) p =
                            -TightVer401.generalRuledDelta (deriv c) e (deriv e) (p 0) ^ 2 /
                              ‖TightVer401.generalRuledCross (deriv c) e (deriv e) p‖ ^ 4 ∧
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)) p <
                            0) ∧
                      (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (w : ℝ),
                          ![1, w] ⬝ᵥ
                                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                                      (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) p) p).mulVec
                                  ![1, w] =
                              0 ↔
                            w =
                              TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e (p 0) * p 1 +
                                TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient c e (p 0) * p 1 ^ 2) ∧
                        (∃ δ > 0,
                            ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ),
                              |u 0| < δ →
                                (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt u (deriv u t) t) →
                                  (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
                                      have p := ![t, u t];
                                      have v := deriv (fun r => ![r, u r]) t;
                                      v ⬝ᵥ
                                          (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                                                (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) p) p).mulVec
                                            v =
                                        0) →
                                    u L = TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L (u 0)) ∧
                          ((TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun u => u) ↔
                              Real.exp (TightVer401.riccatiA (TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e) L) = 1 ∧
                                TightVer401.riccatiV (TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e)
                                    (TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient c e) L =
                                  0) ∧
                            ((TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun u => u) ↔
                              deriv (TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L) 0 = 1 ∧
                                deriv (deriv (TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L)) 0 = 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_return_identity_iff
declarations.type:
∀ (c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (L : ℝ),
  ((TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun u => u) ↔
      Real.exp (TightVer401.riccatiA (TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e) L) = 1 ∧
        TightVer401.riccatiV (TightVer401.generalRuledLinearCoefficient c e)
            (TightVer401.generalRuledQuadraticCoefficient c e) L =
          0) ∧
    ((TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun u => u) ↔
      deriv (TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L) 0 = 1 ∧ deriv (deriv (TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L)) 0 = 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_return_of_asymptotic_curve
declarations.type:
∀ {c e : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {L : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) c →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) e →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.generalRuledDelta (deriv c) e (deriv e) s ≠ 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) ![s, 0]) ![s, 0] 0 0 =
              0) →
          0 ≤ L →
            ∃ δ > 0,
              ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ),
                |u 0| < δ →
                  (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt u (deriv u t) t) →
                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
                        have p := ![t, u t];
                        have v := deriv (fun r => ![r, u r]) t;
                        v ⬝ᵥ
                            (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                                  (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal (deriv c) e (deriv e) p) p).mulVec
                              v =
                          0) →
                      u L = TightVer401.generalRuledReturn c e L (u 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_second_forms
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt c (c₁ s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (e₁ s) s) →
      HasDerivAt c₁ (c₂ (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt e₁ (e₂ (p 0)) (p 0) →
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p) p 0 0 =
              inner ℝ (c₂ (p 0) + p 1 • e₂ (p 0)) (TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p) /
                ‖TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p‖ ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                  (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p) p 0 1 =
                TightVer401.generalRuledDelta c₁ e e₁ (p 0) / ‖TightVer401.generalRuledCross c₁ e e₁ p‖ ∧
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)
                  (TightVer401.generalRuledNormal c₁ e e₁ p) p 1 1 =
                0

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_second_tt
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ c₂ e₂ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt c (c₁ s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (e₁ s) s) →
      HasDerivAt c₁ (c₂ (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt e₁ (e₂ (p 0)) (p 0) →
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.ruledMap c e))
              p =
            c₂ (p 0) + p 1 • e₂ (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.general_ruled_second_tu
declarations.type:
∀ {c e c₁ e₁ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt c (c₁ s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (e₁ s) s) →
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)) p =
          e₁ (p 0) ∧
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.ruledMap c e)) p =
          0

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport
declarations.type: (↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ) → ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_chart
declarations.type:
∀ {H : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ},
  ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) H →
    ∀ (w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hu : ‖w‖ = 1) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
      TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H (TightVer401.sphereHemispherePoint w hw hu p) =
        TightVer401.hemisphereSupport w hw hu H p

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_chartOn
declarations.type:
∀ {H : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ} {Ω : Set ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) H Ω →
    IsOpen Ω →
      ∀ (w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hu : ‖w‖ = 1) {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ TightVer401.hemisphereDomain w hw hu Ω →
          TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H (TightVer401.sphereHemispherePoint w hw hu p) =
            TightVer401.hemisphereSupport w hw hu H p

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_chart_geometryOn
declarations.type:
∀ {H : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ} {Ω : Set ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) H Ω →
    IsOpen Ω →
      ∀ (w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hu : ‖w‖ = 1),
        have Q := TightVer401.sphereHemisphere w hw;
        have P := TightVer401.sphereHemispherePoint w hw hu;
        have g := OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric Q;
        have h := TightVer401.hemisphereHeight w hw hu H;
        have A := fun z => TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H (P z);
        have V := TightVer401.hemisphereDomain w hw hu Ω;
        ∀ p ∈ V,
          (∀ (i : Fin 2),
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i A p =
                TightVer401.sphereTangentLift g Q p (TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor g h p i)) ∧
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt A (Q p) p ∧
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric A p =
                  TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor g h p * (g p)⁻¹ * (TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor g h p).transpose ∧
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental A (Q p) p = -TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor g h p ∧
                  ((TightVer401.sphereSupportTensor g h p).det ≠ 0 →
                    Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ A p) ∧
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric A) p =
                        1 / (TightVer401.sphereSupportEndomorphism g h p).det)

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_congr_of_eventuallyEq
declarations.type:
∀ {H K : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ} {q : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  H =ᶠ[nhds q] K → TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H q = TightVer401.globalSphereSupport K q

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_congr_on_open
declarations.type:
∀ {H K : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ} {Ω : Set ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  IsOpen Ω →
    Set.EqOn H K Ω →
      ∀ {q : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
        q ∈ Ω → TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H q = TightVer401.globalSphereSupport K q

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_contMDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {H : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ},
  ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) H →
    ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H)

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_contMDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {H : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → ℝ} {Ω : Set ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) H Ω →
    IsOpen Ω →
      ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
        (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (TightVer401.globalSphereSupport H) Ω

declarations.name: TightVer401.globalSphereSupport_converseOn
declarations.type:
∀ {F : ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {Ω : Set ↑TightVer401.RoundSphere},
  ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) F Ω →
    IsOpen Ω →
      (∀ q ∈ Ω,
          ∀ (v : TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) q),
            inner ℝ ((mfderiv% F q) v) ↑q = 0) →

  {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  0 < w →
    TightVer401.IdentityBandCentralSupportWithPotential d w a κ S G U →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.identityBandCentralSourceTrace d) ∧
        Function.Periodic (TightVer401.identityBandCentralSourceTrace d) T ∧
          Set.MapsTo (TightVer401.identityBandCentralSourceTrace d) Set.univ U ∧
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.identityBandCentralGradientTrace d) ∧
              Function.Periodic (TightVer401.identityBandCentralGradientTrace d) T ∧
                (∀ (s : ℝ),
                    TightVer401.identityBandCentralGradientTrace d s =
                      TightVer401.planarGradient G (TightVer401.identityBandCentralSourceTrace d s)) ∧
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.identityBandCentralValueTrace d G) ∧
                    Function.Periodic (TightVer401.identityBandCentralValueTrace d G) T ∧
                      (∀ (s : ℝ),
                          deriv (TightVer401.identityBandCentralGradientTrace d) s =
                            (TightVer401.planarHessian G (TightVer401.identityBandCentralSourceTrace d s)).mulVec
                              (deriv (TightVer401.identityBandCentralSourceTrace d) s)) ∧

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBandCentralSupport_seed_geometry
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10000 ≤ N →
    ∀ {η : ℝ},
      0 < η →
        have ell := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N;
        have L := ↑N * ell;
        ∃ e,
          ⇑e = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcMap ↑N ∧
            ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑e.symm ∧
              ∃ a,
                ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a ∧
                  Function.Periodic a ell ∧
                    (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) ∧
                      ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..ell, ‖a r - TightVer401.corrugatedSeedInitialSpeed (↑N) (⇑e.symm) r‖ < η ∧
                        ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                              a r • TightVer401.normalLoopTangent (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) r =
                            0 ∧
                          ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                deriv (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm))
                                    r /
                                  √(a r) =
                              0 ∧
                            TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (1 / 4) (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBeta ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm)
                                (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedPartner (↑N) (⇑e.symm) ell a) ∧
                              TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (4 / 5)
                                  (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                    (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedPartner (↑N) (⇑e.symm) ell a))
                                  (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBeta ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm)) ∧
                                Set.InjOn
                                    (TightVer401.covariantSpeedCurve ell (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedRotation ↑N) a
                                      (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedFrameHorizontal ↑N ⇑e.symm))
                                    (Set.Ico 0 L) ∧
                                  ∃ S,
                                    ⇑S = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a ∧
                                      ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                        ∃ d,
                                          d.γ =
                                              TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedSpatial (↑N) (⇑e.symm) ell a ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                            d.T =
                                                TightVer401.normalLoopTangent
                                                    (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) ∘
                                                  ⇑S.symm ∧
                                              d.E = deriv (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                                d.n = (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                                  d.k =
                                                      TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalK a
                                                        (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature
                                                          (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm))
                                                        ⇑S.symm ∧
                                                    d.τ = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalTau a ⇑S.symm ∧
                                                      TightVer401.PrincipalNormalIdentityBand d ∧
                                                        ∃ (_ :
                                                          0 < OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a L),
                                                          Function.Injective ⋯.lift ∧
                                                            (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < (d.n s).ofLp 2) ∧
                                                              Function.Injective
                                                                  (⇑TightVer401.corrugatedAmbientHorizontalCLM ∘
                                                                    ⋯.lift) ∧
                                                                ∃ oldw > 0,
                                                                  Topology.IsEmbedding d.bandMap ∧
                                                                    Topology.IsEmbedding
                                                                      (⇑TightVer401.corrugatedAmbientHorizontalCLM ∘
                                                                        d.bandMap)

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBandCentralSupport_seed_geometry._proof_1_2
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10000 ≤ N →
    ∀ (hNr : 1 < ↑N) (e : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (a : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∃ A B,
          ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) A ∧
            ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) B ∧
              (∀ (r : ℝ), A ((TightVer401.periodProjection (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N)) r) = a r) ∧
                (∀ (r : ℝ),
                    B ((TightVer401.periodProjection (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N)) r) =
                      TightVer401.corrugatedSeedInitialSpeed (↑N) (⇑e.symm) r) ∧
                  ∃ n ≤ 2,
                    ∃ centers radii,
                      (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 ≤ radii j) ∧
                        ∑ j, 2 * radii j < 1 ∧
                          (Function.support fun q => A q - B q) ⊆
                            ⋃ j,
                              ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N)) ''
                                Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)) →
        ¬2 ≤ N → False

            (∀ (p : M) (v : TangentSpace (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) p),

              (∀ (p : M),
                  Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun p => TightVer401.identityBandPlanarHorizontalCLM (X p)) p)) →
                (Function.Injective fun p => TightVer401.identityBandPlanarHorizontalCLM (X p)) →
                  ∃ G e h g,
                    e.source = Set.univ ∧
                      e.target = Set.range (TightVer401.identityBandPlanarSource N) ∧
                        ↑e = TightVer401.identityBandPlanarSource N ∧
                          ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
                              (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) ↑⊤ ↑e ∧
                            ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
                                (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target ∧
                              h.source = Set.univ ∧

                                        (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (↑⊤) (↑h.symm)
                                        h.target ∧
                                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.target ∧
                                        (∀ (p : M), TightVer401.planarSupportMap G (↑e p) = X p) ∧
                                          g.source = e.target ∧
                                            g.target = h.target ∧
                                              Set.EqOn (↑g) (TightVer401.planarGradient G) g.source ∧

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_cartesian_pullback_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {X N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {P : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      IsOpen V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) P V →
          Set.MapsTo P V U →
            Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarSupportMap G ∘ P) X V →
              Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarUnitNormal ∘ P) N V →
                ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                  p ∈ V →
                    ∀ (v w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                      inner ℝ ((fderiv ℝ X p) v) ((fderiv ℝ N p) w) =
                        (fderiv ℝ P p) v ⬝ᵥ (TightVer401.planarHessian G (P p)).mulVec ((fderiv ℝ P p) w) /
                          TightVer401.planarWeight (P p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_central_cartesian_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (s : ℝ) {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      IsOpen V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) P V →
          Set.MapsTo P V U →
            Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarSupportMap G ∘ P) (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E) V →
              Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarUnitNormal ∘ P) d.rawGaussMap V →
                ![s, 0] ∈ V →
                  ∀ {a : ℝ},
                    0 < a →
                      d.τ s = -a⁻¹ →
                        ∀ (v w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                          (fderiv ℝ P ![s, 0]) (a • v) ⬝ᵥ
                                (TightVer401.planarHessian G (P ![s, 0])).mulVec ((fderiv ℝ P ![s, 0]) (a • w)) /
                              TightVer401.planarWeight (P ![s, 0]) =
                            a * (v 0 * w 1 + v 1 * w 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_central_cartesian_positive_transverse
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (s : ℝ) {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      IsOpen V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) P V →
          Set.MapsTo P V U →
            Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarSupportMap G ∘ P) (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E) V →
              Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarUnitNormal ∘ P) d.rawGaussMap V →
                ![s, 0] ∈ V →
                  ∀ {a t : ℝ},
                    0 < a →
                      d.τ s = -a⁻¹ →
                        0 < t →
                          have v := (fderiv ℝ P ![s, 0]) (a • ![1, t]);
                          have b := v ⬝ᵥ (TightVer401.planarHessian G (P ![s, 0])).mulVec v;
                          b / TightVer401.planarWeight (P ![s, 0]) = 2 * a * t ∧
                            0 < b / TightVer401.planarWeight (P ![s, 0]) ∧ 0 < b

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_central_cartesian_tensor
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (s : ℝ) {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      IsOpen V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) P V →
          Set.MapsTo P V U →
            Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarSupportMap G ∘ P) (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E) V →
              Set.EqOn (TightVer401.planarUnitNormal ∘ P) d.rawGaussMap V →
                ![s, 0] ∈ V →
                  ∀ {a : ℝ},
                    0 < a →
                      d.τ s = -a⁻¹ →
                        have Q := fun i => (fderiv ℝ P ![s, 0]) (a • Pi.single i 1);
                        (fun i j =>
                            Q i ⬝ᵥ (TightVer401.planarHessian G (P ![s, 0])).mulVec (Q j) /
                              TightVer401.planarWeight (P ![s, 0])) =
                          !![0, a; a, 0]

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_central_differential_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (s : ℝ) {a : ℝ},
  a ≠ 0 →
    d.τ s = -a⁻¹ →
      ∀ (v w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_central_mixed_pairing_pos

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_central_support_tensor
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10000 ≤ N →
    ∀ {η : ℝ},
      0 < η →
        have ell := TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcCell ↑N;
        have L := ↑N * ell;
        ∃ e,
          ⇑e = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcMap ↑N ∧
            ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑e.symm ∧
              ∃ a,
                ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a ∧
                  Function.Periodic a ell ∧
                    (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) ∧
                      ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..ell, ‖a r - TightVer401.corrugatedSeedInitialSpeed (↑N) (⇑e.symm) r‖ < η ∧
                        ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                              a r • TightVer401.normalLoopTangent (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) r =
                            0 ∧
                          ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                deriv (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm))
                                    r /
                                  √(a r) =
                              0 ∧
                            TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (1 / 4) (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBeta ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm)
                                (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedPartner (↑N) (⇑e.symm) ell a) ∧
                              TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (4 / 5)
                                  (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                    (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedPartner (↑N) (⇑e.symm) ell a))
                                  (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBeta ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm)) ∧
                                ∃ S,
                                  ⇑S = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a ∧
                                    ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                      ∃ d,
                                        d.γ = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedSpatial (↑N) (⇑e.symm) ell a ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                          d.T =
                                              TightVer401.normalLoopTangent
                                                  (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) ∘
                                                ⇑S.symm ∧
                                            d.E = deriv (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                              d.n = (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm) ∘ ⇑S.symm ∧
                                                d.k =
                                                    TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalK a
                                                      (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature
                                                        (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm))
                                                      ⇑S.symm ∧
                                                  d.τ = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalTau a ⇑S.symm ∧
                                                    TightVer401.PrincipalNormalIdentityBand d ∧
                                                      ∃ (hT :
                                                        0 < OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a L),
                                                        ∃ w > 0,
                                                          TightVer401.IdentityBandTwoSidedCollar d w ∧
                                                            TightVer401.ProtectedIdentityBendingSubband d w ∧
                                                              ∃ G U,
                                                                TightVer401.IdentityBandCentralSupportWithPotential d w
                                                                  a
                                                                  (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature
                                                                    (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere ↑N ∘ ⇑e.symm))
                                                                  S G U

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_corrected_frame_coefficients
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) {a κ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
      (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
        ∀ (S : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ),
          ⇑S = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a →
            d.k = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalK a κ ⇑S.symm →
              d.τ = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalTau a ⇑S.symm →
                ∀ (s : ℝ),
                  TightVer401.ruledLambda d.τ s = -deriv a (S.symm s) / a (S.symm s) ^ 2 ∧
                    TightVer401.ruledD d.k d.τ s = deriv κ (S.symm s) / a (S.symm s) ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_corrected_frame_tangential_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) {a κ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
      (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
        ∀ (S : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ),
          ⇑S = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a →
            d.k = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalK a κ ⇑S.symm →
              d.τ = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalTau a ⇑S.symm →
                ∀ (s u : ℝ),
                  inner ℝ ((fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E) ![s, u]) (Pi.single 0 1))
                      ((fderiv ℝ d.rawGaussMap ![s, u]) (Pi.single 0 1)) =
                    u * (-deriv a (S.symm s) + u * deriv κ (S.symm s)) /
                      (a (S.symm s) ^ 3 * √(TightVer401.ruledEnergy (d.k s) (d.τ s) u))

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_interior_differential_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (p v w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  inner ℝ ((fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E) p) v) ((fderiv ℝ d.rawGaussMap p) w) =
    -(p 1 * d.τ (p 0) * (TightVer401.ruledLambda d.τ (p 0) + p 1 * TightVer401.ruledD d.k d.τ (p 0)) * v 0 * w 0 +
          d.τ (p 0) * (v 0 * w 1 + v 1 * w 0)) /
      √(TightVer401.ruledEnergy (d.k (p 0)) (d.τ (p 0)) (p 1))

    -(p 1 * d.τ (p 0) * (TightVer401.ruledLambda d.τ (p 0) + p 1 * TightVer401.ruledD d.k d.τ (p 0))) /
      √(TightVer401.ruledEnergy (d.k (p 0)) (d.τ (p 0)) (p 1))

declarations.name: TightVer401.identityBand_interior_tangential_pairing_physical
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) {a κ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {s u a' κ' : ℝ},
  d.k = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalK a κ ψ →
    d.τ = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalTau a ψ →
      HasDerivAt a a' (ψ s) →
        HasDerivAt κ κ' (ψ s) →
          0 < a (ψ s) →
            HasDerivAt ψ (a (ψ s))⁻¹ s →
              inner ℝ ((fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E) ![s, u]) (Pi.single 0 1))
                  ((fderiv ℝ d.rawGaussMap ![s, u]) (Pi.single 0 1)) =
                u * (-a' + u * κ') / (a (ψ s) ^ 3 * √(TightVer401.ruledEnergy (d.k s) (d.τ s) u))

declarations.name: TightVer401.momentPathMoment_eq
declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.momentPrescription_circle_above
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (L : ℝ) [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (f : AddCircle L → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (g b : AddCircle L → ℝ),
  Continuous f →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (f ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) →
      Continuous g →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (b ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) →
          (∀ (q : AddCircle L), 0 < b q) →
            (∃ q, 0 < g q) →
              ∀ {η ε B : ℝ},
                0 < η →
                  0 < ε →
                    TightVer401.momentNonlinearPeriod (b ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L))
                          (g ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) L ≤
                        B →
                      ∃ A,
                        ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) A ∧
                          (∀ (q : AddCircle L), 0 < A q) ∧
                            ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                  ‖A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) - b ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r)‖ <
                                η ∧
                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                    A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) • f ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) =
                                  ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                    b ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) • f ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) ∧
                                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L,
                                      g ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) /
                                        √(A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r)) =
                                    B ∧
                                  ∃ centers radii,
                                    (∀ (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ ↥(TightVer401.circleMomentSpan L f) + 1)),
                                        0 ≤ radii j) ∧
                                      ∑ j, 2 * radii j < ε ∧
                                        (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆
                                          ⋃ j,
                                            ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) ''
                                              Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.momentPrescription_circle_arcs_total
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (L : ℝ) {A b χ : AddCircle L → ℝ} {Ψ : Fin n → AddCircle L → ℝ} {ε : ℝ},
  (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆ Function.support χ ∪ ⋃ j, Function.support (Ψ j) →
    (∃ c r,
        0 ≤ r ∧
          2 * r < ε / (↑n + 1) ∧ Function.support χ ⊆ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Set.Icc (c - r) (c + r)) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n),
          ∃ c r,
            0 ≤ r ∧
              2 * r < ε / (↑n + 1) ∧
                Function.support (Ψ j) ⊆ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Set.Icc (c - r) (c + r)) →
        ∃ centers radii,
          (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), 0 ≤ radii j) ∧
            ∑ j, 2 * radii j < ε ∧
              (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆
                ⋃ j, ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.momentPrescription_circle_short_arcs
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (L : ℝ) {A b χ : AddCircle L → ℝ} {Ψ : Fin n → AddCircle L → ℝ} {ε : ℝ},
  (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆ Function.support χ ∪ ⋃ j, Function.support (Ψ j) →
    (∃ c r, 0 ≤ r ∧ 2 * r < ε ∧ Function.support χ ⊆ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Set.Icc (c - r) (c + r)) →
      (∀ (j : Fin n),
          ∃ c r,
            0 ≤ r ∧ 2 * r < ε ∧ Function.support (Ψ j) ⊆ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Set.Icc (c - r) (c + r)) →
        ∃ centers radii,
          (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), 0 ≤ radii j ∧ 2 * radii j < ε) ∧
            (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆
              ⋃ j, ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) '' Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.momentPrescription_circle_support
declarations.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (L : ℝ) {A b χ : AddCircle L → ℝ} {Ψ : Fin n → AddCircle L → ℝ} {a : ℝ → ℝ},
  (∀ (r : ℝ), A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) = a r) →
    (Function.support fun r => a r - b ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r)) ⊆
        Function.support (χ ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) ∪
          ⋃ j, Function.support (Ψ j ∘ ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L)) →
      (Function.support fun q => A q - b q) ⊆ Function.support χ ∪ ⋃ j, Function.support (Ψ j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.momentPrescription_from_controls
declarations.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {b χ g : ℝ → ℝ} {c : Fin n → ℝ} {ψ : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ} {f : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)} {L u v δ η B : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
      (∀ (j : Fin n), ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (ψ j)) →
        Continuous g →
          Continuous f →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < b r) →
              0 < δ →
                Function.Periodic b L →
                  Function.Periodic χ L →
                    (∀ (j : Fin n), Function.Periodic (ψ j) L) →
                      (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ χ r ∧ χ r ≤ 1) →
                        (∀ (r : ℝ), χ r ≠ 0 → ∀ (j : Fin n), ψ j r = 0) →
                          (∀ (r : ℝ), χ r = 0 → δ ≤ b r - ∑ j, |c j| * |ψ j r|) →
                            (∑ j, c j • TightVer401.momentPathMoment L f (ψ j) =
                                TightVer401.momentPathMoment L f fun r => χ r * b r) →
                              (∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, |χ r * b r|) + ∑ j, |c j| * ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, |ψ j r| < η →
                                0 ≤ u →
                                  u < v →
                                    v ≤ L →
                                      (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc u v, χ r = 1) →
                                        ((TightVer401.momentNonlinearPeriod b g L ≤ B ∧
                                              (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, χ r ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ g r) ∧ ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc u v, 0 < g r) ∨
                                            B ≤ TightVer401.momentNonlinearPeriod b g L ∧
                                              (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, χ r ≠ 0 → g r ≤ 0) ∧ ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc u v, g r < 0) →
                                          ∃ a,
                                            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a ∧
                                              Function.Periodic a L ∧
                                                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) ∧
                                                  ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, ‖a r - b r‖ < η ∧
                                                    TightVer401.momentPathMoment L f a =
                                                        TightVer401.momentPathMoment L f b ∧
                                                      TightVer401.momentNonlinearPeriod a g L = B ∧
                                                        (Function.support fun r => a r - b r) ⊆
                                                          Function.support χ ∪ ⋃ j, Function.support (ψ j)

declarations.name: TightVer401.momentPrescription_lift_to_circle
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (L : ℝ) [inst : Fact (0 < L)] {a : ℝ → ℝ} (b g : AddCircle L → ℝ) (f : AddCircle L → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
  {η B : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
    Function.Periodic a L →
      (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →

∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℝ ℝ) M]
  [inst_2 : IsManifold TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) M] {X Y : M → TightVer401.Manifold.ThreeSpace},
  ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ TightVer401.Manifold.ThreeSpace) (↑⊤) X →
    TightVer401.nativeProductIsBending X Y →
      (∀ (p : M), Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% (X + Y) p)) →
        ∃ g,
          ContMDiff OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ TightVer401.Manifold.ThreeSpace) (↑⊤)
              (X + Y) ∧
            ContMDiff OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ TightVer401.Manifold.ThreeSpace) (↑⊤)
                (X - Y) ∧
              (∀ (p : M) (v w : TangentSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel p),
                  ((g.inner p) v) w = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (X + Y) p v w ∧
                    ((g.inner p) v) w = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (X - Y) p v w) ∧
                ∀ (p : M),
                  Function.Injective ⇑(OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.surfaceDifferential (X + Y) p) ∧
                    Function.Injective ⇑(OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.surfaceDifferential (X - Y) p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.nativeProductPlane_ruled_curvature
declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℝ ℝ) M]
  {F : M → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : M} {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt E (-k s • T s + τ s • n s) s) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) U →
        IsOpen U →
          q ∈ U →
            (∀ z ∈ U, TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (z 0)) (E (z 0)) (n (z 0))) →
              (∀ z ∈ U, τ (z 0) ≠ 0) →
                TightVer401.nativeProductCoordinateMap F p =ᶠ[nhds q] TightVer401.ruledMap γ E →
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                      (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.nativeProductPlaneCoordinateMap F p)) q <
                    0

declarations.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_1 : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℝ ℝ) M]
  {F : M → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : M} {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      q ∈ U →
        (TightVer401.planarHessian G q).det ≠ 0 →
          TightVer401.nativeProductCoordinateMap F p =ᶠ[nhds q] TightVer401.planarSupportMap G →
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.nativeProductPlaneCoordinateMap F p)) q =
              1 / (TightVer401.planarWeight q ^ 4 * (TightVer401.planarHessian G q).det)

declarations.name: TightVer401.normalLoop_central_support_tensor
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (a ψ : ℝ → ℝ),
  (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
    d.E = deriv ζ ∘ ψ →
      d.T = TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ ∘ ψ →
        d.τ = TightVer401.normalLoopPhysicalTau a ψ →
          ∀ (s : ℝ),
            ∃ (hw : d.n s ≠ 0),
              ∃ e,
                ![s, 0] ∈ e.source ∧
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e) e.source ∧
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target ∧
                      (∀ q ∈ e.source, d.rawGaussMap q = TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (d.n s) hw (↑e q)) ∧
                        have Q := TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (d.n s) hw;
                        have g := OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric Q;
                        have H := fun y => inner ℝ (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E (↑e.symm y)) (Q y);
                        have V :=
                          ![(fderiv ℝ ↑e ![s, 0]) (a (ψ s) • Pi.single 0 1),
                            (fderiv ℝ ↑e ![s, 0]) (a (ψ s) • Pi.single 1 1)];
                        (∀ y ∈ e.target,
                            TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E (↑e.symm y) = TightVer401.sphereSupportMap g Q H y) ∧
                          (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                              (fderiv ℝ Q (↑e ![s, 0])) (V i) =
                                ![deriv ζ (ψ s), TightVer401.normalLoopTangent ζ (ψ s)] i) ∧
                            (fun i j => TightVer401.sphereSupportTensorBilinear g H (↑e ![s, 0]) (V i) (V j)) =
                                !![0, a (ψ s); a (ψ s), 0] ∧
                              0 < a (ψ s)

                                                                                  ⇑e.symm ∧

                                                                                        a L),

declarations.name: TightVer401.one_slowdown_holonomy_correction
declarations.type:
∀ {L η ε : ℝ} [hL : Fact (0 < L)] {P₃ κ b : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P₃ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
        Function.Periodic P₃ L →
          Function.Periodic κ L →
            ∀ (hbL : Function.Periodic b L),
              (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < b r) →
                (∃ r, P₃ r ≠ 0) →
                  (∃ r, κ r ≠ κ 0) →
                    ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, b r * P₃ r = 0 →
                      0 < η →
                        0 < ε →
                          ∃ a,
                            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a ∧
                              Function.Periodic a L ∧
                                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) ∧
                                  ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, ‖a r - b r‖ < η ∧
                                    ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, a r * P₃ r = 0 ∧
                                      ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, deriv κ r / √(a r) = 0 ∧
                                        ∃ A,
                                          ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (↑⊤) A ∧
                                            (∀ (r : ℝ), A ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) r) = a r) ∧
                                              ∃ n ≤ 2,
                                                ∃ centers radii,
                                                  (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 ≤ radii j) ∧
                                                    ∑ j, 2 * radii j < ε ∧
                                                      (Function.support fun q => A q - hbL.lift q) ⊆
                                                        ⋃ j,
                                                          ⇑(TightVer401.periodProjection L) ''
                                                            Set.Icc (centers j - radii j) (centers j + radii j)

declarations.type:
