  ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..T, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient d.k d.τ r = 0 →
    ∀ (s w : ℝ),
      0 < w →
        ∃ δ > 0,
          δ < w ∧
            ∀ (v : ℝ),
              0 < v →
                v < δ →
                  have U :=
                    TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ) (TightVer401.ruledOmega d.k d.τ) s v;
                  U s = v ∧
                    Function.Periodic U T ∧
                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) U ∧
                        (∀ (t : ℝ), U t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 w) ∧
                          (∀ (t : ℝ),
                              HasDerivAt U
                                (-(U t / 2) * (TightVer401.ruledLambda d.τ t + U t * TightVer401.ruledD d.k d.τ t)) t) ∧
                            ∀ (t : ℝ),
                              have p := ![t, U t];
                              have tangent := deriv (fun r => ![r, U r]) t;
                              tangent ⬝ᵥ
                                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E)
                                        (TightVer401.ruledNormal (d.T t) (d.n t) (d.k t) (d.τ t) (U t)) p).mulVec
                                    tangent =
                                0

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodicRuledFrame_supported_bending_curvature_threshold
declarations.type:
∀ {L b lower upper : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L)
  {Y : AddCircle L × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 b) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  TightVer401.IsBandBending d.bandMap Y →
    0 < lower →
      upper < b →
        (∀ p ∈ tsupport Y, lower ≤ ↑p.2 ∧ ↑p.2 ≤ upper) →
          ∃ δ > 0,
            ∀ (a : ℝ),
              |a| < δ →
                ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                      (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric fun q =>
                        TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E q + a • TightVer401.bandCoordinateLift Y q)
                      p <
                    0

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_bandProfile_contMDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {L b : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < L)] {k τ ρ W : ℝ → ℝ} {T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {F : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ρ →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) T →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) n →
              ∀ (hkL : Function.Periodic k L) (hτL : Function.Periodic τ L) (hρL : Function.Periodic ρ L)
                (hWL : Function.Periodic W L) (hTL : Function.Periodic T L) (hnL : Function.Periodic n L),
                (∀ (s : ℝ), ρ s ≠ 0) →
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
                    ContMDiff ((modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ).prod (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ))
                      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤)
                      (TightVer401.bandProfile hkL.lift hτL.lift hρL.lift hWL.lift F hTL.lift hnL.lift)

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_bandProfile_hasCompactSupport
declarations.type:
∀ {L b : ℝ} [Fact (0 < L)] {k τ ρ W : ℝ → ℝ} {T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {F : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ρ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
      ∀ (hkL : Function.Periodic k L) (hτL : Function.Periodic τ L) (hρL : Function.Periodic ρ L)
        (hWL : Function.Periodic W L) (hTL : Function.Periodic T L) (hnL : Function.Periodic n L),
        (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < ρ s) →
          0 < b →
            HasCompactSupport F →
              (∀ (s c : ℝ), c ∈ tsupport F → 1 / (ρ s * b) - W s < c) →
                HasCompactSupport (TightVer401.bandProfile hkL.lift hτL.lift hρL.lift hWL.lift F hTL.lift hnL.lift)

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_bandProfile_injective
declarations.type:
∀ {L b cb : ℝ} {k τ ρ W : ℝ → ℝ} {T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {F G : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hkL : Function.Periodic k L) (hτL : Function.Periodic τ L) (hρL : Function.Periodic ρ L)
  (hWL : Function.Periodic W L) (hTL : Function.Periodic T L) (hnL : Function.Periodic n L),
  TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T 0) (E 0) (n 0) →
    τ 0 ≠ 0 →
      0 < ρ 0 →
        0 < b →
          1 / (ρ 0 * b) - W 0 ≤ cb →
            tsupport F ⊆ Set.Ioi cb →
              tsupport G ⊆ Set.Ioi cb →
                TightVer401.bandProfile hkL.lift hτL.lift hρL.lift hWL.lift F hTL.lift hnL.lift =
                    TightVer401.bandProfile hkL.lift hτL.lift hρL.lift hWL.lift G hTL.lift hnL.lift →
                  F = G

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_bandProfile_nonzero
declarations.type:
∀ {L b cb c : ℝ} {k τ ρ W : ℝ → ℝ} {T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {F : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hkL : Function.Periodic k L) (hτL : Function.Periodic τ L) (hρL : Function.Periodic ρ L)
  (hWL : Function.Periodic W L) (hTL : Function.Periodic T L) (hnL : Function.Periodic n L),
  TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T 0) (E 0) (n 0) →
    τ 0 ≠ 0 →
      0 < ρ 0 →
        0 < b →
          1 / (ρ 0 * b) - W 0 ≤ cb →
            cb < c →
              F c ≠ 0 → ∃ p, TightVer401.bandProfile hkL.lift hτL.lift hρL.lift hWL.lift F hTL.lift hnL.lift p ≠ 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_bandProfile_real_lift
declarations.type:
∀ {L b : ℝ} {k τ ρ W : ℝ → ℝ} {T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hkL : Function.Periodic k L)
  (hτL : Function.Periodic τ L) (hρL : Function.Periodic ρ L) (hWL : Function.Periodic W L)
  (hTL : Function.Periodic T L) (hnL : Function.Periodic n L) (s : ℝ) (u : ↑(Set.Ioo 0 b)),
  TightVer401.bandProfile hkL.lift hτL.lift hρL.lift hWL.lift F hTL.lift hnL.lift
      ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) s, u) =
    TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W F T n ![s, ↑u]

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_cellIntegral_nat_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℝ → E} {T : ℝ},
  Continuous f → Function.Periodic f T → ∀ (N : ℕ), ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..↑N * T, f r = ↑N • ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..T, f r

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_monotone_eq
declarations.type: ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ}, Function.Periodic f L → 0 < L → Monotone f → ∀ (x y : ℝ), f x = f y

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_nonconstant_derivative_signs
declarations.type:

  Differentiable ℝ f → Function.Periodic f L → 0 < L → (∃ r, f r ≠ f 0) → (∃ r, 0 < deriv f r) ∧ ∃ r, deriv f r < 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_positive_logarithmic_derivative_period_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {a : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a → Function.Periodic a L → (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) → ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, deriv a r / a r = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_ruled_cutoff
declarations.type:
∀ {L b : ℝ} [Fact (0 < L)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) {W : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
    Function.Periodic W L →
      0 < b →
        ∃ cb,
          (∀ (s : ℝ), 1 / (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ s * b) - W s ≤ cb) ∧
            ∃ s, 1 / (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ s * b) - W s = cb

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_ruled_profile_isBandBending
declarations.type:
∀ {L b : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) {W F : ℝ → ℝ} (hWL : Function.Periodic W L),
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt W (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient d.k d.τ s) s) →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F → TightVer401.IsBandBending d.bandMap (d.profile hWL)

declarations.name: TightVer401.periodic_speed_L1_nat_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {a b : ℝ → ℝ} {T : ℝ},

      Function.Periodic a T →
        Function.Periodic b T → ∀ (N : ℕ), ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..↑N * T, |a r - b r| = ↑N * ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..T, |a r - b r|

declarations.type: (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarGradient.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (j : Fin 2),
  TightVer401.planarGradient G p j = OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j G p

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarGradient_contDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U → IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.planarGradient G) U

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarGradient_differential_injective
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ U →
          (TightVer401.planarHessian G p).det ≠ 0 → Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.planarGradient G) p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarGradient_dot_fderiv
declarations.type:
∀ (G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p v : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  (fderiv ℝ G p) v = TightVer401.planarGradient G p ⬝ᵥ v

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarGradient_exists_smooth_local_inverse
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, (TightVer401.planarHessian G q).det ≠ 0) →
        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          p ∈ U →
            ∃ e, p ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ U ∧ ↑e = TightVer401.planarGradient G ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarGradient_exists_smooth_local_inverse_at
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    IsOpen U →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ U →
          (TightVer401.planarHessian G p).det ≠ 0 →
            ∃ e, p ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ U ∧ ↑e = TightVer401.planarGradient G ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarGradient_fderiv_apply
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

    IsOpen U →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ U →
          ∀ (v : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
            (fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.planarGradient G) p) v = (TightVer401.planarHessian G p).mulVec v

declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

    IsOpen U →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ U → ∀ (i j : Fin 2), TightVer401.planarHessian G p i j = TightVer401.planarHessian G p j i

declarations.type:
(OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
  OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord →
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarLegendre.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
  (y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), TightVer401.planarLegendre G e y = ↑e.symm y ⬝ᵥ y - G (↑e.symm y)

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarLegendre_contDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) e.target

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarLegendre_coordPartial
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
        ∀ {y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          y ∈ e.target →
            ∀ (i : Fin 2), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) y = ↑e.symm y i

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarLegendre_gradient
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
        ∀ {y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          y ∈ e.target → TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) y = ↑e.symm y

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarLegendre_hessian
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
        ∀ {y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          y ∈ e.target →
            TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) y = (TightVer401.planarHessian G (↑e.symm y))⁻¹

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarLegendre_saddle
declarations.type:
∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
      (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
        ∀ {y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          y ∈ e.target →
            (TightVer401.planarHessian G (↑e.symm y)).det < 0 →
              (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.planarLegendre G e) y).det < 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarPotential_contDiffOn

declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.planarPotential_normal_height

            ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, TightVer401.planarGradient G (p t) ⬝ᵥ deriv p t = G (p b) - G (p a)

        ∀ {a b : ℝ},

  DifferentiableAt ℝ F (Φ p) →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => F (Φ q)) p =

            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a F (Φ p) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => Φ q a) p

declarations.type:
∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F U →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          Φ p ∈ U →
            (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p).det ≠ 0 →
              TightVer401.seamCorrectedHessian Φ (fun q => F (Φ q)) p =
                (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p).transpose * TightVer401.planarHessian F (Φ p) *
                  TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p

declarations.type:

  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F U →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          Φ p ∈ U →
            ∀ (i j : Fin 2),

                ((TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p).transpose * TightVer401.planarHessian F (Φ p) *
                      TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p)
                    i j +

                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a F (Φ p) * TightVer401.planarHessian (fun q => Φ q a) p i j

                  ((TightVer401.planarGradient G ∘ TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d) q))) ∧
        0 <
            inner ℝ
              (Complex.I *
                TightVer401.positiveExitComplexPoint
                  ((fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.planarGradient G ∘ TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d) q)
                    (TightVer401.positiveExitRawNullDirection d q)))

                (Complex.I *

                    ((TightVer401.planarGradient G ∘ TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d) q))) ∧

                    (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexPoint (TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d q))‖ ∧
            0 <

                    (Complex.I *

              0 <

                      (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexPoint
                        ((fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d) q)
                          (TightVer401.positiveExitRawNullDirection d q))))
                  (TightVer401.corrugatedVisibilityDirection (4 / 5)

declarations.name: TightVer401.positiveExit_label_chosen_root
declarations.type:
∀ {C L M N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 C q ≠ 0 →
    0 < M q →
      0 < M q + N q * (-OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 C q / OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 C q) →
        L q * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 C q ^ 2 -
                2 * M q * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 C q * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 C q +
              N q * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 C q ^ 2 =
            0 →
          (fderiv ℝ C q) ![1, TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N q] = 0

declarations.type:

  IsOpen U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) C U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) M U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) N U →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ U) →
            (∀ (r : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 C ![r, 0] = 0) →
              (∀ (r : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 C ![r, 0] ≠ 0) →
                (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < M ![r, 0]) →
                  (∀ q ∈ U,
                      L q * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 C q ^ 2 -
                            2 * M q * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 C q *
                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 C q +
                          N q * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 C q ^ 2 =
                        0) →
                    ∃ W,
                      IsOpen W ∧
                        W ⊆ U ∧
                          (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ W) ∧
                            (∀ q ∈ W, (fderiv ℝ C q) ![1, TightVer401.fermiAsymptoticSlope L M N q] = 0) ∧
                              ∃ ε > 0, ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ ε → ![r, t] ∈ W

declarations.name: TightVer401.positiveExit_paired_graph_exists_regular_trace
declarations.type:
∀ {P : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < P)] {G Ge : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U C : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {hp : Function.Periodic ζ P} {η ξ σ ρMax : ℝ}
  (D : TightVer401.PositiveExitActualFermiData G U ζ hp η ξ σ ρMax)
  (B : TightVer401.PositiveExitActualCartesianPatch G U C ζ hp η ξ σ ρMax D),
  TightVer401.PositiveExitPairedFermiPreserved D B Ge →
    IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Ge U →
        (Topology.IsEmbedding fun y => TightVer401.planarGradient Ge ↑y) →
          ∀ (n : ℕ) {ν : ℝ},
            0 < ν →
              have v :=
                TightVer401.exitPositiveGraphProfile P
                  (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                    (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport B.epsilon (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                      (TightVer401.positiveExitFermiHeight G ζ) (TightVer401.fermiExitCutoff D.rho ⋯)));
              ∃ δ Cs tr,
                0 < |δ| ∧
                  |δ| < ν ∧
                    0 < δ * B.epsilon ∧
                      (∀ (s : ℝ), tr.p s = TightVer401.positiveExitFermiSource ζ (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ s)) ∧
                        Topology.IsEmbedding Cs ∧
                          (∀ (s : ℝ),
                              ↑(Cs ((TightVer401.periodProjection P) s)) =
                                TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ s)) ∧
                            (∀ (q : AddCircle P), ‖↑(Cs q) - hp.lift q‖ < ν) ∧
                              ∀ j ≤ n,
                                ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 P,
                                  ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
                                          (fun r => TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ r)) s -
                                        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j ζ s‖ <
                                    ν

                    (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport B.epsilon (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                      (TightVer401.positiveExitFermiHeight G ζ) (TightVer401.fermiExitCutoff D.rho ⋯)));

            ∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ζ →
                ∀ (hp : Function.Periodic ζ P),
                  (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < (ζ s).ofLp 2) →
                    (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.gnomonicInverse (ζ s) ∈ U) →
                      (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.angularDescentComplex (TightVer401.gnomonicInverse (ζ s)) ≠ 0) →
                        (∀ (s : ℝ),
                            TightVer401.angularDescentComplex
                                (TightVer401.planarGradient G (TightVer401.gnomonicInverse (ζ s))) ≠
                              0) →
                          TightVer401.HasPositiveArgumentTurn
                              (TightVer401.angularDescentComplex ∘ TightVer401.gnomonicInverse ∘ ζ) P →
                            TightVer401.HasPositiveArgumentTurn
                                (TightVer401.angularDescentComplex ∘
                                  TightVer401.planarGradient G ∘ TightVer401.gnomonicInverse ∘ ζ)
                                P →
                              (TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair Rout
                                  (TightVer401.angularDescentComplex ∘ TightVer401.gnomonicInverse ∘ ζ) fun s =>
                                  Complex.I *
                                    TightVer401.angularDescentComplex
                                      (TightVer401.planarGradient G (TightVer401.gnomonicInverse (ζ s)))) →
                                (TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair Rin
                                    (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                      (TightVer401.angularDescentComplex ∘
                                        TightVer401.planarGradient G ∘ TightVer401.gnomonicInverse ∘ ζ))
                                    fun s =>
                                    Complex.I *
                                      TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                        (TightVer401.angularDescentComplex ∘ TightVer401.gnomonicInverse ∘ ζ) s) →
                                  ∃ η > 0,
                                    ∃ ν > 0,
                                      ∀ (ξ σ ρMax : ℝ) (C : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
                                        (D : TightVer401.PositiveExitActualFermiData G U ζ hp η ξ σ ρMax)
                                        (B : TightVer401.PositiveExitActualCartesianPatch G U C ζ hp η ξ σ ρMax D)
                                        (J : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ),
                                        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) J →
                                          (∀ q ∈ U, TightVer401.fermiCoordinateC2Size J q < η) →
                                            (TightVer401.PositiveExitPairedFermiPreserved D B fun q => G q + J q) →
                                              (Topology.IsEmbedding fun y =>
                                                  TightVer401.planarGradient (fun q => G q + J q) ↑y) →
                                                have v :=
                                                  TightVer401.exitPositiveGraphProfile P
                                                    (TightVer401.fermiSupportSeamSlope
                                                      (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                                                      (TightVer401.fermiPerturbedSupport B.epsilon
                                                        (TightVer401.normalLoopCurvature ζ)
                                                        (TightVer401.positiveExitFermiHeight G ζ)
                                                        (TightVer401.fermiExitCutoff D.rho ⋯)));
                                                ∃ δ Cs t,
                                                  0 < |δ| ∧
                                                    |δ| < ν ∧
                                                      0 < δ * B.epsilon ∧
                                                        (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                                            t.p s =
                                                              TightVer401.positiveExitFermiSource ζ
                                                                (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ s)) ∧
                                                          Topology.IsEmbedding Cs ∧
                                                            (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                                                ↑(Cs ((TightVer401.periodProjection P) s)) =
                                                                  TightVer401.fermiNormalMap ζ
                                                                    (TightVer401.exitGraphCurve v δ s)) ∧
                                                              (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, |δ * v s| < D.rho) ∧
                                                                (∀ j ≤ 1, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ‖⋯ - ⋯‖ < ν) ∧
                                                                  (TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair Rout
                                                                      (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace t.p)
                                                                      fun s =>
                                                                      Complex.I *
                                                                        TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace t.gamma
                                                                          s) ∧
                                                                    TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair Rin
                                                                      (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                                                        (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace t.gamma))
                                                                      fun s =>
                                                                      Complex.I *
                                                                        TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                                                          (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace t.p) s

declarations.name: TightVer401.positiveExit_same_seed_visible_protected_field
declarations.type:
∀ {T w N ell : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < T)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame T) {ψ a κ : ℝ → ℝ}
  {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  0 < w →
    ∀ (hidentity : TightVer401.PrincipalNormalIdentityBand d),
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ψ →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) a →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < a r) →
            ∀ (S : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ),
              ⇑S = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive a →
                ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑S.symm →
                  d.γ = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedSpatial N ψ ell a ∘ ⇑S.symm →
                    d.n = (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedSphere N ∘ ψ) ∘ ⇑S.symm →
                      TightVer401.IdentityBandCentralSupportWithPotential d w a κ S G U →
                        TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (1 / 4) (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBeta N ∘ ψ)
                            (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedPartner N ψ ell a) →
                          TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (4 / 5)
                              (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBalancedPartner N ψ ell a))
                              (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect (TightVer401.corrugatedSeedBeta N ∘ ψ)) →
                            have hb := ⋯;
                            ∃ δ > 0,
                              δ < w ∧
                                ∃ (hinside :
                                  ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo 0 δ,
                                    ∀ (s : ℝ),
                                      TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ)
                                          (TightVer401.ruledOmega d.k d.τ) 0 v s ∈
                                        Set.Ioo 0 w),
                                  ∃ Y,
                                    TightVer401.IsBandBending d.bandMap Y ∧
                                      HasCompactSupport Y ∧
                                        (∃ p, Y p ≠ 0) ∧
                                          tsupport Y ⊆
                                              Set.range (TightVer401.identityFlowBandInclusion d hb 0 hinside) ∧
                                            ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo 0 δ,
                                              have u :=
                                                TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ)
                                                  (TightVer401.ruledOmega d.k d.τ) 0 v;
                                              (TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (1 / 4)
                                                  (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace fun s =>
                                                    TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d ![s, u s])
                                                  fun s =>
                                                  Complex.I *
                                                    TightVer401.positiveExitComplexPoint
                                                      (TightVer401.planarGradient G
                                                        (TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d ![s, u s]))) ∧
                                                TightVer401.ComplexVisiblePair (4 / 5)
                                                  (TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                                    (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace fun s =>
                                                      TightVer401.planarGradient G
                                                        (TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d ![s, u s])))
                                                  fun s =>
                                                  Complex.I *
                                                    TightVer401.corrugatedReverseReflect
                                                      (TightVer401.positiveExitComplexTrace fun s =>
                                                        TightVer401.identityBandCentralCoordinates d ![s, u s])
                                                      s

declarations.name: TightVer401.positiveExit_same_seed_visible_turn_protected_field
declarations.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10000 ≤ N →
    ∀ (e : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ),
      ⇑e = TightVer401.corrugatedSeedArcMap ↑N →
        ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ ⇑e.symm →

declarations.type:
{RN mu h : ℝ} →
  (S : TightVer401.ProtectedSaddleCylinderInput RN mu h) →
    (G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
      (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) →
        (beta : ℝ → ℝ) →
          (A B L d0 dInfinity : ℝ) →
            0 < A →
              A < RN →
                0 < B →
                  0 < L →
                    e.source = {p | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p} →
                      e.target = TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingOpenAnnulus A RN →
                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G e.source →
                          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                            (∀ p ∈ e.source, ↑e p = TightVer401.planarGradient G p) →
                              (∀ p ∈ e.source, (TightVer401.planarHessian G p).det < 0) →
                                (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                    L < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                                      G p =
                                        A * TightVer401.planarRadius p - B / TightVer401.planarRadius p + dInfinity) →
                                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) beta →
                                    StrictMonoOn beta (Set.Icc (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi) →
                                      beta (Real.pi / 2) = A →
                                        beta Real.pi = RN →
                                          (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (Real.pi / 2) Real.pi, 0 < deriv beta u) →
                                            (beta =ᶠ[nhds (Real.pi / 2)] fun u => A + B * (u - Real.pi / 2) ^ 2) →
                                              S.saddle =
                                                  TightVer401.completedSaddleAnnulusCylinderMap G e A RN d0 dInfinity
                                                    beta →
                                                TightVer401.ProtectedTorusActualGraphCylinderData S

declarations.type:

        p ∉ ↑e '' tsupport Y →

declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [Fact (0 < T)] (X Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource)
  (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_bending_common_metric
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < T)] {X Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) X →
    TightVer401.IsBandBending X Y →
      HasCompactSupport Y →
        (∃ p, Y p ≠ 0) →
          ∀ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
            tsupport Y ⊆ e.source →
              ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                ∀ (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                  (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
                  (∀ p ∈ e.source, F (↑e p) = A (X p)) →
                    ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                        (↑⊤) F →
                      ∀ (ε : ℝ) (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource) (v z : ℝ × ℝ),
                        TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm (F + ε • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) p v
                            z =
                          TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm F p v z +
                            ε ^ 2 *
                              TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm (TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) p v z

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_bending_common_smooth_metric
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < T)] {X Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) X →
    TightVer401.IsBandBending X Y →
      HasCompactSupport Y →
        (∃ p, Y p ≠ 0) →
          ∀ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
            tsupport Y ⊆ e.source →
              ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                ∀ (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                  (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
                  (∀ p ∈ e.source, F (↑e p) = A (X p)) →
                    ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                        (↑⊤) F →
                      (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource), Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% F p)) →
                        ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                          have Z := TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y;
                          ∃ g,
                            ContMDiff OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel
                                (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (F + ε • Z) ∧
                              ContMDiff OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel
                                  (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (F - ε • Z) ∧
                                (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource)
                                    (v z : TangentSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel p),
                                    ((g.inner p) v) z = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (F + ε • Z) p v z ∧
                                      ((g.inner p) v) z = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (F - ε • Z) p v z) ∧
                                  ∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
                                    Function.Injective ⇑(OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.surfaceDifferential (F + ε • Z) p) ∧
                                      Function.Injective ⇑(OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.surfaceDifferential (F - ε • Z) p)

declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [Fact (0 < T)] {Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource)
  (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
  HasCompactSupport Y →
    tsupport Y ⊆ e.source →
      ∀ (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (ε : ℝ),
        (∃ q, q ∉ ↑e '' tsupport Y) →
          have U := (↑e '' tsupport Y)ᶜ;
          IsOpen U ∧
            U.Nonempty ∧
              Set.EqOn (F + ε • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) F U ∧
                Set.EqOn (F - ε • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) F U

        (∀ p ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y, TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature F p < 0) →
          (∀ p ∈ TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F,
              F + a • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y =ᶠ[nhds p] F) ∧
            ∀ p ∈ TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F,
              F - a • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y =ᶠ[nhds p] F

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_bending_positive_regions
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [Fact (0 < T)] {Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource)
  (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
  HasCompactSupport Y →
    tsupport Y ⊆ e.source →
      ∀ (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (ε : ℝ),
        (∀ p ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y, TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature F p < 0) →
          (∀ p ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y,
              TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature (F + ε • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) p < 0) →
            (∀ p ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y,
                TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature (F - ε • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) p < 0) →
              have Z := TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y;
              TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (F + ε • Z) = TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F ∧
                TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (F - ε • Z) = TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F ∧
                  Set.EqOn (F + ε • Z) F (TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F) ∧
                    Set.EqOn (F - ε • Z) F (TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F) ∧
                      (F + ε • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (F + ε • Z) =
                          F '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F ∧
                        (F - ε • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (F - ε • Z) =
                            F '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion F ∧
                          (F + ε • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (F + ε • Z) =
                            (F - ε • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (F - ε • Z)

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_curvature_inducedMetric_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {X : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {κ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ X (κ p) →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ κ p →
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (X ∘ κ) p =
        (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian κ p).transpose * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric X (κ p) *
          TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian κ p

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_curvature_planarHessian_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {κ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {U V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen U →
    IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) κ V →
          Set.MapsTo κ V U →
            ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
              p ∈ V →
                ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                  TightVer401.planarHessian (f ∘ κ) p i j =
                    ((TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian κ p).transpose * TightVer401.planarHessian f (κ p) *
                          TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian κ p)
                        i j +
                      ∑ a,
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a f (κ p) *
                          TightVer401.planarHessian (fun q => κ q a) p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_linear_branches_source
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [Fact (0 < T)] (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource)
  (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (X Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (B C : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient →L[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
  (∀ p ∈ e.source, F (↑e p) = A (X p)) →
    ∀ (ε : ℝ) {p : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)},
      p ∈ e.source →
        B (F (↑e p)) +
              ε •
                TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e (AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                  (fun z => C (A.linearIsometryEquiv (Y z))) (↑e p) =
            B (A (X p)) + ε • C (A.linearIsometryEquiv (Y p)) ∧
          B (F (↑e p)) -
              ε •
                TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e (AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                  (fun z => C (A.linearIsometryEquiv (Y z))) (↑e p) =
            B (A (X p)) - ε • C (A.linearIsometryEquiv (Y p))

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_marked_bending_curvature_threshold
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < T)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame T),
  0 < w →
    ∀ (Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
      HasCompactSupport Y →
        ∀ (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
          (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
          tsupport Y ⊆ e.source →
            ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑e) e.source →
              ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                ∀ (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                  (B C : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient →L[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
                  (∀ p ∈ e.source, F (↑e p) = A (d.bandMap p)) →
                    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d A B) →
                      TightVer401.IsInfinitesimalBendingOn (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d A B)
                          (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateField Y A C)
                          (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateDomain w) →
                        (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateDomain w,
                            Function.Injective ⇑(fderiv ℝ (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d A B) q)) →
                          (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateDomain w,
                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric
                                    (TightVer401.markedRuledBandCoordinateBase d A B))
                                  q <
                                0) →
                            (ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel
                                (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) ↑⊤ fun q => B (F q)) →
                              (∀ (q : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
                                  Function.Injective ⇑((mfderiv% fun r => B (F r)) q)) →
                                (TightVer401.nativeProductIsBending (fun q => B (F q)) fun q =>
                                    C (TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y q)) →
                                  ∃ δ > 0,
                                    ∀ (a : ℝ),
                                      |a| < δ →
                                        ∀ q ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y,
                                          TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature (fun r => B (F r)) q < 0 ∧
                                            TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature
                                                  (fun r =>
                                                    B (F r) + a • C (TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y r))
                                                  q <
                                                0 ∧
                                              TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature
                                                  (fun r =>
                                                    B (F r) - a • C (TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y r))
                                                  q <
                                                0

        (B C : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient →L[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (a : ℝ),
        (∀ p ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y, TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature (fun q => B (F q)) p < 0) →
          (∀ p ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y,
              TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature
                  (fun q => B (F q) + a • C (TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y q)) p <
                0) →
            (∀ p ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y,
                TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature
                    (fun q => B (F q) - a • C (TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y q)) p <
                  0) →
              have G := fun q => B (F q);
              have Z := fun q => C (TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y q);
              TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G + a • Z) = TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G - a • Z) = TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                  Set.EqOn (G + a • Z) G (TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G) ∧
                    Set.EqOn (G - a • Z) G (TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G) ∧
                      (G + a • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G + a • Z) =
                          G '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                        (G - a • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G - a • Z) =
                            G '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion G ∧
                          (G + a • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G + a • Z) =
                            (G - a • Z) '' TightVer401.nativeTorusPositiveRegion (G - a • Z)

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_metric_branching
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < T)] {X Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) X →
    TightVer401.IsBandBending X Y →
      HasCompactSupport Y →
        (∃ p, Y p ≠ 0) →
          ∀ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
            tsupport Y ⊆ e.source →
              ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                ∀ (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                  (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
                  (∀ p ∈ e.source, F (↑e p) = A (X p)) →
                    ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
                        (↑⊤) F →
                      (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource), Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% F p)) →
                        (∃ q, q ∉ ↑e '' tsupport Y) →
                          ∀ {ε : ℝ},
                            ε ≠ 0 →
                              have Z := TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y;
                              have U := (↑e '' tsupport Y)ᶜ;
                              ∃ g,
                                ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel
                                    (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (F + ε • Z) ∧
                                  ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel
                                      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (F - ε • Z) ∧
                                    ContMDiff OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel
                                        (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (F + ε • Z) ∧
                                      ContMDiff OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel
                                          (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤) (F - ε • Z) ∧
                                        (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource)
                                            (v z : TangentSpace OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.planeModel p),
                                            ((g.inner p) v) z = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (F + ε • Z) p v z ∧
                                              ((g.inner p) v) z = OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.inducedForm (F - ε • Z) p v z) ∧
                                          (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource) (v z : ℝ × ℝ),
                                              TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm (F + ε • Z) p v z =
                                                  TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm (F - ε • Z) p v z ∧
                                                TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm (F + ε • Z) p v z =
                                                  TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm F p v z +
                                                    ε ^ 2 * TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm Z p v z) ∧
                                            (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource) (v : ℝ × ℝ),
                                                v ≠ 0 → 0 < TightVer401.nativeProductInducedForm (F + ε • Z) p v v) ∧
                                              (∀ (p : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
                                                  Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% (F + ε • Z) p) ∧
                                                    Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% (F - ε • Z) p)) ∧
                                                (IsOpen U ∧
                                                    U.Nonempty ∧ Set.EqOn (F + ε • Z) F U ∧ Set.EqOn (F - ε • Z) F U) ∧
                                                  F + ε • Z ≠ F - ε • Z

declarations.name: TightVer401.protectedTorus_ruled_bending_curvature_threshold
declarations.type:
∀ {T w : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < T)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame T),
  0 < w →
    ∀ {Y : AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
      TightVer401.IsBandBending d.bandMap Y →
        HasCompactSupport Y →
          (∃ p, Y p ≠ 0) →
            ∀ (F : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
              ContMDiff TightVer401.nativeProductModel (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (↑⊤)
                  F →
                (∀ (q : TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource), Function.Injective ⇑(mfderiv% F q)) →
                  ∀ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (AddCircle T × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 w)) TightVer401.NonrigidTorusSource),
                    tsupport Y ⊆ e.source →
                      ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑e) e.source →
                        ContMDiffOn TightVer401.nativeProductModel TightVer401.nativeProductModel (↑⊤) (↑e.symm)
                            e.target →
                          ∀ (A : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
                            (∀ p ∈ e.source, F (↑e p) = A (d.bandMap p)) →
                              ∃ δ > 0,
                                ∀ (a : ℝ),
                                  |a| < δ →
                                    ∀ q ∈ ↑e '' tsupport Y,
                                      TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature F q < 0 ∧
                                        TightVer401.nativeTorusChartCurvature
                                              (F + a • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) q <

                                              (F - a • TightVer401.protectedTorusBendingField e A Y) q <
                                            0

declarations.name: TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff_cartesian_boundary_first_jet
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ (M : ℝ) {h b : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
          Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) →
            Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →
              ∀ (theta : ℝ),
                TightVer401.angularDescentPotential
                      (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M (TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R) h b)
                      (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                    h theta ∧
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                        (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential
                          (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M (TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R) h b))
                        (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                      b theta * Real.cos theta - deriv h theta / R * Real.sin theta ∧
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                        (TightVer401.angularDescentPotential
                          (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M (TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R) h b))
                        (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta]) =
                      b theta * Real.sin theta + deriv h theta / R * Real.cos theta

        (∀ (r : ℝ), 3 * R / 4 ≤ r → TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R r = 1) ∧
          ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R r ∧ TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R r ≤ 1

declarations.type:
∀ {R M : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    0 < M →
      ∀ (theta : ℝ),
        have u := ![Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta];
        have v := ![-Real.sin theta, Real.cos theta];
        have H :=
          TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianLegendreRadialPotential R M)
            (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![M * R / 2, theta]);
        H.mulVec u = (-1 / M) • u ∧
          H.mulVec v = (1 / M) • v ∧
            u ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec u = -1 / M ∧ v ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec v = 1 / M ∧ u ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec v = 0 ∧ v ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec u = 0

        H.mulVec u = (-1 / M) • u ∧
          H.mulVec v = 0 ∧ u ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec u = -1 / M ∧ v ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec v = 0 ∧ u ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec v = 0 ∧ v ⬝ᵥ H.mulVec u = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential_boundary_hessian_det
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ (M : ℝ) {h b : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
          Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) →
            Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →
              ∀ (theta : ℝ),
                (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential R M h b)
                      (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta])).det =
                  (-M * (deriv (deriv h) theta + R * b theta) - (deriv b theta - deriv h theta / R) ^ 2) / R ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential_boundary_hessian_det_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {R M tau : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    0 ≤ M →
      ∀ {h b : ℝ → ℝ},
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
            Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) →
              Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →
                ∀ (theta : ℝ),
                  tau ≤ deriv (deriv h) theta + R * b theta →
                    (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential R M h b)
                          (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta])).det ≤
                      -M * tau / R ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential_boundary_uniform_hessian_margin
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ {h b : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
          Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) →
            Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →
              (∀ (theta : ℝ), 0 < deriv (deriv h) theta + R * b theta) →
                ∃ tau,
                  0 < tau ∧
                    ∀ (M : ℝ),
                      0 ≤ M →
                        ∀ (theta : ℝ),
                          (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential R M h b)
                                (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart ![R, theta])).det ≤
                            -M * tau / R ^ 2

            Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →

declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ (M : ℝ) (h b : ℝ → ℝ) {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
        TightVer401.planarRadius p < R / 2 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential R M h b) p =
              M * (R - TightVer401.planarRadius p) * p i / TightVer401.planarRadius p

declarations.type:
∀ (R M : ℝ) {h b : ℝ → ℝ},
  Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) →
    Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →
      ∀ {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        0 < q 0 →
          TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential R M h b (TightVer401.saddlePolarChart q) =
            TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M (TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R) h b q

declarations.name: TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential_saddle
declarations.type:
∀ {R M : ℝ},
  0 < R →
    ∀ {h b : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b →
          Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) →
            Function.Periodic b (2 * Real.pi) →
              (∀ (q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                  0 < q 0 →
                    q 0 ≤ R →
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                            (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                              (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M (TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R) h b))
                            q <
                          0 ∧
                        0 <
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1
                                (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M (TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R) h b))
                              q +
                            q 0 *
                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                                (TightVer401.dualQuadraticFiller R M (TightVer401.quadraticDominationCutoff R) h b) q) →
                ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                  0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p →
                    TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ R →
                      (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential R M h b) p).det < 0 ∧
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                            (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric
                              (TightVer401.planarSupportMap (TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesianPotential R M h b)))
                            p <
                          0

declarations.name: TightVer401.quadraticFillerCartesian_exists_open_saddle_neighborhood
declarations.type:
∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {R : ℝ},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F {p | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p} →
    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
        0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p → TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ R → (TightVer401.planarHessian F p).det < 0) →
      ∃ U,
        IsOpen U ∧
          U ⊆ {p | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p} ∧
            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                0 < TightVer401.planarRadius p → TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ R → p ∈ U) ∧
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F U ∧
                (∀ p ∈ U, (TightVer401.planarHessian F p).det < 0) ∧
                  ∀ p ∈ U,
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.gaussianCurvature
                        (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.planarSupportMap F)) p <
                      0

declarations.type:

  (hC : 0 < C) (hInner : ∀ x ∈ TightVer401.quadraticRadialFillingRadiusLevel ε, G x = (C / ε) • x)

declarations.type:
∀ {F : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set ℝ},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F U →
    IsOpen U →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ TightVer401.radialPlanarDomain U →
          ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
            TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.radialPlanarPotential F) p i j =
              (deriv F (TightVer401.planarRadius p) / TightVer401.planarRadius p * if i = j then 1 else 0) +
                (deriv (deriv F) (TightVer401.planarRadius p) / TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 2 -
                      deriv F (TightVer401.planarRadius p) / TightVer401.planarRadius p ^ 3) *
                    p i *

declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.reciprocalExtension_slice_hasCompactSupport
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {lower : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < ρ s) →
    0 < lower →
      (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 < lower → f p = 0) →
        ∀ (s : ℝ), HasCompactSupport fun r => TightVer401.reciprocalExtension ρ f ![s, r]

declarations.name: TightVer401.reciprocalExtension_transport
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ lam D : ℝ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {upper : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt ρ (lam s * ρ s / 2) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < ρ s) →
      0 < upper →
        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) →
          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), upper < p 1 → f p = 0) →
            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                0 < p 1 →
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 f p -
                      p 1 / 2 * (lam (p 0) + p 1 * D (p 0)) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 f p =
                    0) →
              ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.reciprocalExtension ρ f) p +
                    D (p 0) / (2 * ρ (p 0)) *
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.reciprocalExtension ρ f) p =
                  0

declarations.name: TightVer401.reciprocalProfile_level_bounds
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ lam D W : ℝ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {lower upper c : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt ρ (lam s * ρ s / 2) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < ρ s) →
      0 < lower →
        0 < upper →
          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) →
            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 < lower → f p = 0) →
              (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), upper < p 1 → f p = 0) →
                (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                    0 < p 1 →
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 f p -
                          p 1 / 2 * (lam (p 0) + p 1 * D (p 0)) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 f p =
                        0) →
                  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt W (D s / (2 * ρ s)) s) →
                    W 0 = 0 →
                      TightVer401.reciprocalProfile ρ f c ≠ 0 →
                        ∀ (s : ℝ), 1 / (ρ s * upper) - W s ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 1 / (ρ s * lower) - W s

declarations.name: TightVer401.reciprocalProfile_reconstruction
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ lam D W : ℝ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {upper : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt ρ (lam s * ρ s / 2) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < ρ s) →
      0 < upper →
        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) →
          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), upper < p 1 → f p = 0) →
            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                0 < p 1 →
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 f p -
                      p 1 / 2 * (lam (p 0) + p 1 * D (p 0)) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 f p =
                    0) →
              (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt W (D s / (2 * ρ s)) s) →
                W 0 = 0 →
                  ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                    0 < p 1 → f p = TightVer401.reciprocalProfile ρ f (1 / (ρ (p 0) * p 1) - W (p 0))

declarations.name: TightVer401.reciprocalProfile_support_bounds
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ lam D W : ℝ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt ρ (lam s * ρ s / 2) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < ρ s) →
      0 < lower →
        0 < upper →
          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) →
            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 < lower → f p = 0) →
              (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), upper < p 1 → f p = 0) →
                (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                    0 < p 1 →
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 f p -
                          p 1 / 2 * (lam (p 0) + p 1 * D (p 0)) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 f p =
                        0) →
                  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt W (D s / (2 * ρ s)) s) →
                    W 0 = 0 →
                      ∀ (s : ℝ),
                        tsupport (TightVer401.reciprocalProfile ρ f) ⊆
                          Set.Icc (1 / (ρ s * upper) - W s) (1 / (ρ s * lower) - W s)

declarations.name: TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise_exterior
declarations.type:
∀ {P V S : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen V →
    V ∩ frontier P ⊆ S →
      ∀ {f g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f V →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) g V →
            (∀ x ∈ V, (TightVer401.planarHessian f x).det < 0) →
              (∀ x ∈ V, (TightVer401.planarHessian g x).det < 0) →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise P f g) (V \ S) ∧
                  ∀ x ∈ V \ S, (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise P f g) x).det < 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise_exterior_domains
declarations.type:
∀ {P V S Uf Ug : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen V →
    V ∩ frontier P ⊆ S →
      IsOpen Uf →
        IsOpen Ug →
          V ∩ interior P ⊆ Uf →
            V ∩ interior Pᶜ ⊆ Ug →
              ∀ {f g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f Uf →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) g Ug →
                    (∀ x ∈ Uf, (TightVer401.planarHessian f x).det < 0) →
                      (∀ x ∈ Ug, (TightVer401.planarHessian g x).det < 0) →
                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise P f g) (V \ S) ∧
                          ∀ x ∈ V \ S, (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise P f g) x).det < 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.relativeSaddleProfile_error_bounds
declarations.type:
∃ B₁ > 0,
  ∃ B₂ > 0,
    ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ),
      δ ≤ 1 →
        ∀ (t : ℝ),
          |TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ hδ (√δ) t - max t 0 ^ 2| ≤ 7 * δ ^ 2 ∧
            |deriv (TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ hδ √δ) t - 2 * max t 0| ≤ 4 * δ + 3 * B₁ * δ * √δ ∧
              (|t| ≤ 2 * √δ →
                |TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ hδ (√δ) t| ≤ 11 * δ ∧
                  |deriv (TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ hδ √δ) t| ≤ (8 + 3 * B₁ * δ) * √δ ∧
                    |deriv (deriv (TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ hδ √δ)) t / 2 -
                          TightVer401.smoothingNormalCDF δ hδ t| ≤
                      3 * B₂ / 2 * δ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.relativeSaddleSeam_common_second_jets
declarations.type:
∀ {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
    ∀ {f g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f U →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) g U →
          IsOpen U →
            (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (γ s) ∈ U) →
              (∀ (s : ℝ),
                  TightVer401.planarGradient f (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (γ s)) =
                    TightVer401.planarGradient g (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (γ s))) →
                ∀ (s : ℝ),
                  have p := TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (γ s);
                  have u := TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (deriv γ s);
                  have v := TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (Complex.I * deriv γ s);
                  TightVer401.seamFramedHessian f p u v =
                      TightVer401.seamSecondJet (TightVer401.seamFramedHessian f p u v 0 0)
                        (TightVer401.seamFramedHessian f p u v 1 0) (TightVer401.seamFramedHessian f p u v 1 1) ∧
                    TightVer401.seamFramedHessian g p u v =
                      TightVer401.seamSecondJet (TightVer401.seamFramedHessian f p u v 0 0)
                        (TightVer401.seamFramedHessian f p u v 1 0) (TightVer401.seamFramedHessian g p u v 1 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.relativeSaddleSeam_exists_collar
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} [Fact (0 < L)] {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
    ∀ (hL : Function.Periodic γ L),
      (∀ (s : ℝ), deriv γ s ≠ 0) →
        Function.Injective hL.lift →
          ∀ {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
            IsOpen U →
              TightVer401.seamNormalSeam γ hL ⊆ U →
                ∃ r > 0,
                  Set.InjOn (TightVer401.seamNormalNative γ hL) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-r) r) ∧
                    (∀ (s t : ℝ),
                        |t| ≤ r →
                          (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ) ![s, t]).det ≠ 0) ∧
                      IsOpen (TightVer401.seamNormalOpenTube γ hL r) ∧ TightVer401.seamNormalOpenTube γ hL r ⊆ U

declarations.type:

  HasDerivAt A q₁ s →
    HasDerivAt u (q₁ * u s + q₂ * u s ^ 2) s →
      HasDerivAt V (q₂ * Real.exp (A s)) s → u s ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.exp (A t) / u t + V t) 0 s

declarations.name: TightVer401.riccati_flow_over_period
declarations.type:
∀ {q₁ q₂ : ℝ → ℝ} (L : ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) q₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) q₂ →
      ∃ δ > 0,
        ∀ (u : ℝ),
          |u| < δ →
            TightVer401.riccatiTrajectory (TightVer401.riccatiA q₁) (TightVer401.riccatiV q₁ q₂) u 0 = u ∧
              (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
                  HasDerivAt (TightVer401.riccatiTrajectory (TightVer401.riccatiA q₁) (TightVer401.riccatiV q₁ q₂) u)
                    (q₁ t * TightVer401.riccatiTrajectory (TightVer401.riccatiA q₁) (TightVer401.riccatiV q₁ q₂) u t +
                      q₂ t *
                        TightVer401.riccatiTrajectory (TightVer401.riccatiA q₁) (TightVer401.riccatiV q₁ q₂) u t ^ 2)
                    t) ∧
                TightVer401.riccatiTrajectory (TightVer401.riccatiA q₁) (TightVer401.riccatiV q₁ q₂) u L =
                  TightVer401.mobiusReturn (Real.exp (TightVer401.riccatiA q₁ L))
                    (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, q₂ t * Real.exp (TightVer401.riccatiA q₁ t)) u

    HasDerivAt u (q₁ * u s + q₂ * u s ^ 2) s →
      u s ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.exp (A t) / u t) (-q₂ * Real.exp (A s)) s

declarations.type:
∀ {A u V q₁ q₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {J : Set ℝ},
  IsOpen J →
    IsPreconnected J →
      (∀ t ∈ J, HasDerivAt A (q₁ t) t) →
        (∀ t ∈ J, HasDerivAt u (q₁ t * u t + q₂ t * u t ^ 2) t) →
          (∀ t ∈ J, HasDerivAt V (q₂ t * Real.exp (A t)) t) →
            (∀ t ∈ J, u t ≠ 0) →
              0 ∈ J → ∀ {L : ℝ}, L ∈ J → A 0 = 0 → V 0 = 0 → u L = TightVer401.mobiusReturn (Real.exp (A L)) (V L) (u 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledBending.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p = α p • T (p 0) + β p • n (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledBending_partial
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {k τ : ℝ},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ α p →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ β p →
      HasDerivAt T (k • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt n (-τ • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p =
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i α p • T (p 0) +
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i β p • n (p 0) +
                (Pi.single i 1 0 * (k * α p - τ * β p)) • E (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledBending_projections
declarations.type:
∀ {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0)) →
    inner ℝ (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p) (T (p 0)) = α p ∧
      inner ℝ (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p) (n (p 0)) = β p

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledBetaFactor
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledCircleChart

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledCircleChart._proof_1

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledCircleChart.congr_simp
declarations.type:
∀ (L r r_1 : ℝ),

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledCircleChart_apply

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledCircleChart_center_source
declarations.type: ∀ (L r : ℝ) [hL : Fact (0 < L)], ![r, 0] ∈ (TightVer401.ruledCircleChart L r).source

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledCircleChart_fullBandMap

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledCircleChart_fullGaussMap
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (r : ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
