declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledD
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledD.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (k τ : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ), TightVer401.ruledD k τ s = deriv k s - k s * TightVer401.ruledLambda τ s

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledEnergy
declarations.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledEnergy.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (k τ u : ℝ), TightVer401.ruledEnergy k τ u = (1 - k * u) ^ 2 + τ ^ 2 * u ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledEnergy_pos
declarations.type: ∀ {k τ u : ℝ}, τ ≠ 0 → 0 < TightVer401.ruledEnergy k τ u

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (ρ W : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p = 1 / (ρ (p 0) * p 1) - W (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral_differentiableAt
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ W : ℝ → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {lam D : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt ρ (lam * ρ (p 0) / 2) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt W (D / (2 * ρ (p 0))) (p 0) →
      ρ (p 0) ≠ 0 → p 1 ≠ 0 → DifferentiableAt ℝ (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W) p

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral_partial
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ W : ℝ → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {lam D : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt ρ (lam * ρ (p 0) / 2) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt W (D / (2 * ρ (p 0))) (p 0) →
      ρ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
        p 1 ≠ 0 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W) p =
              -Pi.single i 1 0 * (lam + p 1 * D) / (2 * ρ (p 0) * p 1) - Pi.single i 1 1 / (ρ (p 0) * p 1 ^ 2)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFullBending
declarations.type:
(OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
      (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
        (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
          (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFullBending._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledFullBending.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (α χ β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.ruledFullBending α χ β T E n p = TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p + χ p • E (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLambda
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLambda.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ), TightVer401.ruledLambda τ s = deriv τ s / τ s

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (ρ ω : ℝ → ℝ) (c s : ℝ), TightVer401.ruledLeaf ρ ω c s = 1 / (ρ s * (c + ω s))

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_first_integral
declarations.type: ∀ {ρ ω : ℝ → ℝ} {c s : ℝ}, ρ s ≠ 0 → c + ω s ≠ 0 → 1 / (ρ s * TightVer401.ruledLeaf ρ ω c s) - ω s = c

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ ω : ℝ → ℝ} {c s lam D : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt ρ (lam * ρ s / 2) s →
    HasDerivAt ω (D / (2 * ρ s)) s →
      ρ s ≠ 0 →
        c + ω s ≠ 0 →
          HasDerivAt (TightVer401.ruledLeaf ρ ω c)
            (-(TightVer401.ruledLeaf ρ ω c s / 2) * (lam + TightVer401.ruledLeaf ρ ω c s * D)) s

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt._simp_1_3
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt._simp_1_4
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt._simp_1_5
declarations.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt._simp_1_6
declarations.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt._simp_1_7
declarations.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_hasDerivAt._simp_1_8
declarations.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_in_band
declarations.type: ∀ {ρ ω : ℝ → ℝ} {c s b : ℝ}, 0 < ρ s → 0 < b → 1 / (ρ s * b) - ω s < c → TightVer401.ruledLeaf ρ ω c s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledLeaf_periodic
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ ω : ℝ → ℝ} {c L : ℝ},
  Function.Periodic ρ L → Function.Periodic ω L → Function.Periodic (TightVer401.ruledLeaf ρ ω c) L

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledMap
declarations.type:
(ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
  (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledMap._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledMap.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (γ E : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.ruledMap γ E p = γ (p 0) + p 1 • E (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledNormal
declarations.type: OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledNormal.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (T n : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (k τ u : ℝ),
  TightVer401.ruledNormal T n k τ u =
    (-τ * u / √(TightVer401.ruledEnergy k τ u)) • T + ((1 - k * u) / √(TightVer401.ruledEnergy k τ u)) • n

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledNormal_hasDerivAt_zero
declarations.type: ∀ (T n : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (k τ : ℝ), HasDerivAt (TightVer401.ruledNormal T n k τ) (-τ • T) 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledNormal_orthogonal
declarations.type:
∀ {T E n : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ u : ℝ},
  TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame T E n →
    inner ℝ ((1 - k * u) • T + (τ * u) • n) (TightVer401.ruledNormal T n k τ u) = 0 ∧
      inner ℝ E (TightVer401.ruledNormal T n k τ u) = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledNormal_unit
declarations.type:
∀ {T E n : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ u : ℝ},
  TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame T E n →
    τ ≠ 0 → inner ℝ (TightVer401.ruledNormal T n k τ u) (TightVer401.ruledNormal T n k τ u) = 1

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledNormal_zero
declarations.type: ∀ (T n : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (k τ : ℝ), TightVer401.ruledNormal T n k τ 0 = n

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledOmega
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledOmega.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (k τ : ℝ → ℝ),
  TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ =
    OAI.ClosedSurfaceR4.PeriodicPrimitive.rawPrimitive (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledOmega_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) →
        ∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt (TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ) (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ s) s

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledOmega_increment
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) →
        Function.Periodic k L →
          Function.Periodic τ L →
            ∀ (s : ℝ),
              TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ (s + L) - TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ s =
                ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ r

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient._proof_1
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (k τ : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ),
  TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ s = TightVer401.ruledD k τ s / (2 * TightVer401.ruledRho τ s)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient_contDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ → (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient_periodic
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ},
  Function.Periodic k L → Function.Periodic τ L → Function.Periodic (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ) L

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential
declarations.type:
(ℝ → ℝ) →
  (ℝ → ℝ) →
    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (k τ : ℝ → ℝ) (α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β p = (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * α p + τ (p 0) * p 1 * β p

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential_differentiableAt
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ k (p 0) →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ τ (p 0) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ α p → DifferentiableAt ℝ β p → DifferentiableAt ℝ (TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β) p

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential_nonzero_of_bending
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) →
        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ α p) →
          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ β p) →
            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                0 < p 1 →
                  (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 α p +
                          τ (p 0) * p 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 β p +
                        k (p 0) * α p -
                      τ (p 0) * β p =
                    0) →
              ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                0 < p 1 →
                  TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p ≠ 0 → ∃ q, 0 < q 1 ∧ TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β q ≠ 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential_partial
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks τs : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt τ τs (p 0) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ α p →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ β p →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β) p =
              (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i α p +
                    τ (p 0) * p 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i β p +
                  Pi.single i 1 0 * (-ks * p 1 * α p + τs * p 1 * β p) +
                Pi.single i 1 1 * (-k (p 0) * α p + τ (p 0) * β p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential_reconstruction
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks τs : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt τ τs (p 0) →
      τ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ α p →
          DifferentiableAt ℝ β p →
            (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 α p +
                      τ (p 0) * p 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 β p +
                    k (p 0) * α p -
                  τ (p 0) * β p =
                0 →
              α p =
                  TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β p -
                    p 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β) p / 2 ∧
                β p =
                  (k (p 0) * TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β p +
                      (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) *
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β) p /
                        2) /
                    τ (p 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential_transport_of_zero_strain
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks τs : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt γ (T (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt E (-k (p 0) • T (p 0) + τ (p 0) • n (p 0)) (p 0) →
      HasDerivAt T (k (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt n (-τ (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
          HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
            HasDerivAt τ τs (p 0) →
              τ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
                DifferentiableAt ℝ α p →
                  DifferentiableAt ℝ β p →
                    TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0)) →
                      TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p 0 0 = 0 →
                        TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p 0 1 = 0 →
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β) p -
                              p 1 / 2 * (τs / τ (p 0) + p 1 * (ks - k (p 0) * (τs / τ (p 0)))) *
                                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β) p =
                            -p 1 * (ks - k (p 0) * (τs / τ (p 0))) * TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β p

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledPotential_zero_of_bending_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0)) →
    TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p = 0 → TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β p = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha._proof_1
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (τ ρ W F : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha τ ρ W F p =
    τ (p 0) * p 1 / (2 * ρ (p 0)) * deriv F (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileBeta
declarations.type: (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileBeta.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (k ρ W F : ℝ → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.ruledProfileBeta k ρ W F p =
    p 1 * F (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p) -
      (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) / (2 * ρ (p 0)) * deriv F (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileField
declarations.type:
(ℝ → ℝ) →
  (ℝ → ℝ) →
    (ℝ → ℝ) →
      (ℝ → ℝ) →
        (ℝ → ℝ) →
          (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
            (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileField.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (k τ ρ W F : ℝ → ℝ) (T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
  TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W F T n =
    TightVer401.ruledBending (TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha τ ρ W F) (TightVer401.ruledProfileBeta k ρ W F) T n

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfileField_add
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ ρ W F G : ℝ → ℝ} {T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient},
  Differentiable ℝ F →
    Differentiable ℝ G →
      TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W (F + G) T n =
        TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W F T n + TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W G T n

declarations.type:

    TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W (fun c => F (c + a)) T n p

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfile_differential
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ ρ W F : ℝ → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks lam f₁ f₂ : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt τ (lam * τ (p 0)) (p 0) →
      HasDerivAt ρ (lam * ρ (p 0) / 2) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt W ((ks - k (p 0) * lam) / (2 * ρ (p 0))) (p 0) →
          ρ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
            p 1 ≠ 0 →
              HasDerivAt F f₁ (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p) →
                HasDerivAt (deriv F) f₂ (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p) →
                  DifferentiableAt ℝ (TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha τ ρ W F) p ∧
                    DifferentiableAt ℝ (TightVer401.ruledProfileBeta k ρ W F) p ∧
                      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha τ ρ W F) p =
                            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledAlphaFactor τ ρ) p * f₁ +
                              TightVer401.ruledAlphaFactor τ ρ p * f₂ *
                                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W) p ∧
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledProfileBeta k ρ W F) p =
                            Pi.single i 1 1 * F (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p) +
                                p 1 * f₁ *
                                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W) p -
                              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledBetaFactor k ρ) p * f₁ +
                                TightVer401.ruledBetaFactor k ρ p * f₂ *
                                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W) p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledProfile_factors
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks lam : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt τ (lam * τ (p 0)) (p 0) →
      HasDerivAt ρ (lam * ρ (p 0) / 2) (p 0) →
        ρ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (TightVer401.ruledAlphaFactor τ ρ) p ∧
            DifferentiableAt ℝ (TightVer401.ruledBetaFactor k ρ) p ∧
              ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledAlphaFactor τ ρ) p =
                    Pi.single i 1 0 * lam * τ (p 0) * p 1 / (4 * ρ (p 0)) + Pi.single i 1 1 * τ (p 0) / (2 * ρ (p 0)) ∧
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledBetaFactor k ρ) p =
                    Pi.single i 1 0 * (-ks * p 1 / (2 * ρ (p 0)) - (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * lam / (4 * ρ (p 0))) -
                      Pi.single i 1 1 * k (p 0) / (2 * ρ (p 0))

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledTransportWeight_partial
declarations.type:
∀ {τ : ℝ → ℝ} {P : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {lam : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt τ (lam * τ (q 0)) (q 0) →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ P q →
      τ (q 0) ≠ 0 →
        q 1 ≠ 0 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2),
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.ruledTransportWeight τ P) q =
              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i P q * (τ (q 0) * q 1 * q 1) -
                  P q * (Pi.single i 1 0 * lam * τ (q 0) * q 1 * q 1 + Pi.single i 1 1 * (2 * τ (q 0) * q 1))) /
                (τ (q 0) * q 1 * q 1) ^ 2

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruledTransportWeight_transport
declarations.type:
∀ {τ : ℝ → ℝ} {P : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {lam D : ℝ},

    DifferentiableAt ℝ P q →
      τ (q 0) ≠ 0 →
        q 1 ≠ 0 →
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 P q -
                q 1 / 2 * (lam + q 1 * D) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 P q =

            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.ruledTransportWeight τ P) q -
                q 1 / 2 * (lam + q 1 * D) *
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (TightVer401.ruledTransportWeight τ P) q =

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_asymptotic_slope
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks τs w : ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt E (-k s • T s + τ s • n s) s) →
      HasDerivAt T (k (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt n (-τ (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
          HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
            HasDerivAt τ τs (p 0) →
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) U →
                IsOpen U →
                  p ∈ U →
                    TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0)) →
                      τ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
                        (![1, w] ⬝ᵥ
                              (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E)
                                    (TightVer401.ruledNormal (T (p 0)) (n (p 0)) (k (p 0)) (τ (p 0)) (p 1)) p).mulVec
                                ![1, w] =
                            0 ↔
                          w = -(p 1 / 2) * (τs / τ (p 0) + p 1 * (ks - k (p 0) * (τs / τ (p 0)))))

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_central_support_tensor
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L) (r : ℝ),
  d.τ r < 0 →
    ∃ (hw : d.n r ≠ 0),
      ∃ e,
        ![r, 0] ∈ e.source ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e) e.source ∧
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target ∧
              (∀ q ∈ e.source, d.rawGaussMap q = TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (d.n r) hw (↑e q)) ∧
                have Q := TightVer401.sphereHemisphere (d.n r) hw;
                have g := OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric Q;
                have H := fun y => inner ℝ (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E (↑e.symm y)) (Q y);
                have c := (-d.τ r)⁻¹;
                have V := ![(fderiv ℝ ↑e ![r, 0]) (c • Pi.single 0 1), (fderiv ℝ ↑e ![r, 0]) (c • Pi.single 1 1)];
                (∀ y ∈ e.target, TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E (↑e.symm y) = TightVer401.sphereSupportMap g Q H y) ∧
                  (∀ (i : Fin 2), (fderiv ℝ Q (↑e ![r, 0])) (V i) = ![d.E r, d.T r] i) ∧
                    (fun i j => TightVer401.sphereSupportTensorBilinear g H (↑e ![r, 0]) (V i) (V j)) = !![0, c; c, 0] ∧
                      0 < c

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_characteristic_derivative_of_asymptotic
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ u : ℝ → ℝ} {s ks τs w : ℝ}
  {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (r : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T r) r) →
    (∀ (r : ℝ), HasDerivAt E (-k r • T r + τ r • n r) r) →
      HasDerivAt T (k s • E s) s →
        HasDerivAt n (-τ s • E s) s →
          HasDerivAt k ks s →
            HasDerivAt τ τs s →
              HasDerivAt u w s →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) U →
                  IsOpen U →
                    ![s, u s] ∈ U →
                      TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T s) (E s) (n s) →
                        τ s ≠ 0 →
                          deriv (fun r => ![r, u r]) s ⬝ᵥ
                                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E)
                                      (TightVer401.ruledNormal (T s) (n s) (k s) (τ s) (u s)) ![s, u s]).mulVec
                                  (deriv (fun r => ![r, u r]) s) =
                              0 →
                            HasDerivAt u (-(u s / 2) * (τs / τ s + u s * (ks - k s * (τs / τ s)))) s

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_flow_over_period
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {s L : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      (∀ (t : ℝ), τ t ≠ 0) →
        Function.Periodic k L →
          Function.Periodic τ L →
            ∃ δ > 0,
              ∀ (u : ℝ),
                |u| < δ →
                  TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho τ) (TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ) s u s = u ∧
                    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc s (s + L),
                        HasDerivAt
                          (TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho τ) (TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ) s u)
                          (-(TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho τ) (TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ) s u
                                  t /
                                2) *
                            (TightVer401.ruledLambda τ t +
                              TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho τ) (TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ) s u
                                  t *
                                TightVer401.ruledD k τ t))
                          t) ∧
                      TightVer401.principalTrajectory (TightVer401.ruledRho τ) (TightVer401.ruledOmega k τ) s u
                          (s + L) =
                        TightVer401.projectiveReturn
                          (TightVer401.ruledRho τ s * ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ r) u

              ∃ W,

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_potential_period_necessity
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {P : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {L lower upper : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) →
        Function.Periodic k L →
          Function.Periodic τ L →
            0 < lower →
              0 < upper →
                (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ P p) →
                  (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 < lower → P p = 0) →
                    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), upper < p 1 → P p = 0) →
                      (∀ (s u : ℝ), P ![s + L, u] = P ![s, u]) →
                        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                            0 < p 1 →
                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 P p -
                                  p 1 / 2 * (TightVer401.ruledLambda τ (p 0) + p 1 * TightVer401.ruledD k τ (p 0)) *
                                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 P p =
                                -p 1 * TightVer401.ruledD k τ (p 0) * P p) →
                          ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                            0 < p 1 → P p ≠ 0 → ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ r = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_profile_recovery_from_potential
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ ρ W F : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {T n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks τs : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt τ τs (p 0) →
      τ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
        ρ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
          0 < p 1 →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
              DifferentiableAt ℝ α p →
                DifferentiableAt ℝ β p →
                  (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 α p +
                            τ (p 0) * p 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 β p +
                          k (p 0) * α p -
                        τ (p 0) * β p =
                      0 →
                    (∀ (q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                        0 < q 1 →
                          TightVer401.ruledPotential k τ α β q =
                            τ (q 0) * q 1 ^ 2 * F (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W q)) →
                      TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p = TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W F T n p

      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ρ →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) T →
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) n →
                (∀ (s : ℝ), ρ s ≠ 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W F T n) {p | p 1 ≠ 0}

  TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T s) (E s) (n s) →
    τ s ≠ 0 →
      0 < ρ s →
        0 < b →
          1 / (ρ s * b) - W s < c →
            (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b,
                TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W F T n ![s, u] =
                  TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ ρ W G T n ![s, u]) →

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_profile_zero_strain
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ ρ W F : ℝ → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {ks lam f₁ f₂ : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt γ (T (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt E (-k (p 0) • T (p 0) + τ (p 0) • n (p 0)) (p 0) →
      HasDerivAt T (k (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt n (-τ (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
          HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
            HasDerivAt τ (lam * τ (p 0)) (p 0) →
              HasDerivAt ρ (lam * ρ (p 0) / 2) (p 0) →
                HasDerivAt W ((ks - k (p 0) * lam) / (2 * ρ (p 0))) (p 0) →
                  ρ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
                    p 1 ≠ 0 →
                      HasDerivAt F f₁ (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p) →
                        HasDerivAt (deriv F) f₂ (TightVer401.ruledFirstIntegral ρ W p) →
                          TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0)) →
                            ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                              TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E)
                                  (TightVer401.ruledBending (TightVer401.ruledProfileAlpha τ ρ W F)
                                    (TightVer401.ruledProfileBeta k ρ W F) T n)
                                  p i j =

TightVer401.ruled_return_of_actual_ODE
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ u : ℝ → ℝ} {L s : ℝ} {J : Set ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      (∀ (r : ℝ), τ r ≠ 0) →
        Function.Periodic k L →
          Function.Periodic τ L →
            IsOpen J →
              IsPreconnected J →
                s ∈ J →
                  s + L ∈ J →
                    (∀ r ∈ J, u r ≠ 0) →
                      (∀ r ∈ J,
                          HasDerivAt u (-(u r / 2) * (TightVer401.ruledLambda τ r + u r * TightVer401.ruledD k τ r))
                            r) →
                        u (s + L) =
                          TightVer401.projectiveReturn
                            (TightVer401.ruledRho τ s * ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ r)
                            (u s)

declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt E (-k s • T s + τ s • n s) s) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) U →
        IsOpen U →
          p ∈ U →
            TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0)) →
              τ (p 0) ≠ 0 →
                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.secondFundamental (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E)
                      (TightVer401.ruledNormal (T (p 0)) (n (p 0)) (k (p 0)) (τ (p 0)) (p 1)) p).det =
                  -τ (p 0) ^ 2 / TightVer401.ruledEnergy (k (p 0)) (τ (p 0)) (p 1)

        HasDerivAt n (-τ (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
          HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →

declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ks τs : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T s) s) →

        HasDerivAt n (-τ (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
          HasDerivAt k ks (p 0) →
            HasDerivAt τ τs (p 0) →
              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E)) p =

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_strain_equations
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  HasDerivAt γ (T (p 0)) (p 0) →
    HasDerivAt E (-k (p 0) • T (p 0) + τ (p 0) • n (p 0)) (p 0) →
      HasDerivAt T (k (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
        HasDerivAt n (-τ (p 0) • E (p 0)) (p 0) →
          DifferentiableAt ℝ α p →
            DifferentiableAt ℝ β p →
              TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0)) →
                TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p 0 0 =
                    2 *
                      ((1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 α p +
                        τ (p 0) * p 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 β p) ∧
                  TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p 0 1 =
                      (1 - k (p 0) * p 1) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 α p +
                            τ (p 0) * p 1 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 β p +
                          k (p 0) * α p -
                        τ (p 0) * β p ∧
                    TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p 1 1 = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_supported_kernel
declarations.type:
∀ {L b : ℝ} [inst : Fact (0 < L)] (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L),
  0 < b →
    ((∃ Y, TightVer401.IsBandBending d.bandMap Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ ∃ p, Y p ≠ 0) ↔
        ∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient d.k d.τ s = 0) ∧
      (∫ (s : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient d.k d.τ s = 0 →
        ∃ W,
          ∃ (hWL : Function.Periodic W L),
            ∃ cb,
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) W ∧
                (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt W (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient d.k d.τ s) s) ∧
                  (∀ (s : ℝ), 1 / (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ s * b) - W s ≤ cb) ∧
                    (∃ s, 1 / (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ s * b) - W s = cb) ∧
                      ∀ (Y : AddCircle L × ↑(Set.Ioo 0 b) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient),
                        TightVer401.IsBandBending d.bandMap Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ↔
                          ∃! F, ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F ∧ HasCompactSupport F ∧ tsupport F ⊆ Set.Ioi cb ∧ Y = d.profile hWL)

declarations.name: TightVer401.ruled_transport_period_necessity
declarations.type:
∀ {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {L lower upper : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) →
        Function.Periodic k L →
          Function.Periodic τ L →
            0 < lower →
              0 < upper →
                (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f p) →
                  (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 < lower → f p = 0) →
                    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), upper < p 1 → f p = 0) →
                      (∀ (s u : ℝ), f ![s + L, u] = f ![s, u]) →
                        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                            0 < p 1 →
                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 f p -
                                  p 1 / 2 * (TightVer401.ruledLambda τ (p 0) + p 1 * TightVer401.ruledD k τ (p 0)) *
                                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 f p =
                                0) →
                          ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                            0 < p 1 → f p ≠ 0 → ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ r = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_abs_le_of_mem_uIcc_zero
declarations.type: ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t → |s| ≤ |t|

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_adjacent_germs
declarations.type:
∀ {w : ℕ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ε e : ℝ} {N : ℕ},
  IsOpen W →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
      (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (w j) (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e))) →
        (∀ j ≤ N,
            ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e),
              ![q 0, w j q] ∈ W ∧ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (w j) q = f ![q 0, w j q]) →
          (∀ j < N, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 e, w j ![r (j + 1), x] = w (j + 1) ![r (j + 1), x]) →
            ∀ j < N,
              ∀
                q ∈
                  TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e) ∩
                    TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r (j + 1)) ε (Metric.ball 0 e),
                q 0 = r (j + 1) → w j =ᶠ[nhds q] w (j + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_adjacent_seam_germs
declarations.type:
∀ {w : ℕ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ε e : ℝ} {N : ℕ},
  0 < ε →
    (∀ j < N, |r (j + 1) - r j| < ε) →
      IsOpen W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
          (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (w j) (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e))) →
            (∀ j ≤ N,
                ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e),
                  ![q 0, w j q] ∈ W ∧ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (w j) q = f ![q 0, w j q]) →
              (∀ j < N, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 e, w j ![r (j + 1), x] = w (j + 1) ![r (j + 1), x]) →
                ∀ j < N, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 e, w j =ᶠ[nhds ![r (j + 1), x]] w (j + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_central_orbit
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {D : Set (ℝ × OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)}
  {Φ : ℝ × OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {δ r : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Φ D →
          (∀ (y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), (0, y) ∈ D → Φ (0, y) = y) →
            (∀ q ∈ D, Φ q ∈ W ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, q.2)) (TightVer401.scalarFlowAutonomization f (Φ q)) q.1) →
              (∀ (a : ℝ), ![a, 0] ∈ W) →
                (∀ (a : ℝ), f ![a, 0] = 0) →
                  (∀ (s : ℝ), |s| < δ → (s, ![r, 0]) ∈ D) → ∀ (t : ℝ), |t| < δ / 2 → Φ (t, ![r, 0]) = ![r + t, 0]

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_compose_finite_cells
declarations.type:
∀ {u : ℕ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ} {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {ε : ℝ} {N : ℕ},
  0 < ε →
    r 0 = 0 →
      (∀ j ≤ N, |r (j + 1) - r j| < ε) →
        (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (u j) (TightVer401.scalarCellSource (r j) ε)) →
          (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource (r j) ε, ![q 0, u j q] ∈ W) →
            (∀ j ≤ N,
                ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource (r j) ε,
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (u j) q = f ![q 0, u j q]) →
              (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ (a : ℝ), |a - r j| < ε → u j ![a, 0] = 0) →
                (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ (x : ℝ), |x| < ε → u j ![r j, x] = x) →
                  ∃ e > 0,
                    ∃ w,
                      (∀ j ≤ N, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (w j) (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e))) ∧
                        (∀ j ≤ N,
                            ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (r j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e),
                              ![q 0, w j q] ∈ W ∧ OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (w j) q = f ![q 0, w j q]) ∧
                          (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ (a : ℝ), |a - r j| < ε → w j ![a, 0] = 0) ∧
                            (∀ j < N, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 e, w j ![r (j + 1), x] = w (j + 1) ![r (j + 1), x]) ∧
                              ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 e, w 0 ![0, x] = x

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_compose_finite_cells._simp_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace α] {x y : α} {ε : ℝ}, (y ∈ Metric.ball x ε) = (dist y x < ε)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_endpoint_contDiffOn
declarations.type:
∀ {u : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {r s ε : ℝ},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u (TightVer401.scalarCellSource r ε) →
    |s - r| < ε → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (fun x => u ![s, x]) (Metric.ball 0 ε)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_endpoint_contDiffOn._simp_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace α] {x y : α} {ε : ℝ}, (y ∈ Metric.ball x ε) = (dist y x < ε)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_equal_on_rectangle
declarations.type:
∀ {u v f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {T ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u (TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε) →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) v (TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε) →
            (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
              (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε, ![q 0, v q] ∈ W) →
                (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) →
                  (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε,
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 v q = f ![q 0, v q]) →
                    (∀ (x : ℝ), |x| < ε → u ![T, x] = v ![T, x]) → Set.EqOn u v (TightVer401.scalarCellSource T (ε / 2))

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_equal_on_strip
declarations.type:
∀ {u v f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {V : Set ℝ} {T ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    IsOpen V →
      IsOpen W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V) →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) v (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V) →
              (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
                (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V, ![q 0, v q] ∈ W) →
                  (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V,
                      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) →
                    (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V,
                        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 v q = f ![q 0, v q]) →
                      (∀ x ∈ V, u ![T, x] = v ![T, x]) → Set.EqOn u v (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T (ε / 2) V)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_exists_composable_cells
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 < P →
    IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
        (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ W) →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), f ![r, 0] = 0) →
            ∃ N ε e,
              0 < N ∧
                0 < ε ∧
                  0 < e ∧
                    0 < TightVer401.scalarCellStep P N ∧
                      TightVer401.scalarCellStep P N < ε / 4 ∧
                        ∃ w,
                          (∀ j ≤ N,
                              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (w j)
                                (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e))) ∧
                            (∀ j ≤ N,
                                ∀
                                  q ∈
                                    TightVer401.scalarCellStrip (TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N j) ε (Metric.ball 0 e),
                                  ![q 0, w j q] ∈ W ∧
                                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (w j) q = f ![q 0, w j q]) ∧
                              (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ (a : ℝ), |a - TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N j| < ε → w j ![a, 0] = 0) ∧
                                (∀ j < N,
                                    ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 e,
                                      w j ![TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N (j + 1), x] =
                                        w (j + 1) ![TightVer401.scalarCellTime P N (j + 1), x]) ∧
                                  ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball 0 e, w 0 ![0, x] = x

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_exists_local_phase_flow
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen W →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
      ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        p ∈ W →
          ∃ D Φ,
            IsOpen D ∧
              (0, p) ∈ D ∧
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Φ D ∧
                  (∀ (x : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), (0, x) ∈ D → Φ (0, x) = x) ∧
                    ∀ q ∈ D,
                      Φ q ∈ W ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ (t, q.2)) (TightVer401.scalarFlowAutonomization f (Φ q)) q.1

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_exists_uniform_finite_cells
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 ≤ P →
    IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
        (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ W) →
          ∃ δ > 0,
            ∃ s D Φ,
              (∀ c ∈ s,
                  IsOpen (D c) ∧
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (Φ c) (D c) ∧
                      (∀ (x : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), (0, x) ∈ D c → Φ c (0, x) = x) ∧
                        ∀ q ∈ D c,
                          Φ c q ∈ W ∧
                            HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ c (t, q.2)) (TightVer401.scalarFlowAutonomization f (Φ c q)) q.1) ∧
                ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ∃ c ∈ s, ∀ (t x : ℝ), |t| < δ → |x| < δ → (t, ![r, x]) ∈ D c

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_exists_uniform_scalar_cells
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 ≤ P →
    IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
        (∀ (r : ℝ), ![r, 0] ∈ W) →
          (∀ (r : ℝ), f ![r, 0] = 0) →
            ∃ ε > 0,
              ∃ u,
                ∀ (r : ↑(Set.Icc 0 P)),
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (u r) (TightVer401.scalarCellSource (↑r) ε) ∧
                    (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource (↑r) ε, ![q 0, u r q] ∈ W) ∧
                      (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource (↑r) ε,
                          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (u r) q = f ![q 0, u r q]) ∧
                        (∀ (a : ℝ), |a - ↑r| < ε → u r ![a, 0] = 0) ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ), |x| < ε → u r ![↑r, x] = x

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_extract_scalar_cell
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {D : Set (ℝ × OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)}
  {Φ : ℝ × OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {δ r : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Φ D →
          (∀ (y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), (0, y) ∈ D → Φ (0, y) = y) →
            (∀ q ∈ D, Φ q ∈ W ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, q.2)) (TightVer401.scalarFlowAutonomization f (Φ q)) q.1) →
              (∀ (a : ℝ), ![a, 0] ∈ W) →
                (∀ (a : ℝ), f ![a, 0] = 0) →
                  (∀ (s x : ℝ), |s| < δ → |x| < δ → (s, ![r, x]) ∈ D) →
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.scalarCellMap Φ r) (TightVer401.scalarCellSource r (δ / 2)) ∧
                      (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource r (δ / 2), ![q 0, TightVer401.scalarCellMap Φ r q] ∈ W) ∧
                        (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource r (δ / 2),
                            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.scalarCellMap Φ r) q =
                              f ![q 0, TightVer401.scalarCellMap Φ r q]) ∧
                          (∀ (a : ℝ), |a - r| < δ / 2 → TightVer401.scalarCellMap Φ r ![a, 0] = 0) ∧
                            ∀ (x : ℝ), |x| < δ / 2 → TightVer401.scalarCellMap Φ r ![r, x] = x

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_finite_positive_bound
declarations.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < e i) → ∃ δ > 0, ∀ i ∈ s, δ ≤ e i

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_initial_germ_unique
declarations.type:
∀ {u v f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U V W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {T x : ℝ},
  IsOpen U →
    IsOpen V →
      IsOpen W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u U →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) v V →
              ![T, x] ∈ U →
                ![T, x] ∈ V →
                  (∀ q ∈ U, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
                    (∀ q ∈ V, ![q 0, v q] ∈ W) →
                      (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) →
                        (∀ q ∈ V, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 v q = f ![q 0, v q]) →
                          ((fun y => u ![T, y]) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => v ![T, y]) → u =ᶠ[nhds ![T, x]] v

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_phase_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {u f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen V →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
      ∀ {r x : ℝ},
        ![r, x] ∈ V →
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u ![r, x] = f ![r, u ![r, x]] →
            HasDerivAt (fun s => ![s, u ![s, x]]) (TightVer401.scalarFlowAutonomization f ![r, u ![r, x]]) r

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_reparameter_cell
declarations.type:
∀ {u f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : ℝ → ℝ} {V : Set ℝ} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {T ε : ℝ},
  IsOpen V →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u (TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) p V →
        (∀ x ∈ V, |p x| < ε) →
          (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
            (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellSource T ε, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) →
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.scalarCellReparameter u p) (TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V) ∧
                (∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V, ![q 0, TightVer401.scalarCellReparameter u p q] ∈ W) ∧
                  ∀ q ∈ TightVer401.scalarCellStrip T ε V,
                    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 (TightVer401.scalarCellReparameter u p) q =
                      f ![q 0, TightVer401.scalarCellReparameter u p q]

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_slice0_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {u : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen V →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
      ∀ {r x : ℝ}, ![r, x] ∈ V → HasDerivAt (fun s => u ![s, x]) (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u ![r, x]) r

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_time_coordinate
declarations.type:
∀ {f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {D : Set (ℝ × OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)}
  {Φ : ℝ × OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {δ r x t : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    (∀ (y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), (0, y) ∈ D → Φ (0, y) = y) →
      (∀ q ∈ D, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, q.2)) (TightVer401.scalarFlowAutonomization f (Φ q)) q.1) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), |s| < δ → (s, ![r, x]) ∈ D) → |t| < δ → Φ (t, ![r, x]) 0 = r + t

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlowPeriod_unique_Icc_local
declarations.type:
∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {u v : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {a b t₀ : ℝ},
  IsOpen W →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F W →
      t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo a b →
        ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc a b) →
          ContinuousOn v (Set.Icc a b) →
            (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt u (F (u t)) t) →
              (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt v (F (v t)) t) →
                (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, u t ∈ W) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, v t ∈ W) → u t₀ = v t₀ → Set.EqOn u v (Set.Icc a b)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlow_return_deriv
declarations.type:
∀ {u f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 ≤ P →
    IsOpen V →
      IsOpen W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
            (∀ q ∈ V, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
              (∀ q ∈ V, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) →
                (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ V) →
                  (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, u ![r, 0] = 0) →
                    (fun x => u ![0, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                      deriv (fun x => u ![P, x]) 0 =
                        Real.exp (∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..P, TightVer401.scalarFlowLinearCoefficient f r)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlow_return_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {u f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 ≤ P →
    IsOpen V →
      IsOpen W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
            (∀ q ∈ V, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
              (∀ q ∈ V, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) →
                (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ V) →
                  (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, u ![r, 0] = 0) →
                    (fun x => u ![0, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                      HasDerivAt (fun x => u ![P, x])
                        (Real.exp (∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..P, TightVer401.scalarFlowLinearCoefficient f r)) 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlow_return_identity_integral_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {u f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {P : ℝ},
  0 ≤ P →
    IsOpen V →
      IsOpen W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
            (∀ q ∈ V, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
              (∀ q ∈ V, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 u q = f ![q 0, u q]) →
                (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, ![r, 0] ∈ V) →
                  (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 P, u ![r, 0] = 0) →
                    (fun x => u ![0, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                      (fun x => u ![P, x]) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                        ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..P, TightVer401.scalarFlowLinearCoefficient f r = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlow_rhs_transverse
declarations.type:
∀ {u f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen V →

      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u V →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f W →
          (∀ q ∈ V, ![q 0, u q] ∈ W) →
            ∀ {r : ℝ},
              ![r, 0] ∈ V →
                u ![r, 0] = 0 →

                    TightVer401.scalarFlowLinearCoefficient f r * TightVer401.scalarFlowJacobian u r

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarFlow_variation_hasDerivAt
declarations.type:
∀ {u f : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {V W : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarReturn_attracts
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ → ℝ} {μ : ℝ},

    R 0 = 0 →
      0 < μ →
        μ < 1 →
          ∃ e > 0,
            ∀ (x : ℝ), |x| < e → (∀ (n : ℕ), |R^[n] x| < e) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => R^[n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: TightVer401.scalarReturn_contraction_iterates
declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ → ℝ} {e q x : ℝ},

        |x| < e → (∀ (n : ℕ), |R^[n] x| < e) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => R^[n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.type: ∀ {R : ℝ → ℝ} {μ : ℝ}, HasDerivAt R μ 0 → R 0 = 0 → 1 < μ → ∃ e > 0, ∀ (x : ℝ), x ≠ 0 → |x| < e → ∃ n, e ≤ |R^[n] x|

declarations.type:

declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.seamCorrectedHessian_comp_det

∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

declarations.name: TightVer401.seamFramedHessian_common_secondJet
declarations.type:

declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {γ : ℝ → ℂ},

    ∀ (hL : Function.Periodic γ L) {r : ℝ},
      Set.InjOn (TightVer401.seamNormalNative γ hL) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-r) r) →
        (∀ (s t : ℝ),
            |t| ≤ r → (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ) ![s, t]).det ≠ 0) →
          ∀ (H F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
            (hPH : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), H (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = H p)
            (hPF : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), F (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = F p)
            {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
            |p 1| < r →
              H =ᶠ[nhds p] F →
                TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H hPH =ᶠ[nhds (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ p)]
                  TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r F hPF

declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
    ∀ (hL : Function.Periodic γ L) {r : ℝ} (H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
      (hPeriod : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), H (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = H p),
      Set.InjOn (TightVer401.seamNormalNative γ hL) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-r) r) →
        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          |p 1| < r →
            (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ) p).det ≠ 0 →
              DifferentiableAt ℝ (TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H hPeriod)
                  (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ p) →
                TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H hPeriod)
                    (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ p) =
                  (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ) p).transpose⁻¹.mulVec
                    (TightVer401.planarGradient H p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_coordPartial_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
      ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => F (Φ q)) p =
          ∑ a,
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a F (Φ p) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => Φ q a) p

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_coordPartial_comp_at
declarations.type:
∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  DifferentiableAt ℝ F (Φ p) →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ p →
      ∀ (i : Fin 2),
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => F (Φ q)) p =
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 F (Φ p) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i Φ p 0 +
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 F (Φ p) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i Φ p 1

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_coordPartial_component
declarations.type:
∀ {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
    ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (a i : Fin 2),
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (fun q => Φ q a) p = OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i Φ p a

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_fderiv_coordinate_apply
declarations.type:
∀ (F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p v : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  (fderiv ℝ F p) v =
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 0 F p * v 0 + OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 F p * v 1

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_hessian_tangent_action
declarations.type:
∀ {G H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
      IsOpen U →
        ∀ {γ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {t : ℝ},
          DifferentiableAt ℝ γ t →
            γ t ∈ U →
              ((fun s => TightVer401.planarGradient G (γ s)) =ᶠ[nhds t] fun s => TightVer401.planarGradient H (γ s)) →
                (TightVer401.planarHessian G (γ t)).mulVec (deriv γ t) =
                  (TightVer401.planarHessian H (γ t)).mulVec (deriv γ t)

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_periodic_eq_representative
declarations.type: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {F : ℝ → V} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L), Function.Periodic F L → ∀ (s : ℝ), F s = F (toIcoMod hL 0 s)

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_planarGradient_comp_at
declarations.type:
∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
    ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (Φ p) →
        TightVer401.planarGradient (fun q => F (Φ q)) p =
          (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p).transpose.mulVec (TightVer401.planarGradient F (Φ p))

declarations.name: TightVer401.seam_planarHessian_comp
declarations.type:
∀ {F : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
      ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i j : Fin 2),
        TightVer401.planarHessian (fun q => F (Φ q)) p i j =
          ((TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p).transpose * TightVer401.planarHessian F (Φ p) *
                TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ p)
              i j +
            ∑ a, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial a F (Φ p) * TightVer401.planarHessian (fun q => Φ q a) p i j

declarations.type:

declarations.type: {m : ℕ} → ℝ → ℝ → (r : ℝ) → 0 < r → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)

declarations.name: TightVer401.slowdownVectorMoment.eq_1
declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.slowdownVectorMoment_norm_le
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)} {L a r M : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (b : ℝ → ℝ),
  0 ≤ M →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖b x • f x‖ ≤ M) →
      0 ≤ a - r → a + r ≤ L → ‖TightVer401.slowdownVectorMoment L a r hr b f‖ ≤ 2 * M * r

declarations.name: TightVer401.slowdown_coefficients_l1_le
declarations.type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} {f : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)} {L a r M C : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (b : ℝ → ℝ),
  0 ≤ M →
    0 ≤ C →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖b x • f x‖ ≤ M) →
        0 ≤ a - r →
          a + r ≤ L →
            ∀ (T : ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L)) → Fin n → ℝ),
              (∀ (u : ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L))), ∑ j, |T u j| ≤ C * ‖u‖) →
                ∀ (u : ↥(TightVer401.momentSampleSpan f (Set.Ioo 0 L))),
                  ↑u = TightVer401.slowdownVectorMoment L a r hr b f → ∑ j, |T u j| ≤ 2 * C * M * r

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingChartHessianState._proof_2

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingChartHessianState.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
  (q : Fin 5 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
  TightVer401.smoothingChartHessianState Φ G R q i j =
    TightVer401.smoothingHessianState G R q i j -
      ∑ k,
        TightVer401.seamChartConnection Φ k i j ![q 0, q 1] *
          (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k G ![q 0, q 1] + (if k = 1 then q 4 else 0) * R ![q 0, q 1] +
            q 3 * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial k R ![q 0, q 1])

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingChartHessianState_continuousAt
declarations.type:
∀ {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
        ∀ (q : Fin 5 → ℝ),
          (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ ![q 0, q 1]).det ≠ 0 →
            ContinuousAt (TightVer401.smoothingChartHessianState Φ G R) q

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingChartHessianState_model
declarations.type:
∀ {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {f : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
        ∀ (s t : ℝ),
          TightVer401.smoothingChartHessianState Φ G R ![s, t, deriv (deriv f) t / 2, f t, deriv f t] =
            TightVer401.seamCorrectedHessian Φ (TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel f G R) ![s, t]

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend
declarations.type:
(OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (χ F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend χ F G p = G p + χ p * (F p - G p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend_contDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {χ F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend χ F G)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend_hessian
declarations.type:
∀ {χ F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i j : Fin 2),
          TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend χ F G) p i j =
            (1 - χ p) * TightVer401.planarHessian G p i j + χ p * TightVer401.planarHessian F p i j +
                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i χ p *
                    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j F p - OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j G p) +
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j χ p *
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i F p - OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i G p) +
              (F p - G p) * TightVer401.planarHessian χ p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend_new_germ
declarations.type:
∀ {χ F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (χ =ᶠ[nhds p] fun x => 1) → TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend χ F G =ᶠ[nhds p] F

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend_old_germ
declarations.type:
∀ {χ F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (χ =ᶠ[nhds p] fun x => 0) → TightVer401.smoothingCutoffBlend χ F G =ᶠ[nhds p] G

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffHessianError
declarations.type:
(OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) →
    (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffHessianError_apply
declarations.type:
∀ {χ F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i j : Fin 2),
          TightVer401.smoothingCutoffHessianError χ F G p i j =
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i χ p *
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j F p - OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j G p) +
                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j χ p *
                  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i F p - OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i G p) +
              (F p - G p) * TightVer401.planarHessian χ p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingCutoffHessianError_entry_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {χ F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) χ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →

                      |OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i F p - OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i G p| ≤ v) →
                    ∀ (i j : Fin 2), |TightVer401.smoothingCutoffHessianError χ F G p i j| ≤ 2 * A * v + u * B

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch_compact_C1
declarations.type:
∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
          ∀ {S : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
            IsCompact S →
              ∀ {η : ℝ},
                0 < η →
                  ∃ δ₀ > 0,
                    ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ),
                      δ < δ₀ →
                        ∀ p ∈ S,
                          |TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch F G δ hδ (√δ) p - TightVer401.smoothingFlatOriginal F G p| <
                              η ∧
                            ‖TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch F G δ hδ √δ) p -
                                  TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.smoothingFlatOriginal F G) p‖ <
                              η

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch_compact_saddle
declarations.type:
∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
          ∀ {K : Set ℝ},
            IsCompact K →
              (∀ s ∈ K, (TightVer401.planarHessian G ![s, 0]).det < 0) →
                (∀ s ∈ K, (TightVer401.planarHessian F ![s, 0]).det < 0) →
                  ∃ δ₀ > 0,
                    ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ),
                      δ < δ₀ →
                        ∀ s ∈ K,
                          ∀ (t : ℝ),
                            |t| ≤ 2 * √δ →
                              (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch F G δ hδ √δ) ![s, t]).det < 0

declarations.type:
∀ {Φ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Φ →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
          (∀ (s : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
            ∀ {K : Set ℝ},
              IsCompact K →
                (∀ s ∈ K, (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian Φ ![s, 0]).det ≠ 0) →
                  (∀ s ∈ K, (TightVer401.seamCorrectedHessian Φ G ![s, 0]).det < 0) →
                    (∀ s ∈ K, (TightVer401.seamCorrectedHessian Φ F ![s, 0]).det < 0) →
                      ∃ δ₀ > 0,
                        ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ),
                          δ < δ₀ →
                            ∀ s ∈ K,
                              ∀ (t : ℝ),
                                |t| ≤ 2 * √δ →
                                  (TightVer401.seamCorrectedHessian Φ (TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch F G δ hδ √δ)
                                        ![s, t]).det <
                                    0

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch_new_germ
declarations.type:
∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},

    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
          ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) {h : ℝ},
            0 < h →
              δ ≤ h →
                ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                  2 * h < p 1 → TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch F G δ hδ h =ᶠ[nhds p] F

declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch_partial_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
          ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) {h B M₀ M₁ : ℝ},
            0 < h →
              0 ≤ B →
                ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                  |deriv (TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep h) (p 1)| ≤ B / h →
                    |TightVer401.smoothingFlatRemainder (F - G) p| ≤ M₀ →
                      (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                          |OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.smoothingFlatRemainder (F - G)) p| ≤
                            M₁) →
                        ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                          |OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch F G δ hδ h) p -
                                OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.smoothingFlatOriginal F G) p| ≤
                            (4 * δ + 3 * δ ^ 2 * (B / h)) * M₀ + 7 * δ ^ 2 * M₁

declarations.type:

      ∀ (L : ℝ),
        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), F (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = F p) →
          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), G (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = G p) →
            ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
              TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch F G δ hδ h (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) =

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingFlatPatch_value_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},

    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial 1 (F - G) ![s, 0] = 0) →
          ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : ℝ) {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {M : ℝ},
            |TightVer401.smoothingFlatRemainder (F - G) p| ≤ M →

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingHessianState
declarations.type: (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → (Fin 5 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingHessianState._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (4 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingHessianState._proof_2
declarations.type: (1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingHessianState._proof_3
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingHessianState.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (q : Fin 5 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
  TightVer401.smoothingHessianState G R q i j =
    TightVer401.planarHessian G ![q 0, q 1] i j + TightVer401.seamSecondJet 0 0 (2 * q 2) i j * R ![q 0, q 1] +
          (if j = 1 then q 4 else 0) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i R ![q 0, q 1] +
        (if i = 1 then q 4 else 0) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j R ![q 0, q 1] +
      q 3 * TightVer401.planarHessian R ![q 0, q 1] i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingHessianState_compact_segment_radius
declarations.type:
∀ {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
      ∀ {K : Set ℝ},
        IsCompact K →
          (∀ s ∈ K, ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, (TightVer401.smoothingHessianState G R ![s, 0, θ, 0, 0]).det < 0) →
            ∃ ε > 0,
              ∀ s ∈ K,
                ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1,
                  ∀ (q : Fin 5 → ℝ), ‖q - ![s, 0, θ, 0, 0]‖ < ε → (TightVer401.smoothingHessianState G R q).det < 0

declarations.type:
∀ {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},

    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
      ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (s t : ℝ),
        TightVer401.smoothingHessianState G R
            ![s, t, TightVer401.smoothingNormalCDF δ hδ t, TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ t,
              deriv (TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ) t] =
          TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel (TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ) G R)
            ![s, t]

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel
declarations.type:
(ℝ → ℝ) →
  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel._proof_1
declarations.type: NeZero (1 + 1)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel f G R p = G p + f (p 1) * R p

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel_compact_core
declarations.type:
∀ {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
      ∀ {K : Set ℝ},
        IsCompact K →
          (∀ s ∈ K, ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc 0 1, (TightVer401.smoothingHessianState G R ![s, 0, θ, 0, 0]).det < 0) →
            ∃ δ₀ > 0,
              ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ),
                δ < δ₀ →
                  ∀ s ∈ K,
                    ∀ (t : ℝ),
                      |t| ≤ δ →
                        (TightVer401.planarHessian
                              (TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel (TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ) G R)
                              ![s, t]).det <
                          0

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel_contDiff
declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel f G R)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel_head_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
      ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
        |p 1| ≤ δ →
          ∀ {M₁ M₂ : ℝ},
            0 ≤ M₁ →
              0 ≤ M₂ →
                (∀ (i : Fin 2), |OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i R p| ≤ M₁) →
                  (∀ (i j : Fin 2), |TightVer401.planarHessian R p i j| ≤ M₂) →
                    ‖TightVer401.planarHessian
                            (TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel (TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ) G R) p -
                          TightVer401.smoothingNormalHead G R (TightVer401.smoothingNormalCDF δ hδ (p 1)) p‖ ≤
                      8 * δ * M₁ + 4 * δ ^ 2 * M₂

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel_hessian
declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i j : Fin 2),
          TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel f G R) p i j =
            TightVer401.planarHessian G p i j + TightVer401.seamSecondJet 0 0 (deriv (deriv f) (p 1)) i j * R p +
                  (if j = 1 then deriv f (p 1) else 0) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i R p +
                (if i = 1 then deriv f (p 1) else 0) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j R p +
              f (p 1) * TightVer401.planarHessian R p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel_partial
declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {G R : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) G →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) R →
        ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (i : Fin 2),
          OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.smoothingNormalModel f G R) p =
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i G p + (if i = 1 then deriv f (p 1) else 0) * R p +
              f (p 1) * OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i R p

declarations.type: ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ), ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile_planar_hessian
declarations.type:

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile_right
declarations.type:
∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) {t : ℝ},

declarations.type: ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (t : ℝ), |deriv (TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ) t - 2 * max t 0| ≤ 4 * δ

declarations.type: ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (t : ℝ), |TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ t - max t 0 ^ 2| ≤ 4 * δ ^ 2

declarations.type: ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) {t : ℝ}, t ≤ -δ → TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ t = 0
