declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_base_derivative_bounds._simp_1_1
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] {a b x : α}, (x ∈ Set.Icc a b) = (a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_base_derivative_bounds._simp_1_3
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b : α}, (¬a ≤ b) = (b < a)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_base_derivatives_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {t : ℝ},
  t < 0 ∨ 3 < t →
    deriv (TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep 1) t = 0 ∧ deriv (deriv (TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep 1)) t = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_bounds
declarations.type: ∀ (h t : ℝ), 0 ≤ TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep h t ∧ TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep h t ≤ 1

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_contDiff
declarations.type: ∀ (h : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep h)

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_deriv_scale
declarations.type: ∀ (h t : ℝ), deriv (TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep h) t = deriv (TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep 1) (t / h) / h

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_one
declarations.type: ∀ {h t : ℝ}, 0 < h → 2 * h ≤ t → TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep h t = 1

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep_scale
declarations.type: ∀ (h t : ℝ), TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep h t = TightVer401.smoothingNormalStep 1 (t / h)

  ∃ B₂ > 0,

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch
declarations.type:
Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord →
  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (T : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (P O : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
  (x : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O x = if x ∈ T then P x else O x

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch_germ_inside
declarations.type:
∀ {T : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen T →
    ∀ (P O : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) {x : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      x ∈ T → TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O =ᶠ[nhds x] P

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch_germ_outside
declarations.type:
∀ {T : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen T →
    ∀ (P O : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) {x : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
      x ∉ T → (x ∈ frontier T → P =ᶠ[nhds x] O) → TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O =ᶠ[nhds x] O

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch_properties
declarations.type:
∀ {V T A : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  IsOpen V →
    IsOpen T →
      IsClosed A →
        A ⊆ T →
          ∀ {P O : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) P T →
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) O (V \ A) →
                (∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier T, P =ᶠ[nhds x] O) →
                  (∀ x ∈ V ∩ T, (TightVer401.planarHessian P x).det < 0) →
                    (∀ x ∈ V \ A, (TightVer401.planarHessian O x).det < 0) →
                      ∀ {η : ℝ},
                        0 < η →
                          (∀ x ∈ V ∩ T,
                              |P x - O x| < η ∧ ‖TightVer401.planarGradient P x - TightVer401.planarGradient O x‖ < η) →
                            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O) V ∧
                              (∀ x ∈ V, (TightVer401.planarHessian (TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O) x).det < 0) ∧
                                (∀ x ∈ V \ T, TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O =ᶠ[nhds x] O) ∧
                                  ∀ x ∈ V,
                                    |TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O x - O x| < η ∧
                                      ‖TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.smoothingOpenPatch T P O) x -
                                            TightVer401.planarGradient O x‖ <
                                        η

declarations.type: (δ : ℝ) → 0 < δ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile.congr_simp
declarations.type:
∀ (δ δ_1 : ℝ) (e_δ : δ = δ_1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h h_1 : ℝ),
  h = h_1 →
    ∀ (t t_1 : ℝ),
      t = t_1 → TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ hδ h t = TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ_1 ⋯ h_1 t_1

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (h t : ℝ),
  TightVer401.smoothingPatchedProfile δ hδ h t =
    TightVer401.smoothingNormalProfile δ hδ t -

            ∀ {V N : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},

                              (hPG :
                                ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), G (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = G p),

                                              p).det <

                                                  (TightVer401.smoothingFlatOriginal F G) ⋯ x) →

declarations.type:

            ∀ {F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ},

                                                    (TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H hPH) x).det <

                                                |p 1| < r →

                                                    TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H

                                                              (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ ![s, t])| <

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothing_tube_boundary_germ
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} [Fact (0 < L)] {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
    ∀ (hL : Function.Periodic γ L) {r ρ w : ℝ},
      0 < ρ →
        ρ < r →
          w < ρ →
            Set.InjOn (TightVer401.seamNormalNative γ hL) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-r) r) →
              (∀ (s t : ℝ),
                  |t| ≤ r →
                    (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ) ![s, t]).det ≠ 0) →
                IsOpen (TightVer401.seamNormalOpenTube γ hL ρ) →
                  ∀ (H F G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
                    (hPH : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), H (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = H p)
                    (hPF : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), F (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = F p)
                    (hPG : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), G (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = G p),
                    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                        |p 1| < r →
                          p 1 ≤ -w →
                            TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H
                                hPH =ᶠ[nhds (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ p)]
                              TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r G hPG) →
                      (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                          |p 1| < r →
                            w ≤ p 1 →
                              TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H
                                  hPH =ᶠ[nhds (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ p)]
                                TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r F hPF) →
                        ∀ {x : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                          x ∈ frontier (TightVer401.seamNormalOpenTube γ hL ρ) →
                            TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H hPH =ᶠ[nhds x]
                              TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r (TightVer401.smoothingFlatOriginal F G) ⋯

declarations.name: TightVer401.smoothing_tube_compact_gradient_error
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ} {γ : ℝ → ℂ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) γ →
    ∀ (hL : Function.Periodic γ L) {r : ℝ},
      Set.InjOn (TightVer401.seamNormalNative γ hL) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-r) r) →
        (∀ (s t : ℝ),
            |t| ≤ r → (TightVer401.seamCoordinateJacobian (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ) ![s, t]).det ≠ 0) →
          ∀ {S : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
            IsCompact S →
              (∀ p ∈ S, |p 1| < r) →
                ∃ M,
                  0 < M ∧
                    ∀ (H O : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ)
                      (hPH : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), H (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = H p)
                      (hPO : ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), O (TightVer401.smoothingSeamShift L p) = O p),
                      ContDiff ℝ 1 H →
                        ContDiff ℝ 1 O →
                          ∀ (η : ℝ),
                            0 ≤ η →
                              (∀ p ∈ S, ‖TightVer401.planarGradient H p - TightVer401.planarGradient O p‖ ≤ η) →
                                ∀ p ∈ S,
                                  ‖TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r H hPH)
                                          (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ p) -
                                        TightVer401.planarGradient (TightVer401.seamNormalTubePotential γ hL r O hPO)
                                          (TightVer401.seamNormalCoordinates γ p)‖ ≤
                                    2 * M * η

declarations.name: TightVer401.sphereGradient.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField) (Q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient)
  (H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
  TightVer401.sphereGradient g Q H p =
    ∑ i,
      (g p)⁻¹.mulVec (fun j => OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j H p) i •
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i Q p

  {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Q U → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U → IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.sphereGradient g Q H) U

declarations.name: TightVer401.sphereGradient_coordinate_change
declarations.type:
∀ {g₁ g₂ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField}
  {Q₁ Q₂ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {H₁ H₂ : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {C : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
  {U₁ U₂ : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g₁ U₁ →
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g₂ U₂ →
      OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsometricOn g₁ Q₁ U₁ →
        OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsometricOn g₂ Q₂ U₂ →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H₂ U₂ →
            IsOpen U₁ →
              IsOpen U₂ →
                ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                  p ∈ U₁ →
                    C p ∈ U₂ →
                      DifferentiableAt ℝ C p →
                        (Q₁ =ᶠ[nhds p] fun q => Q₂ (C q)) →
                          (H₁ =ᶠ[nhds p] fun q => H₂ (C q)) →
                            (∀ q ∈ U₁, inner ℝ (Q₁ q) (Q₁ q) = 1) →
                              (∀ q ∈ U₂, inner ℝ (Q₂ q) (Q₂ q) = 1) →
                                TightVer401.sphereGradient g₁ Q₁ H₁ p = TightVer401.sphereGradient g₂ Q₂ H₂ (C p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.sphereGradient_derivative_normal
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {Q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsometricOn g Q U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
        IsOpen U →
          ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
            p ∈ U →
              (∀ q ∈ U, inner ℝ (Q q) (Q q) = 1) →
                ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                  inner ℝ (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.sphereGradient g Q H) p) (Q p) =
                    -OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i H p

declarations.name: TightVer401.sphereGradient_derivative_tangent
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {Q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}
  {H : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.SmoothPositiveOn g U →
    OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsometricOn g Q U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H U →
        IsOpen U →

                  OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i (TightVer401.sphereGradient g Q H) p +

declarations.name: TightVer401.sphereSupportMap_secondFundamental
declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {Q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}

declarations.type:
∀ {g : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.MetricField} {Q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient}

declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {ψ : ℝ → ℝ},

declarations.name: TightVer401.sphericalCurve_comp_second_deriv
declarations.type:
∀ {ζ : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {ψ : ℝ → ℝ},

    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ψ →
      ∀ (s : ℝ), deriv (deriv (ζ ∘ ψ)) s = deriv (deriv ψ) s • deriv ζ (ψ s) + deriv ψ s ^ 2 • deriv (deriv ζ) (ψ s)

declarations.type:
(OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →
  (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) →

declarations.name: TightVer401.strain.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (X y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord)
  (i j : Fin 2),
  TightVer401.strain X y p i j =
    inner ℝ (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i X p) (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j y p) +
      inner ℝ (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial i y p) (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.coordPartial j X p)

declarations.name: TightVer401.strain_finite_linear
declarations.type:

  {Y : Fin m → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  (∀ (k : Fin m), DifferentiableAt ℝ (Y k) p) →
    ∀ (c : Fin m → ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
      TightVer401.strain X (fun q => ∑ k, c k • Y k q) p i j = ∑ k, c k * TightVer401.strain X (Y k) p i j

declarations.name: TightVer401.strain_finite_linear._simp_1_2
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

declarations.name: TightVer401.strict_band_cutoff_of_upper_support
declarations.type:
∀ {ρ W F : ℝ → ℝ} {upper b : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < ρ s) →
    0 < upper →
      upper < b →
        (∀ (s c : ℝ), c ∈ tsupport F → 1 / (ρ s * upper) - W s ≤ c) →
          ∀ (s c : ℝ), c ∈ tsupport F → 1 / (ρ s * b) - W s < c

declarations.name: TightVer401.supportInverse_bilinear_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {X N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (N q) q) →
        ∀ (w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          ‖w‖ = 1 →
            ∀ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
              e.source ⊆ U →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                  (∀ q ∈ e.source, N q = TightVer401.sphereHemisphere w hw (↑e q)) →
                    ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                      p ∈ e.source →
                        DifferentiableAt ℝ (↑e) p →
                          ∀ (v z : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                            TightVer401.sphereSupportTensorBilinear
                                (OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.inducedMetric (TightVer401.sphereHemisphere w hw))
                                (fun y => inner ℝ (X (↑e.symm y)) (TightVer401.sphereHemisphere w hw y)) (↑e p)
                                ((fderiv ℝ (↑e) p) v) ((fderiv ℝ (↑e) p) z) =
                              inner ℝ ((fderiv ℝ X p) v) ((fderiv ℝ N p) z)

declarations.name: TightVer401.support_above_cutoff_iff_pointwise
declarations.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {ρ W : A → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {b cb : ℝ},
  (∀ (a : A), 1 / (ρ a * b) - W a ≤ cb) →
    (∃ a, 1 / (ρ a * b) - W a = cb) → (tsupport F ⊆ Set.Ioi cb ↔ ∀ (a : A), ∀ c ∈ tsupport F, 1 / (ρ a * b) - W a < c)

declarations.type:

        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
          p ∈ U →
            OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (Q p) p →
              ∀ (i : Fin 2),

declarations.name: TightVer401.support_reconstruction_from_inverse_coordinates
declarations.type:
∀ {X N : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) X U →
    IsOpen U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.IsUnitNormalAt X (N q) q) →
        ∀ (w : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          ‖w‖ = 1 →
            ∀ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
              e.source ⊆ U →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e.symm) e.target →
                  (∀ q ∈ e.source, N q = TightVer401.sphereHemisphere w hw (↑e q)) →
                    ∀ y ∈ e.target,
                      X (↑e.symm y) =
                        TightVer401.sphereSupportMap

declarations.name: TightVer401.supported_ruled_bending_has_profile
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ W : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {lower upper : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt E (-k s • T s + τ s • n s) s) →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt T (k s • E s) s) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt n (-τ s • E s) s) →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
              (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) →
                (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ (↑⊤) α p) →
                  (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → ContDiffAt ℝ (↑⊤) β p) →
                    (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T s) (E s) (n s)) →
                      (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                          0 < p 1 →
                            ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                              TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p i j =
                                0) →
                        0 < lower →
                          0 < upper →
                            (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                p 1 < lower → TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p = 0) →
                              (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                  upper < p 1 → TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p = 0) →
                                (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt W (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ s) s) →
                                  W 0 = 0 →
                                    ∃ F,
                                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F ∧
                                        HasCompactSupport F ∧
                                          (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                              tsupport F ⊆
                                                Set.Icc (1 / (TightVer401.ruledRho τ s * upper) - W s)
                                                  (1 / (TightVer401.ruledRho τ s * lower) - W s)) ∧
                                            ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                              0 < p 1 →
                                                TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p =
                                                  TightVer401.ruledProfileField k τ (TightVer401.ruledRho τ) W F T n p

declarations.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

declarations.name: TightVer401.supported_ruled_bending_period_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {L lower upper : ℝ},
  (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T s) s) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt E (-k s • T s + τ s • n s) s) →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt T (k s • E s) s) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt n (-τ s • E s) s) →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) k →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) τ →
              (∀ (s : ℝ), τ s ≠ 0) →
                Function.Periodic k L →
                  Function.Periodic τ L →
                    (∀ (s u : ℝ), α ![s + L, u] = α ![s, u]) →
                      (∀ (s u : ℝ), β ![s + L, u] = β ![s, u]) →
                        (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ α p) →
                          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), 0 < p 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ β p) →
                            (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T s) (E s) (n s)) →
                              (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                  0 < p 1 →
                                    ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                      TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n) p
                                          i j =
                                        0) →
                                0 < lower →
                                  0 < upper →
                                    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                        p 1 < lower → TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p = 0) →
                                      (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                          upper < p 1 → TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p = 0) →
                                        ∀ {p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                                          0 < p 1 →
                                            TightVer401.ruledBending α β T n p ≠ 0 →
                                              ∫ (r : ℝ) in 0..L, TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient k τ r = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.supported_ruled_transverse_component_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {γ T E n : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {k τ : ℝ → ℝ} {α χ β : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ}
  {b lower : ℝ},
  0 < lower →
    lower < b →
      (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ (T s) s) →
        (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt E (-k s • T s + τ s • n s) s) →
          (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt T (k s • E s) s) →
            (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt n (-τ s • E s) s) →
              (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b → DifferentiableAt ℝ α p) →
                (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b → DifferentiableAt ℝ χ p) →
                  (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord), p 1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b → DifferentiableAt ℝ β p) →
                    (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                        TightVer401.IsOrthonormalFrame (T (p 0)) (E (p 0)) (n (p 0))) →
                      (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                          p 1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b →
                            TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap γ E) (TightVer401.ruledFullBending α χ β T E n) p 1
                                1 =
                              0) →
                        (∀ p ∈ tsupport (TightVer401.ruledFullBending α χ β T E n), lower ≤ p 1) →
                          ∀ (s u : ℝ), u ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b → χ ![s, u] = 0

declarations.name: TightVer401.supported_ruled_vector_has_profile
declarations.type:
∀ {L b lower upper cb : ℝ} (d : TightVer401.PeriodicRuledFrame L)
  {Y : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Ambient} {W : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) Y →
    0 < lower →
      0 < upper →
        upper < b →
          (∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
              0 < p 1 → ∀ (i j : Fin 2), TightVer401.strain (TightVer401.ruledMap d.γ d.E) Y p i j = 0) →
            (∀ p ∈ tsupport Y, lower ≤ p 1 ∧ p 1 ≤ upper) →
              (∀ (s : ℝ), HasDerivAt W (TightVer401.ruledPeriodCoefficient d.k d.τ s) s) →
                W 0 = 0 →
                  (∃ s, 1 / (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ s * b) - W s = cb) →
                    ∃ F,
                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F ∧
                        HasCompactSupport F ∧
                          tsupport F ⊆ Set.Ioi cb ∧
                            ∀ (p : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                              0 < p 1 →
                                Y p = TightVer401.ruledProfileField d.k d.τ (TightVer401.ruledRho d.τ) W F d.T d.n p

declarations.type:
ℝ →
  (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) →
    (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord

declarations.name: TightVer401.terminalPairingRescaledDeriv.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (R : ℝ) (p gamma : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (theta kappa : ℝ → ℝ) (eta s : ℝ),
  TightVer401.terminalPairingRescaledDeriv R p gamma theta kappa eta s =
    eta • deriv p s +
        (TightVer401.visibleConnectorA p (TightVer401.visibleConnectorShiftedRuling R gamma theta eta) s /
            TightVer401.terminalPairingDenom R theta kappa eta s) •
          TightVer401.terminalPairingWDeriv R gamma theta eta s +
      ((TightVer401.terminalPairingADeriv R p gamma theta eta s * TightVer401.terminalPairingDenom R theta kappa eta s -
            TightVer401.visibleConnectorA p (TightVer401.visibleConnectorShiftedRuling R gamma theta eta) s *
              TightVer401.terminalPairingDenomDeriv R theta kappa eta s) /
          TightVer401.terminalPairingDenom R theta kappa eta s ^ 2) •
        TightVer401.visibleConnectorShiftedRuling R gamma theta eta s

declarations.name: TightVer401.terminalPairingWDeriv
declarations.type: ℝ → (ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord

declarations.name: TightVer401.terminalPairingWDeriv.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ (R : ℝ) (gamma : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord) (theta : ℝ → ℝ) (eta s : ℝ),
  TightVer401.terminalPairingWDeriv R gamma theta eta s =
    TightVer401.visibleConnectorJ (deriv gamma s) -
      R • deriv theta s • TightVer401.visibleConnectorJ (TightVer401.visibleConnectorShiftedDirection theta eta s)

declarations.type:
∀ {R : ℝ} {p gamma : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {theta kappa : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) p →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) gamma →
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) theta →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) kappa →
          ∀ (eta s : ℝ),
            TightVer401.terminalPairingDenom R theta kappa eta s ≠ 0 →
              HasDerivAt (fun r => TightVer401.visibleConnectorRescaledTerminalSource R p gamma theta kappa eta r)
                (TightVer401.terminalPairingRescaledDeriv R p gamma theta kappa eta s) s

                                            TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm (p (L * t))) →
                                          closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hi) ⊆
                                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ho →
                                            ∃ e0 E H G U,
                                              e0.source =
                                                  {z |
                                                    1 < TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius z < 2} ∧
                                                e0.target = TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi ∧
                                                  ↑e0 = TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ∧
                                                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e0.symm) e0.target ∧
                                                      (∀
                                                          (z :
                                                            ↑{z |
                                                                1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧
                                                                  TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2}),
                                                          ↑(H z) =
                                                            TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ↑z) ∧
                                                        TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ''
                                                              {z |
                                                                1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧
                                                                  TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2} =
                                                            TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ∧
                                                          {z |
                                                                1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧
                                                                  TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2} ⊆
                                                              E.source ∧
                                                            E.source ⊆ {z | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius z} ∧
                                                              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                                                  (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h)
                                                                  E.source ∧
                                                                (∀ z ∈ E.source,
                                                                    0 <
                                                                      TightVer401.annularJacobian
                                                                        (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p
                                                                          w h)
                                                                        z) ∧
                                                                  ↑E =
                                                                      TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w
                                                                        h ∧
                                                                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑E.symm) E.target ∧
                                                                      TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ⊆
                                                                          E.target ∧
                                                                        Set.EqOn (↑E.symm) (↑e0.symm)
                                                                            (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho
                                                                              Hi) ∧
                                                                          G =
                                                                              TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential
                                                                                L g gamma w h E ∧
                                                                            IsOpen U ∧
                                                                              TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho
                                                                                    Hi ⊆
                                                                                  U ∧
                                                                                U ⊆ E.target ∧
                                                                                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U ∧
                                                                                    (∀ y ∈ U,
                                                                                        (TightVer401.planarHessian G
                                                                                              y).det <
                                                                                          0) ∧
                                                                                      Set.MapsTo
                                                                                          (TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource
                                                                                            p w)
                                                                                          (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain
                                                                                            L p gamma w h E)
                                                                                          U ∧

                                                                                            (G ∘
                                                                                              TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource
                                                                                                p w)
                                                                                            (TightVer401.visibleConnectorHeight
                                                                                              g gamma w)
                                                                                            (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain
                                                                                              L p gamma w h E) ∧

                                                                                                  G ∘

                                                                                                  p w)

                                                  {q | 0 ≤ q 1 ∧ q 1 ≤ h (q 0)} ⊆
                                                      TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain L p
                                                        gamma w h E ∧
                                                    Set.EqOn
                                                        (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential L g gamma w h
                                                            E ∘
                                                          TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource p w)
                                                        (TightVer401.visibleConnectorHeight g gamma w)
                                                        (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain L p
                                                          gamma w h E) ∧
                                                      Set.EqOn
                                                          (TightVer401.planarGradient
                                                              (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential L g gamma
                                                                w h E) ∘
                                                            TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource p w)
                                                          (TightVer401.visibleConnectorGradient p gamma w)
                                                          (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain L p
                                                            gamma w h E) ∧
                                                        (∀
                                                            q ∈
                                                              TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain
                                                                L p gamma w h E,
                                                            (TightVer401.planarHessian
                                                                    (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential L g
                                                                      gamma w h E)
                                                                    (TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource p w q)).mulVec
                                                                (w (q 0)) =
                                                              (TightVer401.visibleConnectorA p w (q 0) *
                                                                    TightVer401.visibleConnectorB gamma w (q 0) /
                                                                  TightVer401.visibleConnectorDelta p gamma w q ^ 2) •
                                                                TightVer401.visibleConnectorJ (w (q 0))) ∧
                                                          (∀
                                                              q ∈
                                                                TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain
                                                                  L p gamma w h E,
                                                              (TightVer401.planarHessian
                                                                    (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential L g
                                                                      gamma w h E)
                                                                    (TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource p w q)).det =
                                                                -TightVer401.visibleConnectorA p w (q 0) ^ 2 *
                                                                    TightVer401.visibleConnectorB gamma w (q 0) ^ 2 /
                                                                  TightVer401.visibleConnectorDelta p gamma w q ^ 4) ∧
                                                            ∀
                                                              q ∈
                                                                TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain
                                                                  L p gamma w h E,
                                                              ∃ N,
                                                                IsOpen N ∧
                                                                  TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource p w q ∈ N ∧
                                                                    N ⊆ E.target ∧
                                                                      ∀ y ∈ N,
                                                                        (TightVer401.planarHessian
                                                                              (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential
                                                                                L g gamma w h E)
                                                                              y).det <
                                                                          0

                                      Omega ∧

                                          (↑(TightVer401.visibleConnectorDisplacedNativeChart L s).symm z))) ∧

                              IsOpen (TightVer401.visibleConnectorDisplacedNativeSolutionDomain e p) ∧
                                ContinuousOn (TightVer401.visibleConnectorDisplacedNativeSolution e p)

                                                              ((TightVer401.periodProjection L) (Q z 0), Q z 1)) ∧
                                                          (∀ z ∈ D,

                                                                  (Q z) =

declarations.type:

  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) gamma →
    ∀ (hp : Function.Periodic gamma L),
      (∀ (s : ℝ), deriv gamma s ≠ 0) →
        Function.Injective hp.lift →
          ∀ {B Gin raw : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {Vraw GinU K T C : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord}
            (E : OpenPartialHomeomorph OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
            Vraw ⊆ E.target →
              IsOpen Vraw →
                IsOpen GinU →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) B Vraw →
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Gin GinU →
                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) raw Vraw →
                        (∀ x ∈ GinU, (TightVer401.planarHessian Gin x).det < 0) →
                          (∀ x ∈ Vraw, (TightVer401.planarHessian raw x).det < 0) →
                            (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s) ∈ Vraw) →
                              (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s) ∈ GinU) →
                                (∀ (s : ℝ), B (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s)) = 0) →
                                  (∀ x ∈ TightVer401.visibleConnectorFinalSmoothingCarrier Vraw GinU B,
                                      B x = 0 → x ∈ Set.range fun s => TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s)) →
                                    (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                        (fderiv ℝ B (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s)))
                                            (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (Complex.I * deriv gamma s)) <
                                          0) →
                                      (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                          Gin (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s)) =
                                            raw (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s))) →
                                        (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                            TightVer401.planarGradient Gin (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s)) =
                                              TightVer401.planarGradient raw (TightVer401.seamComplexCoord (gamma s))) →
                                          IsCompact K →
                                            IsCompact T →
                                              K ⊆ TightVer401.visibleConnectorFinalSmoothingCarrier Vraw GinU B →
                                                T ⊆ TightVer401.visibleConnectorFinalSmoothingCarrier Vraw GinU B →
                                                  (∀ x ∈ K, B x < 0) →
                                                    (∀ x ∈ T, 0 < B x) →
                                                      C ⊆
                                                          TightVer401.visibleConnectorFinalSmoothingCarrier Vraw GinU
                                                            B →
                                                        ∀ {epsilon : ℝ},
                                                          0 < epsilon →
                                                            have V :=
                                                              TightVer401.visibleConnectorFinalSmoothingCarrier Vraw
                                                                GinU B;
                                                            ∃ N H,
                                                              IsOpen V ∧
                                                                V ⊆ E.target ∧
                                                                  IsOpen N ∧
                                                                    TightVer401.seamNormalSeam gamma hp ⊆ N ∧
                                                                      closure N ⊆ V \ (K ∪ T) ∧
                                                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) H V ∧
                                                                          (∀ x ∈ V,
                                                                              (TightVer401.planarHessian H x).det < 0) ∧
                                                                            (∀ x ∈ C,
                                                                                (TightVer401.planarHessian H x).det <
                                                                                  0) ∧
                                                                              (have Oin :=
                                                                                  TightVer401.visibleConnectorFinalSmoothingIncomingOpen
                                                                                    V GinU N B;
                                                                                IsOpen Oin ∧
                                                                                  K ⊆ Oin ∧
                                                                                    Oin ⊆ V ∩ GinU ∧
                                                                                      Set.EqOn H Gin Oin) ∧
                                                                                (have Ot :=
                                                                                    TightVer401.visibleConnectorFinalSmoothingTerminalOpen
                                                                                      V Vraw N B;
                                                                                  IsOpen Ot ∧
                                                                                    T ⊆ Ot ∧
                                                                                      Ot ⊆ V ∩ Vraw ∧
                                                                                        Set.EqOn H raw Ot) ∧
                                                                                  (∀ x ∈ V \ N,
                                                                                      H =ᶠ[nhds x]
                                                                                        TightVer401.relativeSaddlePiecewise
                                                                                          {y | B y < 0} Gin raw) ∧
                                                                                    ∀ x ∈ V, ⋯ ∧ ⋯

                            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.visibleConnectorGinDisplacedGradient Gin p w0)

                                            L) ∧

                                                    (rho, s))

declarations.name: TightVer401.visibleConnectorGradientInverseApplication_charts
declarations.type:

  OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Ho gammaOuter →
    OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Hi gammaInner →
      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Ti etaOuter →
        OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization To etaInner →
          closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hi) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ho →
            closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ti) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior To →
              ∀ {G : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord → ℝ} {U : Set OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord},
                IsOpen U →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U →
                    TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ⊆ U →
                      (∀ z ∈ TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi, (TightVer401.planarHessian G z).det < 0) →
                        (∀ (t : ℝ),
                            TightVer401.annularComplexConjugate (TightVer401.planarGradient G) (gammaOuter t) =
                              etaOuter t) →
                          (∀ (t : ℝ),
                              TightVer401.annularComplexConjugate (TightVer401.planarGradient G) (gammaInner t) =
                                etaInner t) →
                            ∃ P E H,
                              P =
                                  TightVer401.visibleConnectorGradientInverseApplication_restricted_chart E
                                    (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi) ⋯ ∧
                                P.source = TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi ∧
                                  P.target = TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior To Ti ∧
                                    ↑P = TightVer401.planarGradient G ∧
                                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑P) (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi) ∧
                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑P.symm) (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior To Ti) ∧
                                          (∀ (z : ↑(closure (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi))),
                                              ↑(H z) = TightVer401.planarGradient G ↑z) ∧
                                            TightVer401.planarGradient G ''
                                                  closure (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi) =
                                                closure (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior To Ti) ∧
                                              closure (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi) ⊆ E.source ∧
                                                E.source ⊆ U ∧
                                                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G E.source ∧
                                                    (∀ z ∈ E.source, (TightVer401.planarHessian G z).det < 0) ∧
                                                      ↑E = TightVer401.planarGradient G ∧
                                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑E) E.source ∧
                                                          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑E.symm) E.target ∧
                                                            closure (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior To Ti) ⊆
                                                                E.target ∧
                                                              Set.EqOn (↑E) (↑P)
                                                                  (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi) ∧
                                                                Set.EqOn (↑E.symm) (↑P.symm)
                                                                    (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior To Ti) ∧
                                                                  E.target = TightVer401.planarGradient G '' E.source

declarations.name: TightVer401.visibleConnectorGradientInverseApplication_raw
declarations.type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ {p gamma w : ℝ → OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord} {g h : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) p →
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) gamma →
          ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) w →
            ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) g →
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
                Function.Periodic p L →
                  Function.Periodic gamma L →
                    Function.Periodic w L →
                      Function.Periodic g L →
                        Function.Periodic h L →
                          (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < h s) →
                            (∀ (s : ℝ), deriv g s = gamma s ⬝ᵥ deriv p s) →
                              (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.visibleConnectorA p w s) →
                                (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < TightVer401.visibleConnectorB gamma w s) →
                                  (∀ (q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                      0 ≤ q 1 → q 1 ≤ h (q 0) → 0 < TightVer401.visibleConnectorDelta p gamma w q) →
                                    ∀ {Ho Hi : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ},
                                      (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Ho fun t =>
                                          TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm (p (L * t) + h (L * t) • w (L * t))) →
                                        (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Hi fun t =>
                                            TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm (p (L * t))) →
                                          closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hi) ⊆
                                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ho →
                                            ∀ {To Ti : ℂ ≃ₜ ℂ},
                                              (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization To fun t =>
                                                  TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm (gamma (L * t))) →
                                                (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Ti fun t =>
                                                    TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm
                                                      (TightVer401.visibleConnectorGradient p gamma w
                                                        ![L * t, h (L * t)])) →
                                                  closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ti) ⊆
                                                      OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior To →
                                                    ∃ Es G U,
                                                      ↑Es = TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ∧
                                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑Es.symm) Es.target ∧
                                                          G =
                                                              TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential L g gamma w
                                                                h Es ∧
                                                            IsOpen U ∧
                                                              TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ⊆ U ∧
                                                                U ⊆ Es.target ∧
                                                                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) G U ∧
                                                                    (∀ y ∈ U, (TightVer401.planarHessian G y).det < 0) ∧
                                                                      (∀ (s : ℝ),
                                                                          p s ∈ U ∧
                                                                            G (p s) = g s ∧
                                                                              TightVer401.planarGradient G (p s) =
                                                                                  gamma s ∧
                                                                                p s + h s • w s ∈ U ∧
                                                                                  G (p s + h s • w s) =
                                                                                      g s + h s * gamma s ⬝ᵥ w s ∧
                                                                                    TightVer401.planarGradient G
                                                                                        (p s + h s • w s) =
                                                                                      TightVer401.visibleConnectorGradient
                                                                                        p gamma w ![s, h s]) ∧
                                                                        ∃ P Eg HG,
                                                                          P =
                                                                              TightVer401.visibleConnectorGradientInverseApplication_restricted_chart
                                                                                Eg
                                                                                (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                  Ho Hi)
                                                                                ⋯ ∧
                                                                            P.source =
                                                                                TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                  Ho Hi ∧
                                                                              P.target =
                                                                                  TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                    To Ti ∧
                                                                                ↑P = TightVer401.planarGradient G ∧
                                                                                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑P)
                                                                                      (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                        Ho Hi) ∧
                                                                                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑P.symm)
                                                                                        (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                          To Ti) ∧
                                                                                      (∀
                                                                                          (z :
                                                                                            ↑(closure
                                                                                                (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                                  Ho Hi))),
                                                                                          ⋯ = ⋯) ∧
                                                                                        TightVer401.planarGradient G ''
                                                                                              closure
                                                                                                (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                                  Ho Hi) =
                                                                                            closure
                                                                                              (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                                To Ti) ∧
                                                                                          ⋯ ∧ ⋯

                ContinuousOn (fun z => TightVer401.visibleConnectorA (fun s => p (z.1, s)) (fun s => w (z.1, s)) z.2)
                    Omega →

                            (∀ (s : ℝ), a (0, s) = s) →

                                (∀ (s : ℝ),

              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
                Function.Periodic p L →
                  Function.Periodic gamma L →
                    Function.Periodic w L →
                      Function.Periodic g L →
                        Function.Periodic h L →
                          (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < h s) →
                            (∀ (s : ℝ), deriv g s = gamma s ⬝ᵥ deriv p s) →
                              (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.visibleConnectorDet (deriv p s) (w s) < 0) →
                                (∀ (s : ℝ), TightVer401.visibleConnectorDet (deriv p s + h s • deriv w s) (w s) < 0) →

                                            TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm (p (L * t))) →
                                          Disjoint (Set.range p) (Set.range fun s => p s + h s • w s) →
                                            0 ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ho →
                                              0 ∈ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hi →
                                                ∃ e0 E H B U,
                                                  e0.source =

                                                        1 < TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧
                                                          TightVer401.planarRadius z < 2} ∧
                                                    e0.target = TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi ∧
                                                      ↑e0 = TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ∧
                                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e0.symm) e0.target ∧
                                                          (∀
                                                              (z :
                                                                ↑{z |
                                                                    1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧
                                                                      TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2}),
                                                              ↑(H z) =
                                                                TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h
                                                                  ↑z) ∧
                                                            TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ''
                                                                  {z |
                                                                    1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧
                                                                      TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2} =
                                                                TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ∧
                                                              {z |
                                                                    1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧
                                                                      TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2} ⊆
                                                                  E.source ∧
                                                                E.source ⊆ {z | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius z} ∧
                                                                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤)
                                                                      (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w
                                                                        h)
                                                                      E.source ∧
                                                                    (∀ z ∈ E.source,
                                                                        0 <
                                                                          TightVer401.annularJacobian
                                                                            (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource
                                                                              L p w h)
                                                                            z) ∧
                                                                      ↑E =
                                                                          TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L
                                                                            p w h ∧
                                                                        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑E.symm) E.target ∧
                                                                          TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ⊆
                                                                              E.target ∧
                                                                            Set.EqOn (↑E.symm) (↑e0.symm)
                                                                                (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior
                                                                                  Ho Hi) ∧
                                                                              B =
                                                                                  TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotential
                                                                                    L g gamma w h E ∧
                                                                                IsOpen U ∧
                                                                                  TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure
                                                                                        Ho Hi ⊆
                                                                                      U ∧
                                                                                    U ⊆ E.target ∧
                                                                                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) B U ∧
                                                                                        (∀
                                                                                            (y :
                                                                                              OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                                                                                            ⋯) ∧
                                                                                          Set.MapsTo
                                                                                              (TightVer401.visibleConnectorSource
                                                                                                p w)
                                                                                              (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianPotentialRuledDomain
                                                                                                L p gamma w h E)
                                                                                              U ∧
                                                                                            ⋯

declarations.type:

                (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < h s) →

                    (∀ (q : OAI.SmoothLocal.Geometry.Coord),
                        0 ≤ q 1 → q 1 ≤ h (q 0) → 0 < TightVer401.visibleConnectorDelta p gamma w q) →
                      (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Ho fun t =>
                          TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm (p (L * t) + h (L * t) • w (L * t))) →
                        (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Hi fun t =>
                            TightVer401.seamComplexCoord.symm (p (L * t))) →
                          closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hi) ⊆
                              OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ho →
                            ∃ e0 E H,
                              e0.source = {z | 1 < TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius z < 2} ∧
                                e0.target = TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi ∧
                                  ↑e0 = TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ∧
                                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e0.symm) e0.target ∧
                                      (∀ (z : ↑{z | 1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2}),
                                          ↑(H z) = TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ↑z) ∧
                                        TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ''
                                              {z | 1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2} =
                                            TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ∧
                                          {z | 1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius z ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius z ≤ 2} ⊆
                                              E.source ∧
                                            E.source ⊆ {z | 0 < TightVer401.planarRadius z} ∧
                                              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h)
                                                  E.source ∧
                                                (∀ z ∈ E.source,
                                                    0 <
                                                      TightVer401.annularJacobian
                                                        (TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h) z) ∧
                                                  ↑E = TightVer401.visibleConnectorCartesianSource L p w h ∧

                                                      TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ⊆ E.target ∧

                                                          (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi)

      {p | 1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius p ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ 2} ⊆ O →

          OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Ho etaOuter →
            OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.PositiveJordanParametrization Hi etaInner →
              closure (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Hi) ⊆ OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.jordanInterior Ho →
                (∀ (t : ℝ),
                    TightVer401.annularComplexConjugate F (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam 0 2 t) =
                      etaOuter t) →
                  (∀ (t : ℝ),
                      TightVer401.annularComplexConjugate F (OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitCircleParam 0 1 t) =
                        etaInner t) →
                    ∃ e0 E H,
                      e0.source = {p | 1 < TightVer401.planarRadius p ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius p < 2} ∧
                        e0.target = TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi ∧
                          ↑e0 = F ∧
                            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑e0.symm) e0.target ∧
                              (∀ (p : ↑{p | 1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius p ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ 2}),
                                  ↑(H p) = F ↑p) ∧
                                F '' {p | 1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius p ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ 2} =
                                    TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ∧
                                  {p | 1 ≤ TightVer401.planarRadius p ∧ TightVer401.planarRadius p ≤ 2} ⊆ E.source ∧
                                    E.source ⊆ O ∧
                                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F E.source ∧
                                        (∀ p ∈ E.source, 0 < TightVer401.annularJacobian F p) ∧
                                          ↑E = F ∧
                                            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (↑E.symm) E.target ∧
                                              TightVer401.annularCoordJordanClosure Ho Hi ⊆ E.target ∧
                                                Set.EqOn (↑E.symm) (↑e0.symm)
                                                  (TightVer401.annularCoordJordanInterior Ho Hi)
